title: Challenges in AI based tumor board case summarization and recommendations
zh_title: 肿瘤多学科会诊病例摘要与建议生成的AI挑战
summary: npj Digital Medicine 基于四家机构数据，用专家评估检验多款大模型在肿瘤会诊摘要、方案生成与结局预测上的表现。
key_points: 四家机构数据，约9600条参考文本、1.6万条专家判断
摘要子任务与临床对齐相关性约0.2，建议生成约0.6
reason: 多中心数据集与大规模专家人工评估，属有外部评估的重要档
abstract: Tumor boards, recurring meetings at hospital institutions, assemble cancer specialists (e.g., medical oncology and pathology) to discuss patient care. In this work, we formally define tumor board case summarization, options generation, and meeting outcome prediction as AI tasks. We study datasets from four medical institutions and evaluate state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) from the DeepSeek, GPT, Gemini, and Qwen families using expert human assessment. Medical oncologists created ~9.6k reference texts and 16k human judgments across tasks. Clinicians rated LLM-generated case summaries 3.57–4.59 out of 5.0 across institutions, but recommendation generation remained more challenging, with average scores of 2.0–3.6. Clinical alignment analyses showed modest correlations of ~0.2 for case summarization subtasks and higher correlations of ~0.6 for recommendation generation using LLM-as-Judge metrics. Our proposed TBFact metrics were competitive with LLM-as-Judge approaches in longer prose free-text settings, suggesting a promising direction toward explainable evaluation. This study, to our knowledge the largest expert-grading study of tumor board tasks with both granular and direct assessments, found that criterion-level scores and overall judgments are related nonlinearly. Experts also frequently assigned high ratings to responses that differed substantially from their reference texts, challenging assumptions underlying reference-based automatic evaluation metrics.
zh_abstract: 肿瘤委员会是医院机构内定期召开的会议，汇集癌症专科医生（例如肿瘤内科和病理科）讨论患者诊疗。在本研究中，我们将肿瘤委员会病例摘要、方案选项生成和会议结局预测正式定义为AI任务。我们研究来自四家医疗机构的数据集，并使用专家人工评估来评价DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini和Qwen系列的最先进大语言模型（LLM）。肿瘤内科医生创建了约9.6k参考文本和跨任务的16k人工判断。各机构临床医生对LLM生成的病例摘要评分为5.0分中的3.57–4.59分，但推荐生成仍更具挑战性，平均评分为2.0–3.6分。临床一致性分析显示，使用LLM-as-Judge指标时，病例摘要子任务的相关性约为0.2，推荐生成的相关性较高，约为0.6。我们提出的TBFact指标在较长散文式自由文本设置中与LLM-as-Judge方法具有竞争力，提示了通向可解释评估的有前景方向。据我们所知，本研究是规模最大的针对肿瘤委员会任务的专家评分研究，同时包含细粒度评估和直接评估；研究发现标准级评分与总体判断之间呈非线性关系。专家还经常对与参考文本存在显著差异的回答给予高评分，这挑战了基于参考的自动评估指标所依据的假设。

title: [Articles] Development and external validation of an interpretable machine learning score for early sepsis identification in the emergency department: a multicentre retrospective cohort study
zh_title: 急诊早期脓毒症识别的可解释机器学习评分：多中心外部验证
summary: eClinicalMedicine 多中心回顾性队列研究构建分诊时可计算的可解释整数评分，并在外部医疗系统中验证其判别能力。
key_points: 分诊时即可计算的整数评分用于识别急诊脓毒症风险
判别能力在不同医疗系统间迁移良好，无需本地重新估计
作者指出仍需前瞻性评估其能否缩短治疗时间并改善结局
reason: 多中心外部验证且跨系统迁移，但为回顾性设计、未报告临床结局
abstract: An integer score computed at triage identified ED patients at risk of sepsis with discrimination that transferred across health systems without local re-estimation, supporting its use for risk stratification at triage. Prospective evaluation is needed to establish whether acting on it shortens time to treatment and improves outcomes.
zh_abstract: 在分诊时计算的整数评分可识别有脓毒症风险的急诊科（ED）患者，其判别能力可在不同卫生系统间迁移而无需本地重新估计，支持其在分诊时用于风险分层。需要进行前瞻性评估，以确定基于该评分采取行动是否能缩短治疗时间并改善结局。

title: Rapid comparative evaluation of 2 ambient artificial intelligence applications in a learning health system.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 学习型健康系统中两款环境AI记录应用的快速比较评估
summary: JAMIA 发表学习型健康系统评估，用集群随机交叉设计在100名医生中比较 Abridge 与 Nabla 两款AI记录系统。
key_points: 100名医生、90天集群随机交叉比较两款AI记录系统
模拟问诊中两款系统记录要素准确率均为76%，危害风险低
Abridge 在可用性等指标上表现更优
reason: 前瞻性随机交叉设计与工作流结局，但样本仅100名医生、单系统内部评估
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To evaluate ambient Artificial Intelligence (AI) scribe systems (AAS) across multiple domains using a rapid learning health system (LHS) approach, including provider satisfaction, efficiency, documentation quality, usability, and patient sentiment. This LHS evaluation compared 2 AAS systems (Abridge and Nabla) among 100 providers over 90 days. Evaluation incorporated a cluster randomized crossover comparison, analysis of use and EHR-based workflow outcomes, and standardized simulated encounters to assess documentation quality and safety. Outcomes included provider satisfaction, efficiency, note quality, usability, and patient sentiment. In standardized simulated encounters, both systems achieved 76% note element accuracy with minimal risk for harm. In the randomized crossover comparison, Abridge demonstrated higher usability scores (78.5 vs 73) and was preferred 3:1 over Nabla, which had higher automated speech recognition error rates. Across 16 479 clinical encounters, AAS was used in 35.7% of visits. Total EHR time decreased by approximately 5 minutes per day; same-day chart closure increased by approximately 5% during the initial crossover period, but this effect was attenuated. Provider experience was positive (Net Promoter Score [NPS] 53). Both systems demonstrated comparable documentation accuracy and modest efficiency gains while improving clinician satisfaction. Despite similar performance, clinicians reported differences in usability and preference. Adoption below 40% reflected the trade-off between documentation support and verification burden. Rapid, multidimensional evaluation within a LHS can assess AAS across domains of implementation, efficiency, clinician experience, and documentation quality and safety. Ongoing monitoring of efficiency, documentation quality, and use patterns is essential.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 采用快速学习型健康系统（LHS）方法，在多个领域评估环境式人工智能（AI）记录系统（AAS），包括提供者满意度、效率、文档质量、可用性和患者感受。本LHS评估在100名提供者中比较了2种AAS系统（Abridge和Nabla），为期90天。评估包括整群随机交叉比较、使用情况和基于电子健康记录（EHR）的工作流程结局分析，以及标准化模拟接诊以评估文档质量和安全性。结局包括提供者满意度、效率、病历质量、可用性和患者感受。在标准化模拟接诊中，两种系统均达到76%的病历要素准确性，且危害风险极低。在随机交叉比较中，Abridge表现出更高的可用性评分（78.5 vs 73），并且相较Nabla以3:1被偏好；Nabla的自动语音识别错误率更高。在16 479次临床接诊中，AAS在35.7%的就诊中被使用。每日EHR总时间减少约5分钟；在初始交叉期间，当日病历关闭率增加约5%，但该效应减弱。提供者体验积极（净推荐值[NPS] 53）。两种系统均表现出相当的文档准确性和有限的效率提升，同时改善了临床医生满意度。尽管性能相似，临床医生报告了可用性和偏好方面的差异。采用率低于40%反映了文档支持与核验负担之间的权衡。在LHS内进行快速、多维度评估可评估AAS在实施、效率、临床医生体验以及文档质量与安全等领域的表现。持续监测效率、文档质量和使用模式至关重要。

title: AI-assisted chest CT scan analysis of body composition at ICU admission and 6-month mortality
zh_title: AI分析ICU入院胸部CT体成分与6个月死亡率
summary: 单中心前瞻队列用开源AI分割胸部CT体成分，分析其与ICU患者6个月生存的关联。
key_points: 单中心前瞻队列纳入475例ICU患者
开源AI分割量化胸部CT体成分
体成分风险评分与6个月生存相关，AUC 0.68–0.73
reason: 单中心前瞻队列且有临床结局，但仅内部验证、样本约500，未达外部验证档。
abstract: Abnormal body composition at intensive care unit (ICU) admission is associated with worse survival, but it is rarely measured in practice because manual CT analysis is labor-intensive. We conducted a secondary analysis of a single-center prospective cohort of 509 patients who underwent chest CT within 24 h of ICU admission, of whom 475 were included in the final analysis. Open-source AI segmentation was used to quantify body composition, and the resulting features were related to 6-month survival. Risk scores derived from body composition were significantly associated with 6-month survival ( p < 0.001, log-rank test). In five-fold cross-validation, the AUC for discriminating survivors from non-survivors was 0.73; when feature selection was accounted for, the AUC was 0.68 by nested cross-validation and 0.69 by bootstrap optimism correction. The study shows that the automated AI-based analysis of admission chest CT yields body composition scores significantly associated with 6-month mortality after ICU admission.
zh_abstract: 重症监护病房（ICU）入院时身体成分异常与较差的生存相关，但在实践中很少测量，因为手动 CT 分析劳动强度大。我们对一个单中心前瞻性队列进行了二次分析，该队列包括 509 例在 ICU 入院后 24 小时内接受胸部 CT 的患者，其中 475 例纳入最终分析。使用开源 AI 分割量化身体成分，并将所得特征与 6 个月生存相关联。由身体成分得出的风险评分与 6 个月生存显著相关（p < 0.001，log-rank 检验）。在五折交叉验证中，区分生存者与非生存者的 AUC 为 0.73；当考虑特征选择时，AUC 在嵌套交叉验证中为 0.68，在 bootstrap 乐观校正中为 0.69。该研究表明，基于 AI 的入院胸部 CT 自动分析产生的身体成分评分与 ICU 入院后 6 个月死亡率显著相关。

title: Multimodal AI-enabled repurposing and prioritization of ferroptosis-targeting drug combinations in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
zh_title: 多模态AI筛选胰腺癌铁死亡联合用药
summary: 研究提出FeNetDP多模态AI框架，整合转录组、蛋白组、单细胞、空间与生存数据，优先筛选胰腺导管腺癌铁死亡相关可再利用药物组合，并报告了候选化合物的实验验证。
key_points: 构建FeNetDP框架，融合多组学与临床生存数据
定义与预后不良相关的八基因铁死亡抑制模块
候选药物组合经前瞻性实验验证
reason: 同行评审、方法新颖且有实验验证，但无临床外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) lacks scalable and mechanism-informed computational strategies for prioritizing repurposable drug combinations. Here, we developed FeNetDP, a multimodal AI-guided framework that integrates transcriptomic, proteomic, single-cell, spatial, and clinical survival data to enable biologically grounded drug repurposing and combination prioritization in PDAC. FeNetDP combines gene-level network proximity analysis with a biologically constrained neural ranking model to identify candidate compounds and drug pairs linked to a disease-relevant ferroptosis suppressor program. Using this framework, we defined an eight-gene ferroptosis suppressor module enriched in ductal cells and associated with poor prognosis, and prioritized candidate repurposable compounds and combinations targeting this network state. Prospective experimental validation identified panobinostat plus sorafenib as a synergistic combination that suppresses tumor growth and promotes ferroptosis in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, the combination impaired ferroptosis resistance through coordinated disruption of glutathione-dependent antioxidant defense and AIFM2 (FSP1)-associated glutathione-independent protection. Together, these findings establish FeNetDP as a multimodal and experimentally grounded framework for computational repurposing and mechanism-informed therapeutic prioritization in cancer.
zh_abstract: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）缺乏可扩展且基于机制的计算策略来优先筛选可重新利用的药物组合。在此，我们开发了 FeNetDP，一个多模态 AI 引导框架，整合转录组、蛋白质组、单细胞、空间和临床生存数据，以在 PDAC 中实现有生物学依据的药物重定位和组合优先级排序。FeNetDP 将基因水平网络邻近分析与受生物学约束的神经排序模型相结合，以识别与疾病相关铁死亡抑制程序相关的候选化合物和药物对。利用该框架，我们定义了一个八基因铁死亡抑制模块，该模块在导管细胞中富集并与不良预后相关，并优先筛选了靶向该网络状态的候选可重定位化合物和组合。前瞻性实验验证确定 panobinostat 联合 sorafenib 是一种协同组合，可在体外和体内抑制肿瘤生长并促进铁死亡。在机制上，该组合通过协同破坏谷胱甘肽依赖性抗氧化防御和 AIFM2（FSP1）相关的非谷胱甘肽依赖性保护，削弱了铁死亡抵抗。总之，这些发现确立了 FeNetDP 作为一个多模态且经实验支持的框架，用于癌症中的计算药物重定位和基于机制的治疗优先级排序。

title: Generative fundus angiography from misaligned handheld images for non-invasive screening of infantile retinal diseases
zh_title: 扩散模型从手持眼底彩照生成荧光血管造影
summary: npj Digital Medicine 刊发 InfantAngio，用扩散模型把对位不佳的婴儿手持眼底彩照合成为荧光血管造影图像，以无创方式近似血管成像。
key_points: 面向婴儿视网膜疾病的无创血管成像筛查
处理手持相机的角度与视野错配导致的弱空间对应
扩散框架将彩照到造影合成建模为隐空间传输
reason: 同行评审新方法研究，摘要未显示外部验证或临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Infantile retinal diseases are a leading cause of childhood blindness, and vascular findings that guide screening and management are often poorly visible in color fundus photography (CFP). Fundus fluorescein angiography (FFA) provides angiographic visualization of retinal vascular abnormalities, but its invasive nature and reliance on fluorescein dye limit routine use in vulnerable infants. Generative synthesis may provide non-invasive angiographic approximations. However, infant imaging often relies on manually operated handheld contact fundus cameras, with variations in probe angle, contact pressure, and field of view between separate CFP and FFA acquisitions contributing to weak spatial correspondence between modalities. In this paper, we present InfantAngio, a diffusion-based framework that reformulates CFP-to-FFA synthesis as a deterministic latent transport trajectory. Developed and evaluated using 83,950 registration-derived image-pair records from 259 infants, InfantAngio showed favorable performance across quantitative image-quality benchmarks, while ophthalmologists distinguished real from synthesized FFA images with near-chance accuracy of 49.8% in blinded assessment. Adding synthesized FFA to CFP improved both downstream classifier performance and overall diagnostic accuracy in a retrospective ophthalmologist reader study. These results support synthesized FFA as a potentially useful non-invasive adjunct for screening high-risk infants, with the possibility of reducing reliance on dye-based procedures in real-world clinical scenarios.
zh_abstract: 婴儿视网膜疾病是儿童失明的主要原因之一，而指导筛查和管理的血管征象在彩色眼底摄影（CFP）中往往显示不佳。眼底荧光素血管造影（FFA）可对视网膜血管异常提供血管造影可视化，但其侵入性及对荧光素染料的依赖限制了其在脆弱婴儿中的常规使用。生成式合成可能提供无创的血管造影近似。然而，婴儿成像通常依赖手动操作的手持接触式眼底相机，单独的 CFP 与 FFA 采集之间在探头角度、接触压力和视野上的差异导致两种模态之间的空间对应关系较弱。本文提出 InfantAngio，一种基于扩散的框架，将 CFP 到 FFA 的合成重新表述为确定性潜在传输轨迹。InfantAngio 使用来自 259 名婴儿的 83,950 条配准衍生图像对记录进行开发和评估，在多项定量图像质量基准上表现出良好性能；在盲法评估中，眼科医生区分真实与合成 FFA 图像的准确率为 49.8%，接近随机水平。在一项回顾性眼科医生阅片研究中，将合成 FFA 添加到 CFP 后，既改善了下游分类器性能，也提高了总体诊断准确性。这些结果支持将合成 FFA 作为一种可能有用的无创辅助手段用于高危婴儿筛查，并有可能在真实临床场景中减少对基于染料操作的依赖。

title: Performance of a self-supervised pretrained neural network for orthopedic radiograph classification.
zh_title: 自监督预训练网络用于骨科X线分类
summary: 在4.4万张肌骨X线上继续自监督预训练ResNet-50，并在独立外部跟骨队列验证骨折分类与归因可靠性。
key_points: 对比ImageNet监督、DINO与DINO-Ortho三种初始化
含5365张外部跟骨X线（1775例）分布外验证
用ROAD评分量化Grad-CAM归因忠实度
reason: 同行评审，含独立外部队列分布外验证，达重要档
abstract: [Skeletal radiology] To evaluate whether domain-adaptive self-supervised pretraining of a convolutional neural network on musculoskeletal radiographs improves binary fracture classification and attribution faithfulness relative to ImageNet-pretrained baselines. This retrospective study (conducted June 2025 to May 2026) compared three initializations of a ResNet-50 convolutional neural network: supervised ImageNet (control), self-supervised ImageNet (DINO), and DINO further pretrained on 44,029 musculoskeletal radiographs (DINO-Ortho). Each was fine-tuned in three experiments: in-distribution (MURA and FracAtlas), out-of-distribution (5365 external calcaneal radiographs from 1775 patients acquired during 2015-2022), and initial weights (calcaneal fine-tuning). Attribution faithfulness was quantified using Remove and Debias (ROAD) scores from Grad-CAM saliency maps, with higher scores indicating greater faithfulness. AUROCs were compared using DeLong tests, and ROAD scores using Friedman tests with Bonferroni-adjusted post hoc pairwise comparisons. DINO-Ortho AUROC did not differ significantly from either baseline in any experiment (0.82 [95% confidence interval, 0.79-0.84] in-distribution and 0.95 [0.93-0.96] with initial weights). DINO-Ortho ROAD scores were significantly higher than both baselines in-distribution (20.01 vs 3.70 and 9.35, respectively) and with initial weights (20.41 vs 12.15 and 1.67, respectively, P < 0.001 for all) and higher than control but not DINO out-of-distribution (15.47 vs 3.06 and 16.09, respectively). All models discriminated poorly out-of-distribution (AUROC 0.65 [0.63-0.67], 0.64 [0.63-0.66], and 0.64 [0.63-0.66] for control, DINO, and DINO-Ortho, respectively). With no significant difference in AUROC from either baseline, domain-adapted self-supervised pretraining yielded more faithful attributions than supervised ImageNet pretraining in every experiment and than self-supervised ImageNet pretraining in two of three. No model generalized adequately to unfamiliar anatomy without fine-tuning. Groups fine-tuning on their own musculoskeletal data should therefore consider domain-adapted weights, whose saliency maps more reliably show what drove each prediction, making reliance on irrelevant features easier to detect.
zh_abstract: [Skeletal radiology] 评估在肌肉骨骼X线片上对卷积神经网络进行域自适应自监督预训练，相较于ImageNet预训练基线，是否能改善二分类骨折分类和归因忠实度。这项回顾性研究（于2025年6月至2026年5月进行）比较了ResNet-50卷积神经网络的三种初始化：监督式ImageNet（对照）、自监督式ImageNet（DINO），以及在44,029张肌肉骨骼X线片上进一步预训练的DINO（DINO-Ortho）。每种初始化均在三个实验中进行微调：分布内（MURA和FracAtlas）、分布外（2015-2022年期间采集的来自1775例患者的5365张外部跟骨X线片）以及初始权重（跟骨微调）。归因忠实度使用Grad-CAM显著性图的Remove and Debias（ROAD）评分进行量化，评分越高表示忠实度越高。AUROC使用DeLong检验比较，ROAD评分使用Friedman检验并进行Bonferroni校正的事后两两比较。在任何实验中，DINO-Ortho的AUROC与任一基线均无显著差异（分布内为0.82 [95%置信区间，0.79-0.84]，使用初始权重时为0.95 [0.93-0.96]）。在分布内，DINO-Ortho的ROAD评分显著高于两个基线（分别为20.01 vs 3.70和9.35），在使用初始权重时也显著更高（分别为20.41 vs 12.15和1.67，所有P < 0.001）；在分布外，其ROAD评分高于对照但未高于DINO（分别为15.47 vs 3.06和16.09）。所有模型在分布外的区分能力均较差（对照、DINO和DINO-Ortho的AUROC分别为0.65 [0.63-0.67]、0.64 [0.63-0.66]和0.64 [0.63-0.66]）。由于AUROC与任一基线相比均无显著差异，域自适应自监督预训练在每个实验中均产生了比监督式ImageNet预训练更忠实的归因，并在三分之二的实验中产生了比自监督式ImageNet预训练更忠实的归因。若未进行微调，没有任何模型能充分泛化到不熟悉的解剖部位。因此，在自有肌肉骨骼数据上进行微调的团队应考虑使用域自适应权重，其显著性图能更可靠地显示驱动每个预测的因素，从而更容易发现对无关特征的依赖。

title: VoxelSlicer: Adaptive Voxel-wise Slicer for Deformable Image Registration.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: VoxelSlicer：可变形配准的自适应体素切片器
summary: 提出VoxelSlicer模块，用体素级自适应滤波改进可变形图像配准中的局部不连续与消息传递。
key_points: 现有配准方法难处理大幅形变和复杂运动
受双边网格启发加入可学习自适应滤波
实现体素级自适应滤波并提升消息传递效率
reason: 同行评审的新配准方法，但无外部验证或临床结局，属值得一看。
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Recent progress in neural networks has accelerated deformable image registration (DIR) by amortizing iterative optimization, offering faster results and potential accuracy gains with label supervision. However, existing methods struggle with highly deformed structures (e.g., inter-subject abdominal or intra-subject cardiac scans) and fail to handle complex motions like sliding or respiratory dynamics. This limitation arises from isotropic diffusive pair-wise regularization, which leads to inefficient message passing and oversmoothed boundaries. We propose VoxelSlicer, a novel neural network module inspired by the traditional bilateral grid but enhanced with learnable adaptive filtering. VoxelSlicer enables voxel-wise adaptive filtering, addressing local discontinuities in displacement fields and performs more efficient message passing. This design enables adaptive displacement-cost propagation with a compact parameter footprint and a favorable accuracy-complexity trade-off. Experiments on four realistic datasets and two synthetic datasets with different modalities and input constraints demonstrate VoxelSlicer's competitive registration performance together with favorable accuracy-complexity and accuracy-smoothness trade-offs.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 神经网络的最新进展通过摊销迭代优化加速了可变形图像配准（DIR），提供了更快的结果，并有望在标签监督下获得精度提升。然而，现有方法难以处理高度变形的结构（例如受试者间腹部扫描或受试者内心脏扫描），并且无法处理复杂运动，如滑动或呼吸动力学。这一局限源于各向同性扩散的成对正则化，其导致消息传递效率低下和边界过度平滑。我们提出 VoxelSlicer，一种受传统双边网格启发但用可学习自适应滤波增强的新型神经网络模块。VoxelSlicer 实现了体素级自适应滤波，解决了位移场中的局部不连续性，并执行更高效的消息传递。该设计以紧凑的参数占用和有利的精度-复杂度权衡，实现了自适应位移-代价传播。在四个真实数据集和两个具有不同模态和输入约束的合成数据集上的实验表明，VoxelSlicer 具有有竞争力的配准性能，以及有利的精度-复杂度和精度-平滑度权衡。

title: EffNetV2M-ViT: A Hybrid Deep Learning Model for MRI-Based Differentiation of Glioblastoma and Brain Metastasis.
zh_title: CNN-ViT混合模型鉴别胶质母细胞瘤与脑转移
summary: 研究构建EfficientNet与ViT并行融合模型，基于MRI区分胶质母细胞瘤与脑转移。
key_points: 融合卷积局部特征与Transformer全局特征
自动分割增强肿瘤区域作为输入
采用独立验证的多中心数据评估
reason: 同行评审并有独立多中心验证，但属回顾性二分类任务，重要档下沿
abstract: [NMR in biomedicine] Noninvasive differentiation between glioblastoma (GBM) and brain metastasis (BM) remains challenging because of substantial overlap in their MRI appearance. Existing deep learning (DL) approaches have primarily relied on either convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which capture local spatial features, or transformer-based models, which capture long-range contextual relationships. However, the complementary value of combining these representations for GBM-BM discrimination has not been sufficiently investigated, using independently validated multicenter data. This study aimed to develop and evaluate a hybrid CNN-Vision Transformer (ViT) framework for automated differentiation of GBM from BM. The framework integrates EfficientNet-based convolutional feature extraction with ViT-based global feature modeling through parallel fusion. Enhancing tumor was automatically segmented using 3D U-Net, with segmentations visually reviewed and manually corrected when necessary. T2-weighted (T2W) and contrast enhanced T1-weighted (CE-T1W) MRI sequences were used as inputs. A modality ablation study was performed to identify the optimal contrast combination among T1W, CE-T1W, T2W, and FLAIR. The framework was evaluated in a retrospective cohort of 344 patients with histologically confirmed tumors using cross-validation and ensemble methods, with performance further assessed in an independent multicenter external validation cohort from different institutions, MRI scanner platforms, and patient populations. The hybrid EffNetV2M-ViT framework achieved an accuracy of 95.4%, F1-score of 96.2%, and AUC of 98.4% on the internal test set, and 90.9%, 92.7%, and 96.8% on external validation, with sensitivity, specificity of 96.2%, 93.9% and 90.5%, 91.7%, respectively. The hybrid model outperformed the standalone CNN and ViT models across both datasets, with the largest performance gains observed in the external validation cohort, support its generalizability. Ablation analysis confirmed that the paired CE-T1W + T2W input yielded the most consistent performance across both cohorts, with additional contrasts providing no added benefit. These findings suggest that combining local convolutional features with global contextual representations improves automated GBM-BM discrimination, offering a noninvasive, standardized approach for MRI-based tumor classification that may support clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: [NMR in biomedicine] 由于胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）与脑转移瘤（BM）在MRI表现上存在显著重叠，非侵入性区分二者仍具挑战性。现有深度学习方法主要依赖卷积神经网络（CNN），其捕捉局部空间特征，或基于Transformer的模型，其捕捉长程上下文关系。然而，利用独立验证的多中心数据，将这两类表征结合用于GBM-BM鉴别所具有的互补价值尚未得到充分研究。本研究旨在开发并评估一种混合CNN-视觉Transformer（ViT）框架，用于自动区分GBM与BM。该框架通过并行融合，将基于EfficientNet的卷积特征提取与基于ViT的全局特征建模相结合。增强肿瘤使用3D U-Net自动分割，分割结果经视觉审查并在必要时手动校正。T2加权（T2W）和对比增强T1加权（CE-T1W）MRI序列用作输入。进行了模态消融研究，以确定T1W、CE-T1W、T2W和FLAIR中的最佳对比组合。该框架在344例经组织学确诊肿瘤患者的回顾性队列中，使用交叉验证和集成方法进行评估，并在来自不同机构、MRI扫描仪平台和患者人群的独立多中心外部验证队列中进一步评估性能。混合EffNetV2M-ViT框架在内部测试集上达到准确率95.4%、F1分数96.2%和AUC 98.4%，在外部验证中达到90.9%、92.7%和96.8%，敏感度和特异度分别为96.2%、93.9%和90.5%、91.7%。该混合模型在两个数据集上均优于独立CNN和ViT模型，最大性能提升出现在外部验证队列，支持其泛化性。消融分析证实，配对的CE-T1W + T2W输入在两个队列中产生最一致的性能，额外对比序列未带来额外获益。这些发现提示，将局部卷积特征与全局上下文表征相结合可改善自动GBM-BM鉴别，为基于MRI的肿瘤分类提供一种非侵入性、标准化方法，可能支持临床决策。

title: An Integrated Systems Biology and Explainable Artificial Intelligence Framework for Robust Placental Biomarker Discovery in Preeclampsia.
source: PubMed · FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology
zh_title: 可解释AI框架用于子痫前期胎盘标志物发现
summary: 基于GEO胎盘转录组数据，整合系统生物学与可解释AI，构建并外部验证子痫前期生物标志物发现与诊断框架。
key_points: 使用GEO胎盘转录组数据集
整合差异表达、WGCNA与四种特征选择
框架用于PE诊断并探索严重程度分层
reason: 同行评审且有外部验证，但样本量未明、回顾性公共数据，属值得一看档
abstract: [FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology] Preeclampsia (PE) is a heterogeneous pregnancy disorder characterized by placental dysfunction and immune dysregulation. Translation of transcriptomic biomarkers has been limited by inconsistent feature selection, inadequate external validation, and poor model interpretability. We developed an explainable, externally validated, transcriptomics-driven artificial intelligence framework for biomarker discovery, PE diagnosis, and exploratory severity stratification. Placental transcriptomic datasets were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus. Differential expression analysis and weighted gene co-expression network analysis were integrated with consensus feature selection using Elastic Net, LASSO, SVM-RFE, and Boruta. Selected biomarkers were evaluated using conventional machine learning, deep learning, ensemble, and hybrid models with repeated stratified cross-validation and independent cross-platform external validation. Model performance and interpretability were assessed using ROC and precision-recall analyses, DeLong's test, permutation testing, SHAP, and permutation importance. Integrative analyses identified 166 candidate genes and prioritized a six-gene signature comprising CGB5, LEP, LIMCH1, LRRC1, PAPPA2, and SIGLEC6. Logistic Regression achieved the highest external performance (ROC-AUC: 0.8516, 95% CI: 0.7913-0.9119; PR-AUC: 0.8572). DeLong's test showed no significant differences from the best-performing deep or hybrid models. Explainability analyses consistently identified LEP, LRRC1, PAPPA2, and SIGLEC6 as major predictive contributors. Exploratory early versus late-onset PE stratification achieved an ROC-AUC of 0.7617. The proposed framework identified a reproducible six-gene placental signature with robust cross-platform predictive performance and biological interpretability. Integrating consensus biomarker selection, external validation, and explainable artificial intelligence may facilitate the reproducible development of transcriptomic biomarkers for precision medicine in PE.
zh_abstract: [FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology] 子痫前期（PE）是一种以胎盘功能障碍和免疫失调为特征的异质性妊娠疾病。转录组生物标志物的转化一直受限于特征选择不一致、外部验证不足和模型可解释性差。我们开发了一个可解释、经外部验证、由转录组学驱动的人工智能框架，用于生物标志物发现、PE诊断和探索性严重程度分层。胎盘转录组数据集来自Gene Expression Omnibus。差异表达分析和加权基因共表达网络分析与使用Elastic Net、LASSO、SVM-RFE和Boruta的共识特征选择相结合。所选生物标志物使用传统机器学习、深度学习、集成和混合模型进行评估，采用重复分层交叉验证和独立跨平台外部验证。模型性能和可解释性使用ROC和精确率-召回率分析、DeLong检验、置换检验、SHAP和置换重要性进行评估。整合分析识别出166个候选基因，并优先确定一个由CGB5、LEP、LIMCH1、LRRC1、PAPPA2和SIGLEC6组成的六基因特征。逻辑回归取得最高的外部性能（ROC-AUC：0.8516，95% CI：0.7913-0.9119；PR-AUC：0.8572）。DeLong检验显示与表现最佳的深度或混合模型无显著差异。可解释性分析一致识别出LEP、LRRC1、PAPPA2和SIGLEC6为主要预测贡献者。探索性早发型与晚发型PE分层达到ROC-AUC 0.7617。所提出的框架识别出一个可重复的六基因胎盘特征，具有稳健的跨平台预测性能和生物学可解释性。整合共识生物标志物选择、外部验证和可解释人工智能，可能促进用于PE精准医学的转录组生物标志物的可重复开发。

title: Large Language Models for Electronic Health Records in Emergency Department (ED) and ED-Adjacent Emergency Care-Technical Strategies, Clinical Tasks, and Workflow Integration: Systematic Review.
source: PubMed · Journal of medical Internet research

summary: 系统综述总结大模型在急诊及邻近急诊电子病历中的临床任务、技术策略与工作流整合证据。

聚焦急诊EHR异构、时效与安全挑战
涵盖数据集、模型家族与评估实践
reason: 同行评审系统综述、方法规范，但结果细节有限，综述上限档。
abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in clinical text processing, but their role in emergency departments (EDs) and ED-adjacent emergency care remains unclear because ED electronic health records (EHRs) are heterogeneous, time-critical, and safety-sensitive. This study aims to synthesize peer-reviewed evidence on LLM applications to real-world ED EHR data and ED-adjacent emergency care data, focusing on clinical tasks, technical strategies, evaluation practices, and workflow integration. We conducted a PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses)-guided systematic review of PubMed and Web of Science (January 1, 2022, to November 14, 2025). We included peer-reviewed English-language studies applying LLM strategies to ED and ED-adjacent EHR data. We extracted dataset characteristics, model families, task formulations (classification, summarization, and information extraction), adaptation strategies (prompting, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic/hybrid workflows), evaluation metrics, and ED workflow phase. Two reviewers also independently completed a design-matched methodological quality and risk-of-bias appraisal. Thirty-one studies met our inclusion criteria. Many relied on single-center datasets (n=12), relatively small sample sizes (<10,000 encounters; n=20), and English-language unstructured text alone or mixed EHR inputs combining text with structured or semistructured fields. Prompt engineering was the dominant adaptation strategy (n=27), while fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, and hybrid/agentic pipelines were less common. Postencounter studies frequently demonstrated task-specific retrospective technical feasibility, while triage, diagnostic-support, and disposition studies evaluated heterogeneous tasks and outcomes; these nonequivalent measures were not compared as indicators of workflow maturity. Workflow-phase assignment did not imply real-time integration, particularly when model inputs were available only after the relevant clinical decision point. Overall, 22 (71%) studies were classified as technical-performance-only evaluations; clinical utility was empirically assessed in only 3 (9.7%) studies, and prospective deployment in 4 (12.9%). No study directly measured patient outcomes or downstream patient-safety outcomes attributable to LLM use. Current LLM applications across ED and ED-adjacent emergency care primarily function as documentation, surveillance, and aud
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地应用于临床文本处理，但其在急诊科（ED）及 ED 相关急诊医疗中的作用仍不明确，因为 ED 电子健康记录（EHR）具有异质性、时间关键性和安全敏感性。本研究旨在综合关于 LLM 应用于真实世界 ED EHR 数据和 ED 相关急诊医疗数据的同行评审证据，重点关注临床任务、技术策略、评价实践和工作流程整合。我们按照 PRISMA（系统评价和荟萃分析优先报告条目）指南，对 PubMed 和 Web of Science（2022 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 11 月 14 日）进行了系统评价。我们纳入将 LLM 策略应用于 ED 和 ED 相关 EHR 数据的同行评审英文研究。我们提取了数据集特征、模型家族、任务形式（分类、摘要和信息抽取）、适配策略（提示、微调、检索增强生成以及智能体/混合工作流程）、评价指标和 ED 工作流程阶段。两名评审员还独立完成了与设计匹配的方法学质量和偏倚风险评价。31 项研究符合我们的纳入标准。许多研究依赖单中心数据集（n=12）、相对较小的样本量（<10,000 次就诊；n=20），以及仅使用英语非结构化文本或混合 EHR 输入（将文本与结构化或半结构化字段结合）。提示工程是主要适配策略（n=27），而微调、检索增强生成以及混合/智能体流程较少见。就诊后研究经常展示任务特定的回顾性技术可行性，而分诊、诊断支持和处置研究评价了异质性任务和结局；这些不等价的测量未作为工作流程成熟度的指标进行比较。工作流程阶段的划分并不意味着实时整合，尤其是当模型输入仅在相关临床决策点之后才可获得时。总体而言，22 项（71%）研究被归类为仅技术性能评价；临床效用仅在 3 项（9.7%）研究中进行了实证评估，前瞻性部署仅在 4 项（12.9%）研究中开展。没有研究直接测量归因于 LLM 使用的患者结局或下游患者安全结局。当前在 ED 及 ED 相关急诊医疗中的 LLM 应用主要作为文档记录、监测和 aud

title: Artificial intelligence in epilepsy care: a systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical applications in diagnosis, classification, outcome prediction, and surgical decision-making.

summary: 该系统综述与荟萃分析按PRISMA 2020评估AI在癫痫诊断、分类、预后预测与手术决策中的应用。
key_points: 覆盖诊断、病因分类、预后与手术决策
遵循PRISMA 2020，方案注册于PROSPERO
来源摘要未给出纳入研究数与合并效应量
reason: 同行评审系统综述，但摘要未示纳入研究规模与结论强度，未达7分档
abstract: [Neurosurgical review] Epilepsy affects approximately 50 million people worldwide, with disproportionate burden in low- and middle-income countries where access to specialized care remains limited. Despite advances in neuroimaging and electrophysiology, accurate diagnosis, etiological classification, and timely identification of surgical candidates remain major clinical challenges. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising tool to integrate multimodal data and support clinical decision-making across the epilepsy care continuum. To systematically assess and meta-analytically quantify the evidence on AI applications for diagnosis, etiological classification, outcome prediction, surgical candidate selection, and workflow optimization in epilepsy. A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, with protocol registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251117939). Searches were performed in PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, ScienceDirect, Cochrane Library, and SciELO for studies published between January 2014 and March 2026. Eligible studies included original research in human subjects with epilepsy applying AI or machine learning models and reporting at least one quantitative performance metric with internal or external validation. Study quality was assessed using PROBAST. Pooled estimates of Area Under the Curve (AUC), sensitivity, and specificity were derived using DerSimonian-Laird random-effects models across four clinical task groups: diagnosis, classification, outcome prediction, and surgical referral. From 423 identified records, 102 studies met inclusion criteria. Research output increased markedly after 2018, peaking in 2021 and 2024, with geographic concentration in China (n = 31) and the United States (n = 11). title: A prime-editing-based strategy for pooled protein tagging and subcellular localization mapping.

abstract: [Nature cell biology] The subcellular organization of proteins carries important information on cell state and gene function, yet there are limited technologies that enable routine measurements of protein localization at scale. Here we develop pooled endogenous protein tagging using prime editing to image subcellular localizations for many proteins in parallel within a heterogeneous cell pool. We constructed three prime editing libraries comprising 17,280 prime editing guide RNAs (pegRNAs) to exhaustively tag 60 endogenous proteins spanning diverse localization patterns and explore a broad space of genomic and pegRNA design parameters. We integrate pegRNA features into a predictive computational model for tagging efficiency to constrain the search space of effective pegRNAs for large-scale peptide knock-in. Last, we show that combining in situ pegRNA sequencing with deep learning image analysis enables scalable exploration of subcellular organization, setting the stage for systematic studies of proteome dynamics across cell types and perturbations.
zh_abstract: 《Nature cell biology》蛋白质的亚细胞组织携带关于细胞状态和基因功能的重要信息，但能够常规、规模化测量蛋白质定位的技术仍然有限。在此，我们开发了使用先导编辑（prime editing）的混合内源性蛋白标记方法，用于在异质性细胞池中并行成像许多蛋白质的亚细胞定位。我们构建了三个先导编辑文库，包含17,280条先导编辑指导RNA（pegRNAs），以详尽标记60种具有多样定位模式的内源性蛋白质，并探索广泛的基因组和pegRNA设计参数空间。我们将pegRNA特征整合到用于标记效率的预测计算模型中，以约束用于大规模肽段敲入的有效pegRNA搜索空间。最后，我们展示将原位pegRNA测序与深度学习图像分析相结合，能够可扩展地探索亚细胞组织，为跨细胞类型和扰动系统研究蛋白质组动力学奠定基础。

title: Tempering and few-shot calibration of pathology foundation models improve digital biomarker reproducibility across slide scanners
zh_title: 病理基础模型校准提升跨扫描仪可复现性
summary: 对病理基础模型做tempering与少样本校准，显著降低头颈癌HPV、结直肠MSI等任务跨扫描仪预测差异。
key_points: HPV跨扫描仪差异降67.5%，MSI降69.3%

reason: 多任务跨扫描仪验证并报告量化提升，属重要档预印本
abstract: Pathology foundation models underpin a growing number of histology-based cancer biomarkers, but sensitivity to slide scanner-specific image signatures degrades cross-center reliability and reproducibility. We developed a foundation model fine-tuning method that improved consistency in head-and-neck cancer human papillomavirus (HPV) prediction, colorectal cancer microsatellite instability (MSI) identification, prostate cancer grading and breast cancer phenotyping. This tempering method decreased cross-scanner prediction differences by 67.5% for HPV (95% CI 59.0-73.9%), 69.3% for MSI (95% CI 51.9-76.5%) and 63.4%-81.2% for breast signatures. Cross-scanner prostate grade agreement rose from 42.5% to 92.7%. Under full scanner-HPV confounding during training, AUROC fell from 0.80 to 0.68 with original model features but only from 0.86 to 0.84 with tempering. Unlike post hoc feature calibration, tempering used only public data yet matched or exceeded on-site calibration. These findings support tempering to reduce scanner dependence of pathology foundation models.
zh_abstract: 病理基础模型支撑着越来越多基于组织学的癌症生物标志物，但其对切片扫描仪特异性图像特征的敏感性会降低跨中心可靠性和可重复性。我们开发了一种基础模型微调方法，提高了头颈癌人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）预测、结直肠癌微卫星不稳定性（MSI）识别、前列腺癌分级和乳腺癌表型分型的一致性。这种缓和（tempering）方法将HPV的跨扫描仪预测差异降低了67.5%（95% CI 59.0-73.9%），将MSI的跨扫描仪预测差异降低了69.3%（95% CI 51.9-76.5%），将乳腺特征的跨扫描仪预测差异降低了63.4%-81.2%。跨扫描仪前列腺分级一致性从42.5%升至92.7%。在训练期间存在完全扫描仪-HPV混杂时，使用原始模型特征时AUROC从0.80降至0.68，而使用缓和（tempering）时仅从0.86降至0.84。与事后特征校准不同，缓和（tempering）仅使用公开数据，却达到或超过了现场校准。这些发现支持使用缓和（tempering）来降低病理基础模型对扫描仪的依赖。

title: Reliable and grounded reporting of any computed tomography scan with FORA
zh_title: FORA：可定位并生成报告的通用 CT 模型
summary: 基于 304,962 例常规 CT 训练的通用模型，识别并空间定位 1,028 个放射学概念，覆盖 28 种 CT 协议并生成报告。
key_points: 训练数据为 304,962 例常规 CT 及配套报告
无需病灶标注，多示例学习加概念瓶颈
先在胸片开发评测，再扩展至多协议 CT
reason: 30 万例级多协议通用 CT 模型，规模与覆盖属重要档；预印本、外部验证未明
abstract: Artificial intelligence systems for computed tomography (CT) remain largely restricted to specific anatomical regions, examination types or predefined abnormalities, limiting their ability to provide comprehensive and spatially grounded interpretations. Here we present FORA, a general-purpose CT model that recognizes and spatially localizes 1,028 hierarchically organized radiological concepts and generates reports across the 28 CT protocols represented in our cohort. Trained on 304,962 routine CT examinations supervised by their accompanying reports, FORA learns to localize abnormalities without manually annotated lesions. Its architecture combines multiple-instance learning with an interpretable concept bottleneck that connects spatial evidence, radiological findings and report generation. We first developed and benchmarked the architecture on chest radiographs, achieving state-of-the-art performance, before training a separate model on three-dimensional CT examinations. On 36,619 held-out CT examinations, FORA achieved a macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.918 for radiological concept recognition, exceeding the strongest of 18 existing CT models by 0.21. FORA also ranked first on three public benchmarks, outperforming Merlin on its own test set without training on that institution's data (AUROC 0.907 versus 0.826). On independent localization benchmarks for pulmonary emboli, renal masses and rib fractures, FORA's strongest spatial evidence fell within annotated lesions at rates up to 348 times greater than chance. FORA achieved more than threefold higher macro-averaged finding recall than the strongest existing report generator. These results show that a single model can combine broad abnormality recognition, spatial localization and report generation across 12 CT examination types, using routine reports without lesion-level supervision.
zh_abstract: 用于计算机断层扫描（CT）的人工智能系统在很大程度上仍局限于特定解剖区域、检查类型或预定义异常，限制了其提供全面且具空间定位解释的能力。在此，我们提出 FORA，一种通用 CT 模型，可识别并空间定位 1,028 个按层级组织的放射学概念，并针对我们队列中出现的 28 种 CT 协议生成报告。FORA 在 304,962 次常规 CT 检查上训练，以这些检查的伴随报告作为监督，学习定位异常而无需人工标注病灶。其架构将多示例学习与可解释的概念瓶颈相结合，连接空间证据、放射学发现和报告生成。我们首先在胸部 X 线片上开发并基准测试该架构，达到最先进性能，然后在三维 CT 检查上训练一个单独模型。在 36,619 次留出 CT 检查上，FORA 在放射学概念识别方面取得宏平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）0.918，超过 18 个现有 CT 模型中最强者 0.21。FORA 还在三个公共基准上排名第一，在其自身测试集上优于 Merlin，且未在该机构数据上训练（AUROC 0.907 对 0.826）。在肺栓塞、肾脏肿块和肋骨骨折的独立定位基准上，FORA 最强的空间证据落在标注病灶内的比率最高达到随机概率的 348 倍。FORA 的宏平均发现召回率超过现有最强报告生成器的三倍以上。这些结果表明，单一模型可以在 12 种 CT 检查类型中结合广泛的异常识别、空间定位和报告生成，使用常规报告而无需病灶级监督。

title: Evaluation of Large Language Model Chatbots as Patient Education Resources for Glioma: A Comparative Study.
source: PubMed · Journal of cancer education : the official journal of the American Association for Cancer Education
zh_title: 四款LLM聊天机器人生成胶质瘤患者教育信息质量对比
summary: 横断面研究以17个患者问题评测四款公开LLM聊天机器人生成胶质瘤信息的质量、透明度与可读性。
key_points: 用Google Trends筛选19个搜索词衍生17个患者问题

abstract: [Journal of cancer education : the official journal of the American Association for Cancer Education] Patients and caregivers increasingly consult large language model (LLM) chatbots for glioma-related information. Explaining glioma requires discussion of tumor classification, molecular pathology, treatment, and prognosis, making accurate patient education challenging. However, the quality of glioma-related information generated by LLMs has not been systematically evaluated. To compare the quality, transparency, and readability of glioma-related information generated by four publicly accessible LLM chatbots and assess whether their responses meet recommended readability standards for patient education. In this cross-sectional study, Google Trends was used to identify commonly searched glioma-related topics. Seventeen patient-oriented questions derived from 19 search terms were submitted to ChatGPT 5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Microsoft Copilot, and Perplexity. Two independent reviewers assessed response quality using DISCERN, Ensuring Quality Information for Patients (EQIP), the Journal of the American Medical Association (JAMA) benchmark criteria, and the Global Quality Score (GQS). Readability was evaluated using six validated indices. Group differences were analyzed with the Kruskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn-Bonferroni post hoc comparisons. Significant differences were observed among the four chatbots for DISCERN (P = 0.001), EQIP (P < 0.001), JAMA (P < 0.001), and GQS (P = 0.022). Copilot achieved the highest DISCERN and EQIP scores, whereas ChatGPT received the highest GQS. Copilot and Perplexity demonstrated better transparency than ChatGPT and Gemini, although overall transparency remained limited. None of the chatbots met recommended readability standards for patient education. Publicly accessible LLM chatbots can provide structured glioma-related information, but performance varies across platforms. Limited transparency and poor readability restrict their suitability as stand-alone patient education tools. Improvements in evidence attribution, guideline-based retrieval, uncertainty communication, and plain-language adaptation are needed before routine use in neuro-oncology.
zh_abstract: [《Journal of cancer education : the official journal of the American Association for Cancer Education》] 患者和照护者越来越多地使用大型语言模型（LLM）聊天机器人获取胶质瘤相关信息。解释胶质瘤需要讨论肿瘤分类、分子病理、治疗和预后，这使得准确的患者教育具有挑战性。然而，LLM 生成的胶质瘤相关信息的质量尚未得到系统评估。比较四个公开可访问的 LLM 聊天机器人生成的胶质瘤相关信息的质量、透明度和可读性，并评估其回答是否满足患者教育推荐的阅读难度标准。在这项横断面研究中，使用 Google Trends 识别常被搜索的胶质瘤相关主题。将源自 19 个搜索词的 17 个面向患者的问题提交给 ChatGPT 5.5、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Microsoft Copilot 和 Perplexity。两名独立评审者使用 DISCERN、确保患者信息质量（EQIP）、美国医学会（JAMA）基准标准和全球质量评分（GQS）评估回答质量。使用六个经过验证的指数评估可读性。组间差异采用 Kruskal-Wallis 检验，随后进行 Dunn-Bonferroni 事后比较。四种聊天机器人在 DISCERN（P = 0.001）、EQIP（P < 0.001）、JAMA（P < 0.001）和 GQS（P = 0.022）方面观察到显著差异。Copilot 获得最高的 DISCERN 和 EQIP 评分，而 ChatGPT 获得最高的 GQS。Copilot 和 Perplexity 表现出比 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 更好的透明度，尽管总体透明度仍然有限。没有聊天机器人满足患者教育推荐的阅读难度标准。公开可访问的 LLM 聊天机器人可以提供结构化的胶质瘤相关信息，但不同平台的表现存在差异。有限的透明度和较差的可读性限制了其作为独立患者教育工具的适用性。在神经肿瘤学中常规使用之前，需要在证据归属、基于指南的检索、不确定性沟通和通俗语言改编方面进行改进。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Baqiyatallah Medical Sciences University; conditions: Post-Intensive Care Syndrome-Family (PICS-F), Post-Traumatic Stress, Psychological Distress; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The ASSIST trial evaluates whether an AI-assisted smartphone application can reduce post-traumatic stress symptoms and other psychological distress in family members of critically ill patients. Admission to an intensive care unit (ICU) places a severe psychological burden on families, often leading to post-intensive care syndrome-family (PICS-F). Current support is mostly reactive and rarely available after the patient is discharged. This study is a three-center randomized controlled trial involving 1000 family members. Participants will be randomly assigned to receive either standard care or standard care plus the ASSIST smartphone platform. During the ICU stay, the platform uses an artificial intelligence model to simplify clinical information (approved by a clinician) and helps families prepare questions for the medical team. After the patient is discharged, the platform monitors the family member's mood daily. If a risk of anxiety or depression is detected, it provides a brief digital cognitive behavioral therapy module. The main goal is to see if the ASSIST platform reduces post-traumatic stress over a 12-month period compared to standard care alone. Secondary goals include evaluating its effects on acute stress, decisional conflict, anxiety, depression, and caregiver burden. The study will also include qualitative interviews to understand the family members' lived experiences using the platform
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：Baqiyatallah Medical Sciences University；疾病/状况：重症监护后综合征-家庭（PICS-F）、创伤后应激、心理困扰；类型：INTERVENTIONAL（干预性）；分期：NA；招募人数：1000；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING（尚未招募）] ASSIST 试验评估一种 AI 辅助智能手机应用能否减轻危重患者家属的创伤后应激症状和其他心理困扰。入住重症监护病房（ICU）给家庭带来严重心理负担，常导致重症监护后综合征-家庭（PICS-F）。当前支持多为反应性的，且患者出院后很少可获得。本研究是一项三中心随机对照试验，涉及 1000 名家庭成员。参与者将被随机分配接受标准照护或标准照护加 ASSIST 智能手机平台。在 ICU 住院期间，该平台使用人工智能模型简化临床信息（经临床医生批准），并帮助家属为医疗团队准备问题。患者出院后，平台每天监测家庭成员的情绪。如果检测到焦虑或抑郁风险，它提供简短的数字化认知行为治疗模块。主要目标是观察与单独标准照护相比，ASSIST 平台是否在 12 个月期间减少创伤后应激。次要目标包括评估其对急性应激、决策冲突、焦虑、抑郁和照护者负担的影响。该研究还将包括定性访谈，以了解家庭成员使用该平台的亲身经历。

source: PubMed · Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America
zh_title: 智能体AI与感染病实践的未来
summary: 观点文章提出预测式、对话式、智能体三级框架，讨论智能体AI在感染病六个实践领域的潜在影响。
key_points: 定义智能体构成：目标导向、调用工具、持续监控与调整
提出预测—对话—智能体三级框架
单个组件已有价值，但整合系统尚待验证
reason: 同行评审观点文章，框架清晰但明确称整合系统未验证，按观点档取5分
abstract: [Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America] Artificial intelligence (AI) discourse in infectious disease (ID) has focused on benchmarking large language model chatbots against clinicians, a useful but narrowing inquiry. Agentic AI is a different paradigm: goal-directed systems that pursue clinical objectives over time, integrating data, invoking tools, monitoring results, and adapting without repeated prompting. This Viewpoint defines the anatomy of an agent, situates it within a 3-level framework (predictive, conversational, agentic), and examines how agents could transform 6 domains of ID practice: clinical care, antimicrobial stewardship, clinical microbiology, infection prevention and control, research, and epidemiology and pandemic preparedness. Individual components have proven value; integrated systems remain untested. No validated agentic system has been deployed in clinical ID; error propagation, algorithmic bias, cost, absent validation frameworks, undefined liability, and consequences for the workforce and its training must be addressed first. The ID community has a narrow window to shape these systems before decisions are made without it.
zh_abstract: [Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America] 传染病（ID）中的人工智能（AI）讨论一直集中于将大型语言模型聊天机器人与临床医生进行基准比较，这是一项有用但范围日益狭窄的探究。智能体式 AI（Agentic AI）是一种不同的范式：目标导向系统，随着时间的推移追求临床目标，整合数据、调用工具、监测结果并在无需反复提示的情况下进行适应。本观点文章定义了智能体的解剖结构，将其置于一个 3 级框架（预测型、对话型、智能体型）中，并探讨了智能体如何改变 ID 实践的 6 个领域：临床护理、抗菌药物管理、临床微生物学、感染预防与控制、研究以及流行病学和大流行防范。单个组件已被证明有价值；集成系统仍未经测试。尚无经过验证的智能体系统部署在临床 ID 中；错误传播、算法偏差、成本、缺乏验证框架、未定义的责任以及对该劳动力及其培训的后果必须首先得到解决。ID 社区有一个狭窄的窗口来塑造这些系统，以免在没有它的情况下做出决定。

title: AI-Driven Clinical Decision Support in Reproductive Medicine: Fertility Oriented Expert (FOX) System.
zh_title: 生殖医学AI临床决策支持系统FOX的评估
summary: 同行评审研究评估基于RAG的FOX系统，以32个辅助生殖临床问题及三个典型病例考察其决策支持表现。
key_points: 知识库为3,998篇开放获取生殖医学文献（2000–2025）
用32个覆盖ART全流程的问题比较不同FOX模型
以三个含关键诊断线索的病例检验识别与管理建议
reason: 同行评审但为问题集评估、样本量小且无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [Reproductive sciences (Thousand Oaks, Calif.)] Can an AI-driven clinical decision support system reliably support clinical decision making across all steps of assisted reproductive technology (ART) work-up?. This study evaluates Fertility Oriented Expert (FOX), an AI-driven system designed for all steps of ART. FOX incorporates 3,998 full-text, open-access reproductive medicine publications (January 2000 - September 2025) with commercial large language models (LLMs) using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Thirty-two clinical questions covering ART pathway were used to evaluate the system. Responses generated by different FOX models were compared. Three common clinical cases with key diagnostic clues were presented to the FOX-GPT-5 to analyze further if the system could identify these clues and recommend a management plan. Finally, the responses generated by traditional GPT models were compared with the ones generated by FOX. Performance was assessed using G-score and semantic score, with statistical comparison via the Friedman rank-sum. Median G-scores showed no statistically significant differences between the models (0.8 for FOX-GPT-5, 0.8 for FOX-GPT-4o, and 0.95 for FOX-GPT-o1; P = 0.21). Median semantic scores were also similar (0.89 for FOX-GPT-5, 0.89 for FOX-GPT-4o, and 0.9 for FOX-GPT-o1; P = 0.56. For clinical cases, FOX recommended appropriate treatment options, achieving high G-scores and semantic scores (G-score: 1-1; semantic score: 0.88-0.93). GPT models achieved high G-scores and semantic scores based on FOX model answers (G-score: 0.8-1; semantic score: 0.75-0.99) without statistically significant differences between the different GPT models (G-score P = 0.36; semantic score P = 0.65). FOX provides evidence-based information, covering ART pathway, providing clinical decision-making support for fertility specialists.
zh_abstract: [Reproductive Sciences（Thousand Oaks, Calif.）] 人工智能驱动的临床决策支持系统能否在辅助生殖技术（ART）检查评估的所有步骤中可靠地支持临床决策？本研究评估Fertility Oriented Expert（FOX），这是一个为ART所有步骤设计的AI驱动系统。FOX利用检索增强生成（RAG）将3,998篇全文开放获取的生殖医学文献（2000年1月至2025年9月）与商业大语言模型（LLMs）结合。使用32个涵盖ART路径的临床问题评估该系统。比较不同FOX模型生成的回答。向FOX-GPT-5呈现3个带有关键诊断线索的常见临床病例，以进一步分析该系统能否识别这些线索并推荐管理方案。最后，将传统GPT模型生成的回答与FOX生成的回答进行比较。使用G-score和语义评分评估性能，并通过Friedman秩和检验进行统计比较。中位G-score显示模型间无统计学显著差异（FOX-GPT-5为0.8，FOX-GPT-4o为0.8，FOX-GPT-o1为0.95；P = 0.21）。中位语义评分也相似（FOX-GPT-5为0.89，FOX-GPT-4o为0.89，FOX-GPT-o1为0.9；P = 0.56）。对于临床病例，FOX推荐了适当的治疗方案，获得较高的G-score和语义评分（G-score：1-1；语义评分：0.88-0.93）。GPT模型基于FOX模型答案获得较高的G-score和语义评分（G-score：0.8-1；语义评分：0.75-0.99），不同GPT模型之间无统计学显著差异（G-score P = 0.36；语义评分 P = 0.65）。FOX提供循证信息，覆盖ART路径，为生育专科医生提供临床决策支持。

title: FermiLink: An Agent Harness for Multidomain Scientific Simulations.
source: PubMed · Journal of chemical theory and computation
zh_title: FermiLink：多领域科学模拟智能体框架
summary: 开源智能体框架 FermiLink 通过分离软件包知识库与模拟工作流，在高性能计算集群上实现多步骤、多日无人干预的科学模拟。
key_points: 分离软件包知识库与模拟工作流
四层渐进披露统一多软件包操作
面向 HPC，可多日无人干预运行
reason: 同行评审、开源可扩展智能体框架，方法有新意但未涉及医学或临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of chemical theory and computation] Artificial intelligence (AI) agent harnesses have been developed for autonomous scientific simulations, but most current agent harnesses are tested on a single or a small set of software packages. Herein, FermiLink, an extensible open-source agent harness, is introduced for multidomain scientific simulations. Its key design principle is the separation of package knowledge bases from simulation workflows, so that simulation workflows in FermiLink, from figure-level simulations to full-paper-level research on high-performance computing clusters, operate uniformly among supported packages via a four-layer progressive disclosure mechanism. This agent harness is specifically optimized for high-performance computing (HPC) clusters, enabling multiday, multistep scientific simulations in the absence of human intervention. Using OpenAI Codex as the agent provider, the capabilities of FermiLink are demonstrated across approximately 50 scientific software packages spanning nine research domains from chemistry to engineering. Systematic benchmarks on 132 real-world figure-level reproduction tasks with 44 packages show that FermiLink reproduces 74 (56.1%) of published figures with simulations, among which 30 (22.7%) achieve high-fidelity agreement and 35 reach qualitative agreement with the target figures. A smaller set of human expert-guided reproduction benchmarks with 10 packages in physics and chemistry further highlights the importance of expert insights for improving the simulation fidelity. Beyond reproduction, a single-blinded study demonstrates that FermiLink can produce research-grade results on unpublished polariton physics problems when provided with sufficiently detailed research objectives. Overall, FermiLink provides a scalable research infrastructure that may accelerate the path from scientific questions to computational results across diverse domains.
zh_abstract: [Journal of chemical theory and computation] 人工智能（AI）智能体框架（agent harness）已被开发用于自主科学模拟，但当前大多数智能体框架仅在单一或少量软件包上测试。本文介绍FermiLink，一个用于多领域科学模拟的可扩展开源智能体框架。其关键设计原则是将软件包知识库与模拟工作流分离，从而使FermiLink中的模拟工作流——从图表级模拟到高性能计算集群上的整篇论文级研究——通过四层渐进式披露机制在受支持的软件包之间统一运行。该智能体框架专门针对高性能计算（HPC）集群优化，能够在无人干预的情况下开展多日、多步骤的科学模拟。使用OpenAI Codex作为智能体提供方，FermiLink的能力在约50个科学软件包上得到展示，这些软件包涵盖从化学到工程的九个研究领域。使用44个软件包的132个真实世界图表级复现任务的系统基准测试表明，FermiLink通过模拟复现了74幅（56.1%）已发表图表，其中30幅（22.7%）与目标图达到高保真一致，35幅达到定性一致。一套规模较小的、由人类专家指导的复现基准（涉及物理和化学领域的10个软件包）进一步凸显了专家洞见对提高模拟保真度的重要性。除复现外，一项单盲研究表明，当提供足够详细的研究目标时，FermiLink可在未发表的极化激元物理问题上产生研究级结果。总体而言，FermiLink提供了可扩展的研究基础设施，可能加速跨不同领域从科学问题到计算结果的进程。

title: Rethinking radiation dose optimization in pediatric computed tomography imaging: emerging algorithms and clinical integration.
zh_title: 儿童CT辐射剂量优化的算法与临床整合
summary: 综述分析儿童CT剂量优化从迭代重建到深度学习重建及光子计数CT的演进。
key_points: 儿童放射敏感性高，剂量优化尤为关键
深度学习重建可望在降剂量同时保持图像质量
讨论新探测器技术与临床整合路径
reason: 同行评审综述，无原始数据与外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Pediatric radiology] The optimization of radiation dose in pediatric computed tomography (CT) is a critical imperative, driven by the heightened radiosensitivity of children. This review provides a critical analysis of the evolution of dose optimization, from foundational principles like As Low As Reasonably Achievable (ALARA) and conventional techniques to the transformative impact of artificial intelligence (AI). We trace the progression from iterative reconstruction (IR), which offered initial dose reduction but was limited by unnatural image textures and computational demands, to the new paradigm of deep learning reconstruction (DLR) and emerging detector technologies like photon-counting CT. Clinical evidence demonstrates that DLR significantly shifts the traditional compromise between dose and image quality, enabling substantial potential dose reductions while producing images with superior noise properties and diagnostic confidence. Beyond reconstruction, AI is also automating scan protocoling to enhance consistency and reduce errors. However, the clinical integration of these powerful tools is not seamless. Significant barriers remain, including the "black box" nature of algorithms, the need for new training curricula for radiographers, and complex ethical and regulatory challenges. This review synthesizes these issues and charts a path forward, advocating for a holistic approach involving complementary AI-specific reference levels, federated learning, and robust governance to realize the full potential of a safer, more efficient, and patient-specific dose optimization ecosystem.
zh_abstract: [Pediatric radiology] 儿童计算机断层扫描（CT）中的辐射剂量优化是一项关键要求，其驱动力是儿童更高的辐射敏感性。本综述对剂量优化的演变进行了批判性分析，从“在合理可达到的范围内尽可能低”（ALARA）等基本原则和传统技术，到人工智能（AI）的变革性影响。我们追溯了从迭代重建（IR）到深度学习重建（DLR）新范式以及光子计数CT等新兴探测器技术的发展历程；IR最初提供了剂量降低，但受限于不自然的图像纹理和计算需求。临床证据表明，DLR显著改变了剂量与图像质量之间的传统折衷，在产生具有更优噪声特性和诊断信心的图像的同时，实现了显著的潜在剂量降低。除重建外，AI还在自动化扫描协议设置，以提高一致性并减少错误。然而，这些强大工具的临床整合并非无缝。重大障碍仍然存在，包括算法的“黑箱”性质、放射技师需要新的培训课程，以及复杂的伦理和监管挑战。本综述综合了这些问题并规划了前进路径，倡导采取整体方法，包括补充性的AI专用参考水平、联邦学习和稳健治理，以充分发挥更安全、更高效且针对患者的剂量优化生态系统的全部潜力。

title: MitoLODE: a virtual mitochondrion framework with knowledge graph priors for trajectory modeling and mechanistic perturbation analysis.
zh_title: MitoLODE：知识图谱先验的虚拟线粒体框架
summary: 构建线粒体知识图谱MitoKG并据此提出MitoLODE，用于疾病轨迹建模与机制性扰动分析。
key_points: 整合五个权威数据库构建MitoKG，含2549节点、23019边
指出现有伪时间轨迹与虚拟细胞方法的局限
将疾病与对照作为独立轨迹建模以分析演化
reason: 有新方法且构建公开知识图谱资源，但缺乏实验验证信息
abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Mitochondria play a central role in the pathogenesis of major diseases. Tracking how they evolve under disease conditions is valuable for understanding pathological mechanisms and identifying intervention windows. Existing single-cell trajectory inference methods rely on pseudotime rather than a real temporal axis, and rarely model disease and control as independent trajectories. Virtual cell methods target one-shot drug perturbation responses and do not handle the continuous temporal evolution of disease phenotypes. To address these gaps, we propose a virtual mitochondrion research paradigm. We first curate and construct MitoKG, a mitochondria-specific heterogeneous knowledge graph integrated from five authoritative databases. MitoKG contains 2549 nodes of four types and 23 019 edges of five relation types. Building on these priors, we develop MitoLODE, a conditioned dual-trajectory neural ordinary differential equation framework. MitoLODE embeds graph priors and temporal features throughout encoding, continuous-time dynamics, and decoding, modeling disease and control evolution as two coupled paths. Benchmarked against eight baselines across four datasets covering Parkinson's disease, cardiac, and pancreatic differentiation, MitoLODE leads in most settings and remains robust under low-data regimes and extrapolation to unseen time points. Two synthetic datasets with known ground truth validate its trajectory recovery under controlled conditions. Building on the trained model, we design a gradient-guided perturbation procedure that identifies potential intervention targets aligned with known Parkinson's pathology. We develop MGMI, a large language model-based reasoning module that grounds model outputs in MitoKG nodes and turns them into confidence-graded mechanistic hypotheses, which nonetheless require experimental validation.
zh_abstract: 线粒体在重大疾病的发病机制中发挥核心作用。追踪其在疾病条件下如何演变，对于理解病理机制和识别干预窗口具有价值。现有的单细胞轨迹推断方法依赖伪时间而非真实的时间轴，且很少将疾病与对照建模为独立轨迹。虚拟细胞方法针对一次性药物扰动反应，不能处理疾病表型的连续时间演化。为弥补这些空白，我们提出一种虚拟线粒体研究范式。我们首先整理并构建 MitoKG，这是一个整合自五个权威数据库的线粒体特异性异质知识图谱。MitoKG 包含四类共 2549 个节点和五种关系类型共 23 019 条边。基于这些先验，我们开发了 MitoLODE，一个条件化双轨迹神经常微分方程框架。MitoLODE 在编码、连续时间动力学和解码全过程中嵌入图先验和时间特征，将疾病与对照的演化建模为两条耦合路径。在涵盖帕金森病、心脏和胰腺分化的四个数据集上，与八个基线进行基准比较，MitoLODE 在大多数设置中领先，并在低数据情形和向未见时间点外推时保持稳健。两个具有已知真值的合成数据集在受控条件下验证了其轨迹恢复能力。在训练好的模型基础上，我们设计了一种梯度引导的扰动流程，用于识别与已知帕金森病理相符的潜在干预靶点。我们开发了 MGMI，一个基于大语言模型的推理模块，将模型输出锚定到 MitoKG 节点，并将其转化为按置信度分级的机制假设，但这些假设仍需实验验证。

title: AI-Assisted Multimodal Imaging Integration for Individualized Transseptal Puncture Planning During Atrial Fibrillation Ablation.
source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
zh_title: AI 辅助多模态影像用于房颤消融房间隔穿刺规划
summary: 单中心 700 例研究，构建整合术前 CTA 与术中 ICE 的 AI 框架，做自动分割与三维重建以辅助穿刺规划。
key_points: 单中心纳入 700 例房颤消融患者
500 例数据用于自动分割与三维重建建模
融合 CTA 与 ICE 实现患者特异三维解剖引导
reason: 同行评审、样本量可观，但为单中心且仅内部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Transseptal puncture (TSP) is a critical step during atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation, and accurate anatomical understanding of the interatrial septum is essential for individualized procedural planning. Intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) provides real-time visualization of septal anatomy but is limited by its two-dimensional representation and operator dependence. This study developed an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted multimodal imaging framework integrating preprocedural computed tomography angiography (CTA) with intraoperative ICE to provide patient-specific three-dimensional (3D) anatomical guidance for TSP planning. This single-center study enrolled 700 patients undergoing AF ablation. An AI framework was developed using data from 500 patients to perform automated segmentation, 3D reconstruction, and CTA-ICE multimodal image integration. The framework was evaluated in an independent temporal validation cohort of 200 patients. The primary outcome was the influence of AI-assisted anatomical information on individualized TSP planning, assessed by changes in puncture strategy following AI-assisted assessment. Secondary outcomes included decision confidence, planning time, interreader agreement, and procedural feasibility. The AI framework achieved an overall Dice similarity coefficient of 0.854 for automated anatomical segmentation and a Dice coefficient of 0.862 for 3D left atrial reconstruction. In the temporal validation cohort, at least one AI-recommended adjustment was incorporated into the final TSP strategy in 68 patients (34.0%). The recommendations addressed involved three key components of TSP planning: puncture site category in 52 patients (26.0%), puncture direction in 61 patients (30.5%), and puncture trajectory or angle in 74 patients (37.0%). AI-assisted assessment increased decision confidence (4.3 ± 0.6 vs. 3.4 ± 0.8, p < 0.001), reduced planning time (28.7 ± 10.3 vs. 42.5 ± 15.2 s, p < 0.001), and improved interreader agreement for anatomical assessment. In the temporal validation cohort, acute successful TSP was achieved in 196 patients (98.0%), with a mean transseptal time of 6.8-2.5 min and an overall complication rate of 3.0%. AI-assisted integration of preprocedural CTA with intraoperative ICE provides patient-specific 3D anatomical information that supports individualized TSP planning. zh_abstract: 《Journal of imaging informatics in medicine》房间隔穿刺（TSP）是心房颤动（AF）消融过程中的关键步骤，准确理解房间隔解剖对于个体化手术规划至关重要。心腔内超声（ICE）可实时显示间隔解剖，但受限于其二维呈现和操作者依赖性。本研究开发了一种人工智能（AI）辅助的多模态影像框架，将术前计算机断层扫描血管造影（CTA）与术中ICE整合，为TSP规划提供患者特异性三维（3D）解剖指导。这项单中心研究纳入了700例接受AF消融的患者。使用500例患者的数据开发了一个AI框架，用于执行自动分割、3D重建和CTA-ICE多模态图像整合。该框架在由200例患者组成的独立时间验证队列中接受评估。主要结局是AI辅助解剖信息对个体化TSP规划的影响，通过AI辅助评估后穿刺策略的变化来评估。次要结局包括决策信心、规划时间、读者间一致性和手术可行性。AI框架在自动解剖分割中达到总体Dice相似系数0.854，在3D左心房重建中达到Dice系数0.862。在时间验证队列中，68例患者（34.0%）的最终TSP策略纳入了至少一项AI推荐的调整。这些建议涉及TSP规划的三个关键组成部分：52例患者（26.0%）的穿刺部位类别、61例患者（30.5%）的穿刺方向，以及74例患者（37.0%）的穿刺轨迹或角度。AI辅助评估提高了决策信心（4.3 ± 0.6 vs. 3.4 ± 0.8, p < 0.001），缩短了规划时间（28.7 ± 10.3 vs. 42.5 ± 15.2 s, p < 0.001），并改善了解剖评估的读者间一致性。在时间验证队列中，196例患者（98.0%）实现TSP急性期成功，平均房间隔穿刺时间为6.8-2.5 min，总体并发症发生率为3.0%。AI辅助的术前CTA与术中ICE整合提供了患者特异性3D解剖信息，支持个体化TSP规划。所提出的框架展示了可行性，以及与解剖评估和手术规划的兼容性，有望促进

title: Reducing Demographic Bias in Medical Imaging Using Siamese Representation Learning.
source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
zh_title: 孪生表示学习降低影像人口学偏差
summary: 用三元组损失孪生网络减少胸片与脑MRI模型在年龄、性别、种族间的性能差异。
key_points: 胸片10.9万张、脑MRI 1494例两项任务评估
三元组按疾病类别分离并促进跨人群类内相似
以AUROC、精确率与真阳性率评估去偏效果
reason: 同行评审大样本回顾性方法研究，未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Deep learning models for medical imaging often exhibit demographic bias, leading to performance disparities across protected groups such as age, gender, and race. This study proposes a debiasing framework to reduce such disparities while maintaining diagnostic accuracy. We propose a Siamese neural network trained using triplet loss, where demographic attributes are incorporated into triplet selection to encourage separation by disease class while promoting within-class similarity across demographic groups. The method was evaluated on pleural effusion detection using chest X-rays (109,005 images from 41,063 patients) and Alzheimer's disease classification using brain MRI (1494 scans from 348 patients). Performance was assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), precision, and true positive rate, along with equalized odds difference. The proposed method significantly reduced demographic disparities while maintaining or improving overall predictive performance compared with baseline and existing debiasing approaches. In pleural effusion detection, true positive rate gaps were reduced by 32% (race), 8% (age), and 22% (gender). In Alzheimer's disease classification, the true positive rate gap was reduced by 41% (age). Model interpretation indicated clinically meaningful imaging features were used for decision-making. Demographic-aware triplet sampling within a Siamese framework can effectively mitigate demographic performance disparities in medical imaging models while maintaining competitive overall diagnostic performance, suggesting potential for more equitable and clinically reliable deployment of medical imaging AI systems.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 医学影像深度学习模型常表现出人口统计学偏倚，导致在年龄、性别和种族等受保护群体之间存在性能差异。本研究提出一种去偏倚框架，以减少此类差异，同时保持诊断准确性。我们提出一种使用三元组损失训练的孪生神经网络，其中将人口统计学属性纳入三元组选择，以鼓励按疾病类别分离，同时促进不同人口统计学群体内的类内相似性。该方法在胸片胸腔积液检测（来自41,063例患者的109,005张图像）和脑MRI阿尔茨海默病分类（来自348例患者的1494次扫描）上进行了评估。性能使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）、精确率、真阳性率以及均衡几率差进行评估。与基线和现有去偏倚方法相比，所提方法在保持或改善整体预测性能的同时显著减少了人口统计学差异。在胸腔积液检测中，真阳性率差距分别降低了32%（种族）、8%（年龄）和22%（性别）。在阿尔茨海默病分类中，真阳性率差距降低了41%（年龄）。模型解释表明，决策使用了具有临床意义的影像特征。孪生框架内的人口统计学感知三元组采样可有效缓解医学影像模型中的人口统计学性能差异，同时保持有竞争力的整体诊断性能，这表明医学影像AI系统有望实现更公平、更临床可靠的部署。

title: Transitions of Care in Clinical Oncology: Current Applications and Future Opportunities Enabled by Artificial Intelligence and Digital Health.
zh_title: 肿瘤诊疗转衔中的AI与数字健康应用
summary: 综述梳理AI与数字健康在肿瘤患者住院到门诊转衔中的应用，如风险预测与出院规划。
key_points: 聚焦肿瘤患者出院前后转衔期的连续照护
预测分析与临床决策支持用于识别高危患者
属综述，未报告原始研究数据
reason: 同行评审综述，主题有信息量但无原始数据，属值得一看档
abstract: [JCO clinical cancer informatics] Transitions of care from hospital to outpatient settings represent a vulnerable period for patients with cancer, who often face complex treatment regimens, multiple comorbidities, and fragmented coordination across care settings. These challenges contribute to communication breakdowns and unplanned hospital readmissions. Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and digital health technologies offer new opportunities to improve the transitional phases before, during, and after hospital discharge, and strengthen care continuity. This review examines emerging approaches enabled by AI and digital health across the inpatient-to-outpatient care spectrum for hospitalized patients with cancer. We discuss how predictive analytics and clinical decision support can identify patients at elevated risk of complications and guide discharge planning before hospitalization ends. We also review existing AI and digital health solutions tailored to the discharge process, including tools that enhance patient and caregiver education, medication reconciliation, follow-up coordination, discharge documentation, and management of pending test results. Finally, we explore post-discharge technologies, such as remote monitoring, symptom tracking systems, and AI-assisted communication platforms, that empower earlier detection of clinical deterioration and facilitate integration with outpatient and community-based resources. Overall, we highlight, as well as describe the limitations of, innovations that seek to improve coordination, reduce administrative burden, and support safer, more proactive transitions of care for patients undergoing cancer treatment.
zh_abstract: [JCO clinical cancer informatics] 从医院到门诊环境的诊疗过渡是癌症患者的脆弱时期，他们常面临复杂的治疗方案、多种合并症以及跨诊疗环境协调碎片化的问题。这些挑战导致沟通中断和非计划性再入院。人工智能（AI）和数字健康技术的进展为改善出院前、出院期间和出院后的过渡阶段以及加强诊疗连续性提供了新机会。本综述考察了针对住院癌症患者、由AI和数字健康赋能、贯穿住院至门诊诊疗全程的新兴方法。我们讨论了预测分析和临床决策支持如何识别并发症风险升高的患者，并在住院结束前指导出院计划。我们还综述了针对出院流程定制的现有AI和数字健康解决方案，包括增强患者和照护者教育、药物核对、随访协调、出院文书以及待查检验结果管理的工具。最后，我们探讨出院后技术，如远程监测、症状追踪系统和AI辅助沟通平台，这些技术有助于更早发现临床恶化，并促进与门诊和社区资源的整合。总体而言，我们重点介绍并描述了旨在改善协调、减少行政负担，并支持接受癌症治疗患者更安全、更主动诊疗过渡的创新及其局限性。
