title: FedTumor-IoMT: Federated Learning-Aided Brain Tumor Diagnosis on Resource-Constrained Edge IoMT Devices
zh_title: 联邦学习在边缘设备上的脑肿瘤诊断
summary: 预印本提出轻量多任务联邦学习框架，在资源受限边缘设备上联合进行脑肿瘤分割与分类。
key_points: 共享LiteMedSAM编码器，共用分割与分类分支
选择性冻结编码器以降低端侧训练开销
仅在实验室条件下验证，无外部队列评估
reason: 预印本方法创新有限，仅实验室验证、无外部验证或临床结局
abstract: Joint brain tumor segmentation and classification models are computationally intensive, limiting their training on resource-constrained edge platforms and restricting privacy-preserving Federated Learning FL in the Internet of Medical Things IoMT. Existing approaches either perform both tasks on GPU-equipped workstations or support only classification on edge devices. To address this gap, this work proposes a lightweight multitask FL framework for joint segmentation and classification through local edge training. A shared pretrained LiteMedSAM encoder with TinyViT extracts features for a coordinate-attention-based segmentation decoder and a segmentation-guided classification head, eliminating a separate feature extractor. Selective encoder freezing retains 95\% trainable parameters while reducing on-device training costs. The proposed framework is experimentally validated on a laboratory testbed of five resource-constrained edge clients using 1,200 T1-weighted MRI samples. It achieves 94.20\% classification accuracy, 88.53\% DSC, 83.68\% IoU, and 99.87\% ROC-AUC. Its classification accuracy remains within 0.6\% of the GPU-trained baseline of 95.21\% across five FL rounds. The attention and feature refinement modules improve DSC and IoU by 3.82\% and 4.60\%, respectively, with 0.74 GFLOPs of additional computation. On edge hardware, the framework achieves 46.54 s inference latency, 52.8\% CPU utilization, and a peak temperature of 65$^\circ$C without thermal throttling. Its inference latency is observed to be 6.4--10.5 times lower than that of existing frameworks. These results demonstrate the feasibility of privacy-preserving joint brain tumor segmentation and classification on resource-constrained edge platforms.
zh_abstract: 联合脑肿瘤分割与分类模型计算密集，限制了其在资源受限边缘平台上的训练，并限制了医学物联网（Internet of Medical Things, IoMT）中隐私保护的联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）。现有方法要么在配备GPU的工作站上执行两项任务，要么仅支持边缘设备上的分类。为弥补这一空白，本研究提出一种轻量级多任务联邦学习框架，通过本地边缘训练实现联合分割与分类。一个共享的、预训练的、带TinyViT的LiteMedSAM编码器为基于坐标注意力的分割解码器和分割引导的分类头提取特征，从而省去单独的特征提取器。选择性编码器冻结保留95%的可训练参数，同时降低设备端训练成本。所提框架在由五个资源受限边缘客户端组成的实验室测试床上使用1,200个T1加权MRI样本进行了实验验证。其达到94.20%的分类准确率、88.53%的DSC、83.68%的IoU和99.87%的ROC-AUC。在五轮FL中，其分类准确率与GPU训练的基线95.21%相比保持在0.6%以内。注意力与特征细化模块分别将DSC和IoU提高3.82%和4.60%，额外计算量为0.74 GFLOPs。在边缘硬件上，该框架实现46.54 s推理延迟、52.8% CPU利用率和65°C峰值温度，且无热降频。其推理延迟被观察到比现有框架低6.4--10.5倍。这些结果证明了在资源受限边缘平台上进行隐私保护的联合脑肿瘤分割与分类的可行性。

title: Online V-Learning with Adaptive Longitudinal Data
zh_title: 在线V学习：自适应纵向数据的统计理论
summary: 针对移动健康中按批次在线更新的动态治疗方案学习，建立自适应收集数据下的V学习统计理论。
key_points: 面向mHealth动态治疗方案策略估计
批次更新使数据自适应收集且患者相关
给出不同确定性批次大小下的理论结果
reason: 纯方法学理论预印本，无真实数据或临床验证，属增量档
abstract: Reinforcement learning methods for estimating optimal dynamic treatment regimes are increasingly applied in mobile health (mHealth), where treatment decisions are made continually. Luckett et al. (2020) proposed V-learning, which estimates an optimal policy from offline trajectories. In practice, mHealth policies are updated online. Batch updating, in which the policy is re-estimated after each block of new data, is a tractable middle ground between offline learning and updating after every observation. However, because each batch's treatment policy is estimated from data pooled across patients in earlier batches, the resulting data are adaptively collected and patient trajectories are dependent, a setting that offline theory does not address. We develop statistical theory for V-learning in this setting with varying, deterministic batch sizes. For each fixed batch, as the number of patients grows, we establish uniform consistency of the estimated value function, consistency of the estimated policy, a functional central limit theorem over the policy class, asymptotic normality of the estimated value of the learned policy, and a consistent variance estimator. To first order, the online procedure performs as well as an oracle that deploys the optimal policy after the first batch. With the number of patients fixed and the number of batches growing, the estimated value function and policy remain consistent under a persistent identifiability condition. In simulations, as the number of patients grows with the number of batches fixed, confidence intervals attain near-nominal coverage under adaptive assignment and the online procedure closely matches the oracle. With a small cohort followed over many batches, the learned policies improve steadily.
zh_abstract: 用于估计最优动态治疗方案（optimal dynamic treatment regimes）的强化学习方法正越来越多地应用于移动健康（mHealth），其中治疗决策是持续做出的。Luckett 等（2020）提出了 V-learning，它从离线轨迹中估计最优策略。在实践中，mHealth 策略是在线更新的。批更新（batch updating）——即在每一批新数据后重新估计策略——是离线学习与每次观测后更新之间一种可处理的折中方案。然而，由于每一批的治疗策略都是基于先前各批患者汇总的数据估计的，所产生的数据是适应性收集的，且患者轨迹相互依赖，这一情形离线理论并未涉及。我们针对该情形下具有变化且确定批大小的 V-learning 建立统计理论。对于每个固定批次，随着患者数量增长，我们建立估计值函数的一致相合性、估计策略的相合性、策略类上的泛函中心极限定理、所学策略估计值的渐近正态性，以及相合方差估计量。在一阶意义上，该在线程序的表现与在第一批后部署最优策略的 oracle 一样好。在患者数量固定、批次数增长时，在持续可识别条件下，估计值函数和策略仍保持相合。在模拟中，当批次数固定而患者数量增长时，置信区间在适应性分配下达到接近名义覆盖，且在线程序与 oracle 十分接近。当小队列在多个批次中随访时，所学策略稳步改善。

title: ProX-MAD: Aggregating Spatial Context into Representative Proxies for Few-shot Medical Anomaly Detection
zh_title: ProX-MAD：聚合空间上下文的少样本医学异常检测
summary: 提出基于代理的框架，把空间上下文聚合为可学习的状态特异代理，统一处理多数据集的少样本医学异常检测。
key_points: 针对「一对多」统一建模而非逐数据集建模
掩码代理注入注意力保留高置信对应
缓解代理塌缩、提升像素级检测
reason: 预印本方法研究，条目未给出量化对比与外部验证信息，属增量档。
abstract: Few-shot medical anomaly detection (MAD) has largely followed a dataset-specific "one-for-one" paradigm, leaving unified "one-for-many" modeling underexplored. Naively extending existing methods to this setting causes substantial performance degradation, especially at the pixel level. We attribute this to their detection mechanisms: a shared decision boundary becomes unreliable across heterogeneous lesion definitions, whereas a normal-only memory bank cannot adequately cover diverse normal distributions with few references. We propose ProX-MAD, a proxy-based framework that aggregates spatial context into compact, learnable, state-specific proxies for unified few-shot MAD. Its Masked Proxy Infusion Attention (MPIA) module cross-attends proxy tokens to reference patch features and applies proxy-wise masking to retain high-confidence correspondences, mitigating proxy collapse and encouraging diverse proxies that summarize both normal and abnormal references. Across six medical datasets, ProX-MAD exhibits only a marginal performance drop from one-for-one to one-for-many training. Despite being trained only once as a unified model, it also outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods on average even when they use their more favorable one-for-one protocol, demonstrating the practicality of unified multi-dataset MAD.
zh_abstract: 少样本医学异常检测（MAD）在很大程度上遵循特定于数据集的“一对一”范式，使统一的“一对多”建模未得到充分探索。将现有方法朴素地扩展到该设置会导致显著性能下降，尤其是在像素级别。我们将此归因于它们的检测机制：共享决策边界在异构病变定义之间变得不可靠，而仅正常样本的记忆库在参考样本很少时无法充分覆盖多样的正常分布。我们提出ProX-MAD，一个基于代理（proxy）的框架，它将空间上下文聚合为紧凑、可学习、状态特定的代理，用于统一的少样本MAD。其掩码代理注入注意力（MPIA）模块将代理令牌与参考图像块特征进行交叉注意力，并施加代理级掩码以保留高置信度对应关系，从而缓解代理塌缩并鼓励能够同时概括正常与异常参考样本的多样代理。在六个医学数据集上，ProX-MAD从一对一训练到一对多训练仅表现出边际性能下降。尽管仅作为统一模型训练一次，它平均而言仍优于先前的先进方法，即使这些方法使用了对其更有利的一对一协议，这证明了统一多数据集MAD的实用性。

title: Quantum kernels on breast data: concentration, surrogates, and two ways an advantage gets manufactured
zh_title: 乳腺数据上的量子核方法：集中性、替代模型与优势的制造方式
summary: 预印本用三个乳腺数据基准（WDBC、模拟钼靶、BreastMNIST）检验量子核优势宣称，指出其依赖单一对照与选择历史。
key_points: 均为8量子比特经典态矢量模拟，推理路径无量子成分
WDBC样本效率扫描与1200例模拟钼靶原始/处理后对照
BreastMNIST 30种子测量选择膨胀，CMMD临床组因标签泄漏撤出
reason: 预印本方法学基准，无外部验证与临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Quantum-kernel advantage claims on breast data are usually a single number: one quantum arm, one comparator, one test split. We asked what that number measures once the full comparator set and selection history are visible. We report three active benchmarks, all exact classical statevector simulations of 8-qubit fidelity kernels with no quantum component in the inference path: a sample-efficiency sweep on Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer at ten training-set sizes; raw-versus-processed arms on 1,200 M-SYNTH simulated mammograms with a matched closed-form dequantisation surrogate, five classical methods at the same input and eleven kernel families; and a 30-seed selection-inflation measurement on BreastMNIST. A CMMD D1 clinical arm is withdrawn as a result arm because its frozen splits leak the label through patient serial order, a defect reported in a separate study; it is retained only as a worked example. All three active arms are negative. On M-SYNTH raw an apparent +0.1736 (p = 5.2e-06) against a tuned RBF-SVM falls to +0.0019 (p = 0.937) against a random forest at the same input, and a Laplacian kernel wins on validation. On WDBC, with model selection confined to training data, the quantum kernel is below the selected classical arm at every training-set size, with 2 of 200 paired subsamples ahead. Best-of-30 seed selection adds +0.0210 on BreastMNIST. One result does not fit: at bandwidth 2pi the matched closed-form Gaussian surrogate failed to reproduce the M-SYNTH raw kernel (0.5410 against 0.7045, p = 6.3e-06). Comparator choice and selection each produce effects larger than any quantum-classical difference we measured; we give a reporting standard that removes both.
zh_abstract: 关于乳腺数据的量子核优势主张通常只是一个单一数字：一个量子实验组、一个对照方法、一个测试划分。我们追问：一旦完整的对照集合和选择历史可见，该数字衡量的是什么。我们报告三项有效基准，全部是8量子比特保真度核的精确经典态矢量模拟，推理路径中不含任何量子成分：在威斯康星诊断乳腺癌（Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer）数据集上、十个训练集规模下的样本效率扫描；在1,200幅M-SYNTH模拟乳腺X线摄影图像上的原始数据对处理后数据实验组，配备匹配的闭式去量子化替代模型、同一输入下的五种经典方法和十一个核函数族；以及在BreastMNIST上的30个随机种子选择膨胀测量。一个CMMD D1临床实验组不再作为结果实验组，因为其冻结的数据划分通过患者序号顺序泄露标签，该缺陷已在另一项研究中报告；它仅作为示例保留。三个活跃实验组均为负结果。在M-SYNTH原始数据上，相对于调优的RBF-SVM的表观+0.1736（p = 5.2e-06）在相同输入下相对于随机森林降至+0.0019（p = 0.937），而拉普拉斯核在验证集上胜出。在WDBC上，模型选择仅限于训练数据，量子核在每个训练集规模下都低于所选经典实验组，仅在200个配对子样本中有2个领先。30个种子中取最佳的选择在BreastMNIST上增加+0.0210。有一个结果不符合：在带宽2pi下，匹配的闭式高斯替代模型未能复现M-SYNTH原始核（0.5410对0.7045，p = 6.3e-06）。对照方法的选择和选择过程各自产生的影响都大于我们所测得的任何量子-经典差异；我们给出一个可消除这两者的报告标准。

title: Artificial intelligence and multi-omics integration for cardiac regeneration: from cell fate decoding to clinical translation.
source: PubMed · Frontiers in cell and developmental biology
zh_title: AI与多组学整合用于心肌再生：从细胞命运解码到临床转化
summary: 综述梳理AI与多组学整合在心肌再生研究中的应用，涵盖细胞命运解析与向临床转化的路径与障碍。
key_points: 综述AI与多组学在心肌再生中的整合应用
关注细胞命运解码与再生调控机制
讨论细胞治疗存活与微环境抑制等障碍
reason: 综述类，AI仅为其中一个方向且无新数据，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in cell and developmental biology] Heart failure remains among the leading causes of death worldwide, and its burden is increasing as populations age. The adult mammalian heart has almost no capacity to replace cardiomyocytes lost to injury: most cardiomyocytes leave the cell cycle, and the infarcted muscle is replaced by scar, so that function declines progressively. This constraint is not fixed. Neonatal mice regenerate myocardium for a brief window that closes within the first postnatal week, whereas adult zebrafish retain the capacity throughout life; the machinery for regeneration therefore exists, but is held in check. Cell-based therapy was expected to circumvent the problem, yet its clinical benefit has remained modest: transplanted cells survive and engraft poorly, their fate resists precise control, and the host microenvironment actively suppresses regeneration. These shortcomings are symptoms of a single underlying difficulty-scale. The regulatory logic of cardiac regeneration is distributed across transcriptional control, intercellular communication, spatial microenvironments and protein interactions, so that no omics layer examined in isolation, however high its resolution, can recover the integrated picture from high-dimensional, sparse and heterogeneous data. This review proposes an artificial intelligence (AI)-multi-omics integration framework for cardiac regeneration. We survey the methodological progress that becomes available when single-cell transcriptomics, spatial transcriptomics and proteomics are modelled jointly, and examine what these approaches can and cannot establish about cardiac lineage cell fate determination, about regeneration trajectory reconstruction, and about the failing-heart microenvironment. We then consider the translational pathways, and the limits of the evidence for each. The resulting evidence is uneven: the sections on the failing-heart microenvironment rest largely on direct cardiac data, whereas most of the methodological progress has been made outside the heart and transfers only under additional assumptions. One qualification is therefore stated at the outset: evidence for AI in cardiac regeneration is still scarce. The review is positioned as a methodological framework and a forward-looking perspective rather than a synthesis of established conclusions, and the evidence supporting each principal claim is graded, from direct experimental evidence in the heart to methodology.
zh_abstract: 心力衰竭仍然是全球主要死因之一，且随着人口老龄化其负担不断加重。成年哺乳动物心脏几乎没有能力替代因损伤而丧失的心肌细胞：大多数心肌细胞退出细胞周期，梗死心肌被瘢痕替代，因此功能逐渐衰退。这一限制并非固定不变。新生小鼠在出生后第一周内关闭的一个短暂窗口内可再生心肌，而成年斑马鱼终生保有这种能力；因此再生机制是存在的，但受到抑制。细胞疗法曾被期望规避这一问题，然而其临床获益一直有限：移植细胞存活和定植不佳、其命运难以精确控制，且宿主微环境主动抑制再生。这些缺陷是单一潜在困难的表征——尺度。心脏再生的调控逻辑分布于转录调控、细胞间通讯、空间微环境和蛋白质相互作用之中，因此任何孤立考察的组学层面，无论分辨率多高，都无法从高维、稀疏和异质的数据中还原出整合的图景。本综述提出一个用于心脏再生的人工智能（AI）-多组学整合框架。我们综述了当单细胞转录组学、空间转录组学和蛋白质组学被联合建模时所可获得的方法学进展，并考察这些方法在心脏谱系细胞命运决定、再生轨迹重建以及衰竭心脏微环境方面能够确立什么、不能确立什么。随后我们讨论转化路径以及各自证据的局限。由此产生的证据并不均衡：关于衰竭心脏微环境的章节主要基于直接的心脏数据，而大多数方法学进展是在心脏之外取得的，只有在额外假设下才能迁移。因此，我们在开篇即说明一点限定：AI 在心脏再生中的证据仍然稀少。本综述定位为方法学框架和前瞻性视角，而非对既定结论的综合，并对每个主要主张所依据的证据进行分级，从心脏中的直接实验证据到方法学证据。

title: Leakage-Safe Auditing of Attribution-Driven Data Curation in Medical Imaging
zh_title: 医学影像归因数据清洗的防泄漏审计
summary: 对 CT 血管造影动脉瘤 3D 分类器做患者不重叠审计，分别检验归因异常检测与干预有效性两类主张。
key_points: 1,201 个阳性 patch 中 232 个为零值数组
推翻历史 321-patch 注意力失效亚组
GradCAM++ 与 Integrated Gradients 阳性排序不一致
reason: 单数据集审计研究、样本有限，属增量档
abstract: When can an attribution-derived anomaly justify changing a medical-imaging training set? We formulate attribution-driven curation as three separately testable claims: anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility. We test the first and third using a patient-disjoint, identifier-preserving audit of a 3D convolutional classifier for computed tomography angiography aneurysm candidates. We identify 232 exactly zero-valued arrays among 1,201 positive patches, including 170 training positives, and invalidate a historical 321-patch attention-failure subgroup whose identifier-free records were joined to files by position. On the held-out test set, GradCAM++ spatial concentration is central for every candidate class, reversing the historical pattern. GradCAM++ and Integrated Gradients show negative rank-order agreement for positives, limiting method-independent anatomical interpretation. Across five paired training seeds, removing the 170 corrupted training positives yields AUC 0.9617 +/- 0.0044 versus 0.9652 +/- 0.0039 for full-data training (difference -0.0035; 95% CI -0.0082 to 0.0007). Excluding 34 raw-zero test positives widens rather than closes the gap, countering a blank-memorization explanation. Budget-matched random-removal controls suggest the result is not simply an effect of reducing training size. Input corruption does not necessarily imply that deletion improves generalization. Our framework makes leakage control, sample identity, and intervention testing explicit in attribution-driven medical-imaging data curation.
zh_abstract: 归因衍生的异常何时能证明改变医学影像训练集是合理的？我们将归因驱动的数据整理表述为三个可分别检验的主张：异常检测、危害性估计和干预效用。我们使用针对计算机断层扫描血管造影动脉瘤候选者的三维卷积分类器，通过患者不重叠、保留标识符的审计来检验第一和第三个主张。我们在1,201个阳性图块中识别出232个完全为零值的数组，其中包括170个训练阳性样本，并使一个历史性的321图块注意力失败亚组失效，该亚组的无标识符记录按位置与文件连接。在留出测试集上，GradCAM++的空间集中区域对每个候选类别均位于中心，逆转了历史模式。GradCAM++与Integrated Gradients在阳性样本上呈负的秩序一致性，限制了不依赖方法的解剖学解释。在五个配对训练随机种子中，移除170个损坏的训练阳性样本得到的AUC为0.9617 +/- 0.0044，而全数据训练为0.9652 +/- 0.0039（差异 -0.0035；95% CI -0.0082至0.0007）。排除34个原始零值测试阳性会扩大而非缩小差距，反驳了空白记忆解释。预算匹配的随机移除对照表明，该结果并非仅仅是减少训练规模的效果。输入损坏并不必然意味着删除会改善泛化。我们的框架在归因驱动的医学影像数据整理中明确纳入了泄漏控制、样本身份和干预检验。

title: CSC-Mamba: Bridging multimodal convolutional sparse coding and state space models for multi-contrast MRI super-resolution
zh_title: CSC-Mamba：多对比度MRI超分辨率新方法
summary: 提出CSC-Mamba，将深度展开多模态卷积稀疏编码与视觉Mamba结合，用于多对比度MRI超分辨率。
key_points: 结合深度展开稀疏编码与视觉Mamba
利用参考对比度结构先验做MRI超分
摘要未报告外部验证或临床评估
reason: 方法类预印本，有新意但无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Multi-contrast MRI super-resolution accelerates clinical protocols by reconstructing high-resolution (HR) target modalities from low-resolution (LR) inputs, guided by easily acquired reference contrasts. While purely data-driven deep neural networks achieve strong performance via rich representation capacity, they rely on heuristic fusion mechanisms (e.g., naive concatenation or black-box cross-attention) that lack theoretical grounding. Alternatively, model-based deep unfolding networks enforce principled cross-contrast fusion through explicit priors, yet their unrolled steps remain constrained to shallow convolutions, lacking modern deep blocks to capture global context. To bridge this gap, we propose CSC-MAMBA, unifying deep-unfolded multimodal convolutional sparse coding with the Vision Mamba state-space backbone. By fusing common structural priors from the guidance modality via unfolded sparse coding and globally refining contrast-specific representations with a Mamba back- bone, our approach benefits from interpretable, model-guided fusion and long-range spatial context. Experiments on the IXI dataset demonstrate that CSC-MAMBA outperforms state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction quality, achieving up to a 0.62 dB gain in PSNR while remaining computationally efficient.
zh_abstract: 多对比度MRI超分辨率通过从低分辨率（LR）输入重建高分辨率（HR）目标模态，并在易于获取的参考对比度引导下，加速临床协议。纯数据驱动的深度神经网络凭借丰富的表示能力取得强性能，但它们依赖缺乏理论基础的启发式融合机制（如简单拼接或黑箱交叉注意力）。另一方面，基于模型的深度展开网络通过显式先验实现有原则的跨对比度融合，但其展开步骤仍局限于浅层卷积，缺乏现代深度模块来捕捉全局上下文。为弥合这一差距，我们提出CSC-MAMBA，将深度展开的多模态卷积稀疏编码与Vision Mamba状态空间骨干统一起来。通过展开稀疏编码融合来自引导模态的共有结构先验，并利用Mamba骨干全局细化对比度特异性表示，我们的方法受益于可解释的、模型引导的融合和长程空间上下文。在IXI数据集上的实验表明，CSC-MAMBA在重建质量上优于最先进方法，PSNR最高提升0.62 dB，同时保持计算高效。

title: Do Clinician-Scored Examples Help LLMs Code ADOS-2 from Hour-Long Transcripts?
zh_title: 医生评分示例能帮LLM编码ADOS-2吗
summary: 测试临床医生评分示例能否提升LLM对小时级ADOS-2访谈转录的编码一致性。
key_points: 测试医生评分示例对LLM编码的影响
48名儿童、8个言语条目，预注册对照
40名留出儿童中κ仅0.22–0.30
reason: 预注册对照但样本小且一致性低，属增量档
abstract: Large language models can apply a written rubric to a transcript, making automated coding of the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS-2) look within reach. A common way to align such a rater with clinicians is to show it expert-scored examples, but whether correct labels improve agreement is rarely tested. We test this for eight speech-based items of hour-long ADOS-2 Module 3 sessions from 48 children, with one local model and a pre-registered, placebo-controlled design. We compare few-shot scoring, an anchored comparison in which the model only judges a child better, similar or worse than scored anchors and a fixed rule gives the score, post-hoc calibration, protocol-based evidence routing and direct scoring of the full transcript. On 40 held-out children, agreement with clinicians was modest, with quadratic weighted kappa between 0.22 and 0.30. Replacing every example's label with a wrong one changed about a third of the few-shot predictions, more often towards the corrupted labels than chance, but did not lower agreement, 0.25 with correct and 0.23 with wrong labels. A larger second model did the same. The anchored comparison did not improve on few-shot scoring, its cross-child judgements were no more accurate than those implied by absolute scores, and routing did not help. Among the registered, uncalibrated arms, direct scoring of the full transcript agreed best at 0.30. Exploratory follow-up analyses found that the model's graded judgements ranked children better than its final scores, that existing batch calibration raised agreement to 0.46 on the same children, and that in controlled synthetic sessions scoring episodes separately did not beat calibrated whole-transcript scoring. Expert-scored examples do not by themselves calibrate model-based clinical raters, and claims of calibration or added pipeline complexity need corrupted-label controls and strong baselines.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型可以将书面评分标准应用于转录文本，使自闭症诊断观察量表（ADOS-2）的自动编码看起来触手可及。使此类评分者与临床医生对齐的一种常见方法是向其展示专家评分的示例，但正确标签是否提高一致性很少被检验。我们在来自 48 名儿童的时长一小时的 ADOS-2 模块 3 会话的八个基于言语的条目上测试这一点，使用一个本地模型和预注册、安慰剂对照的设计。我们比较少样本评分、锚定比较（其中模型仅判断儿童比已评分锚点更好、相似或更差，并由固定规则给出分数）、事后校准、基于方案证据路由以及对完整转录文本的直接评分。在 40 名留出儿童中，与临床医生的一致性有限，二次加权 kappa 在 0.22 至 0.30 之间。将每个示例的标签替换为错误标签，改变了约三分之一的少样本预测，且比随机更常转向被破坏的标签，但并未降低一致性：正确标签时为 0.25，错误标签时为 0.23。更大的第二个模型也是如此。锚定比较未优于少样本评分，其跨儿童判断并不比绝对分数所隐含的判断更准确，且证据路由没有帮助。在注册的、未校准的各组中，对完整转录文本的直接评分一致性最佳，为 0.30。探索性后续分析发现，模型的等级判断对儿童的排序优于其最终分数；现有批量校准在同一批儿童上将一致性提高到 0.46；在受控合成会话中，分别对片段评分并未胜过经过校准的全转录评分。专家评分示例本身不能校准基于模型的临床评分者，关于校准或增加流程复杂度的主张需要损坏标签对照和强基线。

title: CROSS-Calib: Selective Channel Calibration for Ultrasound Reconstruction
zh_title: CROSS-Calib：超声通道选择性校准重建
summary: 提出以其他通道预测作幅相参考、并用上下文门控选择性融合的通道修复方法，在在体数据与体模上优于基线。
key_points: 用其他通道预测做幅度与相位校准
门控机制选择性保留可用回波、修复不可靠样本
在体数据在增益误差与瞬态干扰下优于全部基线
reason: 预印本方法类，有基线对比与体模/在体测试，但无临床结局与外部多中心验证，属增量档偏上。
abstract: Ultrasound imaging provides views of internal tissue in real time for medical diagnosis. However, ultrasound signals may be affected by interference, and correcting errors and removing transient interference while preserving valid echoes remains challenging. We propose CROSS-Calib, a channel recovery method that uses predictions from other channels as references for amplitude and phase calibration, while a gate using context selectively combines calibrated measurements with predicted echoes to retain usable samples and repair unreliable ones. On the in vivo test set, CROSS-Calib outperforms all baseline models under gain errors and transient interference, while phantom tests show that the model restores cyst contrast with echo widths of wire targets close to the clean reference. CROSS-Calib can perform channel calibration and selective repair before beamforming to improve echo usability and image quality.
zh_abstract: 超声成像可实时提供内部组织视图以用于医学诊断。然而，超声信号可能受到干扰，在保留有效回波的同时校正误差并去除瞬态干扰仍然具有挑战性。我们提出 CROSS-Calib，一种通道恢复方法，它使用其他通道的预测作为幅度和相位校准的参考，同时使用上下文的门控选择性地将校准后的测量与预测回波结合，以保留可用样本并修复不可靠样本。在在体测试集上，CROSS-Calib 在增益误差和瞬态干扰下优于所有基线模型，而体模测试表明该模型恢复了囊肿对比度，线靶的回波宽度接近干净参考。CROSS-Calib 可在波束形成之前执行通道校准和选择性修复，以提高回波可用性和图像质量。

title: XRL4T1D: A Post-hoc Explainability Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Type 1 Diabetes Management
zh_title: XRL4T1D：1型糖尿病强化学习事后解释
summary: 提出无需重训的事后解释框架，用 SHAP 比较胰岛素给药策略对 CGM 与胰岛素史的依赖，评估仅在 UVA/Padova 模拟器完成。
key_points: 用 SHAP 比较 CGM 与胰岛素史输入重要性
按三个20分钟窗口汇总胰岛素史归因
以输入替换检验归因与策略输出敏感性
reason: 纯模拟器内的可解释性方法研究，无真实患者数据或外部验证，属增量档。
abstract: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) requires lifelong insulin therapy, and reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for automated dosing in the UVA/Padova simulator. However, the decisions of RL controllers remain difficult to interpret. We present XRL4T1D, a post-hoc explainability framework for evaluating pretrained insulin-dosing policies without retraining. Each policy uses 60 minutes of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) and administered-insulin history, sampled every 5 minutes, to recommend insulin. We use SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to compare the importance of CGM and insulin-history inputs and summarize insulin-history attributions over three 20-minute windows motivated by insulin-on-board. We assess whether these attributions correspond to policy-output sensitivity through targeted input replacement and compare temporal rankings with TimeSHAP. In all 80 patient-policy-mask-size cases, replacing the highest-attribution inputs changes the normalized insulin recommendation more than replacing the lowest-attribution or random inputs. The highest-attribution insulin-history window is also the most output-sensitive in 115 of 120 patient-policy-scenario configurations, and KernelSHAP and TimeSHAP select the same top window in 111 of 120. Applying XRL4T1D to PPO and G2P2C across 20 virtual patients, we find that both controllers rely predominantly on CGM history, especially G2P2C. However, the distribution of insulin-history importance across recent, middle, and older windows varies by cohort, explainer, and analysis settings, without a consistent separation between controllers. Global feature-attribution rankings remain stable under the tested observation corruptions. These results show why attribution fidelity, temporal reproducibility, and controller-comparison robustness should be assessed separately.
zh_abstract: 1型糖尿病（T1D）需要终身胰岛素治疗，强化学习（RL）在UVA/Padova模拟器中已显示出用于自动给药的潜力。然而，RL控制器的决策仍然难以解释。我们提出XRL4T1D，一个用于评估预训练胰岛素给药策略的事后可解释性框架，无需重新训练。每个策略使用每5分钟采样的60分钟连续葡萄糖监测（CGM）和已给药胰岛素历史来推荐胰岛素。我们使用SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）比较CGM与胰岛素历史输入的重要性，并在受胰岛素在体内（insulin-on-board）启发而设定的三个20分钟窗口上汇总胰岛素历史归因。我们通过有针对性的输入替换评估这些归因是否与策略输出敏感性相对应，并将时间排序与TimeSHAP进行比较。在所有80个患者-策略-掩码尺寸案例中，替换最高归因输入比替换最低归因输入或随机输入更能改变归一化胰岛素推荐。在120个患者-策略-场景配置中有115个，最高归因的胰岛素历史窗口也是对输出最敏感的窗口，且KernelSHAP与TimeSHAP在120个中有111个选择相同的最高窗口。将XRL4T1D应用于20名虚拟患者上的PPO和G2P2C，我们发现两个控制器都主要依赖CGM历史，G2P2C尤其如此。然而，胰岛素历史重要性在近期、中期和较早期窗口上的分布随队列、解释器和分析设置而变化，控制器之间没有一致的分离。在测试的观测扰动下，全局特征归因排序保持稳定。这些结果表明为什么归因保真度、时间可重复性和控制器比较稳健性应分别评估。

title: Contrastive Proxy Forests: Completeness-Preserving Proxy Learning from Multimodal Records
zh_title: 对比代理森林：多模态记录的完整性保留代理学习
summary: 利用近端因果推断条件，从治疗侧与结局侧多模态记录中学习共享表示以捕捉混杂因素，替代人工挑选代理变量。
key_points: 以临床文本与生理波形等多模态记录构建代理
学习跨模态共享部分以过滤模态特异风格
目标是保持代理完整性而非通用降维
reason: 方法学预印本，条目未提供实验规模与外部验证结果，属增量档。
abstract: Proximal causal inference removes unmeasured confounding using two proxies of the confounder, an outcome-side W and a treatment-side Z. The proxies must satisfy exclusion restrictions and be complete, meaning that they reflect every aspect of the confounder. In practice, they are a few variables hand-picked from a structured table, even though clinical notes and physiological waveforms carry rich information about the confounder. Such records are too high-dimensional for a proximal estimator, and generic compression such as PCA may keep modality-specific variation (style) instead of the confounder, destroying completeness. Our key observation is that, under the proximal condition, the confounder is the only link between a treatment-side and an outcome-side modality beyond the covariates. Learning what they share therefore captures the confounder and filters out modality-specific style. Contrastive Proxy Forests (CPF) learns both proxies by contrasting the two modalities, given the covariates, on a separate unlabeled sample, and passes them to a proximal causal forest. This contrastive objective has an exact closed-form solution, ridge canonical correlation analysis. We prove that CPF preserves the exclusion restrictions exactly and that its proxies inherit the completeness of the raw records under conditions we characterize. Where style is strong, CPF lowers the error of conditional effects by 10-22% relative to PCA proxies, and on MIMIC-IV it is the only method whose point estimate of warfarin's effect on stroke falls inside the range of randomized trials.
zh_abstract: 近端因果推断利用混杂因素的两个代理变量——结局侧 W 和治疗侧 Z——来消除未测量混杂。这些代理变量必须满足排除限制并且是完备的，这意味着它们反映混杂因素的每一个方面。在实践中，它们是从结构化表格中手工挑选的少数变量，尽管临床笔记和生理波形携带关于混杂因素的丰富信息。此类记录对于近端估计器而言维度过高，而 PCA 等通用压缩可能保留模态特异变异（风格）而不是混杂因素，从而破坏完备性。我们的关键观察是，在近端条件下，混杂因素是治疗侧模态与结局侧模态之间除协变量之外的唯一联系。因此，学习二者共享的内容可以捕获混杂因素并过滤掉模态特异风格。对比代理森林（Contrastive Proxy Forests, CPF）在给定协变量的情况下，在单独的无标签样本上通过对比两个模态来学习两个代理变量，并将它们传递给近端因果森林。该对比目标具有精确的闭式解，即岭典型相关分析（ridge canonical correlation analysis）。我们证明 CPF 精确保持排除限制，并且在我们刻画的条件卜，其代理变量继承原始记录的完备性。在风格较强时，CPF 相对于 PCA 代理变量将条件效应误差降低 10-22%；在 MIMIC-IV 上，它是唯一一种对华法林影响卒中的点估计落在随机试验范围内的方法。

title: Latent Class Mixed Model Variational Autoencoders for Scalable Phenotyping of Health Trajectories
zh_title: LCMM-VAE：健康轨迹的可扩展表型聚类
summary: 提出潜类混合模型变分自编码器，潜先验为类特异线性混合模型，兼顾可解释表型结构与高维、不规则随访数据的可扩展性。
key_points: 潜轨迹分解为类均值轨迹与个体偏差
推导变分 EM 算法更新类别责任与混合参数
面向不规则访视与高维测量场景
reason: 预印本方法研究，条目未给出真实队列规模与验证结果，属增量档。
abstract: Clustering longitudinal health trajectories requires handling high-dimensional measurements, irregular visit times, and subject-level heterogeneity while retaining clinically interpretable structure. Existing methods address this only partially: latent-class mixed models yield an interpretable, covariate-driven partition but do not scale past a handful of markers, while deep time-series clustering scales at the cost of that structure and generally requires a common time grid. We introduce the Latent Class Mixed Model Variational Autoencoder (LCMM-VAE), a deep generative model whose latent prior is a mixture of class-specific linear mixed models, so that each subject's latent trajectory decomposes into its class mean trajectory and a subject-specific deviation. We derive a variational EM algorithm whose class responsibilities, random effects and mixed-model parameters are updated in closed form, and provide identifiability guarantees under stated conditions. Experiments on simulated and real longitudinal cohorts show that LCMM-VAE returns a partition, a reconstruction of incomplete trajectories and interpretable class-level dynamics at once, while remaining competitive with classical and deep baselines.
zh_abstract: 对纵向健康轨迹进行聚类需要处理高维测量、不规则随访时间和个体水平异质性，同时保留临床可解释的结构。现有方法只能部分解决这一问题：潜在类别混合模型可给出可解释、由协变量驱动的划分，但无法扩展到超过少量标志物的情形；深度时间序列聚类虽可扩展，却以牺牲这种结构为代价，并且通常要求共同的时间网格。我们提出潜在类别混合模型变分自编码器（Latent Class Mixed Model Variational Autoencoder, LCMM-VAE），这是一种深度生成模型，其潜在先验是类别特定线性混合模型的混合，因此每个受试者的潜在轨迹可分解为其类别平均轨迹和受试者特异偏差。我们推导出一种变分 EM 算法，其类别责任度、随机效应和混合模型参数均以闭式更新，并在所述条件下提供可识别性保证。在模拟和真实纵向队列上的实验表明，LCMM-VAE 能同时返回一个划分、对不完整轨迹的重建以及可解释的类别水平动态，同时与经典和深度基线相比仍具竞争力。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University of Pennsylvania; conditions: Population Health Management, Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS), Chronic Lung Diseases, Artificial Intelligence (AI); type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 45; status: RECRUITING] Patients living with chronic lung diseases (CLD) are at high risk of frailty, malnutrition, and depression. However, many of the interventions targeting these conditions are underutilized. Thus, artificial intelligence-based clinical decision support systems (AI-CDSS) offer a promising approach to guide targeted interventions for this population and reduce risk of hospitalization. The purpose of this study is to assess the acceptability and feasibility of a new AI-CDSS for community-dwelling patients with CLD. The goal of this AI-CDSS is to predict the probability that patients would benefit from 5 frailty- and depression-focused interventions (pulmonary rehabilitation, physical therapy, fall-risk assessment, nutrition consultation, and depression consultation). In this study, pulmonologists will review the AI-CDSS's predictions and have the option to recommend referrals for their patients. If a referral is recommended, the study team will contact the patient to discuss the referral and start the referral process. All participants will then complete a semi-structured interview and feedback survey asking their opinions about the AI-CDSS and the study referral process.
zh_abstract: 【新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：University of Pennsylvania（宾夕法尼亚大学）；疾病/状况：Population Health Management（人群健康管理）、Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS)（临床决策支持系统）、Chronic Lung Diseases（慢性肺部疾病）、Artificial Intelligence (AI)（人工智能）；类型：INTERVENTIONAL（干预性）；分期：NA；入组人数：45；状态：RECRUITING（招募中）】患有慢性肺部疾病（CLD）的人群处于衰弱、营养不良和抑郁的高风险中。然而，针对这些状况的许多干预措施利用不足。因此，基于人工智能的临床决策支持系统（AI-CDSS）提供了一种有前景的方法，可指导针对该人群的靶向干预并降低住院风险。本研究的目的是评估一种新型 AI-CDSS 对居住在社区的 CLD 患者的可接受性和可行性。该 AI-CDSS 的目标是预测患者从 5 项以衰弱和抑郁为重点的干预措施（肺康复、物理治疗、跌倒风险评估、营养咨询和抑郁咨询）中获益的概率。在本研究中，肺科医生将审查 AI-CDSS 的预测，并可选择为其患者推荐转诊。如果推荐转诊，研究团队将联系患者讨论转诊并启动转诊流程。随后，所有参与者将完成半结构化访谈和反馈调查，询问他们对 AI-CDSS 及研究转诊流程的看法。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University of Waterloo; conditions: Safety, Feasibility Studies, Pilot Study, Mental Health, Mood; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 20; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The goal of this Pilot study is to examine the possibility and safety of using Artificial Intelligence (AI) conversational tools (chatbots) to help improve individuals' mental well-being. The main questions it aims to answer are: * How safe is an AI chatbot in use for a study about mental wellness? * How usable is the platform for this study? * How willing are participants to remain and complete the study? * What was the user experience like? * Do they show any signs of dependancy on the chatbot? Researchers will compare participants who did the mental wellness sessions with the chosen chatbot, Doro, to those who used common self-help materials to examine the safety and effectiveness of AI chatbots in supporting mental wellness. Participants will: * Have a pre-study mental wellness assessment. * Be divided into 2 groups: the experimental group and the control group. * The experimental group will interact with the Doro AI Chatbot. * The control group will interact with the self-help work materials. * Have a mid-point mental wellness assessment. * Have a mental wellness survey after all the sessions, and * Have a final interview with one of the researchers.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：滑铁卢大学；疾病/状况：安全性、可行性研究、试点研究、心理健康、情绪；类型：干预性；阶段：不适用（NA）；入组人数：20；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 本试点研究的目标是考察使用人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）对话工具（聊天机器人）帮助改善个体心理健康的可能性与安全性。其旨在回答的主要问题包括：* 在一项关于心理健康的研究中使用AI聊天机器人有多安全？* 该平台用于本研究时的可用性如何？* 参与者愿意继续参与并完成研究的程度如何？* 用户体验如何？* 他们是否表现出对聊天机器人依赖的任何迹象？研究人员将比较使用所选聊天机器人Doro进行心理健康课程的参与者与使用常见自助材料的参与者，以考察AI聊天机器人在支持心理健康方面的安全性和有效性。参与者将：* 接受研究前心理健康评估。* 被分为2组：实验组和对照组。* 实验组将与Doro AI聊天机器人互动。* 对照组将使用自助工作材料。* 接受中点心理健康评估。* 在所有课程后接受心理健康调查，并且* 与其中一名研究人员进行最终访谈。

title: Multimodal CT-pathology imaging deep learning model for risk stratification in resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma
zh_title: CT-病理多模态深度学习预测I期肺腺癌复发风险
summary: 基于多中心1078例患者构建CT与全切片图像多模态模型预测I期肺腺癌无病生存，性能优于单模态。
key_points: 多中心队列1078例，含独立验证队列
融合术前CT与术后WSI的双信息实例网络
模型风险分层为独立预后因素，并探索联合临床病理评分
reason: 多中心千例队列且有验证队列评估预后，属重要档
abstract: Lung adenocarcinoma is a highly heterogeneous disease, highlighting the need for more accurate prognosis prediction. We developed a multimodal deep learning model combining preoperative computed tomography (CT) and postoperative whole slide image (WSI) to predict the disease-free survival (DFS) of resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma. Based on a cohort of 1078 patients from multiple centers, our dual-information instance neural network achieved superior performance over unimodal approaches. The risk stratification defined by the model effectively distinguished DFS in both validation cohorts and served as an independent predictor, suggesting the complementary value of the model beyond clinicopathological factors. An exploratory scoring system integrating the model-derived risk stratification with key clinicopathological factors was developed, identifying patients with significantly different prognostic outcomes. Further analyses suggested that patients with high-risk stage IB disease or high scores might derive DFS benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy, warranting prospective validation. Beyond its predictive capacity, the model also provided morphological insights, identifying prognostically significant structures such as tertiary lymphoid structures and stroma barriers, while RNA-sequencing analysis revealed distinct oncogenic pathway activation and immunosuppressive tumor microenvironments in high-risk patients. By leveraging routinely acquired clinical images, this multimodal approach offers a practical tool for improving prognostic stratification, with potential implications for informing patient selection for adjuvant chemotherapy in resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma.
zh_abstract: 肺腺癌是一种高度异质性的疾病，凸显了更准确预后预测的需求。我们开发了一种多模态深度学习模型，结合术前计算机断层扫描（CT）和术后全切片图像（WSI），以预测切除的 I 期肺腺癌的无病生存期（DFS）。基于来自多个中心的 1078 例患者队列，我们的双信息实例神经网络取得了优于单模态方法的性能。模型定义的风险分层在两个验证队列中有效区分了 DFS，并作为独立预测因素，提示该模型在临床病理因素之外具有补充价值。开发了一个探索性评分系统，将模型衍生的风险分层与关键临床病理因素相整合，识别出预后结局显著不同的患者。进一步分析提示，高风险 IB 期疾病或高评分患者可能从辅助化疗中获得 DFS 获益，值得前瞻性验证。除预测能力外，该模型还提供了形态学见解，识别出具有预后意义的结构，如三级淋巴结构和间质屏障，而 RNA 测序分析揭示了高风险患者中不同的致癌通路激活和免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境。通过利用常规获取的临床图像，这种多模态方法为改善预后分层提供了一种实用工具，并可能对指导切除的 I 期肺腺癌患者辅助化疗的患者选择具有意义。

title: Health-state instability and progression in longitudinal clinical records reveal heterogeneous ageing trajectories
zh_title: 纵向病历中的健康状态不稳定与异质衰老轨迹
summary: VitaFlux用下次就诊预测学习潜在健康状态，在约17.9万人纵向队列中关联1年与3年死亡并提升多结局预测。
key_points: 浙江人群队列178,970人、443万次就诊
预测状态不稳定与实际1年、3年死亡相关
当前与预测状态优于综合临床基线
属表征学习框架，非单一终点风险模型
reason: 同行评审、近18万人大样本并报告死亡等临床结局，属重要档
abstract: Longitudinal clinical records capture health changes, but most models reduce them to endpoint risks or single-time biological-age estimates. We developed VitaFlux, a representation-learning framework that uses next-visit forecasting to encode clinical encounters as latent health states. Applied to 178,970 individuals with 4,439,390 aligned visits from the Zhejiang Population Health Cohort, VitaFlux learned a reproducible representation organized by age-associated, disease-burden and multisystem physiological variation. Forecast instability measured predicted health-state change at the next visit and was associated with observed one- and three-year mortality. Continuous trajectory measures captured heterogeneous progression, while current and forecast states improved the prediction of multiple clinical outcomes compared with a comprehensive clinical baseline. After cohort-specific adaptation, future-state forecasting outperformed a no-change persistence baseline in two independent aging cohorts. VitaFlux provides a unified framework for representing health-state position, forecasting near-term dynamics and quantifying longer-term progression from longitudinal clinical records.
zh_abstract: 纵向临床记录能够捕捉健康变化，但大多数模型将其简化为终点风险或单时间点生物学年龄估计。我们开发了 VitaFlux，一种表征学习框架，利用下一次就诊预测将临床就诊编码为潜在健康状态。应用于浙江人群健康队列中 178,970 名个体、4,439,390 次对齐就诊，VitaFlux 学习到一种可重复的表征，该表征由年龄相关、疾病负担和多系统生理变异组织。预测不稳定性测量了预测的下一次就诊健康状态变化，并与观察到的 1 年和 3 年死亡率相关。连续轨迹测量捕捉了异质性进展，而当前和预测状态与全面的临床基线相比改善了多种临床结局的预测。经过队列特异性适配后，未来状态预测在两个独立衰老队列中优于无变化持续性基线。VitaFlux 提供了一个统一框架，用于表征健康状态位置、预测近期动态并量化来自纵向临床记录的长期进展。

title: Artificial intelligence model for pancreatic cancer risk prediction in patients with pancreatic cystic lesions
zh_title: AI模型预测胰腺囊性病变患者胰腺癌风险
summary: 基于影像报告与临床数据开发AI模型，在8707例胰腺囊性病变患者的多站点回顾队列中预测胰腺癌发生风险。
key_points: 纳入23398份腹盆CT/MRI报告、8707例患者
1.8%患者后续发生胰腺癌
XGBoost最优，AUC约0.94–0.96
reason: 多站点回顾性研究、样本数千，但未见独立外部验证或前瞻设计，属值得一看档
abstract: Pancreatic cystic lesions (PCLs) are prevalent and potential precursors of pancreatic cancer. Cancer risk assessment is a crucial step in PCL management, but the complexity and limited accuracy of existing approaches contribute to suboptimal patient care. We developed and validated an artificial intelligence (AI) model that uses radiology reports and clinical data to predict the future risk of pancreatic cancer in patients with PCLs. The model was developed and tested in a 13-year retrospective cohort comprising 23,398 abdominal CT/MRI examination reports from 8707 patients with PCLs across a multisite healthcare system. Of these, 430 (1.8%) corresponded to patients who later developed pancreatic cancer, defined as adenocarcinoma, invasive mucinous neoplasm, or high-grade dysplasia. Among the models evaluated, XGBoost achieved the highest performance, with AUCs of 0.960, 0.945, and 0.944 for predicting pancreatic cancer incidence at 1, 3, and 5 years after imaging, respectively. The model outperformed guideline-based risk stratification, with AUC improvements of 0.161 to 0.235 ( P < 0.001). For examinations conducted within a year before cancer diagnosis, radiologists identified potential cancer in 51.5% of cases, while the AI model flagged 82.3%. These findings support the potential of AI to complement existing approaches for individualized pancreatic cancer risk stratification in patients with PCLs.
zh_abstract: 胰腺囊性病变（PCL）常见，并且是胰腺癌的潜在前驱病变。癌症风险评估是PCL管理中的关键步骤，但现有方法的复杂性和有限准确性导致患者照护欠佳。我们开发并验证了一种人工智能（AI）模型，该模型使用放射学报告和临床数据来预测PCL患者未来发生胰腺癌的风险。该模型在一个为期13年的回顾性队列中开发并测试，该队列包含来自多院区医疗系统8707例PCL患者的23,398份腹部CT/MRI检查报告。其中430份（1.8%）对应后来发生胰腺癌的患者，胰腺癌定义为腺癌、浸润性黏液性肿瘤或高级别异型增生。在评估的模型中，XGBoost表现最佳，预测影像检查后1年、3年和5年胰腺癌发病率的AUC分别为0.960、0.945和0.944。该模型优于基于指南的风险分层，AUC提高0.161至0.235（P<0.001）。对于癌症诊断前一年内进行的检查，放射科医生在51.5%的病例中识别出潜在癌症，而AI模型标记了82.3%。这些发现支持AI在PCL患者个体化胰腺癌风险分层中补充现有方法的潜力。

title: Deep learning-based assessment of residual breast cancer after neoadjuvant treatment predicts outcomes.
zh_title: 深度学习评估乳腺癌新辅助治疗后残留病灶并预测结局
summary: 同行评审研究用可解释深度学习量化乳腺癌新辅助治疗后残留浸润病灶，并分析其与DFS和OS的关联。
key_points: 丹麦多中心队列纳入527例、1301张全切片图像
AI计算肿瘤组织比、肿瘤-间质比及AI-RCB评分
AI指标与无病生存和总生存相关
reason: 同行评审多中心回顾性概念验证，样本中等，属值得一看档
abstract: [Breast (Edinburgh, Scotland)] Residual disease (RD) after neoadjuvant therapy (NAT) gives important prognostic insights in breast cancer (BC). However, there is still uncertainty regarding who should receive adjuvant treatment. This proof-of-concept study applies deep learning (DL) to derive quantitative measures of residual invasive disease in the primary tumor bed on post-NAT specimens and assesses their prognostic value. We developed an automated, explainable DL pipeline that calculates tumor-tissue ratio (TTR), tumor-tumor + stroma ratio (TSR), invasive cancer cell density (ICCD), and an AI-based residual cancer burden-like (AI-RCB) score. Associations with disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS) were analyzed using Cox models in a multicentre Danish cohort of BC patients. A total of 1301 whole-slide images from 527 patients were analyzed. AI-derived metrics strongly correlated with pathologist-estimated cellularity (ρ = 0.70-0.78, p < 0.001). Higher post-NAT AI quantitative measures were significantly associated with inferior DFS and OS (all p < 0.03). In multivariable analysis, all metrics were independently prognostic of both DFS and OS. Replacing pathologist-estimated cellularity with TTR in the RCB formula (AI-RCB) resulted in prognostic discrimination comparable to the conventional RCB. AI-based quantification of RD cellularity on routine HE slides has the potential to provide an objective, reproducible, and explainable measure of residual disease after NAT. AI-metrics capture prognostic information that may refine post-treatment risk assessment.
zh_abstract: [Breast（苏格兰爱丁堡）] 乳腺癌（BC）患者新辅助治疗（NAT）后的残留病灶（RD）可提供重要的预后信息。然而，关于哪些患者应接受辅助治疗仍存在不确定性。这项概念验证研究应用深度学习（DL）对NAT后标本中原发肿瘤床的残留浸润性疾病进行定量测量，并评估其预后价值。我们开发了一个自动化、可解释的DL流程，用于计算肿瘤-组织比（TTR）、肿瘤-肿瘤+间质比（TSR）、浸润性癌细胞密度（ICCD）以及基于人工智能的类残留癌症负荷（AI-RCB）评分。在一个丹麦多中心BC患者队列中，使用Cox模型分析这些指标与无病生存期（DFS）和总生存期（OS）的关联。共分析了来自527例患者的1301张全切片图像。AI衍生指标与病理学家估计的细胞密度强相关（ρ = 0.70-0.78，p < 0.001）。NAT后较高的AI定量指标与较差的DFS和OS显著相关（所有p < 0.03）。在多变量分析中，所有指标均对DFS和OS具有独立预后价值。在RCB公式中以TTR替代病理学家估计的细胞密度（AI-RCB），其预后区分能力与传统RCB相当。基于AI对常规HE切片上RD细胞密度进行量化，有潜力为NAT后残留疾病提供一种客观、可重复且可解释的测量方法。AI指标所捕获的预后信息可能改进治疗后风险评估。

title: Medical Reasoning in Large Language Models: Development and Evaluation of the MedEvalArena Benchmark.
source: PubMed · Journal of medical Internet research
zh_title: MedEvalArena：大模型医学推理动态基准
summary: 构建可动态再生的医学推理基准，由6个前沿大模型循环出题、判定并作答评测。
key_points: 6家前沿模型对称循环生成选择题
LLM评审小组筛题，按专科分布配比
每模型贡献50道通过验证的题目

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Large language models (LLMs) perform strongly on medical specialty board multiple-choice questions (MCQs) but underperform in complex medical reasoning. This gap indicates a need to improve LLM medical reasoning and evaluation paradigms. This study aimed to develop and evaluate MedEvalArena, a dynamically regenerable benchmark for assessing medical reasoning in LLMs. In a symmetric round-robin format, 6 frontier LLMs from the OpenAI, Grok, Gemini, Claude, Kimi, and DeepSeek families generated challenging board-style medical MCQs, adjudicated question validity on an ensemble LLM-as-judge panel, and answered the validated examination. Candidate items were generated until each model contributed 50 validated questions according to Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC)/American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) physician specialty distributions, yielding a 300-question examination. Judges adjudicated candidate questions' logical validity and medical accuracy. We compared question-generation validity rates, assessed leave-one-out judge agreement, and tested for self-judging preference. Questions were audited for overlap with public MedQA (medical question-answering) benchmarks. We tested question-answering (QA) accuracy across LLMs using a binomial-logit generalized linear mixed model likelihood-ratio test. A generator-stratified 90-question subset was completed by 5 board-certified physicians for paired human-LLM analysis. We evaluated inference cost-accuracy tradeoffs. Multiple comparisons were adjusted by the Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure. zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 大语言模型（LLMs）在医学专科委员会多项选择题（MCQs）上表现强劲，但在复杂医学推理中表现不佳。这一差距表明需要改进 LLM 医学推理与评估范式。本研究旨在开发并评估 MedEvalArena，一个用于评估 LLM 医学推理的动态可再生基准。在对称循环赛制中，来自 OpenAI、Grok、Gemini、Claude、Kimi 和 DeepSeek 家族的 6 个前沿 LLM 生成了具有挑战性的委员会式医学 MCQs，在集成 LLM 作为评判者的专家组中裁定问题有效性，并回答了经过验证的考试。候选题目持续生成，直到每个模型根据美国医学院协会（Association of American Medical Colleges, AAMC）/美国医学专科委员会（American Board of Medical Specialties, ABMS）医师专科分布贡献 50 个验证问题，从而形成一份 300 题考试。评判者裁定候选题目的逻辑有效性和医学准确性。我们比较了问题生成有效率，评估了留一法评判者一致性，并检验了自我评判偏好。对问题进行了审计，以检查与公开 MedQA（medical question-answering）基准的重叠。我们使用二项-逻辑广义线性混合模型似然比检验来检验 LLM 间的问答（QA）准确性。一个按生成器分层的 90 题子集由 5 名委员会认证医师完成，用于配对的人类-LLM 分析。我们评估了推理成本-准确性权衡。多重比较采用 Benjamini-Hochberg（BH）程序校正。对于由 OpenAI（94.8%，Wilson 95% CI 85.9%-98.2%）、Gemini（92.3%，95% CI 83.2%-96.7%）和 Claude（83.3%，95% CI 72.6%-90.4%）模型生成的问题，评判专家组有效率显著高于由 Kimi（63.8%，95% CI 54.3%-72.4%）、Grok（56%，95% CI 45.8%-65.8%）和 DeepSeek（46.0%，95% CI 37.4%-54.7%）生成的问题。Kimi 还显示出显著高于 DeepSeek 的有效性（两样本比例检验；BH 校正 P=.01）。公开来源相似性审计未发现完全或近似重复匹配。留一法评判者一致性为中等。生成器特异的同家族评判系数为非负（0 至 11.0 个百分点）；然而，经 BH 校正后无一仍显著。在 300 题考试中，6 个前沿 LLM 的 QA 准确性范围为 85.7%（257/300）至 91.7%（275/300），它们之间无显著差异（广义线性混…

title: Who Gets Re-ranked When a Clinical Model Gains New Data?
zh_title: 临床模型新增数据后谁被重新排序
summary: 在两家医院急诊队列中分析模型新增检验或影像文本数据后，不同数据可及患者的排序变化。
key_points: MC-MED 78,475次急诊就诊分析
MIMIC-IV-ED 10万次就诊做预注册复现
缺新数据的患者排序仍可能改变
reason: 预印本但含第二家医院预注册外部复现，样本量大并揭示更新带来的排序公平问题
abstract: Hospitals often update a deployed risk model by adding a data source, such as laboratory results, that only some patients have. Work on safe model updates assumes fixed inputs and so ignores patients who lack the new data. The update has no new measurements for them, yet their rank can change, and a sick patient not yet tested can drop off an alert list. We split rank-based compatibility by data availability and pair it with error correction and alert-list effects. We compared each update with ordinary retraining on the old inputs, predicting ICU admission or death and hospital admission, on 78,475 emergency department visits from MC-MED and, in a pre-registered replication, 100,000 stays from MIMIC-IV-ED at a second hospital. Radiograph report text gave no detectable gain and almost no extra re-ranking. Laboratory results improved prediction but, at both hospitals and with linear or tree models, pushed patients without labs down alert lists; linear updates also reshuffled them more than retraining did, without ranking them better. A top-20% admission list caught 4.2% of admitted patients without labs after the update, against 18.8% after retraining (second hospital: 4.9% against 22.6%), while catching more patients overall. This held for list sizes from 5% to 50% and in every patient group we checked, despite better measured calibration. Separate alert thresholds for patients with and without labs restored most or all of their catch rate at both hospitals at almost no cost. Teams should check these patients before deploying such an update.
zh_abstract: 医院通常通过添加仅部分患者具有的数据源（如实验室结果）来更新已部署的风险模型。关于安全模型更新的工作假设输入固定，因此忽略了缺乏新数据的患者。更新没有他们的新测量值，但他们的排名可能改变，尚未检测的患病患者可能从警报列表中掉出。我们按数据可用性拆分基于排名的兼容性，并将其与误差校正和警报列表效应配对。我们将每次更新与基于旧输入的普通再训练进行比较，预测ICU入住或死亡以及住院，在来自MC-MED的78,475次急诊科就诊中，并在预注册重复中，在第二家医院的MIMIC-IV-ED的100,000次住院中进行。放射学报告文本未带来可检测的增益，且几乎没有额外重排序。实验室结果改善了预测，但在两家医院以及使用线性或树模型时，均将没有实验室结果的患者推向警报列表下方；线性更新还比再训练更多地重新排列他们，却没有更好地对他们进行排名。更新后，前20%住院警报列表捕获了4.2%的无实验室结果住院患者，而再训练后为18.8%（第二家医院：4.9%对22.6%），同时总体上捕获更多患者。这一现象在5%至50%的列表规模以及我们检查的每个患者组中均成立，尽管测得的校准更好。对有和无实验室结果的患者采用单独的警报阈值，在两家医院以几乎零成本恢复了其大部分或全部捕获率。团队在部署此类更新前应检查这些患者。

title: Meddies-PII: A Multilingual Framework for Personally Identifiable Information Extraction in Clinical De-identification
zh_title: Meddies-PII：临床文本多语言去标识化框架

在德语、西班牙语人工标注临床语料上无需适配即可与最优公开系统竞争

abstract: Multilingual PII extraction in clinical text is limited by scarce governed data and by synthetic corpora whose construction is thinly documented. We present a large multilingual dataset covering seventeen languages, including seven Southeast Asian languages, and nine PII labels. We also document a detailed generation pipeline and release the complete prompts, catalogues, checks and label maps. A compact 350M-parameter BIOES token classifier trained on the resource achieves the highest score on all fifteen public benchmarks, significantly ahead of the strongest of four public systems on fourteen of them, with a mean exact-match F1 of 0.827 against 0.672 for the strongest system. We also tested it, without adaptation, on multilingual benchmarks, including two human-annotated German and Spanish clinical-style corpora, where it is competitive with the best public systems once annotation conventions are aligned, and is best in four of ten MultiGraSCCo languages; the results show that performance transfers across public benchmarks. We also analyse the data and find almost no near-duplicates and no text overlap between training and any evaluation set. The dataset, benchmark, model, generation framework and evaluation code are planned for public release upon acceptance.
zh_abstract: 临床文本中的多语言 PII 提取受限于受治理数据稀缺，以及构建过程记录不足的合成语料库。我们呈现一个大型多语言数据集，覆盖十七种语言，包括七种东南亚语言，以及九个 PII 标签。我们还记录了详细的生成流程，并发布完整的提示词、目录、检查项和标签映射。在此资源上训练的紧凑型 350M 参数 BIOES 词元分类器在全部十五个公开基准上取得最高分，在其中十四个基准上显著领先于四个公开系统中最强者，平均精确匹配 F1 为 0.827，而最强系统为 0.672。我们还在未做适配的情况下在多语言基准上测试了它，包括两个人工标注的德语和西班牙语临床风格语料库；在标注规范对齐后，它与最佳公开系统具有竞争力，并在十个 MultiGraSCCo 语言中的四个上表现最佳；结果表明性能可在公开基准之间迁移。我们还分析了数据，发现几乎没有近重复样本，并且训练集与任何评估集之间都没有文本重叠。数据集、基准、模型、生成框架和评估代码计划在录用后公开发布。

title: A Multiagent Large Language Model Framework for Longitudinal Multimodal Tracking of Wet Age-Related Macular Degeneration: Retrospective Feasibility Study.
zh_title: 多智能体大模型纵向追踪湿性AMD
summary: 基于GPT-4o与AutoGen的多智能体框架，整合湿性AMD纵向多模态影像与治疗记录生成结构化报告。
key_points: 三层多智能体LLM框架
视觉定位提示驱动影像智能体

abstract: [JMIR formative research] Wet age-related macular degeneration (AMD) requires long-term, high-frequency management involving multimodal retinal imaging across repeated follow-up visits. Reconstructing disease trajectories from fragmented imaging reports, treatment histories, and clinical notes creates a substantial information integration burden for clinicians in routine chronic disease management. This study aimed to evaluate the preliminary feasibility of a proof-of-concept, multiagent large language model (LLM) framework that integrates longitudinal multimodal imaging findings and treatment records into structured reports to support clinician review during wet AMD follow-up. We developed a 3-layer multiagent LLM framework using GPT-4o and AutoGen. The framework consisted of modality-specific perception agents using a visual grounding prompting strategy, an integration agent, and a tracking report agent. To test technical feasibility, the framework was evaluated on a dense retrospective pilot dataset of 12 patients encompassing 69 long-term follow-up visits. AI-generated outputs were assessed against expert review at the visit level and through report-level quality scoring. In this exploratory cohort, the framework achieved a mean visit-level activity classification accuracy of 80.8% (SD 3.4%) across 4 independent runs (range 78.3%-85.5%), with a mean Cohen κ of 0.605 (SD 0.072; range 0.549-0.705). The framework generated structured longitudinal summaries of disease activity, multimodal findings, and treatment histories. The visual grounding prompting strategy reduced the nonimage reference rate from 13.8% (12/87) to 1.1% (1/87), supporting more consistent grounding of image-based outputs in visual evidence. This proof-of-concept study supports the preliminary feasibility of using a multiagent LLM framework to organize longitudinal multimodal wet AMD follow-up data and produce structured summaries for clinician review. These reports are intended to support review of disease progression and treatment response associations during longitudinal follow-up. Future prospective multicenter studies with larger patient cohorts should evaluate whether these reports improve clinical workflow efficiency, reduce clinician workload, and support follow-up management decisions.
zh_abstract: [JMIR formative research] 湿性年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）需要长期、高频管理，涉及在反复随访就诊中进行多模态视网膜影像检查。从碎片化影像报告、治疗史和临床记录中重建疾病轨迹，给常规慢性病管理中的临床医生带来巨大的信息整合负担。本研究旨在评估一个概念验证性多智能体大语言模型（LLM）框架的初步可行性，该框架将纵向多模态影像所见和治疗记录整合为结构化报告，以支持湿性 AMD 随访期间的临床医生审阅。我们使用 GPT-4o 和 AutoGen 开发了一个 3 层多智能体 LLM 框架。该框架由采用视觉接地提示策略的模态特异性感知智能体、一个整合智能体和一个追踪报告智能体组成。为测试技术可行性，该框架在一个包含 12 名患者、69 次长期随访就诊的密集回顾性试点数据集上进行了评估。AI 生成输出在访视层面与专家审阅进行对照评估，并通过报告层面质量评分进行评估。在这一探索性队列中，该框架在 4 次独立运行中达到平均访视层面活动性分类准确率 80.8%（SD 3.4%）（范围 78.3%-85.5%），平均 Cohen κ 为 0.605（SD 0.072；范围 0.549-0.705）。该框架生成了疾病活动性、多模态所见和治疗史的结构化纵向摘要。视觉接地提示策略将非图像引用率从 13.8%（12/87）降至 1.1%（1/87），支持基于图像的输出更一致地建立在视觉证据之上。这项概念验证研究支持使用多智能体 LLM 框架组织纵向多模态湿性 AMD 随访数据并生成结构化摘要供临床医生审阅的初步可行性。这些报告旨在支持纵向随访期间对疾病进展与治疗反应关联的审阅。未来需要更大患者队列的前瞻性多中心研究，评估这些报告是否能改善临床工作流程效率、减少临床医生工作量并支持随访管理决策。

title: From detection to clinical comprehension: a cognitive hierarchy for the epistemic and ethical limits of artificial intelligence in radiology.
zh_title: 放射学AI的认知层级与伦理边界
summary: 同行评审观点文章提出检测、分类、诊断、临床理解四级认知层级，讨论放射学AI的认识论与伦理限度。
key_points: 借鉴Ackoff数据—信息—知识—智慧模型构建四级层级
指出检出病灶不等于理解疾病
结合放射学感知研究与医学认识论权威讨论
reason: 有信息量的概念框架型观点文章，无实证数据，按综述观点上限取值得一看档。
abstract: [La Radiologia medica] Artificial intelligence (AI) detects findings in medical images at a level that, for specific tasks, matches or exceeds that of an expert radiologist. Detecting a finding, however, is not the same as understanding a disease. AI radiology literature rarely distinguishes between these two processes. This article proposes a four-level cognitive hierarchy, inspired by Ackoff's [1] model of data, information, knowledge, and wisdom, to analyze at which level current AI operates and its epistemic and ethical consequences. The four levels, detection, classification, diagnosis, and clinical comprehension, form a gradient of increasing cognitive demand. The last of these corresponds to the tacit knowledge described by Polanyi [2] and is consistent with classic studies of radiological perception. Recent literature on epistemic authority in medicine suggests that the gap between this level and AI reflects, at least in part, a difference in the type of justification underpinning clinical judgment. AI reliably automates the first two levels, makes partial progress on the third when structured clinical data are available, and currently lacks an operational counterpart for the fourth. This distinction has implications for the training of specialists and for clinical responsibility, which remains with the radiologist in AI-assisted diagnosis.
zh_abstract: [La Radiologia medica] 人工智能（AI）在医学图像中检测发现的能力，在特定任务上达到或超过专家放射科医师的水平。然而，检测到某一发现并不等同于理解一种疾病。AI放射学文献很少区分这两个过程。本文受Ackoff[1]的数据、信息、知识和智慧模型启发，提出一个四级认知层级，以分析当前AI在哪个层级运行及其认识论和伦理后果。这四个层级——检测、分类、诊断和临床理解——构成认知需求递增的梯度。最后一级对应于Polanyi[2]所描述的默会知识，并与放射学感知的经典研究一致。近期关于医学中认识论权威的文献表明，这一层级与AI之间的差距至少部分反映了支撑临床判断的证成类型差异。AI可靠地自动化前两个层级，在可获得结构化临床数据时在第三层级取得部分进展，目前尚缺乏第四层级的可操作对应物。这一区分对专科医师培训和临床责任具有意义；在AI辅助诊断中，临床责任仍由放射科医师承担。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Aided Design of Peptides with Custom Secondary Structure Motifs and Reduced Amino Acid Alphabets.
source: PubMed · Journal of chemical information and modeling
zh_title: AI设计定制二级结构基序与缩减氨基酸字母表的肽
summary: 研究构建生成式AI蛋白设计模型，针对定制二级结构基序与缩减氨基酸字母表进行设计与评估。
key_points: 结合覆盖理论与生成式AI进行肽设计

abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] Proteins are highly diverse functional polymers where the specific sequence of amino acids, selected from a standard genetically encoded alphabet of 20 (C20), determines the structure and ultimately the function of the resulting folded protein. This standard alphabet has been identified to be nonrandomly distributed in physicochemical properties crucial to both structure formation and function, often referred to as coverage theory. While machine learning models have drastically improved protein structure prediction, success of protein design models lags structure prediction, particularly for custom secondary structure motifs and amino acid alphabets. Here, we therefore bridge contemporary biological theory with recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) to develop and evaluate a generative AI protein design model, trained on hundreds of thousands of proteins within the RCSB PDB, for custom secondary structure motifs using reduced amino acid alphabets (RAAs). Results indicate an overall success in designing novel proteins with desired secondary structure motifs for a broad range of amino acid alphabets and complexity of designs. Interestingly, for a substantial fraction of designs, ESMFold predicts a fold close to that of the target structure despite training only on physicochemical sequence space and secondary structure information. The development of this model advances research across multiple disciplines, from general scientific AI architecture development to protein design for biotechnology, astrobiology, and early-Earth evolutionary biology.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling] 蛋白质是高度多样的功能聚合物，其中从由 20 种（C20）标准遗传编码字母表中选择的特定氨基酸序列决定了结构，并最终决定所得折叠蛋白质的功能。该标准字母表已被发现在对结构形成和功能均至关重要的物理化学性质上呈非随机分布，这通常被称为覆盖理论（coverage theory）。尽管机器学习模型已大幅提升蛋白质结构预测，蛋白质设计模型的成功仍落后于结构预测，尤其是在定制二级结构基序和氨基酸字母表方面。因此，我们在此将当代生物学理论与人工智能（AI）的最新进展相结合，开发并评估一个生成式 AI 蛋白质设计模型；该模型在 RCSB PDB 中的数十万个蛋白质上训练，用于使用简化氨基酸字母表（RAAs）设计定制二级结构基序。结果表明，在广泛的氨基酸字母表和设计复杂度范围内，设计具有所需二级结构基序的新蛋白质总体上是成功的。有趣的是，对于相当一部分设计，尽管仅在物理化学序列空间和二级结构信息上训练，ESMFold 预测的折叠仍接近目标结构的折叠。该模型的开发推进了跨多个学科的研究，从通用科学 AI 架构开发到面向生物技术、天体生物学和早期地球演化生物学的蛋白质设计。

title: BlindDDG: A Blind Evaluation-Based Method for Protein Mutation Stability Prediction.
source: PubMed · Journal of chemical information and modeling
zh_title: BlindDDG：盲评估式蛋白质突变稳定性预测
summary: 提出BlindDDG框架，将蛋白质突变稳定性预测由ΔΔG定量回归改为稳定性变化方向分类，并引入盲评估策略建模突变效应。
key_points: 将定量回归任务重构为方向性稳定性变化分类
引入盲评估策略学习突变诱导的变化

reason: 方法有新意但仅见摘要，未提及外部验证或开源，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] Protein thermodynamic stability changes upon mutation profoundly affect protein structure and biological function. Recent advances in deep learning and protein language models have provided powerful tools for computational analysis of mutation-induced stability changes. However, most existing methods focus on quantitative regression of free-energy changes, which places strong dependence on precise experimentally measured ΔΔG values, although reliably determining the direction of stability change is itself an important objective in many practical applications. Here, we propose BlindDDG, a novel framework that reformulates protein mutation stability prediction from quantitative ΔΔG estimation to direction-oriented stability change classification. First, we introduce a blind-evaluation strategy that models mutation-induced changes by learning the representation difference between wild-type and mutant proteins, rather than relying solely on their individual intrinsic properties. This formulation focuses on the direction of stability changes and reduces the dependence on precise quantitative ΔΔG measurements. Second, a Siamese architecture with shared parameters is employed to encode the wild-type and mutant states and capture subtle mutation-associated differences. Third, a local structure-aware cross-attention mechanism is developed to integrate mutation-centered structural information with global protein language model representations, enabling effective multimodal feature interaction. Experimental results on the independent S669 benchmark demonstrate that BlindDDG achieves strong classification performance, obtaining an F1 score of 0.5449, an MCC of 0.3929, an accuracy of 0.7721, and a recall of 0.5417 for stabilizing mutation identification. BlindDDG outperforms all evaluated methods in F1 score, MCC, accuracy, and recall, highlighting its effectiveness in capturing mutation-induced stability changes, particularly for imbalanced stability classification.
zh_abstract: [Journal of chemical information and modeling] 突变引起的蛋白质热力学稳定性变化深刻影响蛋白质结构和生物学功能。深度学习和蛋白质语言模型的最新进展为计算分析突变诱导的稳定性变化提供了强大工具。然而，现有大多数方法集中于自由能变化的定量回归，这强烈依赖于精确实验测得的ΔΔG值，尽管可靠确定稳定性变化的方向本身在许多实际应用中就是一个重要目标。在此，我们提出BlindDDG，一种新颖框架，它将蛋白质突变稳定性预测从定量ΔΔG估计重新表述为面向方向的稳定性变化分类。首先，我们引入盲评估策略，通过学习野生型与突变型蛋白质之间的表示差异来建模突变诱导的变化，而不是仅依赖它们各自的固有性质。该表述聚焦于稳定性变化的方向，并降低对精确定量ΔΔG测量的依赖。其次，采用共享参数的孪生架构来编码野生型和突变型状态，并捕获细微的突变相关差异。第三，开发局部结构感知交叉注意力机制，将突变中心的结构信息与全局蛋白质语言模型表示相整合，从而实现有效的多模态特征交互。在独立S669基准上的实验结果表明，BlindDDG取得较强的分类性能，在稳定化突变识别中获得F1分数0.5449、MCC 0.3929、准确率0.7721和召回率0.5417。BlindDDG在F1分数、MCC、准确率和召回率上均优于所有评估方法，凸显其在捕获突变诱导的稳定性变化方面的有效性，尤其是对于不平衡的稳定性分类。

title: AI foundation models for pathology and how to use them.

abstract: [Minimally invasive therapy & allied technologies : MITAT : official journal of the Society for Minimally Invasive Therapy] Foundation models (FMs) are transforming artificial intelligence by generating large-scale representations of data that can be adapted across diverse downstream tasks. In computational pathology, the emergence of FMs trained on whole-slide images (WSIs) promises to reduce annotation burden, improve generalization, and enable multimodal disease modeling. This review summarizes the evolution in AI and deep learning that enabled pathology FM and surveys major publicly reported models developed by both academia and industry. To construct a comprehensive and representative survey of pathology foundation models, we performed a narrative literature search targeting peer-reviewed journals, preprint repositories (arXiv, medRxiv), and major Artificial Intelligence in medicine conferences up to mid-2026. The search strategy utilized combinations of keywords including 'pathology foundation model', 'self-supervised learning whole-slide images', and 'computational pathology vision transformers'. The survey highlights the current landscape of high-performing models while discussing their clinical promise alongside key technical and implementation challenges. Pathology foundation models represent a significant shift in the field. Future directions must focus on developing multimodal architectures and achieving seamless clinical integration to fully realize their potential.
zh_abstract: [Minimally invasive therapy & allied technologies : MITAT : official journal of the Society for Minimally Invasive Therapy] 基础模型（FMs）正在通过生成可适配多种下游任务的大规模数据表征来改变人工智能。在计算病理学中，基于全切片图像（WSIs）训练的FMs的出现有望减少标注负担、改善泛化并实现多模态疾病建模。本综述总结了使病理学FM成为可能的人工智能与深度学习演进，并调查了学术界和产业界开发的已公开报道的主要模型。为构建全面且有代表性的病理学基础模型调查，我们进行了叙述性文献检索，目标为截至2026年中期的同行评议期刊、预印本存储库（arXiv、medRxiv）以及主要医学人工智能会议。检索策略使用了关键词组合，包括“pathology foundation model”、“self-supervised learning whole-slide images”和“computational pathology vision transformers”。该调查强调了当前高性能模型的格局，同时讨论了其临床前景以及关键技术与实施挑战。病理学基础模型代表了该领域的重大转变。未来方向必须集中于开发多模态架构并实现无缝临床整合，以充分发挥其潜力。

title: AI-based histopathologic grading for predicting biochemical recurrence in prostate cancer.

abstract: [BJU international] Our objective was to evaluate artificial intelligence (AI)-based Gleason grading of prostate cancer (PCa) biopsies compared with expert pathologist-based consensus grading and clinical risk factors for predicting biochemical recurrence (BCR) after radical prostatectomy. Although Gleason grading is the most validated prognostic factor in PCa, interobserver variability may affect its prognostic accuracy, particularly for intermediate-risk tumours and non-subspecialty pathologists. Whole-slide images from PCa biopsy specimens were analysed in patients originally diagnosed with grade group (GG)-2 PCa by general pathologists; patients subsequently underwent radical prostatectomy (n = 217). A representative biopsy slide containing up to two cores was analysed per case. Gleason scores were re-assigned by consensus among three genitourinary pathologists or by AI model. Cox proportional hazards models were constructed using CAPRA (Cancer of the Prostate Risk Assessment) score, percent pattern 4 (%p4), and cribriform/intraductal carcinoma, derived from either pathologist consensus or AI-based grading. Discrimination was described with Harrell's C-index; the pathologist-based and AI-based multivariable models were formally compared using Uno's C-statistic, 3- and 5-year time-dependent area under the curve, and Akaike information criterion. In total, 35 patients (16%) had BCR. In univariable models, AI-based GG had a numerically higher C-index than consensus pathologist GG (0.66 vs 0.61). Similarly, CAPRA score incorporating AI-based GG (AI-CAPRA) had a numerically higher C-index than that incorporating consensus-pathologist GG (pathologist-CAPRA) (0.68 vs 0.65). In multivariable models, AI-detected cribriform/intraductal carcinoma independently predicted an increased risk of BCR when combined with AI-CAPRA and AI %p4 (hazard ratio 2.97; 95% confidence interval 1.11-7.91), whereas neither pathologist-detected cribriform/intraductal carcinoma nor pathologist-detected %p4 was independently prognostic when combined with pathologist-CAPRA. AI-based Gleason grading had prognostic performance similar to that of expert pathologist consensus grading, alone or combined with clinical variables. AI-detected (but not pathologist-detected) cribriform/intraductal carcinoma had independent prognostic value in multivariable models with CAPRA score. These findings support a role for AI-assisted pathology in PCa risk stratification, particularly in settings without subspecialty genitou
zh_abstract: [BJU international] 我们的目标是评估基于人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）的前列腺癌（prostate cancer, PCa）活检 Gleason 分级，与专家病理学家基于共识的分级及临床危险因素相比，在预测根治性前列腺切除术后生化复发（biochemical recurrence, BCR）方面的表现。尽管 Gleason 分级是 PCa 中最经过验证的预后因素，但观察者间变异可能影响其预后准确性，尤其是对中危肿瘤和非亚专科病理学家。研究分析了最初由普通病理学家诊断为分级分组（grade group, GG）2 的 PCa 患者的 PCa 活检标本全切片图像；这些患者随后接受了根治性前列腺切除术（n = 217）。每例分析一张代表性活检切片，最多包含两个穿刺芯。Gleason 评分由三名泌尿生殖病理学家共识重新判定，或由 AI 模型重新判定。使用 CAPRA（Cancer of the Prostate Risk Assessment）评分、模式 4 百分比（percent pattern 4, %p4）以及筛状/导管内癌（cribriform/intraductal carcinoma）构建 Cox 比例风险模型，这些变量分别来自病理学家共识或基于 AI 的分级。采用 Harrell's C-index 描述区分度；使用 Uno's C-statistic、3 年和 5 年时间依赖曲线下面积以及 Akaike 信息准则，对基于病理学家的多变量模型和基于 AI 的多变量模型进行正式比较。总共 35 例患者（16%）发生 BCR。在单变量模型中，基于 AI 的 GG 的 C-index 在数值上高于共识病理学家 GG（0.66 vs 0.61）。同样，纳入基于 AI 的 GG 的 CAPRA 评分（AI-CAPRA）的 C-index 在数值上高于纳入共识病理学家 GG 的 CAPRA 评分（pathologist-CAPRA）（0.68 vs 0.65）。在多变量模型中，当与 AI-CAPRA 和 AI %p4 联合时，AI 检测到的筛状/导管内癌独立预测 BCR 风险增加（风险比 2.97；95% 置信区间 1.11-7.91），而病理学家检测到的筛状/导管内癌和病理学家检测到的 %p4 在与 pathologist-CAPRA 联合时均无独立预后价值。基于 AI 的 Gleason 分级单独使用或与临床变量联合时，其预后表现与专家病理学家共识分级相似。在与 CAPRA 评分的多变量模型中，AI 检测到（而非病理学家检测到）的筛状/导管内癌具有独立预后价值。这些发现支持 AI 辅助病理学在 PCa 风险分层中的作用，尤其是在没有亚专科 genitou 的情况下。

title: TrialAgentBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Clinical-Trial Analysis and Long-Horizon Drug-Development Decisions
zh_title: TrialAgentBench：评估临床试验分析与药物开发决策的智能体基准
summary: arXiv预印本发布约3500项任务的基准，用模拟试验评估AI智能体在临床试验分析与长周期药物开发决策中的表现。
key_points: 以模拟试验构建真值已知的评估环境
公开约3500项任务，覆盖单试验分析到多期项目决策
以重跑代码和决策价值分别衡量分析与决策质量
reason: 公开约3500项任务的大规模智能体基准有实用价值，但为预印本、无临床结局
abstract: Clinical drug development is a long-horizon, high-stakes process requiring sequential decisions based on information that costs money and time to acquire. AI agents have demonstrated capabilities for scientific analysis, but there is no established way to evaluate them on these decisions, as real trials are expensive, involve people, and never reveal the counterfactual. We introduce TrialAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on clinical trial analysis and drug development decision-making using simulated trials where the truth is known, embedded within the data records of a fictional drug sponsor. We publicly release nearly 3,500 tasks, varying from analysing a single trial to managing multi-phase programmes with budget and time constraints. We score each analysis by rerunning its code on new trials, and each programme by the value its decisions achieve. Across 24 closed- and open-weight models, the strongest agents can analyse raw, messy trial records to within 6% of a process-aware analysis, even when an assumption is violated, with 95% confidence intervals containing the true effect 94--95% of the time. Over the prior year, the best model improved from 19% above this analysis, with serious misses on 15% of tasks, to 3.5% and 1%. What limits them is decision-making from evidence under uncertainty: when to correct, what evidence to buy, when to stop. The strongest agents are overly careful, correcting on 83% of tasks with equal recording errors, where it is unnecessary. On drug programmes, the best agent has substantial headroom, reaching 48% of the value an oracle achieves against 58% for a rule-based developer, with others falling 24 to 66% short. Model generations show ongoing improvements in handling data and evidence, with substantial variation. The strongest models can act as competent analysts, but do not yet make reliable long-horizon decisions.
zh_abstract: 临床药物开发是一个长周期、高风险的过程，需要基于获取起来既费钱又费时的信息做出序贯决策。AI智能体已在科学分析方面展现出能力，但目前尚无既定方法来评估它们在这些决策上的表现，因为真实试验昂贵、涉及人，且从不揭示反事实。我们推出TrialAgentBench，这是一个用于评估AI智能体在临床试验分析和药物开发决策方面表现的基准，使用已知真实结果的模拟试验，并嵌入一家虚构药物申办方的数据记录中。我们公开发布近3,500项任务，范围从分析单项试验到在预算和时间约束下管理多阶段项目。我们通过在 новых试验上重新运行其代码来对每项分析评分，并通过其决策所实现的价值对每个项目评分。在24个闭源和开放权重模型中，最强的智能体能够分析原始、杂乱的试验记录，其结果与过程感知分析的差距在6%以内，即使在某一假设被违反时也是如此，95%置信区间在94%–95%的情况下包含真实效应。在过去一年中，最佳模型从比该分析高19%、且在15%任务上出现严重遗漏，改善到3.5%和1%。限制它们的是在不确定性下基于证据进行决策：何时纠正、购买何种证据、何时停止。最强的智能体过于谨慎，在记录错误相同的情况下对83%的任务进行了纠正，而这是不必要的。在药物项目上，最佳智能体仍有很大提升空间，达到oracle所实现价值的48%，而基于规则的开发者达到58%，其他模型则落后24%至66%。各代模型在处理数据和证据方面表现出持续改进，但差异很大。最强模型可以作为称职的分析师，但尚不能做出可靠的长期决策。

title: Development and Validation of an Artificial Intelligence-Driven Multigene Assay Decision-Support System for Personalized Management of T1 High-Grade Bladder Cancer.
zh_title: AI驱动多基因检测辅助T1高级别膀胱癌决策
summary: 将多组学分层框架转化为30基因RT-qPCR联合临床病理变量的AI决策辅助，预测进展与复发。
key_points: 30基因TaqMan检测结合临床病理变量
预测疾病进展与复发风险
含卡介苗与膀胱灌注等治疗情境模块
reason: 将既有框架转化为常规病理可用工具，验证设计规范但条目未显示外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [MedComm] T1 high-grade bladder cancer presents a therapeutic dilemma, as current risk stratification fails to guide the choice between early cystectomy and bladder-preserving therapy. In our recent work, we defined a high-risk multiomic subtype driven by anoikis resistance and immune evasion and developed the T1HG-UCBguider framework for risk stratification; however, its reliance on multiomic sequencing limits clinical implementation. Here, we translate this framework into Guider, an artificial intelligence-driven reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) decision-aid designed for cost-conscious use in routine pathology workflows and integrating a 30-gene TaqMan assay with clinicopathological variables to predict progression and recurrence, with exploratory treatment-context modules for no instillation, Bacillus Calmette-Guérin, and intravesical chemotherapy. In a multicenter ambispective cohort of 1198 patients, Guider achieved > 10% higher absolute predictive performance than guideline-based risk groups and the published 12-gene progression score within this Chinese T1 high-grade cohort. Reclassification identified 82.5% of guideline-defined high-risk patients who progressed and 45.1% of very-high-risk nonprogressors who might be considered for bladder preservation. Guider could potentially support treatment de-escalation in 29.7% and escalation in 12.9% of patients. These findings establish a scalable translational framework bridging multiomic discovery and clinical decision support, warranting prospective interventional validation in geographically, ethnically, and demographically diverse populations.
zh_abstract: [MedComm] T1高级别膀胱癌呈现治疗困境，因为当前风险分层无法指导早期膀胱切除术与保留膀胱治疗之间的选择。在我们最近的工作中，我们定义了一种由失巢凋亡抵抗和免疫逃逸驱动的高风险多组学亚型，并开发了用于风险分层的T1HG-UCBguider框架；然而，其对多组学测序的依赖限制了临床实施。在此，我们将该框架转化为Guider，一种人工智能驱动的逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）决策辅助工具，旨在常规病理工作流程中考虑成本效益使用，并将30基因TaqMan检测与临床病理变量相结合以预测进展和复发，并具有针对无灌注、卡介苗（Bacillus Calmette-Guérin）和膀胱内化疗的探索性治疗情境模块。在一个1198例患者的多中心双向性队列中，Guider在此中国T1高级别队列中比基于指南的风险分组和已发表的12基因进展评分实现了>10%的更高绝对预测性能。重新分类识别出82.5%的指南定义高风险且发生进展的患者，以及45.1%的极高风险且未进展、可能考虑保留膀胱的患者。Guider可能支持29.7%患者的治疗降阶梯和12.9%患者的治疗升阶梯。这些发现建立了一个可扩展的转化框架，连接多组学发现与临床决策支持，值得在地理、民族和人口学多样化人群中进行前瞻性干预验证。

title: High-risk pancreatic cancer pathology reveals a B3GNT3-associated glycosylation program.
zh_title: 高危胰腺癌病理揭示B3GNT3相关糖基化程序
summary: 同行评审研究整合TCGA与福建医科大学附属协和医院H&E全切片，构建GlyPath-Risk病理组学预后评分并探索其高风险表型的分子状态。

在训练、内部验证及外部队列评估预后表现
