zh_abstract: 患者层面划分是医学影像评估中防止受试者泄漏的标准保障，但它无法消除每个折都继承的一个混杂因素：一个在整个队列中与诊断对齐的采集变量。我们提出针对候选混杂因素的五问审计：它对诊断的预测能力如何，它能否从图像中被解码，诊断评分是否依赖于它，图像是否在其之外提供增量预测价值，以及在控制它之后还能保留多少区分度。我们将其应用于DMR-IR，这是大多数乳腺热成像机器学习结果所依赖的公共数据集。在严格患者不重叠方案下的236名患者中，仅采集日期就能以AUROC 0.980预测恶性肿瘤，高于九个影像分支中的最佳者（0.949），因为良性和恶性患者是在不同年份招募的。采集年份

zh_title: 临床AI评估中的观察偏倚：从记录到基准的循环

As this evidence travels into publications and reference knowledge graphs, crucial distinctions disappear: unexamined symptoms blur with confirmed negatives, and chronological disease progression is lost. title: Ruby: State-of-the-Art Potency Prediction across Discovery Regimes Using Learned Structural Representations
zh_title: Ruby：利用学习到的结构表征预测候选化合物效价
summary: 预印本提出基于结构基础模型中间表征的效价预测器Ruby，无需每个化合物都有明确结合构象，并发布公开效价训练数据集。

abstract: Small-molecule drug discovery proceeds through repeated design-make-test-analyze cycles. The goal is often to maximize potency while keeping other properties within the ranges required for a viable therapeutic candidate. Compound prioritization places different demands on computational methods as drug discovery progresses from hit identification through hit-to-lead and lead optimization, with changing computational budgets and increasing amounts of on-target experimental data. We introduce Ruby, a Robust Universal Binding affinitY predictor that uses intermediate representations from the structural foundation model Pearl without requiring an explicit binding pose for every compound. Ruby is trained on proprietary data plus GenesisPotency-2026, an audited public-source potency training dataset released for academic and commercial use under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license with row-level provenance
zh_abstract: 小分子药物发现通过反复的设计-合成-测试-分析循环推进。目标通常是最大化效力，同时使其他性质保持在可行治疗候选物所需范围内。随着药物发现从命中识别推进到命中到先导和先导优化，化合物优先级排序对计算方法提出了不同要求，计算预算不断变化，靶点实验数据量不断增加。我们介绍Ruby，一种稳健通用结合亲和力预测器（Robust Universal Binding affinitY predictor），它使用结构基础模型Pearl的中间表示，而不需要为每个化合物提供明确的结合构象。Ruby在专有数据以及GenesisPotency-2026上训练；GenesisPotency-2026是一个经过审计的公共来源效力训练数据集，依据CC BY-SA 4.0许可发布供学术和商业使用，并带有行级来源信息

title: MorphoHELM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Representations for Microscopy-Based Morphology Assays

abstract: Microscopy images contain rich information about how cells respond to perturbations, making them essential to applications like drug screening. To quantify images, researchers often use representation extraction methods, and recent years have seen a proliferation of deep learning methods. While measuring the quality of these representations is essential, evaluation remains fragmented, with each proposed model evaluated on different tasks and datasets, using custom pipelines and metrics, making it difficult to fairly compare models. Here, we introduce MorphoHELM, a comprehensive open benchmark for evaluating feature extraction methods for Cell Painting, the most widely-used morphological profiling assay. zh_abstract: 显微镜图像包含关于细胞如何响应扰动的大量信息，使其对药物筛选等应用至关重要。为量化图像，研究人员常使用表征提取方法，而近年来深度学习方法大量涌现。尽管衡量这些表征的质量至关重要，但评估仍然分散：每个提出的模型都在不同任务和数据集上、使用自定义流程和指标进行评估，导致难以公平比较模型。在此，我们推出 MorphoHELM，一个用于评估 Cell Painting 特征提取方法的综合性开放基准；Cell Painting 是使用最广泛的形态学表型分析检测。MorphoHELM 整合了该领域的评估标准，对其加以扩展和修正以使其更稳健，并在迄今最广泛的方法范围内进行评估。该基准的一个标志性特征是 ben

abstract: Visual Question Answering (VQA) holds great promise for clinical support, particularly in ophthalmology, where retinal fundus photography is essential for diagnosis. To ensure anatomical consistency and clinical validity, all lesions are spatially localized using the Early Treatment Diabetic Retinopathy Study (ETDRS) grid, enabling standardized mapping to nine clinically meaningful retinal regions. zh_abstract: 视觉问答（VQA）在临床支持方面具有巨大潜力，尤其是在眼科，因为视网膜眼底摄影对于诊断至关重要。然而，眼科 VQA 基准主要强调答案准确性，忽略了临床可解释性所需的显式视觉证据。在本工作中，我们介绍 FundusGround，一个新的基准，用于具有空间定位病灶证据的临床可解释眼科 VQA。具体而言，我们提出一个三阶段流程，收集了 10,719 张眼底图像，包含 15,595 个图像级精细标注的病灶。为确保解剖一致性和临床有效性，所有病灶均使用早期糖尿病视网膜病变治疗研究（ETDRS）网格进行空间定位，从而能够标准化映射到九个具有临床意义的视网膜区域。基于这种结构化病灶证据，72,706 个问题被

title: LingSante-Pulse: Unified Physiological Pretraining through Random-Feature Prediction and Cross-Modal Alignment

summary: 预印本提出统一生理表征框架，用随机特征预测与跨模态对齐联合学习异构生理记录。

abstract: Clinical monitoring and wearable devices capture complementary physiological signals, but their partially overlapping modality coverage makes within-signal information and cross-modal relationships difficult to exploit jointly. zh_abstract: 临床监测和可穿戴设备捕获互补的生理信号，但它们部分重叠的模态覆盖范围使得信号内信息和跨模态关系难以被联合利用。我们介绍 LingSante-Pulse，一个统一、通用且灵活的生理表示框架，可从这些异构记录中学习。一个共享的、以信号为条件的编码器独立处理每个物理通道，并支持不同数量和组合的信号，以进行多模态评估和单传感器推断。成对跨模态对齐、结构化随机特征预测（RFP）和掩码波形重建共同学习生理关系并保留有信息量的信号内结构。在涵盖 PPG、ECG、EEG 和 EMG 的 38 种通用生理任务配置中，冻结编码器达到了

title: SLP-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Acoustic Claims of Reasoning Audio Language Models on Clinical Speech

summary: 新基准按临床医生感知评分逐条核验推理音频模型对嗓音的陈述，覆盖5个数据集与25个维度。

abstract: Audio language models (ALMs) can answer clinical questions from speech, outperforming baselines built on handcrafted acoustic features. Reasoning ALMs generate a chain of thought that refers to properties of the speaker's voice before predicting. Each statement the model makes about the voice needs to be checked against clinicians' perceptual ratings of the same recording. On clinical speech, existing evaluations score only the final answer. We introduce Speech Language Pathologist Bench (SLP-Bench), a benchmark grading each acoustic claim in the chain of thought against clinicians' perceptual ratings of the same recording. It covers five clinician-rated datasets and 25 perceptual dimensions, and assesses claims for factuality, stability under resampling, and consistency across reworded and different questions. abstract: [Current problems in pediatric and adolescent health care] Adolescent mental health remains a topic of concern in the United States and worldwide. The COVID-19 pandemic accelerated the youth mental health crisis, which began nearly a decade earlier. The ongoing shortage of mental health professionals, including therapists and child and adolescent psychiatrists, means many adolescents who require mental health treatment do not receive it. The emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) technology has demonstrated promise in the field of adolescent mental health, including in screening, detection and risk prediction, intervention and treatment, clinical decision support and workflow augmentation, and in the training of future mental health professionals. However, the study of AI tools in the mental health space remains in its infancy, and most are not yet ready for routine use in clinical practice. Furthermore, the potential risks of AI and its use in adolescent mental health treatment are significant and must be addressed prior to widespread use. Health care professionals, adolescents, and their caregivers need to develop AI literacy to use the technology safely and responsibly. Additionally, AI governance and legal frameworks are necessary to ensure that AI technology use is safe, equitable and ethical for all users. At the present time, AI technology should serve a supportive and complementary role to human-delivered adolescent mental health care.

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Multi-omics integration amalgamates genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic layers to provide a systems-level portrait of multifaceted diseases such as cancer. However, its practical application faces constraints posed by challenges including elevated dimensionality, diverse data types, and prevalent missing values. This review delivers a structured summary of recent advances in machine-learning-driven integration of multi-omics datasets, with a specific emphasis on the potential of this field for translational cancer research. First, we discuss the importance of multi-omics integration. Next, we provide an overview of key machine learning methodologies, including high-dimensional variable selection techniques (e.g., knockoff filters for controlling the false discovery rate), deep learning models (for survival prediction and classification), and generative models (e.g., diffusion models and variational autoencoders for data augmentation and missing data imputation). These approaches demonstrate high accuracy in cancer subtype classification, biomarker discovery, prognosis evaluation, and personalized therapy. For example, they achieve over 85% accuracy in triple-negative breast cancer subtype analysis. We also cover the contributions of single-cell multi-omics technologies (e.g., SHARE-seq and SNARE-seq) and emerging databases (e.g., scImmOmics and scCancerExplorer) to enhancing data resolution. While challenges remain in terms of interpretability and computational efficiency, integrating explainable AI and multimodal learning shows promise in accelerating clinical translation. This review seeks to equip researchers with a systematic methodological roadmap and demonstrate its practical utility in precision medicine via exemplar case studies.

abstract: [Biomarker research] Although immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have transformed breast cancer treatment, predicting durable clinical benefit remains challenging. Current biomarkers, primarily derived from tumor tissue or peripheral blood, do not directly capture the adaptive immune response at its site of initiation. Tumor-draining lymph nodes (TDLNs) are not passive conduits for metastasis but dynamic immunological hubs where anti-tumor T cell priming and immune evasion converge. In this review, we critically examine the nascent intersection of TDLN immunobiology, high-resolution multi-omics, and artificial intelligence (AI) to evaluate TDLN-derived features as candidate next-generation biomarkers for immunotherapy. We synthesize the complex cellular and molecular architecture of the breast cancer TDLN, including T cell exhaustion, B cell-mediated immunity, and stromal crosstalk, before evaluating the state-of-the-art single-cell and spatial technologies capable of decoding this microenvironment. We assess the application of AI and foundation models in this domain, identifying a major methodological gap: while AI frameworks are increasingly mature for primary tumors, their application to TDLNs remains unvalidated and limited by a severe scarcity of annotated multi-omics datasets. Furthermore, we address pivotal translational considerations, including the immunological implications of axillary surgery in the ICI era. We emphasize that no TDLN-derived biomarker has yet undergone prospective validation as a predictive biomarker for immunotherapy in breast cancer, and that retrospective analyses of trial specimens must account for the timing of tissue acquisition relative to systemic therapy. Finally, we chart immediate research priorities, including establishing TDLN reference atlases and developing clinically feasible specimen collection pathways for biomarker validation. This review provides a conceptual framework and translational roadmap to assess whether TDLN-derived features can complement existing tumor-centric metrics in guiding immunotherapy decisions.
zh_abstract: 【生物标志物研究】尽管免疫检查点抑制剂（immune checkpoint inhibitors, ICIs）已经改变了乳腺癌治疗，但预测持久临床获益仍然具有挑战性。当前生物标志物主要来源于肿瘤组织或外周血，并未直接捕捉在其起始部位的适应性免疫反应。肿瘤引流淋巴结（tumor-draining lymph nodes, TDLNs）不是转移的被动通道，而是抗肿瘤 T 细胞致敏和免疫逃逸汇聚的动态免疫枢纽。在本综述中，我们批判性审视 TDLN 免疫生物学、高分辨率多组学和人工智能（AI）的新兴交叉领域，以评估 TDLN 衍生特征作为免疫治疗候选下一代生物标志物。我们先综合乳腺癌 TDLN 的复杂细胞和分子结构，包括 T 细胞耗竭、B 细胞介导的免疫和基质串扰，然后评估能够解码该微环境的最先进单细胞和空间技术。我们评估 AI 和基础模型在该领域的应用，指出了一个主要方法学空白：虽然 AI 框架对于原发肿瘤日益成熟，但其在 TDLN 中的应用仍未得到验证，并受限于严重缺乏带注释的多组学数据集。此外，我们讨论关键的转化考虑因素，包括 ICI 时代腋窝手术的免疫学意义。我们强调，尚无 TDLN 衍生生物标志物作为乳腺癌免疫治疗预测性生物标志物经过前瞻性验证，并且对试验标本的回顾性分析必须考虑组织获取相对于全身治疗的时间。最后，我们列出近期研究重点，包括建立 TDLN 参考图谱和开发临床可行的标本采集路径以用于生物标志物验证。本综述提供了一个概念框架和转化路线图，以评估 TDLN 衍生特征能否补充现有以肿瘤为中心的指标来指导免疫治疗决策。

abstract: Microbiome data analysis demands customized workflows tailored to specific biological questions, sequencing modalities, and data properties. However, constructing and executing these workflows requires navigating heterogeneous software dependencies, reference databases, and multi-step parameter tuning. Here, we present MicroBioAgent, an autonomous, domain-specific agent framework that translates high-level biological queries into executable, study-specific pipelines across 16S rRNA amplicon, reference-based shotgun, and de novo assembly-based metagenomics. Rather than relying on static pipeline templates, MicroBioAgent employs a closed-loop execution architecture: it dynamically selects and runs bioinformatics tools within user-controlled environments while iteratively inspecting intermediate outputs to adapt downstream analytical decisions. Furthermore, to address the long-running nature of metagenomic computation, we introduce an asynchronous background task-management mechanism that reduces LLM token consumption by over 50% while enabling real-time plan adjustment and automated workflow resumption. We systematically evaluated MicroBioAgent across three benchmarks of increasing complexity: (1) paired amplicon and shotgun profiling of tomato rhizosphere microbiomes, (2) taxonomic and functional profiling coupled with machine-learning classification in a colorectal cancer cohort, and (3) de novo metagenomic assembly, metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) binning, and metabolic pathway reconstruction in a polyethylene degradation study. Across all benchmarks, MicroBioAgent faithfully recapitulated the primary biological findings of the original studies, exhibiting high analytical concordance despite expected tool- and database-dependent variations. In systematic robustness evaluations across 27 independent runs spanning three backbone large language models and three prompt-complexity tiers, MicroBioAgent achieved a 98.8% task completion rate and yielded highly reproducible diversity and differential-abundance estimates. MicroBioAgent establishes a scalable, adaptive paradigm for end-to-end computational microbiome research.
zh_abstract: 微生物组数据分析需要针对特定生物学问题、测序模式和数据特性定制的工作流程。然而，构建和执行这些工作流程需要在异构软件依赖、参考数据库和多步骤参数调优中进行导航。在此，我们提出 MicroBioAgent，一个自主的、领域特定的智能体框架，可将高层次的生物学查询转化为跨16S rRNA扩增子、基于参考的鸟枪法和基于从头组装的宏基因组学的可执行、研究特异性流程。MicroBioAgent 不依赖静态流程模板，而是采用闭环执行架构：它在用户控制的环境中动态选择并运行生物信息学工具，同时迭代检查中间输出，以调整下游分析决策。此外，针对宏基因组计算的长时间运行特性，我们引入异步后台任务管理机制，在实现实时计划调整和自动化工作流恢复的同时，将LLM token消耗降低50%以上。我们在三个复杂度递增的基准上系统评估 MicroBioAgent：(1) 番茄根际微生物组的配对扩增子和鸟枪法谱分析；(2) 结直肠癌队列中的分类学和功能谱分析，并结合机器学习分类；(3) 聚乙烯降解研究中的从头宏基因组组装、宏基因组组装基因组（MAG）分箱和代谢通路重建。在所有基准中，MicroBioAgent 忠实重现了原始研究的主要生物学发现，尽管存在预期的工具和数据库依赖性差异，仍表现出高度分析一致性。在跨越三种骨干大语言模型和三个提示复杂度层级的27次独立运行的系统稳健性评估中，MicroBioAgent 达到98.8%的任务完成率，并产生高度可重复的多样性和差异丰度估计。MicroBioAgent 为端到端计算微生物组研究建立了一个可扩展、自适应的范式。

abstract: [Systematic reviews] Acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD) imposes a substantial burden on patients and healthcare systems. Although traditional risk assessment tools exist, machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) may offer improved prediction. This systematic review aims to evaluate the performance of ML and DL algorithms for predicting AECOPD risk. This review was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA guidelines. PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library and Web of Science were systematically searched from 1 January 2021 to 6 May 2026. Studies that developed or validated ML and DL models for predicting AECOPD risk were included. Methodological quality, risk of bias and applicability were assessed using the PROBAST + AI, and reporting quality was assessed using the TRIPOD + AI. Because of substantial heterogeneity, we synthesised model performance descriptively. Thirteen studies were included, of which only two performed external validation. Overall, reported AUC values ranged widely from 0.661 to 0.9721. By outcome type, AUC values for AECOPD risk prediction ranged from 0.668 to 0.9721, whereas those for AECOPD‑related hospitalisation ranged from 0.661 to 0.885. Similarly, by prediction windows, short‑term prediction achieved AUCs of 0.668‑0.972, compared with 0.661‑0.884 for long‑term prediction. However, PROBAST + AI revealed high methodological quality concerns and risk of bias in all 13 studies, and TRIPOD + AI showed suboptimal reporting transparency with an overall completeness rate of 54.3%. Limited evidence indicates that models for any AECOPD may outperform those for hospitalisation, and that models with shorter prediction windows may show higher AUCs, although this association could be confounded by small sample sizes and potential patient-level leakage. These findings provide valuable direction for future model development and validation, although the current evidence base is constrained by methodological quality concerns, risk of bias and suboptimal reporting transparency. PROSPERO CRD420261391432.

abstract: Accurate differential diagnosis of neurodegenerative disorders remains challenging due to overlapping clinical manifestations and heterogeneous, often incomplete multimodal observations. Existing multimodal models can integrate imaging and clinical measurements but often overlook disease-specific evidence patterns and pairwise relations among competing diagnoses. We therefore propose Knowledge-enhanced Structural Reasoning (KnowSR), which aligns multimodal patient representations with a literature-grounded knowledge bank of disease prototypes, signed evidence directions, and pairwise diagnostic relations. abstract: Dermatologists describe lesions with a standardized morphological lexicon, which makes concept-based models attractive for interpretable skin disease diagnosis. How much diagnostic information these concepts actually carry, however, is rarely quantified. We present DermKG, a concept-centric knowledge graph built on the expert-annotated SkinCon subset of Fitzpatrick17k (3,230 images, 48 concepts, 113 diseases). DermKG has 3,452 nodes of 8 types and 19,365 edges of 11 relation types, and encodes disease concept profiles, concept co-occurrence, a three-level diagnostic hierarchy, and 20 clinical morphology rules, all of which are supported by the training data (15 strong, 5 moderate). An information-ceiling analysis shows that the 3,230 lesions collapse onto only 813 distinct concept vectors, bounding concept-only top-1 accuracy at 38.9\% for diseases and 77.6\% for the nine categories. abstract: Automated EEG seizure type classification systems are typically trained and evaluated under the closed-set assumption, where all seizure types encountered at deployment are seen during training. In clinical practice, this assumption fails: patients present with rare or atypical seizure types that fall outside the training label space, and a system that forces a wrong label is worse than one that abstains. We introduce the first open-set recognition protocol for EEG seizure type classification on the Temple University Hospital Seizure Corpus (TUSZ v2.0.3), defining known and unknown classes using the clinical taxonomy itself: seizure types with sufficient subject representation (at least 12 subjects) form the known set, and rare types form the unknown set. title: PathOPEN: A pathologist-curated histopathology dataset for visual question answering

abstract: PathOPEN is a histopathology dataset for visual question answering. Two clinical pathologists selected 157 cases with 229 available original images and wrote open-ended, five-option multiple-choice and close-ended (yes/no) questions. They supplied both a correct and a wrong answer for 201 of the 309 open-ended questions. Each case records the organ, pathology category and regional anatomy, and each image records its magnification. The dataset includes 6,870 augmented images and four manifests that select subsets to improve balance by individual metadata field. Five additional pathologists and two vision-language model judges rated items with scoring rubrics, and six models answered questions zero-shot across the three formats. The metadata support subgroup evaluation, and the paired answers can be used to construct preference examples.
zh_abstract: PathOPEN 是一个用于视觉问答的组织病理学数据集。两名临床病理学家选取了 157 例病例，包含 229 张可用原始图像，并编写了开放式、五选项多项选择和封闭式（是/否）问题。在 309 道开放式问题中，他们为 201 道提供了正确答案和错误答案各一个。每例记录器官、病理类别和局部解剖，每张图像记录其放大倍数。该数据集包括 6,870 张增强图像和四个清单，这些清单按各元数据字段选择子集以改善平衡。另外五名病理学家和两名视觉-语言模型评审使用评分细则对条目进行评分，六种模型在三种格式下零样本回答了问题。元数据支持亚组评估，配对答案可用于构建偏好示例。

abstract: Surgical skill assessment, AR guidance, and robot learning from demonstration all benefit from 3D tracking of the surgeon's hands, yet no surgical dataset offers real egocentric articulated 3D hand pose. zh_abstract: 手术技能评估、AR 引导和机器人从演示中学习都受益于对术者手部的三维跟踪，然而尚无外科数据集提供真实的自我中心（egocentric）关节化三维手部姿态。我们提出 EgoSurgHands，这是一个用于在合成垫上进行开放手术训练时真实采集的自我中心手部姿态估计的基准。它使用多传感器眼镜采集，包含横跨 55 段手术记录的 41,909 行训练手部实例，以及横跨 13 段留出记录的 9,476 行经人工验证的评估行，涵盖 13 项任务、3 种手套颜色和 4 名受训者（从一年级医学生到三年级住院医师）。每一帧都带有多传感器栈：内参、带每只手置信度的手部关键点、时间戳和眼动注视，以及在 SLAM 成功处的 SLAM 外参。评估标签结合了传感器融合的伪真值、对每一帧的人工交叉复核、外科医生 adju

title: Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction for Effective Subgroup Reliability

abstract: Conformal prediction offers a distribution-free coverage guarantee, making it especially attractive for clinical applications. Standard conformal prediction, however, provides such guarantees only at the population level, and its prediction sets can exhibit coverage disparities across clinically important subgroups. A natural remedy is to calibrate within predefined groups. However, this can require access to sensitive subgroup attributes and is prone to a worst-group bottleneck: protecting the most difficult subgroup can inflate prediction sets for all, increasing cognitive burden on decision makers. To this end, we propose Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction (SGCP), a conformal framework for subgroup-reliable uncertainty quantification. zh_abstract: 共形预测提供无分布假设的覆盖保证，使其对临床应用尤其有吸引力。然而，标准共形预测仅在总体水平上提供此类保证，其预测集可能在临床重要亚组之间表现出覆盖差异。一种自然的补救方法是在预定义组内进行校准。然而，这可能要求访问敏感亚组属性，并且容易遭遇最差组瓶颈：保护最困难亚组可能会使所有人的预测集膨胀，增加决策者的认知负担。为此，我们提出随机分组共形预测（Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction, SGCP），一种用于亚组可靠不确定性量化的共形框架。它学习一个随机分组映射，使每个样本能够从具有相似校准行为的其他样本中获取校准信息，产生

title: Tracing the Scientific Discovery Capacity of LLMs to Their Training Data

summary: 提出以「单次事实率」解释大模型科学发现能力的理论框架，并在材料科学与监管基因组学中通过调控训练集单次事实比例验证其影响。

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show growing promise for scientific discovery, yet basic questions remain about what enables reliable discovery. How can we trace the scientific discovery capacity of LLMs to their training data? We study this question as one of missing probability mass and develop a theoretical account in which monofacts---the facts observed once during training---set the discovery capacity. In materials science and regulatory genomics, we directly manipulate monofact rates in training sets and find that more monofacts consistently yield more discoveries across two open-weight model families, sampling strategies, and reasoning budgets. abstract: A synoptic pathology report is a checklist of questions with fixed answer sets, many composed from others. Pathology foundation models answer them accurately with one classifier trained with labels for each, and frontier language models, which compose freely, cannot fit a slide of fourteen thousand tiles in their context. On 189 breast report questions, frontier models that read a written description of the slide or look at a thumbnail and tiles of it answer at 0.50 to 0.66, below the majority class at 0.67. A description is written before the question is known, and a look covers a handful of tiles. zh_abstract: 概要性病理报告（synoptic pathology report）是一份问题清单，配有固定答案集，其中许多问题由其他问题组合而成。病理基础模型（pathology foundation models）用针对每个问题标签训练的单个分类器即可准确回答这些问题；而可自由组合的前沿语言模型（frontier language models）无法在其上下文中容纳一张由一万四千个图块（tiles）组成的切片。在 189 个乳腺报告问题上，阅读切片书面描述、或查看切片缩略图及其图块的前沿模型回答得分为 0.50 至 0.66，低于多数类（majority class）的 0.67。描述是在问题已知之前写好的，而“看一眼”只覆盖少量图块。我们提出 Opsis，它转而让模型提问：在冻结的病理编码器（frozen pathology encoder）上提供类型化问题接口（typed question interface）。切片仅编码一次，问题在运行时指定算子（operator）、参数（arguments）和候选（candidates），答案为各候选上的概率。我们将其构建为一个 10 M 参数（10 M parameter）的

title: HistoGPA: A Context-Conditioned Gene-Prior Attention Framework for Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction

summary: 提出以切片级组织学表征调节预训练基因嵌入记忆的框架，从常规H&E切片预测空间基因表达，在HEST-1k十个任务上优于四个近期方法。

abstract: Spatial transcriptomics is costly, motivating the prediction of spatial gene expression from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) slides. Existing methods use tissue context to refine visual features but keep pretrained gene priors fixed across specimens. Since the relevance of such a prior may vary with tissue context, we propose HistoGPA, which conditions the gene prior itself on the slide being analyzed. A slide-level histological representation modulates a memory of pretrained gene embeddings before each spatial location queries it through cross-attention, and also gates context into the local features. Across ten cancer-specific tasks from HEST-1k, HistoGPA achieves a macro-averaged gene-wise Pearson correlation of 0.300 on the HEST-Bench genes, compared with 0.260 for the strongest of four recent methods. zh_abstract: 空间转录组学（spatial transcriptomics）成本高昂，这促使人们从常规苏木精-伊红（hematoxylin and eosin, H&E）切片预测空间基因表达。现有方法利用组织上下文来精炼视觉特征，但使预训练基因先验（pretrained gene priors）在不同标本间保持固定。由于这种先验的相关性可能随组织上下文而变化，我们提出 HistoGPA，它使基因先验本身以所分析的切片为条件。切片级组织学表征（slide-level histological representation）调节预训练基因嵌入的记忆（memory of pretrained gene embeddings），随后每个空间位置通过交叉注意力（cross-attention）查询该记忆，并且还将上下文门控到局部特征中。在来自 HEST-1k 的十项癌症特异性任务中，HistoGPA 在 HEST-Bench 基因上取得宏平均基因级 Pearson 相关系数 0.300，而四项近期方法中最强者为 0.260。容量匹配消融（capacity-matched ablations）证明了切片特异性信息（slide-specific inform）的重要性

abstract: Whole-body segmentation tools such as TotalSegmentator and MOOSE split more than 100 classes across five or six networks. The reason is memory. abstract: Promptable segmentation foundation models are increasingly used in specialized domains, but it remains unclear how SAM-3 should be fine-tuned when adapting it beyond its original training distribution. We study this question by comparing five adaptation families --LoRA, HiRA, KRAdapter, QuanTA, and Full Fine-Tuning-- across five segmentation datasets spanning medical imaging, remote sensing, and dense material segmentation. Across these datasets, compact parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods often match or approach Full Fine-Tuning in DSC and IoU, suggesting that strong in-domain adaptation does not always require updating the full model. However, this performance cannot be explained by nominal adapter rank or trainable parameter count alone. abstract: [Frontiers in public health] The evolution of medical epistemology from the unassailable authority of eminence to the empirical rigour of evidence has prepared the healthcare system for its most profound transformation yet, intelligence-based medicine. Driven by the integration of artificial intelligence (AI), this emerging era offers unprecedented capabilities to process complex health data and personalise patient care within high-stakes environments like emergency departments. However, this paradigm shift simultaneously introduces a critical risk of modernised, digital dogma, manifesting as algorithmic paternalism. If AI systems are deployed without rigorous oversight, they threaten to silently amplify historical biases, diagnostic inaccuracies, and outdated clinical heuristics, trading the unquestioned authority of historical figures for the presumed infallibility of machines. To safeguard care in emergency departments, AI must not operate unchecked. Adapting existing Learning Health System frameworks offers a pragmatic solution to govern AI integration. By embedding these computational technologies within continuous, self-correcting clinical ecosystems, departments can enforce robust data hygiene and rigorously audit data provenance. An essential component of this approach is separating objective safety surveillance and adverse event reporting from the algorithm's internal learning mechanisms to detect epistemic drift and automation bias. Ultimately, the successful and safe integration of intelligence-based medicine depends on an unwavering commitment to transparent governance. When computational power is harnessed as a regulated, transparent tool within an LHS, AI can actively dismantle entrenched clinical dogma, ensuring future care is anchored in dynamic, validated evidence rather than perpetuating the medical errors propagated by eminence from the past.

abstract: [BMC nursing] To clarify the concept of AI and algorithmic literacy among nurses and to provide a conceptual foundation for nursing education, clinical practice, and responsible AI governance. Rodgers' evolutionary concept analysis. Guided by Rodgers' evolutionary method, the literature was analyzed to determine how AI and algorithmic literacy among nurses has been used and conceptualized. Defining attributes, antecedents, consequences, and related concepts were extracted, compared, and synthesized. A systematic search was conducted in Web of Science, PubMed, Embase, and CINAHL. Search terms focused on nurses, nursing students, health workers, artificial intelligence literacy, algorithmic literacy, AI competence, AI readiness, and generative AI literacy. Articles published between January 2020 and June 2026 were screened. Twenty-eight articles were included in the final concept analysis. Four defining attributes were identified: conceptual understanding of AI-mediated nursing contexts; critical interpretation and risk recognition of algorithmic outputs; clinical integration and human oversight of AI recommendations; and ethical governance awareness grounded in professional accountability. Antecedents included AI education and training, digital or informatics foundations, prior AI exposure, individual readiness, organizational support, faculty preparedness, and governance environments. Consequences included improved learning outcomes, critical thinking, AI adoption and readiness, patient safety awareness, human-AI collaboration, and professional innovation. Related concepts included AI literacy, algorithmic literacy, digital literacy, nursing informatics competence, AI readiness, AI competence, and AI self-efficacy. Based on this synthesis, both a brief definition and a full conceptual definition of AI and algorithmic literacy among nurses were proposed. AI and algorithmic literacy among nurses is a multidimensional concept that extends beyond technical knowledge or willingness to use AI. It reflects nurses' ability to understand, interpret, supervise, and responsibly integrate AI outputs into nursing judgment while maintaining patient safety and professional accountability. Clarifying this concept can support the development of nursing AI education, competency frameworks, measurement tools, clinical training, and governance strategies. abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] Timecourse single-cell RNA (scRNA) datasets have become indispensable biological tools for studying and uncovering the underlying regulatory processes driving continuous cell-state transitions such as the epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition. However, these highly fluid, non-linear gene program dynamics remain difficult to disentangle. While deep neural network models can effectively map complex topologies, they are biological black boxes, lacking the gene-level interpretability required by experimental practitioners. Here, we introduce scCont, a fully unsupervised contrastive learning framework for extracting interpretable functional transition units from scRNA-seq data. Rather than relying on explicit temporal labels or clustering priors, scCont uses an unsupervised k-nearest neighbors approach to project local transcriptomic neighborhoods into a low-dimensional embedding. During post-training analysis, scCont employs Shapley network attribution to determine gene-latent relationships, mapping latent dimensions directly into functional gene programs. We quantitatively and qualitatively validate this representation by demonstrating that scCont captures biologically interpretable dynamics more effectively than baseline methods such as LDVAE. Evaluated across 13 diverse EMT timecourse datasets and four simulated datasets, scCont exposes interpretable functional dynamics and effectively maps context-dependent functional groups, helping to bridge the gap between deep learning representation and translational biological utility. scCont is an open source software available on GitHub ( https://github.com/nramani611/scCont ).
zh_abstract: [bioRxiv：生物学预印本服务器] 时间序列单细胞 RNA（scRNA）数据集已成为不可或缺的生物学工具，用于研究和揭示驱动连续细胞状态转变（如上皮-间质转化）的潜在调控过程。然而，这些高度流动、非线性的基因程序动力学仍然难以厘清。尽管深度神经网络模型能够有效映射复杂拓扑结构，但它们是生物学黑箱，缺乏实验实践者所需的基因水平可解释性。在此，我们介绍 scCont，一种完全无监督的对比学习框架，用于从 scRNA-seq 数据中提取可解释的功能转变单元。scCont 不依赖显式时间标签或聚类先验，而是使用无监督 k 最近邻方法将局部转录组邻域投影到低维嵌入中。在训练后分析中，scCont 采用 Shapley 网络归因来确定基因-潜在维度关系，将潜在维度直接映射到功能基因程序。我们通过证明 scCont 比 LDVAE 等基线方法更有效地捕捉具有生物学可解释性的动力学，从定量和定性两方面验证了该表示。在 13 个多样化的 EMT 时间序列数据集和 4 个模拟数据集上评估，scCont 揭示了可解释的功能动力学，并有效映射上下文依赖的功能组，有助于弥合深度学习表示与转化生物学效用之间的差距。scCont 是开源软件，可在 GitHub（https://github.com/nramani611/scCont）获取。

abstract: [Frontiers in microbiology] Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in Staphylococcus aureus is a growing clinical threat, and machine learning (ML) offers a scalable approach to identifying allele-level resistance determinants. Using a dataset of 300 clinical isolates, we trained and compared seven ML models - LSTM, CNN, Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), Decision Tree, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, and Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) - to predict resistance across six clinically important antibiotics from allele, locus-tag, and EggNOG-annotation features. Training-set class imbalance was corrected with SMOTE and all seven models were retrained under one identical pipeline. XGBoost achieved the strongest overall test-set performance (accuracy 95%, ROC AUC 0.9745, F1-score 0.9474), closely matched by Decision Tree (accuracy 95%, F1-score 0.9520). Both outperformed the deep-learning architectures (LSTM, CNN, MLP), which showed pronounced overfitting after class-imbalance correction. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis identified "cat__allele_Cluster_1015_Allele_8" as the most influential feature; this association is hypothesis-generating and reflects statistical importance within this dataset, not a confirmed causal or biological mechanism. The genomic feature set was selected once, on the full isolate collection, by a prior SVM-RFE pipeline before the present train/test split, and no external, temporal, or multi-center validation dataset was used. Reported performance should therefore be read as an upper-bound, best-case estimate rather than a validated benchmark. These findings support ML, and ensemble methods such as XGBoost and Decision Tree in particular, as candidate components of future AMR surveillance and diagnostic pipelines, pending external and prospective validation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in microbiology] 金黄色葡萄球菌中的抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）是日益增长的临床威胁，机器学习（ML）为识别等位基因水平的耐药决定因素提供了一种可扩展的方法。我们使用包含 300 株临床分离株的数据集，训练并比较了七种 ML 模型——LSTM、CNN、多层感知机（MLP）、决策树、XGBoost、逻辑回归和随机梯度下降（SGD）——以根据等位基因、基因座标签和 EggNOG 注释特征预测对六种临床重要抗生素的耐药性。训练集类别不平衡通过 SMOTE 校正，所有七种模型均在同一个完全相同的流程下重新训练。XGBoost 取得了最强的总体测试集性能（准确率 95%，ROC AUC 0.9745，F1-score 0.9474），决策树紧随其后（准确率 95%，F1-score 0.9520）。两者均优于深度学习架构（LSTM、CNN、MLP），后者在类别不平衡校正后表现出明显的过拟合。SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）分析将“cat__allele_Cluster_1015_Allele_8”识别为最具影响力的特征；这一关联具有假设生成性，反映的是本数据集内的统计重要性，而非已确认的因果或生物学机制。基因组特征集是在当前训练/测试划分之前，由先前的 SVM-RFE 流程在全部分离株集合上一次性选出的，且未使用外部、时间或多中心验证数据集。因此，所报告的性能应被理解为上限式的最佳情况估计，而不是经过验证的基准。这些发现支持 ML，尤其是 XGBoost 和决策树等集成方法，作为未来 AMR 监测和诊断流程的候选组成部分，但仍需外部和前瞻性验证。

abstract: [Proceedings of the ... International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications. International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications] Immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining is frequently used to resolve diagnostically ambiguous prostate cancer biopsy findings on hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained tissue. However, PIN-4 IHC is typically performed on adjacent tissue sections, limiting direct spatial comparison between the H&E morphology that indicated the need for IHC and the corresponding immunophenotypic signal. A paired, registered H&E/PIN-4 dataset was constructed from routine clinical prostate biopsy whole-slide images (WSIs), and a conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) was trained to synthesize PIN-4 staining patterns directly from native H&E image patches. The final dataset comprised 172 paired WSIs from 93 patients and 27,298 registered 1024 × 1024 patch pairs, spanning adenocarcinoma-positive and benign cases with representation across age, race, and ethnicity groups. The model was evaluated on an independent held-out test set of 1,814 patch pairs from 17 WSIs, achieving a mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 21.88 dB, structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.667, Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) of 0.684, and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) of 0.417. Qualitative review by a board-certified pathologist demonstrated that generated images captured diagnostically relevant PIN-4 staining patterns, including AMACR/racemase expression and basal-cell-associated staining, while preserving spatial correspondence with the source H&E morphology. Synthesis quality varied across morphologically complex regions, including high-grade carcinoma and intraductal carcinoma. These results support the feasibility of supervised computational PIN-4 staining from routinely acquired brightfield H&E prostate biopsy images. The approach enables direct interpretation of predicted PIN-4 marker patterns in the context of the source prostate H&E architecture, addressing a current spatial limitation of conventional adjacent-section IHC.

abstract: Vision-language models for medical image segmentation often produce masks that conflict with the accompanying text, especially under multi-site/multi-lesion descriptions. abstract: [Healthcare informatics research] This study quantitatively evaluated the accuracy and clinical reliability of EzOrtho, deep learning software designed to identify anatomical landmarks automatically for orthodontic diagnosis. Real-world clinical data were used to assess its applicability in practice. We analyzed 23 lateral cephalometric radiographs. EzOrtho automatically identified 36 anatomical landmarks per radiograph, yielding 828 data points for comparison with ground truth established by experienced orthodontists using a standardized annotation protocol. Accuracy was quantified using mean radial error (MRE), and clinical reliability was assessed using the successful detection rate (SDR), defined as the percentage of all points within the clinically acceptable threshold of 2.0 mm. The overall MRE was 0.78 mm, and the SDR at the 2.0 mm threshold was 86%. Although most landmarks were detected precisely, the landmark-specific analysis identified higher error rates at a few points in anatomically complex regions, indicating areas for improvement. The findings suggest that EzOrtho may offer clinical utility and reliability for automatic cephalometric landmark detection using real clinical data. Its performance indicates the potential to improve efficiency and consistency relative to manual tracing. However, the study's limitations, including its small sample size, mean that these results remain preliminary. Further validation is needed to establish its role as a decision-support tool in orthodontic practice.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare informatics research] 本研究定量评估了 EzOrtho 的准确性和临床可靠性；EzOrtho 是一种旨在为正畸诊断自动识别解剖标志的深度学习软件。研究使用真实世界临床数据评估其在实践中的适用性。我们分析了 23 张头颅侧位 X 线片。EzOrtho 每张 X 线片自动识别 36 个解剖标志，共产生 828 个数据点，用于与由经验丰富的正畸医生使用标准化标注方案建立的真实值进行比较。准确性使用平均径向误差（MRE）量化，临床可靠性使用成功检测率（SDR）评估，SDR 定义为所有点中位于 2.0 mm 临床可接受阈值内的百分比。总体 MRE 为 0.78 mm，2.0 mm 阈值下的 SDR 为 86%。尽管大多数标志被精确检测到，但标志特异性分析发现，在解剖复杂区域的少数点上错误率较高，提示仍有改进空间。研究结果表明，EzOrtho 在使用真实临床数据进行自动头影测量标志检测方面可能具有临床实用性和可靠性。其性能表明，相对于手工描记，它有可能提高效率和一致性。然而，该研究的局限性（包括样本量小）意味着这些结果仍是初步的。需要进一步验证，以确立其作为正畸实践中决策支持工具的作用。

abstract: AI-powered cardiac screening could evolve sports medicine by boosting accuracy, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness, with automated ECG interpretation based on foundation models becoming key for large-scale athlete screening. We evaluated whether ECG foundation models trained on general clinical populations can diagnose athlete-specific ECG findings. We fine-tuned three models (ECG-FM, HuBERT-ECG, ECGFounder) on PhysioNet/CinC 2021, 87,662 samples, and tested them on 43 expert-annotated ECGs from highly trained/national-level athletes. Performance was strong on PhysioNet/CinC 2021 (AUROC 0.97, AUPRC 0.57, Sensitivity 0.89) but dropped on athletes’ data, confirming domain shift. ECGFounder performed best (AUROC 0.84, AUPRC 0.72, Sensitivity 0.57) and detected the most frequent findings, Sinus Bradycardia (AUROC 0.87) and Sinus Arrhythmia (AUROC 0.95), well. Per-label estimates for rare classes must be interpreted cautiously, given the small cohort. This work contributes to developing athlete-focused AI frameworks for reliable ECG-based screening.
zh_abstract: AI 驱动的心脏筛查可通过提高准确性、效率和成本效益来推动运动医学发展，其中基于基础模型的自动心电图解读正成为大规模运动员筛查的关键。在部署前，至关重要的是验证这些在临床人群中开发的模型是否适用于该人群。我们评估了在一般临床人群中训练的心电图基础模型能否诊断运动员特异性心电图表现。我们在 PhysioNet/CinC 2021 的 87,662 个样本上微调了三个模型（ECG-FM、HuBERT-ECG、ECGFounder），并在来自高度训练/国家级运动员的 43 份经专家标注的心电图上进行测试。模型在 PhysioNet/CinC 2021 上表现强劲（AUROC 0.97、AUPRC 0.57、Sensitivity 0.89），但在运动员数据上下降，证实了域偏移。ECGFounder 表现最佳（AUROC 0.84、AUPRC 0.72、Sensitivity 0.57），并良好检测了最常见表现，即窦性心动过缓（AUROC 0.87）和窦性心律不齐（AUROC 0.95）。鉴于队列较小，对稀有类别的逐标签估计必须谨慎解读。这项工作有助于开发以运动员为中心的 AI 框架，以实现可靠的心电图筛查。

title: Potential and pitfalls of artificial intelligence to address disparities in epilepsy.
zh_title: AI缓解癫痫诊疗不平等的潜力与陷阱
summary: 综述探讨AI通过脑电、手机数据与电子病历改善资源匮乏地区癫痫诊疗，并警示透明度与公平风险。

关注临床专业能力保留、算法透明度与医疗公平

abstract: [Nature reviews. Neurology] The convergence of artificial intelligence (AI) and health care offers unprecedented opportunities to address global disparities in access to specialized epilepsy diagnosis and treatment, particularly in resource-limited settings. Advances in AI models, combined with increasing internet connectivity and smartphone usage in low-income and middle-income countries, offer promising solutions for epilepsy diagnosis and monitoring through AI-based analysis of electroencephalography recordings captured with affordable open-source systems, smartphone data and electronic health records. However, this technological revolution raises important questions about the preservation and expansion of clinical expertise, AI algorithm transparency and health-care equity. In this Review, we examine how AI can help to address disparities and improve global epilepsy care while maintaining high clinical standards and addressing systemic challenges.
zh_abstract: 《Nature Reviews Neurology》人工智能（AI）与医疗保健的融合为解决全球在获得专科癫痫诊断和治疗方面的差异提供了前所未有的机会，尤其是在资源有限的环境中。AI模型的进步，加之低收入和中等收入国家互联网连接和智能手机使用的增加，通过基于AI分析用负担得起的开源系统采集的脑电图记录、智能手机数据和电子健康记录，为癫痫诊断和监测提供了有前景的解决方案。然而，这场技术革命提出了关于临床专业知识的保留与扩展、AI算法透明度和医疗保健公平性的重要问题。在本综述中，我们考察AI如何帮助解决差异并改善全球癫痫照护，同时保持高临床标准并应对系统性挑战。

title: Generative AI adoption is more widespread than predictive AI at US hospitals.
zh_title: 美国医院生成式 AI 采用率高于预测式 AI
summary: 基于 2203 家美国医院 2025 年调查，81% 使用 AI，77% 使用生成式 AI，较 2024 年翻倍以上。
key_points: 样本为 2203 家非联邦急症医院
生成式 AI 使用率 77%，超 2024 年两倍
最常见用途为环境文档记录，占 73%
reason: 全国性大样本采用率调查，但为横断面描述，属值得一看档
abstract: [Health affairs scholar] Artificial intelligence (AI) adoption among U.S. hospitals has accelerated rapidly, yet national estimates of predictive and generative AI implementation across clinical and administrative settings remain limited. Using data from 2203 nonfederal acute care hospitals in the 2025 American Hospital Association Information Technology Survey, we described AI adoption, model source (electronic health record [EHR] developer, third-party developer, or self-developed), and specific clinical and administrative use cases. We assessed associations between hospital and area characteristics and AI adoption, model source, and number of AI use cases using weighted multivariable regression. In 2025, 81% of hospitals reported using AI, with 77% of hospitals using generative AI-more than double the rate reported in 2024. The most common applications were ambient documentation (73%) and predicting health trajectories or risks (70%). System affiliation and use of the market-leading EHR were the strongest predictors of AI adoption. Hospitals using EHR-developed AI reported 2.48 additional AI use cases (95% CI, 1.93-3.03). Generative AI adoption surpassed predictive AI for the first time, driven by ambient documentation. While use of EHR-developed AI was associated with greater use, there was a greater influence of third-party vendors for generative AI compared to predictive AI. Continued monitoring will be essential to assess AI's impact across healthcare.
zh_abstract: [Health affairs scholar] 美国医院对人工智能（AI）的采用已迅速加快，但关于预测性 AI 和生成式 AI 在临床与行政环境中实施的全国估计仍然有限。我们使用 2025 年美国医院协会信息技术调查（American Hospital Association Information Technology Survey）中 2203 家非联邦急性护理医院的数据，描述了 AI 采用情况、模型来源（电子健康记录 [EHR] 开发商、第三方开发商或自行开发）以及具体临床和行政用例。我们使用加权多变量回归评估了医院和地区特征与 AI 采用、模型来源及 AI 用例数量之间的关联。2025 年，81% 的医院报告使用 AI，其中 77% 的医院使用生成式 AI——是 2024 年报告率的两倍多。最常见应用是环境记录（ambient documentation，73%）和预测健康轨迹或风险（70%）。系统隶属关系和市场领先 EHR 的使用是 AI 采用的最强预测因素。使用 EHR 开发商开发的 AI 的医院报告了额外 2.48 个 AI 用例（95% CI，1.93-3.03）。生成式 AI 的采用首次超过预测性 AI，这由环境记录推动。虽然使用 EHR 开发商开发的 AI 与更多使用相关，但与预测性 AI 相比，第三方供应商对生成式 AI 的影响更大。持续监测对于评估 AI 在整个医疗保健中的影响至关重要。

title: The Transformative Role of Artificial Intelligence in Wearable Health Monitoring: Applications in Diagnosis, Therapy, and Rehabilitation.
source: PubMed · Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] This chapter explores the transformative impact of artificial intelligence (AI)-augmented wearable technology in dynamic health monitoring across diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation. Innovations include real-time cardiovascular disease detection, AI-driven continuous glucose monitoring for diabetes, and neurological disorder tracking using flexible electroencephalograph (EEG) sensors. Therapeutic advances feature smart drug-delivery patches responsive to biomarkers, remote intervention systems, and surgical tools like augmented reality (AR) navigation. Rehabilitation breakthroughs encompass wearables for motor recovery, cardiopulmonary optimization, and neurorehabilitation using brain-computer interfaces. Future progress hinges on multifunctional hardware, federated learning for privacy, explainable AI, and standardized regulations.
zh_abstract: [Methods in Molecular Biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 本章探讨人工智能（AI）增强的可穿戴技术在诊断、治疗和康复动态健康监测中的变革性影响。创新包括实时心血管疾病检测、AI 驱动的糖尿病连续血糖监测，以及使用柔性脑电图（EEG）传感器进行神经系统疾病追踪。治疗进展包括响应生物标志物的智能药物递送贴片、远程干预系统，以及增强现实（AR）导航等手术工具。康复突破包括用于运动恢复、心肺优化以及使用脑机接口进行神经康复的可穿戴设备。未来进展取决于多功能硬件、保护隐私的联邦学习、可解释 AI 和标准化法规。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Precision Nutrition: From Multi-Omics Integration to Personalized Dietary Interventions.
zh_title: AI在精准营养中的应用：从多组学到个体化干预
summary: 叙述性综述考察机器学习、深度学习、计算机视觉、NLP与多组学在精准营养中的应用。
key_points: AI可分析饮食、临床、生理与分子数据
区分预测研究、数字营养与商业平台
数字精准营养可改善部分饮食行为
reason: 叙述性综述，无新数据，证据有限，增量档
abstract: [Clinical nutrition ESPEN] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being investigated as a tool for precision nutrition because it can analyse heterogeneous dietary, clinical, physiological, behavioural, and molecular data. This narrative review critically examines how machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing, explainable AI, continuous glucose monitoring, wearable technologies, and multi-omics approaches may support individualized nutritional assessment and decision-making. Particular attention is given to the distinction between predictive research, digital personalized nutrition, AI-enabled clinical interventions, and commercial nutrition platforms. Current evidence shows that personalized digital nutrition can improve selected dietary behaviours, while observational AI and multi-omics studies can predict substantial inter-individual variation in metabolic responses. Importantly, evidence that an AI-enabled intervention improves clinical outcomes is still limited and is concentrated in selected settings, including a multicentre randomized trial of an AI-based dietary management platform in adults with type 2 diabetes. Emerging technologies such as large language models, digital twins, federated learning, and adaptive algorithms remain promising but require prospective clinical validation. Major barriers include data quality, algorithmic bias, privacy, interoperability, model transparency, regulatory uncertainty, and limited external validation. Future research should prioritize pragmatic multicentre randomized trials, transparent reporting of model performance, independent validation, health-economic evaluation, and clinically meaningful outcomes. AI should therefore be considered an adjunct to evidence-based nutritional care rather than a replacement for professional clinical judgement. The review differs from technology-centred and methodology-focused reviews by explicitly linking AI modalities and multi-omics data with evidence maturity, clinical trial findings, implementation barriers, and the level of inference justified for each technology.
zh_abstract: 《Clinical Nutrition ESPEN》人工智能（AI）正越来越多地被研究作为精准营养的工具，因为它能够分析异质性的膳食、临床、生理、行为和分子数据。本叙述性综述批判性地考察机器学习、深度学习、计算机视觉、自然语言处理、可解释AI、连续血糖监测、可穿戴技术和多组学方法如何可能支持个体化营养评估与决策。特别关注预测性研究、数字个性化营养、AI赋能的临床干预与商业营养平台之间的区别。当前证据显示，个性化数字营养可以改善选定的膳食行为，而观察性AI和多组学研究可以预测代谢反应中显著的个体间差异。重要的是，AI赋能干预改善临床结局的证据仍然有限，且集中于选定环境，包括一项在2型糖尿病成人中开展的基于AI的膳食管理平台的多中心随机试验。大语言模型、数字孪生、联邦学习和自适应算法等新兴技术仍有前景，但需要前瞻性临床验证。主要障碍包括数据质量、算法偏倚、隐私、互操作性、模型透明度、监管不确定性以及有限的外部验证。未来研究应优先开展实用性多中心随机试验、模型性能的透明报告、独立验证、卫生经济学评价以及具有临床意义的结局。因此，AI应被视为循证营养照护的辅助手段，而不是专业临床判断的替代品。本综述不同于以技术为中心和以方法学为重点的综述，因为它明确将AI模式和多组学数据与证据成熟度、临床试验发现、实施障碍以及每种技术所能支持的推断水平联系起来。

title: AI-driven Immuno-Radio-Multi-Omics in triple-negative breast cancer: mapping the immune landscape for precision immunotherapy.
zh_title: AI驱动免疫-放射-多组学用于三阴性乳腺癌
summary: 文章讨论AI影像组学联合多组学刻画三阴性乳腺癌免疫微环境，以支持精准免疫治疗。
key_points: TNBC肿瘤免疫微环境高度异质，影响免疫治疗反应
PD-L1与TILs评估受取样偏差和空间异质性限制
AI影像组学可将常规影像转为无创高通量生物标志物
reason: 同行评审综述，梳理AI影像组学与多组学在TNBC的应用，无原始数据。
abstract: [Frontiers in immunology] In triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) is highly heterogeneous and constitutes a key determinant of response to immunotherapy. Nevertheless, current clinical assessment of biomarkers, notably programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression and tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs), relies primarily on static and localized tissue sampling, constrained by spatial heterogeneity, sampling bias, and lack of longitudinal assessment, which limits its capacity to fully represent the evolving TIME and support adaptive treatment decision-making. Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven radiomics has emerged as a non-invasive framework enabling the conversion of routine imaging into high-throughput biomarkers, capturing TIME imaging phenotypes. When integrated with genomic data, this strategy extends into radiogenomics, allowing the association of radiomics features with underlying molecular features to better characterize the TNBC landscape. However, given the inter/intra-diversity of TNBC-TIME, integrating complementary multi-omics layers becomes necessary to fully reflect TIME landscape and represent the interplay between TIME components. Several findings from studies on solid tumors, including TNBC, suggest that AI-derived radiomics signatures are associated with immune and molecular patterns and may predict PD-L1 expression, TILs, TIME phenotypes and response to immune checkpoint blockade. Beyond static and isolated biomarker development, 'Immuno-Radio-Multi-Omics' could enable dynamic non-invasive whole-tumor immune profiling, enhanced patient stratification, and support the future development of longitudinal and adaptive therapeutic strategies. Meanwhile, its clinical translation is currently limited by the lack of large and prospective datasets, standardization, validation and interpretability. Through this mini-review, we aim to critically discuss current evidence, limitations and next frontiers of 'Immuno-Radio-Multi-Omics' in TNBC, emphasizing its potential to advance dynamic and personalized immunotherapy strategies in TNBC.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in Immunology] 在三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）中，肿瘤免疫微环境（TIME）高度异质，是免疫治疗反应的关键决定因素。然而，目前生物标志物的临床评估，尤其是程序性死亡配体 1（PD-L1）表达和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（TILs），主要依赖于静态和局部组织取样，受空间异质性、取样偏倚及缺乏纵向评估的限制，这限制了其充分代表不断演变的 TIME 并支持适应性治疗决策的能力。人工智能（AI）驱动的放射组学已成为一种非侵入性框架，能够将常规影像转化为高通量生物标志物，捕捉 TIME 影像表型。当与基因组数据整合时，该策略延伸至放射基因组学，使放射组学特征与潜在分子特征相关联，从而更好地刻画 TNBC 图景。然而，鉴于 TNBC-TIME 的间/内多样性，整合互补的多组学层面变得必要，以充分反映 TIME 图景并表征 TIME 各组分之间的相互作用。包括 TNBC 在内的实体瘤研究的一些发现提示，AI 衍生的放射组学特征与免疫和分子模式相关，并可能预测 PD-L1 表达、TILs、TIME 表型及对免疫检查点阻断的反应。超越静态和孤立的生物标志物开发，“Immuno-Radio-Multi-Omics”可实现动态、非侵入性的全肿瘤免疫分析，增强患者分层，并支持纵向和适应性治疗策略的未来发展。同时，其临床转化目前受限于缺乏大型前瞻性数据集、标准化、验证和可解释性。通过本小型综述，我们旨在批判性讨论“Immuno-Radio-Multi-Omics”在 TNBC 中的当前证据、局限性和下一前沿，强调其推进 TNBC 动态和个性化免疫治疗策略的潜力。

title: Calibrating trust in generative artificial intelligence for clinical communication through Chinese medical humanism.
zh_title: 以中国医学人文校准生成式AI临床沟通信任
summary: 小型综述讨论以中国医学人文理念校准生成式AI在临床沟通中的信任边界。
key_points: 生成式AI已进入患者消息、健康教育与对话式决策支持
需区分感知共情与关系责任、技术表现与患者获益
仁爱、诚、整体关注与情境判断可作信任校准资源
reason: 规范性的小型综述，有信息量但无实证数据，属值得一看档
abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Generative artificial intelligence is entering clinical communication through patient messaging, health education, and conversational decision support. Its capacity to produce reassuring language can coexist with inaccurate advice, unclear responsibility, and culturally inappropriate explanations. This mini-review examines how Chinese medical humanism can inform the calibration of trust in these encounters. Targeted literature identification integrates studies of trust and perceived empathy, research on traditional Chinese medicine communication, and medical education evidence with normative scholarship. The evidence distinguishes perceived empathy from relational accountability and technical performance from demonstrated patient benefit. Chinese medical ideals of benevolence, sincerity, holistic attention, and contextual judgment offer resources for interpreting professional responsibilities, but their incorporation into artificial intelligence has not been shown to restore trust or improve health outcomes. We synthesize these insights into a proposed dual-verification approach: an epistemic track checks evidence, uncertainty, and safety, while a relational track checks patient understanding, cultural meaning, preferences, and access to human care. Their convergence supports accountable communication and allows unresolved concerns to trigger human review. Educational applications connect critical appraisal of generated responses with reflection on classical medical ethics. Evaluation should prioritize appropriate reliance, error recognition, patient agency, and equitable access rather than maximizing trust scores. This approach reframes humanistic integration as a set of responsibilities for clinicians and institutions, with its effectiveness remaining an empirical question.
zh_abstract: 《Frontiers in Public Health》生成式人工智能正通过患者消息传递、健康教育和对话式决策支持进入临床沟通。其生成令人安心语言的能力可能与不准确建议、责任不清和文化上不恰当的解釋并存。本小型综述考察中国医学人文主义如何为这些互动中的信任校准提供依据。有针对性的文献识别将信任与感知共情的研究、中医沟通研究以及医学教育证据与规范性学术研究相结合。证据区分了感知共情与关系性问责，以及技术性能与已证实的患者获益。中国医学中仁爱、真诚、整体关注和情境判断的理想为解释专业责任提供了资源，但将其纳入人工智能尚未被证明能够恢复信任或改善健康结局。我们将这些见解综合为一种提出的双重验证方法：认知轨道检查证据、不确定性和安全性，而关系轨道检查患者理解、文化意义、偏好和获得人类照护的机会。二者的汇聚支持可问责的沟通，并允许未解决的担忧触发人工审查。教育应用将生成回答的批判性评价与对经典医学伦理的反思联系起来。评价应优先考虑适当依赖、错误识别、患者能动性和公平可及，而不是最大化信任评分。这种方法将人文整合重新界定为临床医生和机构的一套责任，其有效性仍是一个实证问题。

title: Individual Probability of Successful Extubation Using a Neural Network: A Proof-of-Concept Analysis.
zh_title: 神经网络预测个体拔管成功概率
summary: 概念验证研究用 14 项以呼吸为主的参数构建单隐层神经网络，输出个体拔管成功概率。
key_points: 14 项呼吸参数输入，单隐层网络输出单一概率
训练集仅 17 例，其中 13 例拔管成功
结果显示成功与失败组分离度较好
reason: 单中心极小样本（17 例）概念验证，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Rhode Island medical journal (2013)] Studies have shown that artificial intelligence can aid in extubating patients from ventilators, but none have used predominantly respiratory parameters to yield a simple probability of successful extubation that can immediately aid clinicians in their decision to extubate or not extubate patients. We sought to determine whether it is possible to create a neural network as a proof-of-concept analysis using predominantly respiratory parameters to derive a single probability of successful extubation for an individual patient. Fourteen predominantly respiratory parameters were the input for a neural network with one hidden layer to yield a single output, a simple probability of extubation. The system trained on 17 patients, 13 of whom successfully extubated, four of whom failed. The results showed excellent separation between the extubation successes and failures. When applied to the test group of four patients, there also was excellent separation between the three successful extubations (prediction range: 98.8% to 100% probability) and the one failure (2.9% probability). This proof-of-concept analysis showed that it is possible to use predominantly respiratory parameters to present a single number, a probability of extubation, as the output from a neural network. This analysis needs to be performed on a larger sample before it can be applied confidently, but the framework now is available for further development to assist intensivists who work with ventilated patients.
zh_abstract: 《Rhode Island Medical Journal (2013)》研究显示，人工智能可以帮助患者脱离呼吸机拔管，但尚无研究使用以呼吸参数为主的数据来给出一个简单的成功拔管概率，从而能够立即帮助临床医生决定是否对患者拔管。我们试图确定是否可能创建一个神经网络，作为概念验证分析，使用以呼吸参数为主的数据，为单个患者推导出一个成功拔管的单一概率。14个以呼吸参数为主的参数作为一个具有一个隐藏层的神经网络的输入，以产生单一输出，即一个简单的拔管概率。该系统在17名患者上训练，其中13名成功拔管，4名失败。结果显示拔管成功与失败之间有极好的区分度。当应用于4名患者的测试组时，3例成功拔管（预测范围：概率98.8%至100%）与1例失败（概率2.9%）之间也有极好的区分度。这项概念验证分析表明，有可能使用以呼吸参数为主的数据，将单一数字——拔管概率——作为神经网络的输出呈现。该分析需要在更大样本上进行，才能有把握地应用，但该框架现在可用于进一步开发，以帮助处理机械通气患者的重症监护医生。

title: Deep learning reconstruction for low-dose thoracic CT of calcification inserts: A phantom study of CNR, noise magnitude, and noise texture.
source: PubMed · Journal of applied clinical medical physics
zh_title: 深度学习重建用于低剂量胸部 CT 钙化体模研究
summary: 在体模上比较 FBP、50% ASiR 与中等强度 DLIR 的 CNR、噪声幅度与噪声纹理表现。
key_points: QRM 胸部体模含心脏钙化插件，80–140 kVp 多条件扫描
比较 FBP、ASiR 与 DLIR 三种重建方式
以 CNR、背景噪声与噪声功率谱为评价指标
reason: 纯体模、无临床数据与对照结局的技术比较，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of applied clinical medical physics] To compare filtered back projection (FBP), 50% Adaptive Statistical Iterative Reconstruction-Veo (ASiR), and medium-strength deep learning image reconstruction (DLIR) for hydroxyapatite calcification inserts under different dose, tube-voltage, and phantom-size conditions using contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), background noise magnitude, and noise power spectrum (NPS) analysis. A QRM-Thorax containing a QRM-CCI D100 cardiac calcification insert was scanned on a GE Revolution Apex CT system using institution-defined routine and low-dose protocols at 80, 100, 120, and 140 kVp, with and without an Extension Ring L. Images were reconstructed at 2.5-mm thickness using FBP, ASiR, and DLIR. CNR was evaluated for 3- and 5-mm inserts at 200, 400, and 800 mg HA/cm3. Background noise was assessed from a calcification-excluded mask. For NPS analysis, 10 calcification-free images were analyzed for each acquisition condition. Total two-dimensional NPS power, power-weighted normalized radial NPS, and power-weighted mean spatial frequency were calculated. DLIR reduced background noise magnitude and increased CNR relative to FBP across the evaluated conditions, whereas differences relative to ASiR varied with insert size, density, tube voltage, and phantom size. Across all 16 protocol, phantom-size, and tube-voltage combinations, ASiR and DLIR reduced total 2D NPS power by 58.1% and 75.8%, respectively, relative to FBP; DLIR reduced total power by 41.9% relative to ASiR. ASiR produced a more consistent shift toward lower power-weighted mean spatial frequencies, averaging 12.4% below FBP, whereas the shift with DLIR was smaller and more condition dependent, averaging 3.2% below FBP. In this controlled phantom study, DLIR reduced total noise power and improved CNR relative to FBP, but its incremental difference from ASiR was task and protocol dependent. CNR and noise magnitude should be interpreted together with NPS because nonlinear reconstruction methods can alter both noise magnitude and spatial-frequency distribution.
zh_abstract: [Journal of applied clinical medical physics] 旨在使用对比噪声比（CNR）、背景噪声幅度和噪声功率谱（NPS）分析，比较滤波反投影（FBP）、50% 自适应统计迭代重建-Veo（ASiR）和中等强度深度学习图像重建（DLIR）在不同剂量、管电压和体模尺寸条件下对羟基磷灰石钙化插入物的表现。使用机构定义的常规和低剂量方案，在 80、100、120 和 140 kVp 下，在有和无 Extension Ring L 的情况下，于 GE Revolution Apex CT 系统上扫描了包含 QRM-CCI D100 心脏钙化插入物的 QRM-Thorax 体模。图像以 2.5 mm 层厚使用 FBP、ASiR 和 DLIR 重建。对 200、400 和 800 mg HA/cm3 的 3 mm 和 5 mm 插入物评估 CNR。从排除钙化的掩膜评估背景噪声。对每种采集条件分析 10 幅无钙化图像以进行 NPS 分析。计算总二维 NPS 功率、功率加权归一化径向 NPS 和功率加权平均空间频率。在所有评估条件下，DLIR 相对 FBP 降低背景噪声幅度并提高 CNR，而相对 ASiR 的差异随插入物尺寸、密度、管电压和体模尺寸而变化。在所有 16 种方案、体模尺寸和管电压组合中，ASiR 和 DLIR 相对 FBP 分别将总二维 NPS 功率降低 58.1% 和 75.8%；DLIR 相对 ASiR 将总功率降低 41.9%。ASiR 产生更一致的向较低功率加权平均空间频率的偏移，平均比 FBP 低 12.4%，而 DLIR 的偏移较小且更依赖条件，平均比 FBP 低 3.2%。在这项受控体模研究中，DLIR 相对 FBP 降低了总噪声功率并改善了 CNR，但其相对于 ASiR 的增量差异取决于任务和方案。CNR 和噪声幅度应与 NPS 一起解读，因为非线性重建方法可同时改变噪声幅度和空间频率分布。

title: Evaluating readability of AI-generated pediatric dental education materials.
zh_title: AI 生成儿童口腔健康教育材料可读性评估
summary: 向六款 AI 聊天机器人各提交 10 个儿童口腔健康问题，用六项可读性指标评估 60 篇文本。
key_points: 涉及 GPT-5 Mini、Gemini 3 Flash、DeepSeek-V3 等六款模型
共生成 60 篇文本，采用区组重复测量设计
以 FRE、FKGL 等六项指标对照 AMA 推荐水平
reason: 设计规范但仅评估可读性指标、无临床结局，属增量偏上档
abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] General-purpose large language models (LLMs) have become a popular source of oral health information. However, the patient education materials (PEMs) generated by these models often pose readability challenges. This study aimed to: (1) compare the readability of PEMs generated by six AI chatbots in response to ten frequently asked questions on pediatric oral health; and (2) determine whether the readability of these texts meets the level recommended by the American Medical Association (AMA). Ten sample questions on pediatric oral health were compiled. Each question was submitted once to each of six AI chatbots (GPT-5 Mini, Gemini 3 Flash, Claude Haiku 4.5, DeepSeek-V3, Kimi K2.5, and Qwen3-Max), generating a corpus of 60 texts in a blocked (repeated-measures) design. Six readability indices - Flesch Reading Ease (FRE), Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (FKGL), Gunning Fog Index (GFI), Coleman-Liau Index (CLI), Simple Measure of Gobbledygook (SMOG), and Automated Readability Index (ARI) - were calculated for every text. Each index was analysed separately using the Friedman test, with the ten questions as blocks and the six models as conditions, followed by Dunn's multiple comparison test. Kendall's coefficient of concordance (W) was calculated to quantify the consistency of model ranking across questions. DeepSeek-V3 showed the highest readability (easiest texts) and Gemini 3 Flash the second highest, whereas Claude Haiku 4.5 showed the lowest readability across all six indices; GPT-5 Mini, Qwen3-Max, and Kimi K2.5 occupied intermediate positions. All six Friedman tests were statistically significant (χ 2(5) = 31.77-35.94, all p < 0.0001), and Kendall's W ranged from 0.635 to 0.719, indicating that the relative ranking of the six models was broadly consistent across the ten questions. Against the AMA-recommended sixth-grade reading level, all models exceeded the recommended difficulty on every index; even against a more lenient seventh-grade threshold, only the ARI median of DeepSeek-V3 (6.5) fell below 7. The PEMs generated by the six LLMs were written at a reading level above the AMA recommendation, and reading difficulty differed systematically among models. Readability should be explicitly controlled through prompt design, model optimisation, and professional review before such materials are used in pediatric oral health education.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] 通用大型语言模型（LLMs）已成为口腔健康信息的热门来源。然而，这些模型生成的患者教育材料（PEMs）常常在可读性方面带来挑战。本研究旨在：（1）比较六个 AI 聊天机器人针对十个儿童口腔健康常见问题生成的 PEM 的可读性；（2）确定这些文本的可读性是否达到美国医学会（AMA）推荐的水平。编制了 10 个儿童口腔健康示例问题。将每个问题各提交一次给六个 AI 聊天机器人（GPT-5 Mini、Gemini 3 Flash、Claude Haiku 4.5、DeepSeek-V3、Kimi K2.5 和 Qwen3-Max），采用区组（重复测量）设计生成包含 60 篇文本的语料库。对每篇文本计算六种可读性指数——Flesch Reading Ease（FRE）、Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level（FKGL）、Gunning Fog Index（GFI）、Coleman-Liau Index（CLI）、Simple Measure of Gobbledygook（SMOG）和 Automated Readability Index（ARI）。每个指数分别使用 Friedman 检验分析，以十个问题为区组、六个模型为条件，随后进行 Dunn 多重比较检验。计算 Kendall 一致性系数（W）以量化各问题间模型排名的一致性。DeepSeek-V3 显示最高可读性（文本最容易），Gemini 3 Flash 第二高，而 Claude Haiku 4.5 在全部六种指数上显示最低可读性；GPT-5 Mini、Qwen3-Max 和 Kimi K2.5 处于中间位置。六项 Friedman 检验均具有统计学显著性（χ 2(5) = 31.77-35.94，所有 p < 0.0001），Kendall 的 W 范围为 0.635 至 0.719，表明六个模型的相对排名在十个问题间总体一致。相对于 AMA 推荐的六年级阅读水平，所有模型在每个指数上均超过推荐难度；即使采用更宽松的七年级阈值，也只有 DeepSeek-V3 的 ARI 中位数（6.5）低于 7。六个 LLM 生成的 PEM 的阅读水平高于 AMA 推荐，且不同模型间阅读难度存在系统性差异。在此类材料用于儿童口腔健康教育之前，应通过提示设计、模型优化和专业审查明确控制可读性。

title: CryoID2: deep learning-enhanced identification of protein and RNA from cryoEM maps.
source: PubMed · bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
zh_title: CryoID2：深度学习从冷冻电镜图识别蛋白与 RNA
summary: 预印本提出 CryoID2，用三个 3D U-Net 预测特征并结合序列检索与结构拟合鉴定冷冻电镜图组分。
key_points: 三个 3D U-Net 输出结构类别、关键原子与简化残基类型
蛋白用 BLASTp、RNA 用 maximin 策略排序候选序列
检索 PDB 或 AlphaFold 模型刚性拟合后按密度一致性排序
reason: 预印本新方法含 52 例基准，但未经同行评审、证据有限
abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] Identifying the molecular components of cryoEM/cryoET maps of endogenous or poorly characterized complexes remains a major bottleneck. CryoID2 addresses this by integrating deep learning-based feature prediction with sequence prioritization and structural evaluation. Three 3D U-Nets extract structure classes, key-atom positions, and reduced residue/nucleotide types from the input map. These predictions support backbone tracing and the generation of short sequence queries that rank candidates from a user-supplied pool-using BLASTp for proteins and a maximin strategy for RNA. Corresponding PDB or AlphaFold models are then retrieved, rigidly fitted using predicted features and experimental density, and ranked by map agreement. Module-level tests show high-recall feature prediction and resolution-dependent atom clustering, while a 52-case benchmark recovers near-reference fitting quality. In practice, cryoID2 correctly identified PfA-M17 from a 166-protein mass-spectrometry pool and the unannotated Ca-raiA RNA from a genome-derived non-coding sequence set, demonstrating a unified sequence-plus-structure route to molecular identification in cryoEM maps.
zh_abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] 鉴定内源性或表征不佳复合物的冷冻电镜（cryoEM）/冷冻电子断层扫描（cryoET）图谱中的分子组分仍是一个主要瓶颈。CryoID2 通过将基于深度学习的特征预测与序列优先级排序和结构评估相结合来解决这一问题。三个 3D U-Net 从输入图谱中提取结构类别、关键原子位置以及简化的残基/核苷酸类型。这些预测支持主链追踪，并生成短序列查询；这些查询使用针对蛋白质的 BLASTp 和针对 RNA 的 maximin 策略，从用户提供的候选池中对候选进行排序。随后检索相应的 PDB 或 AlphaFold 模型，利用预测特征和实验密度进行刚性拟合，并按与图谱的一致性排序。模块级测试显示高召回率特征预测和分辨率依赖的原子聚类，而一个 52 例基准测试恢复了接近参考的拟合质量。在实践中，cryoID2 从 166 种蛋白质的质谱池中正确鉴定出 PfA-M17，并从基因组来源的非编码序列集中鉴定出未注释的 Ca-raiA RNA，展示了在 cryoEM 图谱中通过序列加结构的统一途径进行分子鉴定。

title: Cloud vs. on-premise large language models for urgent patient-portal message screening: a comparative evaluation
zh_title: 云端与本地大模型筛查患者门户紧急消息对比
summary: 在三个队列中比较六种大模型与医师标准，用于患者门户紧急消息分诊。
key_points: 500条基层消息加503条癫痫门诊消息，及300条外部平台消息
基层队列多数裁定下GPT-5未漏诊紧急消息

reason: 同行评审且有机构外队列外部验证，属重要档
abstract: Patient portal messaging carries a substantial share of outpatient communication, and rising message volume has slowed clinical response to urgent concerns embedded in routine traffic. Whether large language models (LLMs) can triage these messages, and whether locally hosted open-weight models can match cloud-hosted ones, remains unclear. We evaluated six LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-5, GPT-5 Mini, Llama 4 Scout, GPT-OSS 20B, Gemma 3 27B) against a physician reference standard in three cohorts: 500 primary care messages enriched for urgent cases, 503 epilepsy clinic messages from the same health system, and 300 patient-authored messages from public platforms outside it. Under Majority adjudication in primary care, GPT-5 missed no urgent message, and four of six models, including one deployable on-premises, reached sensitivity 0.97 or higher and negative predictive value 0.98 or higher. Rank ordering held across cohorts. Both cloud-hosted and on-premise LLMs can rule out urgent messages with high sensitivity, though specificity remained limited.
zh_abstract: 患者门户消息在门诊沟通中占据相当大的份额，而消息量的上升已放缓临床对常规信息流中紧急关切的响应。大型语言模型（LLMs）能否对这些消息进行分诊，以及本地托管的开放权重模型能否与云端托管模型匹敌，仍不清楚。我们在三个队列中对照医师参考标准评估了六种 LLM（GPT-4o、GPT-5、GPT-5 Mini、Llama 4 Scout、GPT-OSS 20B、Gemma 3 27B）：500 条针对紧急病例富集的基层医疗消息、来自同一医疗系统的 503 条癫痫门诊消息，以及来自该系统之外公共平台的 300 条患者撰写消息。在基层医疗的多数裁决下，GPT-5 未漏掉任何紧急消息，六种模型中有四种（包括一种可本地部署的模型）达到灵敏度 0.97 或更高、阴性预测值 0.98 或更高。排序在各队列中保持一致。云端托管和本地部署的 LLM 均能以高灵敏度排除紧急消息，但特异性仍然有限。

title: Tele-Cranio: a CT-free AI solution for remote diagnosis and planning of craniomaxillofacial deformities
zh_title: Tele-Cranio：免CT的颅颌面畸形远程AI诊断与规划
summary: 基于手机2D面部照片重建3D面形并估计骨骼形态，辅助颅颌面畸形远程评估与术后模拟。
key_points: 用手机2D照片重建3D面部与骨骼形态
539例配对多模态样本，含334例畸形患者
可依据术者骨性方案生成术后面部模拟
reason: 方法新颖、样本量中等，未见外部验证，属回顾性开发研究
abstract: Computed tomography (CT) is central to craniomaxillofacial (CMF) deformity care, yet dependence on in-hospital imaging constrains remote preoperative assessment and outcome visualization, and repeated imaging can increase radiation and access burdens, particularly for children. We developed Tele-Cranio, a telemedicine-oriented artificial intelligence framework that uses mobile-acquired 2D facial photographs to reconstruct 3D facial morphology, estimate corresponding skeletal morphology and support postoperative facial simulation conditioned on surgeon-defined skeletal plans. Tele-Cranio was developed using 539 paired multimodal samples comprising 2D facial photographs, 3D facial scans and CT-derived skeletal models from individuals aged 3–60 years, including 334 patients with CMF deformities across malocclusion, cleft lip with/without palate, hemifacial microsomia and rare anomalies. Its core model, the Bidirectional Craniomaxillofacial Model-Deformity, learns a shared anatomical representation linking facial soft tissue and skeletal structures across normal and pathological morphology. For remote assessment, Tele-Cranio converts facial photographs into 3D facial surfaces and then infers 3D patient-specific skeletal geometry. For simulation, it generates individualized 3D postoperative facial previews after clinicians complete skeletal planning using standard clinical tools. Validated across heterogeneous CMF subgroups, Tele-Cranio provides an interpretable CT-free layer for remote triage, pre-CT consultation, radiation-free follow-up and surgeon–patient communication, while complementing rather than replacing CT-based definitive diagnosis and operative planning.
zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（CT）在颅颌面（craniomaxillofacial, CMF）畸形诊疗中处于核心地位，但依赖院内成像限制了远程术前评估和结果可视化，反复成像会增加辐射和可及性负担，尤其对儿童。我们开发了Tele-Cranio，一个面向远程医疗的人工智能框架，利用移动设备采集的2D面部照片重建3D面部形态，估计相应骨骼形态，并支持以外科医生定义的骨骼方案为条件的术后面部模拟。Tele-Cranio使用539对配对多模态样本开发，这些样本包括来自3–60岁个体的2D面部照片、3D面部扫描和CT衍生骨骼模型，其中包括334例CMF畸形患者，涵盖错颌畸形、伴/不伴腭裂的唇裂、半侧颜面短小和罕见异常。其核心模型Bidirectional Craniomaxillofacial Model-Deformity学习一个共享解剖表征，将正常和病理形态下的面部软组织与骨骼结构联系起来。对于远程评估，Tele-Cranio将面部照片转换为3D面部表面，然后推断3D患者特异性骨骼几何。对于模拟，它在临床医生使用标准临床工具完成骨骼规划后生成个体化3D术后面部预览。在异质性CMF亚组中验证，Tele-Cranio提供一个可解释的无CT层，用于远程分诊、CT前会诊、无辐射随访和医患沟通，同时补充而非替代基于CT的明确诊断和手术规划。

title: Virtual atrial fibrillation dynamics reflect clinical outcomes after catheter ablation
zh_title: 虚拟房颤动力学可反映消融术后临床结局
summary: 基于323例患者高密度电解剖图构建左房数字孪生，虚拟诱导房颤的可持续性及恢复模式可分层预测消融后房性心律失常复发。
key_points: 323例重构左房数字孪生，虚拟起搏诱导房颤
识别四种恢复模式，Overall-Low复发风险更低(aHR 0.37)
非持续性虚拟房颤独立预测更低复发风险
reason: 同行评审、样本可观并报告临床复发结局，但为单队列建模验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Chamber-wide assessment of restitution dynamics is not feasible in vivo during atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation. We reconstructed left-atrial digital twins from high-density (HD) bipolar electroanatomical maps in 323 patients, computed node-level restitution steepness (maximal restitution slope [Smax]; >0.4 million nodes), and induced virtual AF with standardized ramp pacing to classify sustainability (sustained ≥16 s vs non-sustained <16 s), excluding 32 cases with extensive low-voltage substrate and depressed mean Smax. We found that clustering of HD restitution profiles identifies four restitution patterns that stratify clinical atrial arrhythmia recurrence, with the Overall-Low pattern (aHR, 0.37) and the Average-Homogeneous pattern (aHR, 0.59) each showing lower risk than the Overall-High pattern. Furthermore, non-sustained virtual AF independently predicted lower recurrence (aHR: 0.27). Adding restitution pattern and sustainability to clinical covariates improved discrimination (ΔHarrell’s C-index: 0.050), and the combined digital-twin model remained incremental after adjustment for low-voltage area burden, supporting digital-twin outputs as complementary functional descriptors for risk stratification after pulmonary vein isolation.
zh_abstract: 在心房颤动（AF）消融过程中，于体内进行全腔恢复动力学评估不可行。我们从323例患者的高密度（HD）双极电解剖标测图中重建左心房数字孪生，计算节点水平恢复陡度（最大恢复斜率[Smax]；>40万个节点），并用标准化斜坡起搏诱导虚拟AF，以对可持续性进行分类（持续≥16 s vs 非持续<16 s），排除了32例具有广泛低电压基质和平均Smax降低的病例。我们发现，HD恢复谱聚类识别出四种恢复模式，可对临床房性心律失常复发进行分层，其中整体-低模式（aHR，0.37）和平均-均质模式（aHR，0.59）均显示出比整体-高模式更低的风险。此外，非持续性虚拟AF独立预测较低的复发风险（aHR：0.27）。将恢复模式和可持续性加入临床协变量后改善了判别能力（ΔHarrell's C-index：0.050），并且在调整低电压面积负荷后，联合数字孪生模型仍具有增量价值，支持数字孪生输出作为肺静脉隔离后风险分层的补充功能描述指标。

title: Epidemiology-informed graph neural networks for predicting and interpreting transmissible hospital-acquired infections
zh_title: 流行病学信息引导的图神经网络预测院内传播性感染
summary: npj Digital Medicine 提出将机制流行病学模型与图神经网络结合的 EIGNN 框架，用于动态医院环境下的患者状态转移预测与参数估计。
key_points: 将流行病学机制模型融入 GNN，提升可解释性

reason: 同行评审新方法，但摘要未提外部验证或临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Transmissible hospital-acquired infections (HAIs) arise from complex, time-varying interactions among patients, healthcare workers, and clinical environments. Although data-driven approaches like graph neural networks (GNNs) effectively model these contacts, they often function as black boxes that overlook established epidemiological principles, limiting interpretability and clinical trust. Inspired by physics-informed neural networks, we propose an epidemiology-informed GNN (EIGNN) framework for patient-level state transitions prediction in dynamic hospital settings, integrating mechanistic epidemiological models into GNNs in a principled manner. Patient-level risk factors learned from dynamic contact networks are jointly leveraged to infer latent epidemiological states, predict state transitions across multiple horizons, and estimate key epidemiological parameters, including transmission and recovery rates. We evaluate the approach on a real-world hospital-onset COVID-19 cohort and two public datasets simulating viral and bacterial HAIs. Across multiple architectures and horizons, EIGNNs achieves AUC-ROC up to 98.46% while providing interpretable, mechanistically consistent insights, offering a transparent tool for infection prevention and control.
zh_abstract: 可传播的医院获得性感染（HAIs）源于患者、医护人员和临床环境之间复杂的、随时间变化的相互作用。尽管图神经网络（GNNs）等数据驱动方法能有效建模这些接触，但它们常作为黑箱运行，忽视已建立的流行病学原理，限制了可解释性和临床信任。受物理信息神经网络启发，我们提出一种流行病学信息引导的GNN（EIGNN）框架，用于动态医院环境中的患者级状态转移预测，以有原则的方式将机制性流行病学模型整合到GNNs中。从动态接触网络中学习到的患者级风险因素被联合利用，以推断潜在流行病学状态、预测多个时间跨度上的状态转移，并估计关键流行病学参数，包括传播率和恢复率。我们在一个真实世界医院发病COVID-19队列和两个模拟病毒性与细菌性HAIs的公共数据集上评估该方法。在多种架构和时间跨度上，EIGNNs达到高达98.46%的AUC-ROC，同时提供可解释、机制一致的洞见，为感染预防与控制提供透明工具。

title: Shape-informed cardiac mechanics surrogates in data-scarce regimes via geometric encoding and generative augmentation

summary: 同行评审：两步框架将左心室几何表征与物理响应学习解耦，用生成合成几何增强稀缺数据下的力学替代建模。
key_points: 形状模型学习左心室几何的紧凑潜表征
潜空间支持合成几何生成以扩充训练数据
神经场替代模型在该条件下预测外载下心室位移
reason: 方法新颖的同行评审研究，但属计算仿真替代模型，验证范围有限
abstract: High-fidelity computational models of cardiac mechanics provide mechanistic insight into the heart function but are computationally prohibitive for routine clinical use. Surrogate models can accelerate simulations, but generalization across diverse anatomies is challenging, particularly in data-scarce settings. We propose a two-step framework that decouples geometric representation from learning the physics response, to enable shape-informed surrogate modeling under data-scarce conditions. First, a shape model learns a compact latent representation of left ventricular geometries. The learned latent space effectively encodes anatomies and enables synthetic geometries generation for data augmentation. Second, a neural field-based surrogate model, conditioned on this geometric encoding, is trained to predict ventricular displacement under external loading. The proposed architecture performs positional encoding by using universal ventricular coordinates, which improves generalization across diverse anatomies. Geometric variability is encoded using two alternative strategies, which are systematically compared: a PCA-based approach suitable for working with point cloud representations of geometries, and a DeepSDF-based implicit neural representation learned directly from point clouds. Overall, our results, obtained on idealized and patient-specific datasets, show that the proposed approaches allow for accurate predictions and generalization to unseen geometries, and robustness to noisy or sparsely sampled inputs.
zh_abstract: 心脏力学的高保真计算模型可提供对心脏功能的机制性洞见，但对于常规临床使用而言计算成本过高。代理模型（surrogate models）可以加速仿真，但跨多样解剖结构的泛化具有挑战性，尤其是在数据稀缺的条件下。我们提出一个两步框架，将几何表示与物理响应的学习解耦，以便在数据稀缺条件下实现形状信息驱动的代理建模。首先，形状模型学习左心室几何的紧凑潜表示。学到的潜空间有效编码了解剖结构，并能够生成合成几何用于数据增强。其次，一个基于神经场（neural field）的代理模型以该几何编码为条件，被训练用于预测外部载荷下的心室位移。所提出的架构通过使用通用心室坐标（universal ventricular coordinates）进行位置编码，从而提高了跨多样解剖结构的泛化能力。几何变异性使用两种备选策略进行编码，并对其进行了系统比较：一种适合处理几何点云表示的基于 PCA 的方法，以及一种直接从点云学习的基于 DeepSDF 的隐式神经表示。总体而言，我们在理想化和患者特异性数据集上获得的结果显示，所提出的方法能够实现准确预测和对未见几何的泛化，并且对含噪或稀疏采样的输入具有鲁棒性。

zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Antonio Luiz Pinho Ribeiro；疾病：心力衰竭、左心室（LV）收缩功能障碍；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；分期：NA；入组人数：5400；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING] 这项平行组整群随机临床试验的目标是评估，在巴西公共卫生系统内的初级卫生保健中心接受常规诊疗的≥40岁成人中，使用应用于心电图的人工智能算法（AI-ECG）对左心室收缩功能障碍（LVSD）进行机会性筛查，是否增加既往未被识别的LVSD的检出。LVSD是诊断射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）的关键发现，该病已有有效的指南导向药物治疗，但仍诊断不足和治疗不足。该研究还将评估AI-ECG筛查对临床管理、医疗资源利用、实施结局和医疗成本的影响。本研究旨在回答的主要问题包括：1. 与仅临床评估相比，在临床评估基础上增加AI-ECG筛查是否在六个月内增加新检出LVSD（左心室射血分数<50%）患者的比例？2.
