abstract: Objective: Magnetic Resonance Elastography (MRE) is a non-invasive imaging technique for mapping biomechanical properties of in vivo tissue, including shear wave speed (SWS), but involves intrinsically slow data acquisition and an ill-posed wave inversion. Instead of relying on handcrafted image priors, we propose a data-driven approach jointly combining image reconstruction and MRE inversion for robust SWS estimation from undersampled k-space data. Methods: Our physics-informed reconstruction framework comprises two blocks: a model-based neural network (NN)-regularized reconstruction module and a phase-gradient inversion (k-MDEV) calculating SWS from the reconstructed images. Concatenating both blocks yields an end-to-end trainable method to estimate SWS directly from measured k-space data. We evaluated the method on retrospectively highly undersampled brain MRE data and compared it to a total variation (TV) minimization-based approach. We assessed the impact of end-to-end training (qualitative images and SWS maps as targets) versus pre-training (qualitative images as targets) and applied the method also to in vivo data. Results: Our approach significantly reduces NRMSE by 30% compared to TV. End-to-end training improves SWS estimation over separate image reconstruction and SWS calculation. Conclusion: Accurate SWS quantification is possible at acceleration factors up to 19. Our method significantly outperforms TV, highlighting the need for data-driven regularization in this challenging MR problem. Further, our approach successfully generalizes to in vivo data. Significance: We present the first end-to-end trainable MRE reconstruction method for estimating SWS maps directly from k-space. NN-based reconstruction can enable rapid stiffness mapping for dynamic studies, functional imaging, and real-time clinical feedback.
zh_abstract: 【目的】磁共振弹性成像（Magnetic Resonance Elastography, MRE）是一种非侵入性成像技术，用于绘制体内组织的生物力学特性，包括剪切波速度（shear wave speed, SWS），但其本质上涉及缓慢的数据采集和不适定的波反演。我们不再依赖手工设计的图像先验，而是提出一种数据驱动方法，将图像重建与 MRE 反演联合结合，以从欠采样 k 空间数据中进行稳健的 SWS 估计。【方法】我们的物理信息重建框架包括两个模块：一个基于模型的神经网络（neural network, NN）正则化重建模块，以及一个从重建图像计算 SWS 的相位梯度反演（k-MDEV）。将两个模块串联可得到一种端到端可训练方法，直接从测得的 k 空间数据估计 SWS。我们在回顾性高度欠采样的脑 MRE 数据上评估该方法，并与基于全变差（total variation, TV）最小化的方法进行比较。我们评估了端到端训练（以定性图像和 SWS 图为目标）与预训练（以定性图像为目标）的影响，并将该方法也应用于体内数据。【结果】与 TV 相比，我们的方法将 NRMSE 显著降低 30%。端到端训练相较于分别进行图像重建和 SWS 计算改善了 SWS 估计。【结论】在高达 19 的加速因子下仍可实现准确的 SWS 定量。我们的方法显著优于 TV，凸显了在这一具有挑战性的 MR 问题中采用数据驱动正则化的必要性。此外，我们的方法成功泛化到体内数据。【意义】我们提出了首个可直接从 k 空间估计 SWS 图的端到端可训练 MRE 重建方法。基于 NN 的重建可为动态研究、功能成像和实时临床反馈实现快速硬度映射。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Yonsei University; conditions: Thyroid Nodule, Education, Medical, Undergraduate; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 40; status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING] This study compares four educational methods for teaching thyroid ultrasound interpretation to novice learners. Preclinical medical students with no prior training in thyroid ultrasound or the Korean Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System (K-TIRADS) are randomly assigned to one of four groups: (A) traditional one-on-one apprenticeship training, (B) self-learning with images labeled only as benign or malignant, (C) self-learning assisted by an artificial intelligence-based computer-aided diagnosis (AI-CAD) system, or (D) self-learning with images structured by K-TIRADS category. abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Integrating brain imaging data with clinical reports enables the effective use of complementary multimodal information, supporting more accurate and timely diagnosis in real-world clinical settings. This approach has gained growing attention in brain disorder research, yet significant limitations remain: how to encode brain structure and function to reflect meaningful neurological patterns, and how to effectively link objective imaging data with subjective text-based reports while establishing interpretable associations. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal framework that aligns brain connectomes with clinical reports in a shared cross-modal latent space at both subject and connectome levels. Our key innovation lies in treating brain subnetworks as tokens rather than raw image patches, enabling more efficient identification of system-level associations between neuroimaging findings and clinical observations. These cross-modal associations are further fused to enhance mild cognitive impairment (MCI) prediction and provide interpretable diagnostic insights. To our knowledge, this is the first attempt to integrate both structural and functional brain connectivity with non-imaging clinical information. Experimental validation on the ADNI dataset demonstrates performance competitive with recently reported methods. Notably, despite no explicit connectome-token-level supervision, the learned connectome-text associations recover multiple relationships independently reported in the neuroimaging and clinical literature, suggesting that the framework captures clinically coherent cross-modal associations. This pioneering work advances multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) for neurodegenerative disease diagnosis by bridging the gap between neuroimaging analysis and clinical text interpretation through innovative connectome tokenization and cross-modal alignment strategies.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 将脑影像数据与临床报告相结合，能够有效利用互补的多模态信息，支持在真实临床环境中更准确、更及时的诊断。这种方法在脑部疾病研究中日益受到关注，但仍存在显著局限：如何编码脑结构与功能以反映有意义的神经学模式，以及如何有效连接客观影像数据与主观文本报告，同时建立可解释的关联。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的多模态框架，在受试者水平和连接组水平上，将脑连接组与临床报告在共享的跨模态潜在空间中对齐。我们的关键创新在于将脑子网络视为令牌（tokens），而非原始图像块（image patches），从而能够更高效地识别神经影像发现与临床观察之间的系统级关联。这些跨模态关联进一步被融合，以增强轻度认知障碍（MCI）预测并提供可解释的诊断洞见。据我们所知，这是首次尝试将结构性和功能性脑连接与非影像临床信息整合起来。在 ADNI 数据集上的实验验证表明，其性能与近期报道的方法具有竞争力。值得注意的是，尽管没有明确的连接组令牌级监督，学习到的连接组-文本关联恢复了神经影像和临床文献中独立报道的多种关系，这表明该框架捕获了临床一致的跨模态关联。这项开创性工作通过创新的连接组令牌化和跨模态对齐策略，弥合了神经影像分析与临床文本解释之间的差距，从而推进了用于神经退行性疾病诊断的多模态人工智能（AI）。

abstract: Predicting clinical trial outcomes requires interpreting biological and clinical evidence in the context of a specific intervention, population and study design. Here we test whether a general-purpose large language model (LLM) can predict trial outcomes from publicly available evidence. We introduce TrialDossier, which assembles standardized evidence dossiers, and TrialOutlook, which uses these dossiers with GPT-5 to estimate the probability that a trial meets its prespecified primary endpoint. Among 694 ongoing trials with results expected within six months of cohort assembly, 69 outcomes first disclosed after forecast recording had been adjudicated by 20 October 2026. TrialOutlook achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.819 (95% confidence interval, 0.708 to 0.914) and an average precision of 0.860. TrialOutlook correctly identified 27 of 29 failures (93.1%) and incorrectly classified 17 of 40 successes as failures. We further recorded forecasts for 5,809 ongoing trials associated with US-listed companies and established a public benchmark linking archived evidence and fixed forecasts to adjudicated outcomes as they become available.
zh_abstract: 预测临床试验结局需要在特定干预、人群和研究设计的背景下解释生物学和临床证据。在此，我们检验通用大语言模型（LLM）能否根据公开可获得的证据预测试验结局。我们引入TrialDossier，其汇编标准化证据档案；并引入TrialOutlook，其使用这些档案与GPT-5来估计试验达到其预设主要终点的概率。在694项正在进行的试验中，其结果预计在队列组建后六个月内公布，其中69项在预测记录后首次披露的结局已于2026年10月20日前完成裁定。TrialOutlook达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）0.819（95%置信区间，0.708至0.914）和平均精度0.860。TrialOutlook正确识别了29项失败中的27项（93.1%），并将40项成功中的17项错误分类为失败。我们进一步记录了与在美国上市公司相关的5,809项正在进行的试验的预测，并建立了一个公共基准，将存档证据和固定预测与随后可获得并经裁定的结局联系起来。

title: OpenTME: An Open Dataset of AI-powered H&E Tumor Microenvironment Profiles from TCGA

abstract: The tumor microenvironment (TME) plays a central role in cancer progression, treatment response, and patient outcomes, yet large-scale, consistent, and quantitative TME characterization from routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained histopathology remains scarce. We introduce OpenTME, an open-access dataset of pre-computed TME profiles derived from 5,268 H&E-stained whole-slide images across ten cancer types (bladder, breast, colorectal, head and neck, liver, lung, ovarian, pancreatic, prostate, and stomach cancer) from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). All outputs were generated using HETA (H&E Tissue Analysis), an AI-powered application built on the Atlas family of pathology foundation models, which performs tissue quality control, tissue segmentation, cell detection and classification, tumor zone and tertiary lymphoid structure (TLS) detection, and spatial neighborhood analysis, yield
zh_abstract: 肿瘤微环境（TME）在癌症进展、治疗反应和患者结局中发挥核心作用，然而从常规苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色的组织病理学中获得大规模、一致且定量的TME表征仍然稀缺。我们推出OpenTME，这是一个开放获取数据集，包含预计算的TME特征谱，来源于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）中十种癌症类型（膀胱癌、乳腺癌、结直肠癌、头颈癌、肝癌、肺癌、卵巢癌、胰腺癌、前列腺癌和胃癌）的5,268张H&E染色全切片图像。所有输出均使用HETA（H&E Tissue Analysis）生成，这是一款基于Atlas系列病理基础模型的AI驱动应用，可执行组织质量控制、组织分割、细胞检测与分类、肿瘤区域和三级淋巴结构（TLS）检测以及空间邻域分析，产生

title: WakeSentry: real-time awakening detection from single-channel EEG across sleep cohorts and forehead headbands
zh_title: WakeSentry：单通道EEG实时觉醒检测
summary: 预印本提出实时觉醒检测模型，在五个睡眠队列1529夜及224个头带夜中外部验证并优于基线。
key_points: 仅用既往额区EEG实时判定觉醒
三临床队列留出外部验证
reason: 多队列外部验证且含可穿戴场景，预印本封顶8
abstract: Objective/Background: Awakenings after sleep onset are a core measure of sleep continuity, and EEG headbands and closed-loop stimulators, now used at home, must detect each one as it happens, to count it or to stop stimulation. Open sleep stagers match expert scorers, yet have been evaluated only offline over whole nights, so their real-time performance is untested. Patients/Methods: To fill this gap, we developed WakeSentry, which reads only past frontal EEG and learns the moment of waking through an awakening module. We tested it on 1,529 nights from five polysomnography (PSG) cohorts, three clinical, each held out of training, and on 224 headband nights, against GSSC, U-Sleep and YASA. Results: At a matched rate of 0.5 false awakenings per hour, WakeSentry caught more awakenings than GSSC in every cohort and on both headbands. On PSG its sensitivity rose from 63.8% to 70.5%, above U-Sleep and YASA on average. On the headbands it rose from 49.8% to 53.9%, a gain lost without the awakening module. With thresholds preset on the training cohorts, it still outperformed GSSC in six of seven test sets, with at most 0.40 false awakenings per hour. As a replayed stimulator gate, it shortened stimulation during wake in five test sets while staying open for at least 85% of N2 and N3. Conclusions: WakeSentry therefore works in patients and on unseen headbands. It can count awakenings at home and stop stimulation at each one, enabling multi-night monitoring of insomnia and closed-loop stimulation that stops when the sleeper wakes.
zh_abstract: 【目的/背景】睡眠开始后的觉醒是睡眠连续性的核心指标，而如今在家庭中使用的EEG头带和闭环刺激器必须在每次觉醒发生时将其检出，以便计数或停止刺激。开放睡眠分期器与专家评分者表现相当，但仅在整夜数据上进行离线评估，因此其真实时性能尚未经过检验。【患者/方法】为填补这一空白，我们开发了WakeSentry，它仅读取过去的额部EEG，并通过觉醒模块学习觉醒发生的时刻。我们在来自五个多导睡眠图（PSG）队列（其中三个为临床队列，各队列均未纳入训练）的1,529个夜晚，以及224个头带夜晚上进行测试，并与GSSC、U-Sleep和YASA比较。【结果】在每小时0.5次假觉醒的匹配率下，WakeSentry在每个队列和两个头带上都比GSSC捕获更多觉醒。在PSG上，其敏感性从63.8%升至70.5%，平均高于U-Sleep和YASA。在头带上，其敏感性从49.8%升至53.9%，若无觉醒模块则该增益消失。使用在训练队列上预设的阈值时，它仍在七个测试集中的六个优于GSSC，每小时假觉醒最多为0.40次。作为回放的刺激器门控，它在五个测试集中缩短了清醒期刺激，同时在N2和N3期至少85%的时间内保持开放。【结论】因此，WakeSentry可在患者中以及未见过的头带上工作。它可在家庭环境中计数觉醒，并在每次觉醒时停止刺激，从而实现失眠的多夜监测，以及当睡眠者醒来时停止的闭环刺激。

abstract: Segmentation foundation models offer reusable tools for universal medical-image segmentation, but their development and evaluation have largely centered on structural CT and MRI imaging. Functional imaging such as PET provides complementary metabolic information yet remains less studied and validated. Moreover, existing evaluations often involve different datasets and tasks, making modality-associated variation difficult to distinguish from differences in segmentation targets and data distributions. To enable a more direct comparison, we introduce UMD, a whole-body multi-organ dataset comprising 490 PET/CT and 464 PET/MRI examinations with 13 annotated organs (approximately 675,000 2D slices and 12,000 3D organ annotations). UMD evaluates structural and functional images separately on corresponding organs within the same examination, reducing variation in patient anatomy and target selec
zh_abstract: 分割基础模型为通用医学图像分割提供了可复用工具，但其开发和评估在很大程度上集中于结构性 CT 和 MRI 成像。诸如 PET 的功能成像提供互补的代谢信息，但研究和对验证仍较少。此外，现有评估通常涉及不同的数据集和任务，使得难以将模态相关变异与分割目标和数据分布差异区分开来。为了实现更直接的比较，我们引入 UMD，一个全身多器官数据集，包含 490 例 PET/CT 和 464 例 PET/MRI 检查，标注了 13 个器官（约 675,000 个 2D 切片和 12,000 个 3D 器官标注）。UMD 在同一检查内对相应器官分别评估结构和功能图像，减少患者解剖结构和目标选择的变异。

abstract: External-eye photography captures clinically relevant periocular anatomy at low acquisition cost, yet no large-scale standardized resource exists for evaluating self-supervised external-eye representations. We introduce a 4.35-million-image Standardized External-Eye Corpus (SEEC) derived from fourteen heterogeneous public face datasets, together with a benchmark for external-eye representation learning. For evaluation, we provide held-out evaluation distributions, landmark-annotated anatomical probe sets, and clinical disease-classification experiments spanning ptosis, thyroid eye disease, and craniofacial syndromes. zh_abstract: 自动、跨可穿戴设备类型和疾病状况、大规模塑造大量人群健康行为的能力，在改善全球健康结局方面具有巨大潜力。我们设计并实施了一个由人工智能驱动的数字算法助推平台，该平台基于图神经网络（Graph-Neural Network, GNN）的推荐系统以及来自可穿戴健身设备的细粒度健康行为数据实现。在此，我们描述了该平台在新加坡为期12周、对 n=84,764 名个体进行个性化且情境化助推的能力及其有效性结果。我们通过统计验证发现，在接受此类 AI 优化每日助推的目标组参与者中，每日身体活动（如步数）增加了 6.17%（p = 3.09×10^{-4}），每周中等至剧烈身体活动（Moderate to Vigorous Physical Activity, MVPA）分钟数增加了 7.61%（p = 1.16×10^{-2}），相较于匹配的

abstract: Objectives: Radiologists interpreting oncologic chest-abdomen-pelvis (CAP) CT must also detect non-oncologic conditions, yet existing CT foundation models are trained on single anatomical regions or on non-oncologic data. Materials & Methods: CAPTOR is a contrastive vision-language model pretrained on 25,512 predominantly oncologic CAP CT-report pairs (single or multiple series) from a retrospective multicenter dataset (North America, Europe, Asia). zh_abstract: 咳嗽声学有望用于无创结核病（TB）筛查，但机器学习（ML）模型捕捉的是疾病相关声学特征还是数据采集伪影仍未解决。我们在三个独立数据集上评估了经典 ML 和深度学习（DL）基于咳嗽的 TB 分类器的跨数据集泛化能力。尽管数据集内性能中等（ROC-AUC 最高达 0.76 ± 0.06），两种流程均无法泛化，外部性能常低于 0.6，表明可能存在数据局限。我们进一步观察到，音频表征按录音设备和数据集而非 TB 状态组织，预测的 TB 概率在 CODA 中追踪国家级患病率，设备不匹配会降低迁移性能，而设备多样化训练可改善迁移。此外，临床变量基线泛化更一致（ROC-A

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] In the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence (AI), statistics plays a crucial role in addressing challenges faced by medical AI. This review begins by highlighting the primary tasks of medical AI and the integration of statistical methodologies into their modeling processes. Despite the widespread application of AI in medicine and healthcare, key challenges persist: poor model interpretability, lack of causal reasoning, overfitting, unfairness, imbalanced datasets, AI "hallucinations" and "disinformation." Statistics provides unique strategies to tackle these challenges, including rigorous statistical design, regularization techniques, and statistical frameworks grounded in causal inference. Finally, the review offers several recommendations for the sustainable development of medical AI: enhancing data quality, promoting model simplicity and transparency, fostering independent validation standards, and facilitating interdisciplinary collaboration between statisticians and medical AI practitioners.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 在快速发展的人工智能（AI）领域，统计学在应对医学 AI 面临的挑战中发挥着关键作用。本综述首先强调医学 AI 的主要任务，以及统计方法学在其建模过程中的整合。尽管 AI 在医学和医疗保健中广泛应用，关键挑战仍然存在：模型可解释性差、缺乏因果推理、过拟合、不公平、数据集不平衡、AI“幻觉”和“虚假信息”。统计学为应对这些挑战提供了独特策略，包括严谨的统计设计、正则化技术以及基于因果推断的统计框架。最后，本综述为医学 AI 的可持续发展提出若干建议：提高数据质量、促进模型简洁性和透明度、建立独立验证标准，以及促进统计学家与医学 AI 从业者之间的跨学科合作。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Deep learning now underpins most protein-compound interaction (PCI) prediction pipelines, spanning virtual screening, affinity estimation, and lead optimization. Yet strong numbers on standard benchmarks do not reliably translate into discovery outcomes: accuracy can drop sharply under distribution shift, many predictions are hard to rationalize or corroborate with physical evidence, and reported performance is often sensitive to how labels are defined, how data are split, and which metrics are emphasized. In this review, we introduce recent progress in deep learning for PCI prediction across task definitions, protein/ligand representations, interaction modeling architectures, benchmark resources, and evaluation practice, emphasizing the methodological choices that determine reliability outside curated test sets. We relate widely used label and task setups to their underlying assumptions and typical failure modes, analyze how redundancy and similarity leakage can inflate in-distribution results, and highlight recurring trade-offs between model expressiveness, scalability, physical realism, and generalization to unseen targets or chemotypes. We end by outlining practical priorities for evaluation and reporting, including split protocols matched to the intended deployment scenario, explicit treatment of assay heterogeneity, uncertainty-aware and decision-focused metrics, and benchmark designs that better anticipate prospective utility.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 深度学习如今支撑着大多数蛋白质-化合物相互作用（protein-compound interaction，PCI）预测流程，涵盖虚拟筛选、亲和力估计和先导化合物优化。然而，标准基准上的强劲数值并不能可靠地转化为发现结果：在分布偏移下准确率可能急剧下降，许多预测难以合理化或用物理证据佐证，且报告的性能往往对标签如何定义、数据如何划分以及强调哪些指标敏感。在本综述中，我们介绍深度学习用于PCI预测的最新进展，涵盖任务定义、蛋白质/配体表示、相互作用建模架构、基准资源和评估实践，强调决定在精选测试集之外可靠性的方法学选择。我们将广泛使用的标签和任务设置与其基本假设和典型失效模式联系起来，分析冗余和相似性泄漏如何可能夸大分布内结果，并强调模型表达能力、可扩展性、物理真实性和对未见靶点或化学型的泛化之间反复出现的权衡。最后，我们概述评估和报告的实际优先事项，包括与预期部署场景匹配的划分协议、明确处理检测异质性、不确定性感知和以决策为中心的指标，以及能更好预见前瞻性效用的基准设计。

abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) exhibits substantial biological and clinical heterogeneity, posing critical challenges for advancing precision medicine. Existing data-driven approaches often rely on modality-specific clustering or predefined biomarker trajectories, limiting their ability to discover disease subtypes from incomplete, heterogeneous real-world data. In this study, we introduce ADSMoE, a mixture-of-experts (MoE)-based multimodal representation learning framework that jointly identifies AD subtypes as latent disease signatures while accommodating incomplete modality combinations. ADSMoE integrates a Fleximodal MoE encoder that accommodates arbitrary combinations of available modalities with a novel subtype-specific MoE decoder to capture complementary disease characteristics through expert specialization. Using data from 5,422 participants across three independent cohorts, we trained ADSMoE on the ADNI cohort and externally validated the identified subtypes in NACC and UKB without model retraining. The proposed ADSMoE identified four AD subtypes with distinct neuroimaging patterns, genetic and proteomic associations, and clinical characteristics. Benchmarking analyses demonstrated robust subtype discovery and strong biological and clinical relevance, while external validation revealed consistent subtype-associated characteristics across independent cohorts. ADSMoE advances AD subtyping by uncovering biologically and clinically meaningful AD heterogeneity from incomplete multimodal data, providing a scalable framework for disease stratification, biomarker discovery, and future precision medicine applications in AD.
zh_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）表现出显著的生物学和临床异质性，对推进精准医学构成关键挑战。现有数据驱动方法通常依赖模态特异性聚类或预定义的生物标志物轨迹，限制了其从不完整、异质的真实世界数据中发现疾病亚型的能力。在本研究中，我们提出ADSMoE，一种基于专家混合（MoE）的多模态表示学习框架，可在适应不完整模态组合的同时，联合识别AD亚型作为潜在疾病特征。ADSMoE整合了一个Fleximodal MoE编码器（可适应可用模态的任意组合）和一个新颖的亚型特异性MoE解码器，通过专家专业化捕捉互补的疾病特征。使用来自三个独立队列的5,422名参与者的数据，我们在ADNI队列上训练ADSMoE，并在NACC和UKB中对识别出的亚型进行外部验证，且未重新训练模型。所提出的ADSMoE识别出四种AD亚型，具有不同的神经影像模式、遗传和蛋白质组学关联以及临床特征。基准分析表明其亚型发现稳健，并具有强生物学和临床相关性，而外部验证显示亚型相关特征在独立队列中一致。ADSMoE通过从不完整多模态数据中揭示具有生物学和临床意义的AD异质性，推进了AD亚型分型，为疾病分层、生物标志物发现以及AD未来精准医学应用提供了可扩展框架。

abstract: A unified 3D medical foundation model promises reusable, frozen features that serve a wide variety of tasks such as segmentation, classification and registration on MRI, CT and PET as well as specialist models do. abstract: Accurate fitness prediction is central to protein engineering and understanding sequence-function relationships. With advances in deep learning, protein foundation models (PFMs) have become widely used for this task. abstract: Coronary angiography (CAG) is the gold-standard imaging modality for evaluating coronary artery disease, but its interpretation and subsequent treatment planning rely heavily on expert cardiologists. To enable AI-based decision support, we introduce a two-stage, physician-curated pipeline and a bilingual (Japanese/English) CAG image-report dataset. First, we sample 14,686 frames from 539 exams and annotate them for key-frame detection and left/right laterality; a ConvNeXt-Base CNN trained on this data achieves 0.96 F1 on laterality classification, even on low-contrast frames. abstract: Evaluating general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for surgical scene understanding remains limited due to scarce surgical data and fragmented evaluation protocols. We address these challenges through a two-stage evaluation framework for surgical scene understanding. In Stage I, we introduce SurgKnowBench, a diagnostic benchmark that harmonizes public surgical datasets across procedures and tasks and evaluates proprietary and open-source MLLMs to map the boundary of pretrained surgical competence. SurgKnowBench reveals that current models retain partial visual priors but remain weak on relational and procedural understanding and workflow assessment. Building on this failure frontier and motivated by the scaffolded nature of surgical training, we introduce SurgAgentGym, an agentic environment where general-purpose MLLM agents can use bounded knowledge search over SurgWiki

zh_abstract: 糖尿病患者的非计划30天再入院带来沉重的临床和经济负担，然而大多数预测模型仅使用结构化电子健康记录（EHR）数据，而忽略自由文本临床笔记，这些笔记常包含代码混合的印地语-英语（Hinglish）措辞和否定表达，通用语言模型对其解析不可靠。我们提出一个神经符号多模态框架，在公开的Diabetes 130-US Hospitals数据集（101,766次就诊；71,518名患者）上以患者水平分组80/20划分进行评估。融合三个数据流：工程化结构化特征；通过截断奇异值分解获得的Bio_ClinicalBERT笔记嵌入的32个成分；以及由开放权重临床语言模型在三阶段混合检索增强生成流水线（稠密检索、稀疏词汇检索）中提取的符号实体。

zh_abstract: 胸部X线在胸部诊断中发挥核心作用，其解读本质上需要多步骤、基于证据的推理。然而，大型视觉-语言模型（large vision-language models, LVLMs）常生成看似合理但并未忠实基于诊断证据的回答，并提供的可用于验证的视觉证据有限；同时它们需要昂贵的再训练来支持新的诊断任务，这限制了其在临床环境中的可靠性和适应性。为解决这些局限，我们提出CXReasonAgent，一种诊断智能体，它将大型语言模型（large language model, LLM）与临床依据的诊断工具整合，以使用源自图像的诊断证据和视觉证据进行基于证据的诊断推理。为评估这些能力，我们引入CXReasonDail，一个包含跨12个诊断任务的1,946段对话的多轮对话基准，并表明CXReasonAgent

abstract: As AI systems are increasingly used to draft radiology reports, reliably evaluating their clinical quality remains a critical challenge. We introduce RadMatch, a multi-stage LLM-based framework that turns report evaluation into a structured, auditable finding-level record. It extracts findings from a reference and a candidate report, matches them by clinical equivalence, grades each match over ten clinical attributes, and gives every match and unmatched finding a verdict and a clinical-significance tier. To validate metrics on CT, we build and release MetricEval-BodyCT, the first public metric-evaluation benchmark of chest and abdomen CT reports annotated by radiologists error by error. abstract: Biomedical tables often combine thousands of measured variables with only tens or hundreds of labelled samples, a regime that is poorly represented in general-purpose tabular benchmarks. At the reference cell of 10,000 features and 100 training samples, RealTabPFN 2.5 has the highest point estimate, closely followed by TabPFN 3 and Logistic Regression. abstract: Many medical conditions require clinical assessment of symptoms, history, and functioning rather than judgments from appearance. We study whether vision-language models (VLMs) abstain from facial attribution of autism spectrum disorder (ASD), attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), major depressive disorder (MDD), and generalized anxiety disorder (GAD). To support this study, we construct PARITY (Paired Assessment with Reused Identity), a demographically balanced dataset for testing whether changing facial expressions alters diagnostic judgments, while holding identity and other visual factors as constant as possible. Our comprehensive evaluation of 27 open- and closed-weight models reveals inconsistent abstention across expressions, conditions, and task formats. abstract: Reliable evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) and medical vision-language models (Medical-VLMs) requires calibrated confidence, particularly under realistic clinical conditions. The benchmark covers eight different backbones, three medical modalities, including fundus imaging, histopathology, and chest X-ray under in-domain and domain shift settings. zh_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）和医学视觉语言模型（Medical-VLMs）的可靠评估需要经过校准的置信度，尤其是在真实临床条件下。然而，现有工作主要集中于提高准确率，使医学领域的校准问题尚未得到充分探索。为此，我们提出 MVC-Bench，一个以校准为中心的基准，用于使用 VLMs 和 Medical-VLMs 进行医学图像分类。MVC-Bench 从三个维度评估校准：（i）对模态、骨干网络和域偏移的稳健性；（ii）校准策略和提示调优方法的有效性；（iii）在提示模板和随机种子变化下的稳定性。该基准涵盖八种不同骨干网络、三种医学模态，包括眼底成像、组织病理学和胸部 X 射线，在域内和域偏移设置下进行评估。它比较事后校准、训练时

abstract: Medical evaluation is shifting from static option-based questioning to realistic clinical scenarios with open-ended output modes. We ask what happens when the rubrics themselves are not airtight, and whether such flaws can be detected and corrected. abstract: ProteinGeoBench is a set of 131 tasks that give an agent protein structure files and ask it to look up recorded facts, check sequences, calculate geometry from atom coordinates or reason about structures. We ran four frontier models on every task several times (4,249 runs) and 26 models on a subset. A single overall score hides two different skills. Three of the four frontier models are best at looking up facts and worst at calculating from coordinates: Claude Opus 5 scores 0.907 on lookup and 0.716 on calculation. abstract: Real-world clinical diagnosis is a complex process in which the doctor is required to obtain information from both interaction with the patient and conducting medical exams. Additionally, the doctor needs to adapt to different patient personas, as well as noisy and incomplete information that can happen at any time during the process. However, existing benchmarks for medical LLMs and methods for automatic diagnosis largely simplify this process by reducing it to single-turn question answering, noise-free conversations, or sequential exam making, etc., ignoring the interactive and uncertain nature of clinical diagnosis. abstract: Cervical cancer remains a major malignancy in women, with large-scale human papillomavirus-based screening generating a large volume of biopsies and, for advanced cases, surgical specimens, imposing an overwhelming diagnostic burden that necessitates precise histopathological evaluation. Although deep learning shows promise, general foundation models offer a broader reach but remain limited in capturing subspecialty-specific features and task adaptability. We introduce the Cervical Subspecialty Pathology (CerS-Path) diagnostic system, built upon the subspecialized dataset and developed through two synergistic pretraining stages: self-supervised learning on approximately 190 million tissue patches to build a cervical-specific feature extractor, and multimodal enhancement with 2.5 million image-text pairs, followed by diagnostic functions integration and downstream task enhancement. abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for medical guidance, but women's health remains under-evaluated in benchmark design. We present the Women's Health Benchmark (WHBench), a targeted evaluation suite of 47 expert-crafted scenarios across 10 women's health topics, designed to expose clinically meaningful failure modes including outdated guidelines, unsafe omissions, dosing errors, and equity-related blind spots. We evaluate 22 models using a 23-criterion rubric spanning clinical accuracy, completeness, safety, communication quality, instruction following, equity, uncertainty handling, and guideline adherence, with safety-weighted penalties and server-side score recalculation. Across 3,102 attempted responses (3,100 scored), no model mean performance exceeds 75 percent; the best model reaches 72.1 percent. zh_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于医学指导，但女性健康在基准设计中仍评估不足。我们提出女性健康基准（WHBench），这是一个有针对性的评估套件，包含 47 个专家设计的场景，涵盖 10 个女性健康主题，旨在暴露具有临床意义的失效模式，包括过时指南、不安全遗漏、剂量错误和与公平性相关的盲点。我们使用包含 23 项标准的评分细则评估 22 个模型，涵盖临床准确性、完整性、安全性、沟通质量、指令遵循、公平性、不确定性处理和指南依从性，并采用安全性加权惩罚和服务器端分数重新计算。在 3,102 次尝试回答（3,100 次评分）中，没有模型的平均表现超过 75%；最佳模型达到 72.1%。即使是顶尖模型也显示出较低的完全正确率，并且在 h 方面存在显著变异。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Pulmonary diseases currently pose significant threats to global health, spanning common chronic conditions including lung cancer, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and asthma, as well as infectious and inflammatory diseases like tuberculosis, interstitial lung disease (ILD), and COVID-19. Therefore, accurate diagnosis, effective therapeutic strategies, and reliable assessment of prognosis for pulmonary diseases are essential for improving patient outcomes and safeguarding public health. Despite the increasing availability of medical imaging and pathological data owing to improvements in detection technologies, what is becoming increasingly evident are the limitations of conventional diagnosis, which relies solely on clinicians' subjective judgment based on imaging, pulmonary function, pathology, and clinical experience. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) technology, especially machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), has made significant progress in areas such as image recognition and model construction. Numerous studies have demonstrated the widespread application of AI in the screening and diagnosis of lung diseases, the optimization of treatment strategies, and prognosis assessment, revealing its remarkable ability to process and interpret complex clinical data. Although concerns persist regarding data quality, the "black box" nature of algorithms, clinical practice, and the regulatory landscape, the application of AI in lung disease research and clinical care is more and more promising. In this review, we summarize the latest advances of AI in the diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary diseases, analyze the challenges and limitations of current AI technologies ranging from data and algorithms to clinical translation, and highlight directions for future research.
zh_abstract: [《分子生物学方法》（Methods in Molecular Biology，Clifton, N.J.）] 肺部疾病目前对全球健康构成重大威胁，涵盖常见慢性疾病，包括肺癌、慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）和哮喘，以及结核病、间质性肺疾病（ILD）和COVID-19等感染性和炎症性疾病。因此，对肺部疾病进行准确诊断、有效治疗策略以及可靠预后评估，对于改善患者结局和保障公共卫生至关重要。尽管由于检测技术的进步，医学影像和病理数据的可获得性日益增加，但越来越明显的是，仅依赖临床医生基于影像、肺功能、病理和临床经验的主观判断的传统诊断存在局限性。近年来，人工智能（AI）技术，尤其是机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL），在图像识别和模型构建等领域取得了显著进展。大量研究已证明AI在肺部疾病筛查与诊断、治疗策略优化和预后评估中的广泛应用，显示出其处理和解读复杂临床数据的显著能力。尽管数据质量、算法的“黑箱”性质、临床实践和监管环境等方面仍存在担忧，但AI在肺部疾病研究和临床照护中的应用正变得越来越有前景。在本综述中，我们总结AI在肺部疾病诊断和治疗中的最新进展，分析当前AI技术从数据和算法到临床转化所面临的挑战和局限性，并强调未来研究方向。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] With the development of artificial intelligence (AI), AI-assisted clinical diagnosis, driven by big data analytics and machine/deep learning (ML/DL), has brought great changes in clinical decision. AI enhances disease detection, classification, and treatment planning by processing diverse data such as electronic health records (EHRs), medical images, and genomics. Key applications include high-accuracy cancer screening, neurological disorder prediction, and diagnostics in ophthalmology, endocrinology, and pediatrics. Significant challenges involve data quality/standardization, model interpretability, and ethical/legal concerns. Mitigation strategies include federated learning, Explainable AI, and fairness constraints. Future directions focus on multimodal data fusion, real-time monitoring via wearables, and collaborative human-AI diagnostics. AI is positioned as a tool to augment clinicians, promising improved diagnostic precision, efficiency, and accessibility in precision medicine, contingent on overcoming technical and ethical hurdles through interdisciplinary collaboration.
zh_abstract: [《分子生物学方法（Clifton, N.J.）》] 随着人工智能（AI）的发展，由大数据分析以及机器学习/深度学习（ML/DL）驱动的AI辅助临床诊断已在临床决策中带来巨大变化。AI通过处理电子健康记录（EHR）、医学图像和基因组学等多样化数据，增强疾病检测、分类和治疗规划。关键应用包括高准确度癌症筛查、神经系统疾病预测，以及眼科、内分泌科和儿科诊断。重大挑战涉及数据质量/标准化、模型可解释性以及伦理/法律问题。缓解策略包括联邦学习、可解释AI（Explainable AI）和公平性约束。未来方向聚焦于多模态数据融合、通过可穿戴设备进行实时监测，以及人机协作诊断。AI被定位为增强临床医生的工具，有望在精准医学中提高诊断精确性、效率和可及性，但前提是通过跨学科合作克服技术和伦理障碍。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] As a crucial component in preclinical cancer research, patient-derived models (PDMs) are experiencing a substantial transformation due to AI integration. AI improves the conversion efficiency of PDMs' static-dynamic predictions through cross-modal data integration and supports a comprehensive precision medicine technology platform that encompasses everything from molecular mechanisms to clinical translation. In clinical translation, the "AI-PDMs" system is revolutionizing oncology drug development and enabling personalized treatment decisions, moving from experience-based methods to data-driven strategies. This paper provides a detailed summary of AI's innovative uses of PDMs, such as machine learning-based high-dimensional pharmacological sensitivity data mining, deep learning-enhanced 3D tumor microenvironment modeling, and computer vision-driven advancements in pathological feature annotation, thereby offering a systematic framework for future cancer diagnosis and treatment innovations.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 作为临床前癌症研究的关键组成部分，患者来源模型（patient-derived models, PDMs）正因人工智能（AI）整合而经历重大转变。AI通过跨模态数据整合提高了PDMs静态-动态预测的转化效率，并支持一个涵盖从分子机制到临床转化的全面精准医学技术平台。在临床转化中，“AI-PDMs”系统正在革新肿瘤药物开发并使个性化治疗决策成为可能，从基于经验的方法转向数据驱动策略。本文详细总结了AI对PDMs的创新性应用，例如基于机器学习的高维药理学敏感性数据挖掘、深度学习增强的3D肿瘤微环境建模，以及计算机视觉驱动的病理特征注释进展，从而为未来癌症诊断和治疗创新提供系统框架。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Precision medicine relies heavily on electronic health records (EHRs) to systematically capture longitudinal clinical data across populations. Integrating omics data, such as genomics, proteomics, and metabolomics, with EHRs holds transformative potential for individual-level disease risk assessment and therapeutic optimization. Recent advances in artificial intelligence, particularly multimodal learning algorithms, have enabled deeper exploration of EHR data, enhancing predictive modeling, patient stratification, and phenotyping. These artificial intelligence (AI)-driven approaches are expanding the scope of precision medicine from research contexts to scalable, real-time clinical decision-making. In real-world implementation, however, leveraging EHRs for precision medicine demands navigating complex technical, ethical, and operational challenges. These include data interoperability, model generalizability, and equity concerns. Future efforts should emphasize standardization, responsible AI practices, and integration of digital health and patient-reported outcomes to build learning health systems that are adaptive, equitable, and clinically impactful.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 精准医学高度依赖电子健康记录（EHRs）来系统捕获人群的纵向临床数据。将组学数据（如基因组学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学）与EHR整合，对于个体层面的疾病风险评估和治疗优化具有变革性潜力。人工智能的最新进展，尤其是多模态学习算法，使得对EHR数据的更深入探索成为可能，增强了预测建模、患者分层和表型分析。这些人工智能（AI）驱动的方法正在将精准医学的范围从研究情境扩展到可扩展的实时临床决策。然而在现实实施中，利用EHR开展精准医学需要应对复杂的技术、伦理和运营挑战。这些挑战包括数据互操作性、模型泛化性和公平性关切。未来工作应强调标准化、负责任的AI实践，以及整合数字健康和患者报告结局，以构建自适应、公平且具有临床影响力的学习型医疗系统。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] The inherent complexity and heterogeneity of cancer create an urgent need for individualized treatment strategies. However, traditional population-based medical approaches have limitations in addressing patient-specific differences. Meanwhile, conventional clinical trials are often constrained by lengthy timelines, high costs, and difficulties in patient recruitment, particularly for rare cancers and pediatric populations, thereby hindering the development of novel therapies. To address these challenges, medical digital twins (MDTs) have emerged as dynamic computational models that represent an individual patient's physiology and disease state and are continuously updated as real-world data accumulate. To explain how MDTs transform accumulating patient data into actionable insights, this chapter first introduces their fundamental architecture, comprising five interdependent components: the patient, data connection, patient-in-silico, interface, and twin synchronization. Within this architecture, the patient-in-silico component can be constructed using mechanistic models based on established biological principles, artificial intelligence models driven by large-scale clinical data, or hybrid models combining both approaches. Representative mechanistic and artificial intelligence-driven MDTs are then presented to illustrate how these modeling approaches have been applied in oncology. Specifically, MDTs can support precision oncology and improve the efficiency of clinical trials. In precision oncology, MDTs can simulate disease progression and therapeutic responses, allowing treatment regimens to be tested virtually before administration and thereby supporting personalized treatment decisions. In virtual clinical trials, MDTs can enhance randomized trials through the PROCOVA™ methodology, provide synthetic control arms for single-arm studies, and support the identification of optimal dosing regimens in early-phase trials. However, MDTs also face challenges related to computational complexity, generalizability across diverse populations, AI-related model validation and regulatory compliance, and underdeveloped ethical frameworks for continuous-learning systems. Despite these challenges, MDTs hold considerable potential to reshape cancer care, optimize individualized therapies, and accelerate oncology drug development.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 癌症固有的复杂性和异质性迫切需要个体化治疗策略。然而，传统的基于人群的医学方法在应对患者特异性差异方面存在局限。同时，传统临床试验常受限于周期长、成本高以及患者招募困难，尤其是罕见癌症和儿科人群，从而阻碍了新疗法的开发。为应对这些挑战，医学数字孪生（medical digital twins, MDTs）应运而生，它们是动态计算模型，可表征个体患者的生理和疾病状态，并随着真实世界数据的积累而持续更新。为解释MDTs如何将不断积累的患者数据转化为可操作的洞见，本章首先介绍其基本架构，该架构由五个相互依存的组成部分构成：患者、数据连接、计算机模拟患者（patient-in-silico）、接口和孪生同步。在该架构中，计算机模拟患者组件可使用基于既定生物学原理的机制模型、由大规模临床数据驱动的人工智能模型，或结合两种方法的混合模型来构建。随后介绍代表性的机制型和人工智能驱动的MDTs，以说明这些建模方法如何应用于肿瘤学。具体而言，MDTs可支持精准肿瘤学并提高临床试验效率。在精准肿瘤学中，MDTs可模拟疾病进展和治疗反应，允许在给药前虚拟测试治疗方案，从而支持个性化治疗决策。在虚拟临床试验中，MDTs可通过PROCOVA™方法增强随机试验，为单臂研究提供合成对照臂，并支持在早期试验中识别最佳给药方案。然而，MDTs也面临与计算复杂性、跨不同人群的泛化性、与人工智能相关的模型验证和监管合规，以及持续学习系统伦理框架欠发达相关的挑战。尽管存在这些挑战，MDTs在重塑癌症照护、优化个体化治疗和加速肿瘤药物开发方面具有相当大的潜力。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] The rapid growth of electronic health records, clinical trial repositories, and real-world medical data creates new opportunities for estimating how treatment effects vary across patients. In recent years, a wide range of artificial intelligence (AI)-based methods has been developed to move beyond average treatment effects (ATE) and support more individualized treatment decisions. However, despite this methodological progress, only a small number of these approaches are used in routine clinical practice. At the same time, precision medicine highlights the limitations of relying solely on population-average treatment effects. In this chapter, we review the main ideas and methods underlying AI-based individual treatment effect (ITE) estimation. We discuss the limitations of conventional subgroup analysis and introduce the major classes of conditional average treatment effect (CATE) estimation methods, including outcome modeling, effect modeling, and deep causal learning approaches. We further illustrate their use in both randomized trials and observational studies, with examples from intensive blood pressure control and sepsis care, and highlight the evaluation and interpretability challenges essential for clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 电子健康记录、临床试验数据库和真实世界医疗数据的快速增长，为估计治疗效果如何在患者间变化创造了新机会。近年来，已开发出广泛的人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）方法来超越平均治疗效应（average treatment effects, ATE），并支持更个体化的治疗决策。然而，尽管有这些方法学进展，其中只有少数方法用于常规临床实践。同时，精准医学凸显了仅依赖人群平均治疗效应的局限性。在本章中，我们综述基于AI的个体治疗效应（individual treatment effect, ITE）估计的主要思想和方法。我们讨论传统亚组分析的局限性，并介绍条件平均治疗效应（conditional average treatment effect, CATE）估计方法的主要类别，包括结局建模、效应建模和深度因果学习方法。我们进一步以强化血压控制和脓毒症诊疗为例，说明其在随机试验和观察性研究中的应用，并强调对临床转化至关重要的评估和可解释性挑战。

title: AI-Driven Approaches in Pharmacogenomics for Precision Medicine.

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] With the advancement of precision medicine, pharmacogenomics (PGx) is playing an increasingly important role in guiding personalized drug therapy. The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, particularly machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), is infusing new momentum into PGx research and significantly accelerating its translational applications in clinical settings. This review systematically summarizes recent progress and practical applications of AI in the field of PGx. We highlight that AI not only enhances the interpretation of complex genetic variations but also uncovers potential mechanisms of drug response and adverse reactions from large-scale heterogeneous data, thereby exerting substantial influence on both drug development and clinical pharmacotherapy. Nevertheless, the clinical implementation of AI in PGx still faces multiple challenges, including data bias, limited model generalizability, insufficient regulatory frameworks, and ethical and legal concerns. In the future, with continued optimization of algorithms, interdisciplinary collaboration, and the establishment of robust ethical standards, AI is expected to play a more central role in advancing personalized medicine and bridging the gap between research and clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 随着精准医学的进步，药物基因组学（PGx）在指导个体化药物治疗方面发挥着越来越重要的作用。人工智能（AI）技术，尤其是机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）的快速发展，正为PGx研究注入新动力，并显著加速其在临床环境中的转化应用。本综述系统总结了AI在PGx领域的最新进展和实际应用。我们强调，AI不仅增强了对复杂遗传变异的解读，还能从大规模异质性数据中揭示药物反应和不良反应的潜在机制，从而对药物研发和临床药物治疗产生重大影响。然而，AI在PGx中的临床实施仍面临多重挑战，包括数据偏倚、模型泛化能力有限、监管框架不足以及伦理和法律问题。未来，随着算法的持续优化、跨学科合作以及稳健伦理标准的建立，AI有望在推进个性化医疗和弥合研究与临床实践之间的差距方面发挥更核心的作用。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have been instrumental in uncovering the genetic basis of complex traits, yet classical single-variant testing remains limited in power and biological interpretability. Over the past decade, GWAS methodology has expanded from purely statistical association frameworks toward integrative models that incorporate functional annotations, multi-trait information, and data-driven prioritization strategies. Early developments leveraged regulatory genomics and cross-phenotype statistics to improve locus discovery, while machine learning approaches enabled systematic ranking of sub-threshold variants. More recently, deep learning architectures, including Transformer-based frameworks, have been introduced to integrate GWAS summary signals with linkage disequilibrium patterns and diverse genomic annotations. In parallel, multi-omics integration and transfer learning across related traits have emerged as practical solutions for limited sample sizes and population heterogeneity. This chapter reviews the evolving methodological landscape of AI-enabled GWAS, highlights key advances in variant discovery and functional interpretation, and discusses remaining challenges such as ancestry bias, interpretability, and the need for biological validation. Together, these approaches provide a foundation for more context-aware and scalable genetic studies of complex disease.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 全基因组关联研究（GWAS）在揭示复杂性状的遗传基础方面发挥了重要作用，但经典的单变异检验在统计效力和生物学可解释性方面仍然有限。过去十年间，GWAS方法学已从纯粹的统计关联框架扩展到整合功能注释、多性状信息和数据驱动优先排序策略的整合模型。早期发展利用调控基因组学和跨表型统计来改进位点发现，而机器学习方法则使对低于显著性阈值的变异进行系统排序成为可能。更近期，包括基于Transformer的框架在内的深度学习架构被引入，以将GWAS汇总信号与连锁不平衡模式及多样化基因组注释相整合。与此同时，多组学整合和跨相关性状的迁移学习已成为应对样本量有限和群体异质性的实用解决方案。本章综述了AI赋能GWAS不断演变的方法学图景，重点介绍了变异发现和功能解读方面的关键进展，并讨论了仍存在的挑战，如祖源偏倚、可解释性以及生物学验证的必要性。总之，这些方法为更情境感知且可扩展的复杂疾病遗传研究奠定了基础。

abstract: [Biomedicine & pharmacotherapy = Biomedecine & pharmacotherapie] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in cardiovascular research where conventional analysis struggles with scale, heterogeneity, and multimodal integration. Its contribution differs across imaging, computational omics, mechanistic simulation, and drug discovery. This narrative review examines substantive applications of machine learning and deep learning while distinguishing them from routine bioinformatics and purely biophysical modeling. We assess independent biological units, validation strategies, and strength of inference in representative studies. Deep-learning imaging systems can provide reproducible quantitative phenotypes, but workflow performance alone does not establish mechanism. In single-cell and spatial studies, clustering, integration, trajectory inference, and network reconstruction generally yield associations or hypotheses unless experimentally supported. Mechanistic interpretation is bounded by the specific effect established through targeted perturbation or rescue with functional testing; lineage tracing and orthogonal readouts provide complementary support, not standalone proof of causation. Hybrid AI-biophysical models may accelerate personalized simulation, whereas heart-on-chip, engineered tissue, and organoid systems without learned components are validation platforms rather than AI methods. In drug discovery, active learning and molecular redesign can prioritize candidates, but predicted reductions in ion-channel liability do not demonstrate biological safety or reduced proarrhythmic risk. Major limitations include pseudoreplication, data leakage, domain shift, batch effects, uncertain labels, few independent hearts, demographic imbalance, incomplete calibration, and limited transfer among animal, iPSC-derived, and adult human systems. AI is most valuable when it produces robust phenotypes or experimentally testable hypotheses within a transparent validation framework, rather than when predictive accuracy is treated as mechanistic evidence.
zh_abstract: [Biomedicine & pharmacotherapy = Biomedecine & pharmacotherapie] 人工智能（AI）正越来越多地用于心血管研究，而传统分析在规模、异质性和多模态整合方面面临困难。其贡献在影像学、计算组学、机制模拟和药物发现中各不相同。本叙述性综述考察机器学习和深度学习的实质性应用，同时将其与常规生物信息学和纯生物物理建模区分开来。我们评估代表性研究中的独立生物学单元、验证策略和推断强度。深度学习影像系统可提供可重复的定量表型，但仅凭工作流程性能并不能确立机制。在单细胞和空间研究中，聚类、整合、轨迹推断和网络重建通常产生关联或假设，除非得到实验支持。机制解释受限于通过靶向扰动或功能测试中的挽救实验所确立的具体效应；谱系追踪和正交读出提供补充支持，而非独立的因果证明。混合 AI-生物物理模型可能加速个性化模拟，而芯片心脏（heart-on-chip）、工程组织和无学习成分的类器官系统是验证平台，而非 AI 方法。在药物发现中，主动学习和分子重新设计可对候选物进行优先级排序，但预测的离子通道风险降低并不能证明生物学安全性或致心律失常风险降低。主要局限包括伪重复、数据泄漏、域偏移、批次效应、标签不确定、独立心脏样本少、人口学不平衡、校准不完整，以及在动物、iPSC 衍生和成人人类系统之间迁移有限。当 AI 在透明验证框架内产生稳健表型或可实验检验的假设时，其价值最大；而非将预测准确性视为机制证据时。

title: AI-Driven Monitoring of Biomechanical Loading in Mild Traumatic Brain Injury.
source: PubMed · Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)
zh_title: AI监测轻度脑外伤的生物力学负荷

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) is difficult to identify rapidly because clinical symptoms may be delayed and conventional CT or MRI often reveals no structural abnormalities. Biomechanics-based monitoring provides an objective complementary strategy by measuring head kinematics at the moment of impact and estimating the resulting brain deformation. This review summarizes how artificial intelligence (AI) can overcome two major barriers to this approach: errors in wearable-sensor measurements and the high computational cost of finite element head models. AI-based methods can denoise instrumented mouthguard signals, distinguish true impacts from false triggers, and infer impact direction, location, speed, and force. Deep learning head models can further map six-degree-of-freedom head kinematics to whole-brain strain and strain-rate distributions within milliseconds, enabling near-real-time tissue-level injury assessment. Recent advances, including kinematic feature optimization, principal component analysis, impact subtyping, transfer learning, unsupervised domain adaptation, and spatiotemporal prediction, have improved model efficiency, interpretability, and generalizability across impact scenarios. Integrating wearable sensing with AI-accelerated brain modeling could support rapid removal from exposure, earlier clinical evaluation and intervention, and monitoring of cumulative impact dose. Future research should improve sensor wearability and coupling, incorporate subject-specific brain morphology and cortical folding, represent cerebrospinal fluid mechanics more realistically, and develop unified models that jointly estimate brain deformation and predict clinically confirmed injury. AI-enabled biomechanical monitoring may therefore complement symptom- and imaging-based assessments and advance real-time, personalized mTBI detection and prevention.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 轻度创伤性脑损伤（mTBI）难以快速识别，因为临床症状可能延迟出现，且常规 CT 或 MRI 常无结构异常。基于生物力学的监测通过测量撞击瞬间的头部运动学并估计由此产生的脑变形，提供了一种客观的补充策略。本综述总结了人工智能（AI）如何克服该方法的两大障碍：可穿戴传感器测量误差和有限元头部模型的高计算成本。基于 AI 的方法可对仪器化护齿信号去噪，区分真实撞击与假触发，并推断撞击方向、位置、速度和力。深度学习头部模型可进一步在数毫秒内将六自由度头部运动学映射为全脑应变和应变率分布，从而实现近实时的组织水平损伤评估。近期进展，包括运动学特征优化、主成分分析、撞击亚型划分、迁移学习、无监督域适应和时空预测，提高了模型效率、可解释性以及在各种撞击情景中的泛化能力。将可穿戴传感与 AI 加速的脑建模相结合，可支持快速脱离暴露、更早的临床评估和干预，以及累积撞击剂量监测。未来研究应改善传感器的可佩戴性和耦合，纳入受试者特异性脑形态和皮层折叠，更真实地表示脑脊液力学，并开发联合估计脑变形和预测临床确诊损伤的统一模型。因此，AI 赋能的生物力学监测可补充基于症状和影像的评估，并推进实时、个性化的 mTBI 检测和预防。

abstract: [Trends in endocrinology and metabolism: TEM] The complex structures and dynamic processes of lipids make it challenging to decipher lipid reprogramming in metabolic diseases. Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) with lipidomics, mass spectrometry imaging, and lipid metabolic fluxomics enables rapid, high-precision, and in-depth spatiotemporal profiling of lipid species. In this review, we summarize advances in AI-empowered lipidomics, which not only accelerate spatiotemporal data processing but also offer new avenues to resolve the heterogeneity of lipid metabolism. Importantly, AI-assisted lipidomics could identify candidate biomarkers and generate testable hypotheses about disease mechanisms. Furthermore, we evaluate whether computational advances yield trustworthy evidence by examining annotation confidence, quantitative accuracy, cross-platform reproducibility, uncertainty calibration, and external validation. We also address the current limitations of AI-assisted lipidomics, particularly the risk of AI hallucinations.
zh_abstract: [Trends in endocrinology and metabolism: TEM] 脂质的复杂结构和动态过程使得解析代谢疾病中的脂质重编程具有挑战性。将人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）与脂质组学、质谱成像和脂质代谢通量组学相结合，能够对脂质种类进行快速、高精度且深入的时空分析。在本综述中，我们总结了人工智能赋能脂质组学的进展，这些进展不仅加速了时空数据处理，还为解析脂质代谢异质性提供了新途径。重要的是，人工智能辅助脂质组学能够识别候选生物标志物，并就疾病机制提出可检验的假设。此外，我们通过考察注释置信度、定量准确性、跨平台可重复性、不确定性校准和外部验证，评估计算进展是否能产生可信证据。我们还讨论了人工智能辅助脂质组学当前的局限性，尤其是人工智能幻觉的风险。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Human-Virus Protein-Protein Interactions (HV-PPIs) are the core mechanisms underlying viral invasion of host cells, completion of the viral life cycle, and induction of pathological responses. Predicting HV-PPIs in higher accuracy is of great significance for elucidating viral pathogenic mechanisms, developing antiviral drugs, and designing vaccines. However, traditional experimental methods such as Yeast Two-Hybrid (Y2H) and Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry (AP-MS) face bottlenecks including low throughput, high cost, high false positive rates, and incomplete data in the identification of cross-species interactions. In recent years, computational biology approaches, especially deep learning-based multimodal fusion frameworks, have emerged as the primary driving force for accelerating HV-PPIs prediction. This review systematically summarizes the latest advances in the field of HV-PPIs prediction, elaborates on key aspects such as data construction, feature engineering, deep learning architectures, and performance evaluation, summarizes the technical essentials, advantages, and limitations of existing methods, discusses the development trends of the field by integrating representative research findings from recent years, and serves as a reference for future investigations in this domain.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 人-病毒蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（Human-Virus Protein-Protein Interactions, HV-PPIs）是病毒侵入宿主细胞、完成病毒生命周期并诱导病理反应的核心机制。以更高准确性预测 HV-PPIs 对于阐明病毒致病机制、开发抗病毒药物和设计疫苗具有重要意义。然而，酵母双杂交（Yeast Two-Hybrid, Y2H）和亲和纯化-质谱（Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry, AP-MS）等传统实验方法在鉴定跨物种相互作用时面临通量低、成本高、假阳性率高和数据不完整等瓶颈。近年来，计算生物学方法，尤其是基于深度学习的多模态融合框架，已成为加速 HV-PPIs 预测的主要驱动力。本综述系统总结了 HV-PPIs 预测领域的最新进展，阐述了数据构建、特征工程、深度学习架构和性能评估等关键方面，概括了现有方法的技术要点、优势和局限性，结合近年代表性研究成果讨论了该领域的发展趋势，并为该领域未来研究提供参考。

abstract: [Current opinion in ophthalmology] This review examines the current state of artificial intelligence (AI) models for the detection and prediction of glaucomatous progression. Machine learning and deep learning models have been developed to analyze longitudinal data from optic disc photographs, optical coherence tomography images, and visual field tests to identify worsening glaucoma. Recent AI research has also expanded beyond simply detecting progression to predicting future disease trajectories. These approaches may provide more efficient assessment than clinician review alone. AI models can rapidly analyze large volumes of clinical data to support individualized glaucoma management; these models can guide treatment intensity and follow-up intervals by detecting and predicting glaucomatous progression. However, significant hurdles to clinical adoption remain, including the "black box" nature of AI, absence of a universally accepted reference standard for progression, variable data quality, and limited generalizability across populations and clinical settings. AI is poised to function as a clinical decision support tool rather than a replacement for clinicians. Prospective studies are needed to determine the impact of AI in improving patient outcomes, clinical efficiency, and healthcare costs.
zh_abstract: 【当前眼科学观点】本综述考察了用于检测和预测青光眼性进展的人工智能（AI）模型的现状。已开发出机器学习和深度学习模型，用于分析来自视盘照片、光学相干断层扫描图像和视野检查的纵向数据，以识别青光眼的恶化。近期 AI 研究也已超出单纯检测进展的范围，扩展到预测未来的疾病轨迹。这些方法可能比仅靠临床医师审阅提供更高效的评估。AI 模型能够快速分析大量临床数据，以支持个体化青光眼管理；这些模型可通过检测和预测青光眼性进展来指导治疗强度和随访间隔。然而，临床采用仍存在重大障碍，包括 AI 的“黑箱”性质、缺乏普遍接受的进展参考标准、数据质量参差不齐，以及在人群和临床环境之间泛化能力有限。AI 有望作为临床决策支持工具发挥作用，而非取代临床医师。尚需前瞻性研究来确定 AI 在改善患者结局、临床效率和医疗成本方面的影响。

title: SCALE: Towards Whole-Slide Counterfactual Explanations in Cancer Histopathology
zh_title: SCALE：面向癌症病理全切片的反事实解释

abstract: Accurate cancer diagnosis depends on histopathological evaluation, in which tumor morphology drives disease classification and therapeutic decision-making. While deep learning models have demonstrated strong performance in predicting diagnostic and prognostic properties from histopathology images, their clinical adoption remains limited by a lack of interpretability. Unlike conventional medical images where diagnostic findings are spatially localized, histopathological images are characterized by complex textural patterns distributed across the entire whole slide image (WSI), making it difficult to explain model predictions through region-based localization alone. Counterfactual explanations offer a promising alternative by asking "what changes in the image could have altered the model prediction." To achieve this, we propose SCALE, a framework for generating such counterfactual explanat
zh_abstract: 准确的癌症诊断依赖于组织病理学评估，其中肿瘤形态驱动疾病分类和治疗决策。尽管深度学习模型在从组织病理学图像预测诊断和预后特性方面已表现出强大性能，但其临床采用仍因缺乏可解释性而受限。与传统医学图像中诊断发现具有空间定位不同，组织病理学图像的特征是分布在整个全切片图像（WSI）中的复杂纹理模式，这使得仅通过基于区域的定位来解释模型预测变得困难。反事实解释提供了一种有前景的替代方法，其追问“图像中哪些变化本可能改变模型预测”。为实现这一点，我们提出SCALE，一个用于生成此类反事实解释的框架。

title: An LLM-assisted Pipeline for Identifying ClinicalTrials.gov Registry Changes and Their Association with Primary Endpoint Positivity
zh_title: LLM流程检测临床试验注册信息变更
summary: 预印本用LLM辅助分类自动比对ClinicalTrials.gov版本变更，发现主要终点修改与阳性结果相关。

主要结局修改与阳性结果相关（OR 1.91）

reason: 规范的方法学预印本，关联分析有统计结果，但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Registration of randomized clinical trials (RCTs) in a public registry such as ClinicalTrials.gov should minimize the risk of reporting bias. However, records may be modified during a trial and the resulting discrepancies are not always apparent without a detailed examination of all version histories, a process that is cumbersome when performed manually. We developed an automated workflow to investigate whether specific changes to RCT registry entries are associated with primary endpoint positivity. Our pipeline extracts RCT records from ClinicalTrials.gov and systematically detects changes between successive versions using a combination of deterministic textual analysis and large language model (LLM)-assisted classification. We could show a positive association between trial positivity and changes to primary outcomes (OR 1.91; 95% CI 1.48-2.47) as well as to arms and interventions (OR 2.10; 95% CI 1.62-2.73). Associations were weaker when changes occurred exclusively before the primary completion date, pointing to the importance of timing in evaluating potentially consequential modifications to RCT design. Our automated pipeline can enable analysis of trial registration records at scale, facilitating the work of reviewers and meta-scientists to promote research integrity.
zh_abstract: 在ClinicalTrials.gov等公共注册平台注册随机临床试验（RCT）应能最大限度降低报告偏倚风险。然而，试验期间记录可能被修改，若不详细检查所有版本历史，由此产生的差异并不总是显而易见；人工执行这一过程十分繁琐。我们开发了一套自动化工作流程，以研究RCT注册条目中的特定更改是否与主要终点阳性相关。我们的流程从ClinicalTrials.gov提取RCT记录，并结合确定性文本分析和大型语言模型（LLM）辅助分类，系统检测连续版本之间的变化。我们能够显示，试验阳性与主要结局的更改（OR 1.91；95% CI 1.48-2.47）以及研究组和干预措施的更改（OR 2.10；95% CI 1.62-2.73）之间存在正相关。当更改仅发生在主要完成日期之前时，相关性较弱，这指出在评估RCT设计中可能具有重要影响的修改时，时机的重要性。我们的自动化流程能够实现大规模分析试验注册记录，促进审稿人和元科学家的工作，以提升研究诚信。

abstract: Background: Precision oncology requires integration of heterogeneous molecular and pathology data, yet many fusion models offer limited biologically grounded interpretability and struggle with missing modalities. Methods: We present Hierarchical Interpretable Tensor Fusion (HIT-Fuse), integrating six modalities: somatic copy number variation, DNA methylation, RNA sequencing, microRNA expression, RPPA protein abundance, and vision transformer-derived pathomics across four TCGA cohorts (glioma, lung adenocarcinoma, breast, and kidney cancer). Modality-specific autoencoders compress high-dimensional inputs, followed by two-stage CP tensor decomposition. Missing latent modalities are reconstructed using clinical covariates and observed omics to expand cohorts and retrain downstream models. title: Verifiable Logic in Medical LLMs: A Critical Review of Agentic Clinical Reasoning Optimization and Neuro-Symbolic Grounding
zh_title: 医学大模型的可验证逻辑：批判性综述
summary: 综述临床大模型幻觉、智能体幻觉级联、过程奖励建模与神经符号约束四条可验证推理路径。

abstract: Clinical large language models are usually judged by whether the final answer is right. Yet a model can reach a fluent, plausible output through invalid reasoning that static benchmarks do not detect, and confident hallucination, causally invalid inference, and spurious demographic shortcuts can pass conventional evaluation. This critical review covers four paradigms in turn: how clinical hallucination arises and why static metrics miss it; the agentic hallucination cascade, in which multi-agent and tool-augmented systems propagate and amplify early reasoning errors; process reward modeling as step-level supervision; and neuro-symbolic grounding, in which formal logic engines, ontology reasoners, and knowledge graphs place verifiable constraints on neural output. zh_abstract: 临床大语言模型通常根据最终答案是否正确来评判。然而，模型可能通过静态基准无法检测的无效推理得到流畅、看似合理的输出，并且自信的幻觉、因果上无效的推断以及虚假的人口统计学捷径可以通过常规评估。本批判性综述依次涵盖四种范式：临床幻觉如何产生以及静态指标为何漏检；智能体幻觉级联，其中多智能体和工具增强系统传播并放大早期推理错误；作为步骤级监督的过程奖励建模；以及神经符号基础（neuro-symbolic grounding），其中形式逻辑引擎、本体推理器和知识图谱对神经输出施加可验证约束。在其编码领域内，具有符号否决层的系统提供相对于其编码知识成立的保证

Applying ViTs directly to small cellular crops also presents an architectural challenge: upsampling increases computational cost without adding morphological information and may introduce interpolation artefacts. abstract: Rad-Linter checks chest X-ray reports against image-derived evidence to flag potential errors for review. A pretrained image classifier supplies scores for nine pathologies, and a 1.5B-parameter language model, fine-tuned with LoRA on 1,816 examples, checks their consistency with the report. We compare it with a keyword-and-negation rule baseline given the same reports and scores. Evaluation uses controlled report-score pairings from OpenI, with consistency labels derived from automatic report labels and score thresholds. Each counterfactual quad crosses two real reports with two real score vectors from other patients, creating two consistent and two inconsistent pairs. Every report and score vector occurs in both conditions, so either input alone permits only 50% accuracy. abstract: Medical vision--language models (VLMs) often need to identify small, subtle lesions within high-resolution images containing extensive normal anatomy and redundant visual information. Visual-token compression improves efficiency, but preserving salient regions alone can discard the context needed for diagnostic interpretation. This context can extend across images: in bilateral mammography, the opposite breast provides a patient-specific anatomical reference. Yet retaining such evidence does not ensure that the model uses it effectively. We propose Bilateral Evidence Selection and Reasoning (BESR), which connects evidence preservation with comparative assessment through a bilateral-guided token selector and a bilateral reward. zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLMs）常需要在高分辨率图像中识别小而微妙的病变，这些图像包含大量正常解剖结构和冗余视觉信息。视觉 token 压缩提高了效率，但仅保留显著区域可能丢弃诊断解读所需的上下文。这种上下文可跨图像延伸：在双侧乳腺X线摄影中，对侧乳腺提供患者特异性解剖参考。然而，保留此类证据并不能确保模型有效利用它。我们提出双侧证据选择与推理（BESR），它通过双侧引导的 token 选择器和双侧奖励，将证据保留与比较评估连接起来。在共享 token 预算下，选择器联合优先考虑病变外观及其局部和双侧上下文，而奖励鼓励能够 b 的评估

abstract: Automating experiments does not necessarily advance scientific understanding. Research agents must identify meaningful knowledge gaps, determine what available data can resolve, and assess whether their findings advance existing knowledge. We introduce DeepQuest, a knowledge-gap-driven AI scientist framework for Alzheimer's disease research. DeepQuest transforms unresolved questions from domain reviews into traceable, testable hypotheses and prioritizes them through data feasibility screening and groupwise Elo ranking. It couples iterative experimentation with two-level auditing that separates experimental reliability from knowledge contribution relative to two frozen literature corpora. On OASIS-3, DeepQuest produces 42 feasible hypotheses and outperforms the strongest baselines in 14 of 15 evaluator-dimension comparisons across three language-model reviewers. abstract: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher. We construct this teacher explicitly. At training time the label and the unobserved feature values are available, and together they determine the teacher in closed form: an oracle that ranks every candidate by its effect on the downstream predictor's error. OracleImitator distills this ranking into a deployable policy by soft-target imitation. zh_abstract: 获取一个实例的每个特征通常代价高昂：一项测量可能带来金钱成本、时间延迟或隐私成本。主动特征获取（Active Feature Acquisition, AFA）通过学习一种策略来应对这一问题，该策略针对每个实例决定在预算下获取哪些特征。现有 AFA 方法通过优化自构建的效用目标来训练该策略，而不是蒸馏一个显式教师。我们显式构建该教师。在训练时，标签和未观测到的特征值均可用，二者共同以闭式确定教师：一个 oracle，它根据每个候选对下游预测器误差的影响对其进行排名。OracleImitator 通过软目标模仿将该排名蒸馏为可部署的策略。在多模态医学诊断和 AFABench 基准上，OracleImitator 在整个预算范围内达到或优于现有 AFA 方法，recov

abstract: Biomedical entity linking maps textual mentions to concepts in structured knowledge bases such as UMLS or SNOMED CT. Most existing systems link each mention independently, using only the mention or its surrounding sentence. This ignores dependencies between mentions in the same document and can lead to inconsistent predictions, especially when the same concept appears under different surface forms. We introduce LongBEL, a document-level generative framework that combines full-document context with a memory of previous predictions. To make this memory robust, LongBEL is trained with cross-validated predictions rather than gold labels, reducing the mismatch between training and inference and limiting cascading errors. zh_abstract: 逆向 RNA 折叠（Inverse RNA Folding）在于寻找一条能折叠成预定义二级结构的核苷酸序列。它可用于合成生物学、医学和纳米技术。我们提出 Montparnasse，一种基于广义嵌套 rollout 策略自适应（Generalized Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation）的蒙特卡洛搜索框架，并加入了由能量模型导出的结构先验、第 1 层的缓慢而长期的自适应、字典序多准则评估、对预测折叠出错的碱基对进行局部修复，以及一组通过共享束耦合的并行工作器，其多样性维护基于候选方案所犯的错误而非候选方案本身。在 Eterna100 V1 基准上，两个求解器均在 Turner 1999 模型下通过相同的 ViennaRNA 1.8.5 库进行折叠，使用 100 个并行工作器且每个谜题预算为 30 分钟，Montparnasse 求解 100 个谜题中的中位数为 96 个

abstract: Medical-image embeddings are increasingly shared in place of raw images for authorized downstream tasks, yet they may reveal sensitive attributes. Standard concept-erasure methods target population-level guardedness. We further show how global erasure affects linear readers' discrimination between positive and negative samples with different sensitive attributes, deriving an approximate closed-form prediction of its utility cost from pre-erasure statistics. zh_abstract: 医学图像嵌入正越来越多地代替原始图像被共享，用于授权的下游任务，然而它们可能泄露敏感属性。标准概念擦除方法针对的是群体级防护性。然而，我们证明，当二值任务标签和敏感标签相关联时，在保留非零线性任务信号的同时，全局和任务条件线性防护性不能同时成立，因此全局擦除必须要么消除该信号，要么保留任务条件线性泄漏。我们进一步展示全局擦除如何影响线性读取器对具有不同敏感属性的正样本和负样本的区分，并从擦除前统计量推导其效用代价的近似闭式预测。受这一冲突启发，我们引入 Task-Conditional LEACE（TC-LEACE），这是 LEACE 的一种闭式变体，它在每个……内强制线性防护性

zh_abstract: 医院质量改进（QI）项目通常分两个阶段进行：（1）假设生成，即识别可能改善医疗质量与效率的候选因素；（2）验证性分析，即针对这些因素实施并评估QI举措。尽管大多数研究集中于验证性阶段，但假设生成同样重要，因为它决定了团队将精力投向何处。目前，假设生成依赖于专家驱动的定性方法（例如精益医疗工具），这些方法可能基于轶事经验、难以复现、耗时且资源密集。大语言模型（LLM）可通过大规模分析临床笔记来加速这一过程，但现有AI工具只能扩展定义明确的任务，而假设生成是一个“模糊的”、探索性和迭代性的过程。我们提出，不仅应将LLM inst

title: Spectral Vision Transformer for Efficient Tokenization with Limited Data
zh_title: 面向小数据的高效令牌化谱视觉Transformer
summary: 预印本提出以固定基谱系数替代空间切片的视觉Transformer，在医学影像等小数据场景评测并开源代码。

abstract: Vision transformers tokenize an image into patches, which couples the token count to resolution and requires the embedding to be learned from data. We propose a spectral vision transformer architecture for efficient tokenization in the limited-data regime, with an emphasis on medical imaging. Rather than using spatial patches, we tokenize into coefficients of a fixed basis. This approach defines each token as one spectral mode, and the sequence length is chosen rather than implied by resolution, reducing the cost of attention. Our proposed spectral ViT shows superior or comparable performance where data is scarce in public medical imaging benchmarks, natural images, object shapes, simulations, and protected clinical data. We release our code at: https://github.com/agr78/SpectralViT.
zh_abstract: 视觉 Transformer（vision transformer）将图像划分为图像块（patch）进行标记化，这使标记数量与分辨率耦合，并要求嵌入从数据中学习。我们提出一种光谱视觉 Transformer（spectral vision transformer）架构，用于有限数据情形下的高效标记化，重点在医学影像。我们不使用空间图像块，而是将图像标记化为固定基的系数。这种方法将每个标记定义为一个光谱模式，序列长度是选择得到的，而不是由分辨率隐含决定，从而降低注意力计算成本。我们提出的光谱 ViT（spectral ViT）在公共医学影像基准、自然图像、物体形状、模拟以及受保护临床数据中数据稀缺时表现出更优或相当的性能。我们在以下地址发布代码：https://github.com/agr78/SpectralViT。

We ask a narrow, testable question: on the spans a de-identifier actually replaces, can downstream PHI detectors still find the surrogate as well as they found the original value? Our key insight is that, although RNA and proteins represent distinct molecular modalities, their biological relationships provide valuable shared knowledge that can benefit single-omics prediction tasks. title: The Effectiveness and Durability of Pretraining Data Filtering in Protein Language Models

summary: 在 ESM-2 系列蛋白语言模型上考察过滤病毒蛋白预训练数据的效果、持久性与可恢复性。
key_points: 过滤病毒序列显著削弱病毒蛋白的掩码建模与突变效应预测

abstract: Pretraining filtering is one of the most common safeguards for open-weight language models. Here we study its effectiveness, durability and scalability using the ESM-2 family of protein language models. We find that filtering viral proteins from the pretraining data meaningfully degrades masked language modelling, mutation effect prediction and long-range contact prediction on viral proteins, while largely preserving performance on non-viral proteins. These effects are concentrated among proteins from human-infecting viruses, and grow as we scale models from 8M to 3B parameters. As models increase in size, we find that stringent filtering becomes more effective. However, fine-tuning on sequences from the removed viral families restores the lost performance. Although the cost to recover performance increases with model scale, even for the largest models it costs about 80 USD of H100 time.
zh_abstract: 预训练过滤是开放权重语言模型最常见的防护措施之一。在此，我们使用 ESM-2 蛋白质语言模型家族研究其有效性、持久性和可扩展性。我们发现，从预训练数据中过滤病毒蛋白会明显降低病毒蛋白上的掩码语言建模、突变效应预测和长程接触预测性能，同时在很大程度上保留非病毒蛋白上的性能。这些效应集中在感染人类的病毒蛋白中，并随着我们将模型从 8M 扩展到 3B 参数而增强。随着模型规模增大，我们发现严格过滤变得更有效。然而，在来自被移除病毒家族的序列上进行微调可恢复丢失的性能。尽管恢复性能的成本随模型规模增加，即使对最大的模型，也只需约 80 美元的 H100 机时。

abstract: Reconstructing cellular dynamics from snapshots is challenging because the destructive nature of single-cell measurements makes tracking the same cells over time impossible. Cellular dynamics are inherently stochastic and involve changes in population size through proliferation and apoptosis. Growth-based methods represent population change as a rate on the density, which does not assign exits and entries to individual cells. Unbalanced Schrödinger bridges model individual events, but neural solvers for killed diffusion bridges simulate trajectories during training. We introduce Elysium, a simulation-free solver that jointly learns state transition and mass change. Using a killed Brownian reference and its time reversal, Elysium constructs direct regression objectives from an optimal endpoint coupling and conditional bridge distributions, without simulating trajectories during training.
zh_abstract: 从快照重建细胞动力学具有挑战性，因为单细胞测量的破坏性使得无法随时间追踪同一批细胞。细胞动力学本质上是随机的，并涉及通过增殖和凋亡引起的群体大小变化。基于生长的方法将群体变化表示为密度上的速率，这不会把退出和进入分配给单个细胞。非平衡薛定谔桥（Unbalanced Schrödinger bridges）可对单个事件建模，但用于 killed diffusion bridges 的神经求解器会在训练期间模拟轨迹。我们提出 Elysium，一种无模拟求解器，可联合学习状态转移和质量变化。使用 killed Brownian reference 及其时间反转，Elysium 从最优端点耦合和条件桥分布构造直接回归目标，而无需在训练期间模拟轨迹。

zh_abstract: 可穿戴设备和智能手机传感器可捕捉与心理健康相关的行为信号，但从这些信号推断心理健康结局传统上依赖于需要标注数据的监督模型，并且对其预测提供的洞见有限。大语言模型（LLM）为基于行为证据进行推理提供了新机会，但现有的基于 LLM 的被动感知方法在很大程度上仍继续依赖任务特定微调或传感器特定预训练。在本文中，我们介绍 OAK-Mind，一种零训练、多智能体、基于知识的 LLM 流程，用于从被动感知数据推断心理健康变化。该流程将感知数据组织为行为维度，包括睡眠、身体活动、位置移动性和智能手机使用，并编排以心理健康文献为依据的专门智能体来解释纵向

However, most existing zero-shot approaches employ down-sampling operations that reduce spatial resolution and cause domain shifts, which become particularly evident when applied to raw sinogram data. abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Kayseri City Hospital; conditions: Anesthesia, Risk Assessment, Preoperative Care; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 330; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The ASA Physical Status Classification is widely used in preoperative risk assessment, but agreement between raters is limited, particularly between ASA II and III. This prospective observational study compares the ASA class assigned to the same patients by three types of raters: anesthesia residents working in the preoperative anesthesia clinic, a large language model (LLM), and a consensus of two senior anesthesiologists, which is the reference standard. Residents complete the standard preoperative evaluation form and assign an ASA class as part of routine care. A copy of the completed form, with patient identifiers and the resident's ASA class removed, is then given independently to the LLM and to the two senior anesthesiologists. No intervention is applied to participants and routine care is not changed. The primary aim is to measure how closely the residents and the LLM agree with the expert consensus (weighted kappa). Secondary aims are agreement among all three raters, agreement between the two senior anesthesiologists, the direction of misclassification, and how often the LLM matches the consensus when the resident does not.

The research will be conducted using a randomized controlled experimental design with an AI-assisted nursing diagnostic system developed for the field of women's health and obstetrics. The study population consists of nurses working in the obstetrics and gynecology departments (delivery room, postpartum ward, etc.) of two hospitals and providing care to women aged 18-49. Approximately 600 nurses meeting the inclusion criteria were identified as constituting the population. In the study, nurses' perceptions of diagnoses, their opinions regarding nursing diagnoses, and their attitudes towards artificial intelligence will be evaluated through structured data collection tools. The use of the AI-assisted system will be compared with traditional nursing diagnostic processes to analyze the system's impact on clinical decision-making processes. The study expects that the AI-assisted nursing diagnostic system will increase diagnostic accuracy, support clinical decision-making processes, and positively influence nurses' attitudes towards technology. Furthermore, it is anticipated that the findings will contribute to the standardization of nursing care and provide a scientific basis for the development of digital health applications aimed at improving maternal and infant safety in the field of women's health.

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Precision medicine, which involves tailoring medical treatment to the individual characteristics of each patient, is poised for a new era of advancement through artificial intelligence (AI). This chapter explores the future directions of precision medicine in the context of AI-driven innovation, focusing on emerging technologies and their impact on personalized care. We discuss recent breakthroughs in AI-enabled diagnostics, genomics, drug discovery, and clinical decision-making, highlighting how these developments are reshaping the practice of medicine. We also examine the challenges and opportunities in implementing AI for precision medicine, including data integration, model interpretability, regulatory considerations, and ethical issues. Drawing on high-impact research and reports from leading institutions, we present a forward-looking analysis of how AI will drive the next generation of personalized treatments. The convergence of AI and precision medicine promises to revolutionize healthcare by improving early disease detection, optimizing therapy selection, and enabling truly individualized patient care.

abstract: Motivation: Pathogen phylogenies are useful for monitoring the evolution of pathogens and for detecting new variants, as it provides information that can aid public health decisions and outbreak response. Since not all infections are sequenced, certain pathogen lineages may be missing or only poorly represented in reconstructed phylogenies. Identifying these gaps could help to determine where additional data collection is required. Results: We developed a computational method to locate regions of missing samples from the observed tree alone, without sequences from those samples. A machine learning model predicts which branches lead toward the missing region. Beam search then identifies three representative paths and estimates a candidate most recent common ancestor (MRCA) of the missing region for each path. We tested this framework on 5,000 simulated phylogenies where we controlled which tips were deleted. On an independent test set, the best candidate recovered an average of 89.9% of deleted tips, increasing to 90.7% when all three candidates were combined. Predicted and true MRCAs lay on the same ancestral-descendant lineage in 91.3% of cases. We further evaluated the approach on an empirical SARS-CoV-2 phylogeny with introduced missingness. By identifying potentially underrepresented lineages, this framework could help real-time identification of missing infections and improve outbreak response.

We developed a Bidirectional Attention-enhanced Diffusion Transformer (BA-DiT) that combines self-supervised multimodal representation learning with supervised Bayesian fine-tuning. The model integrates pretreatment CT images and three-dimensional dose distributions, focusing on bilateral parotid glands while incorporating surrounding anatomical and dosimetric information. During pretraining, bidirectional cross-attention integrates anatomical and dosimetric features, while a latent Diffusion Transformer learns joint representations through diffusion-based learning, feature reconstruction, and contrastive alignment. We have developed a fully automated pipeline for transformation of raw Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption/Ionization Mass Spectrometry imaging (MALDI-MSI) data into deep-learning-ready image patches for binary pancreatic tissue classification (tumoral vs non-tumoral) and built individual models for recognition of tumoral regions in spectral images. abstract: Causal discovery is increasingly applied to healthcare data, where the recovered relationships can encode biased pathways that propagate to downstream prediction. Path-specific fairness analysis, through direct, indirect, and spurious effect decompositions along with fairness-utility ratio assessment allows bias quantification and associated prediction cost. However, existing evaluations of causal discovery under fairness constraints have largely used non-clinical datasets and have not separated the contribution of confounders from that of mediators, leaving open how discovery-algorithm choice propagates through path-specific fairness to the utility trade-off in clinical settings. abstract: Kicker is a personal health assistant. We propose a two-stage physics-guided decomposition that turns a globally non-identifiable inverse mapping into conditionally identifiable sub-problems. The first stage is a constrained inverse surrogate that isolates the intrinsic parameter under a fixed reference geometry. abstract: While deep learning offers tremendous promise for scientific and medical imaging, any failures and hallucinations (predictions that do not coincide with reality) are hard to pinpoint and can have serious downstream consequences. Uncertainty estimation techniques, such as conformal prediction, can help by predicting statistically valid error bars for a model's prediction. However, popular conformal prediction methods were not designed for high-dimensional image-valued problems and do not take into account spatial correlations within an image during conformal calibration, resulting in larger-than-necessary uncertainty intervals. We propose a practical simultaneous quantile regression method that enables non-linear, spatially-adaptive scaling during conformal calibration. Our method, QUTCC uses a U-Net architecture with a quantile embedding to learn a full conditional quantile distribution
zh_abstract: 尽管深度学习为科学和医学成像带来了巨大前景，但任何失败和幻觉（与事实不符的预测）都难以精确定位，并可能造成严重的下游后果。不确定性估计技术（如共形预测）可以通过为模型预测预测统计上有效的误差条来提供帮助。然而，常用的共形预测方法并非为高维图像值问题而设计，并且在共形校准过程中未考虑图像内的空间相关性，导致不确定性区间大于必要范围。我们提出一种实用的同时分位数回归方法，可在共形校准过程中实现非线性、空间自适应缩放。我们的方法 QUTCC 使用带有分位数嵌入的 U-Net 架构来学习完整的条件分位数分布
