title: Explainable and CPU-Efficient Brain Tumor Classification from MRI Using Two-Phase EfficientNetB3 Fine-Tuning
zh_title: 两阶段微调EfficientNetB3实现脑肿瘤MRI分类
summary: arXiv预印本提出两阶段微调EfficientNetB3的脑MRI四分类流程，测试集准确率90.62%。
key_points: 冻结主干后再解冻37层微调
1600张平衡测试集准确率90.62%
强调可解释性与CPU效率
reason: 预印本、公开数据集内部划分验证，仅指标无临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Brain tumors are among the most lethal neurological disorders, with over 308,000 new diagnoses annually worldwide. Accurate classification of tumor type from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans is critical for treatment planning; however, manual radiological interpretation is time-consuming and prone to inter-observer variability. This paper proposes an automated deep learning pipeline for four-class brain MRI classification (glioma, meningioma, no tumor, and pituitary tumor) using EfficientNetB3 transfer learning with a custom classification head. A two-phase training strategy is adopted: Phase 1 trains the head with a frozen backbone (best validation accuracy: 92.77%), and Phase 2 selectively fine-tunes the top 37 layers at a 100x reduced learning rate (best validation accuracy: 94.91%). On an independent balanced test set of 1,600 MRI images, the system achieves 90.62% overall accuracy and a macro-average AUC of 0.9854. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) is integrated for class-discriminative visual explainability. The proposed system simultaneously addresses three dimensions absent in prior work: high accuracy, CPU-only computational efficiency, and clinical interpretability.
zh_abstract: 脑肿瘤是最致命的神经系统疾病之一，全球每年新增诊断超过308,000例。从磁共振成像（MRI）扫描中准确分类肿瘤类型对于治疗规划至关重要；然而，人工放射学解读耗时且易受观察者间变异影响。本文提出了一种自动化深度学习流程，用于四分类脑MRI分类（胶质瘤、脑膜瘤、无肿瘤和垂体瘤），采用EfficientNetB3迁移学习并搭配自定义分类头。采用两阶段训练策略：第1阶段在冻结主干网络的情况下训练分类头（最佳验证准确率：92.77%），第2阶段以降低100倍的学习率选择性微调顶部37层（最佳验证准确率：94.91%）。在包含1,600张MRI图像的独立平衡测试集上，系统达到90.62%的总体准确率和0.9854的宏平均AUC。集成梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM）以实现类别判别性视觉可解释性。所提出的系统同时解决了先前工作缺失的三个维度：高准确率、仅使用CPU的计算效率和临床可解释性。

title: Element-Wise Femoral Stress Prediction: A Hybrid Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Finite Element Analysis
zh_title: 混合图神经网络代理模型逐单元预测股骨应力
summary: 用图卷积与残差学习构建有限元代理模型，快速预测股骨应力以评估骨折风险。
key_points: 针对有限元分析计算成本高的瓶颈
GCN-SAGE-Residual建模网格空间依赖
目标为股骨强度与髋部骨折风险评估
reason: 单中心方法类预印本，无外部验证与临床结局，属增量偏上
abstract: Hip fractures represent a significant clinical challenge because they cause excess disability and mortality, and have a growing incidence in aging populations, as bone fragility increases. Although finite element analysis (FEA) provides biomechanical assessment of femoral strength, its clinical applicability is mainly limited by high computational cost. Conventional machine learning (ML) approaches have been explored as surrogate models for FEA; predictions are fast but fail to capture the spatial and topological structure of finite element meshes. To address these limitations, this study proposes a hybrid Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based framework for femoral stress prediction using graph-structured finite element modeling (FEM) data. The proposed GCN-SAGE-Residual architecture combines graph convolution, neighborhood aggregation, and residual learning to model spatial dependencies and stress propagation across mesh elements. We systematically evaluated 14 models in a primary comparison, spanning classical ML methods and baseline GNN architectures, complemented by a targeted architectural ablation that isolates the contribution of each component of the proposed design. Evaluation results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid architecture achieves the strongest predictive performance among all evaluated models. The proposed hybrid model achieves the best performance with an R^2 score of 0.8022 and mean absolute error of 2.879 MPa, highlighting the importance of incorporating mesh topology in biomechanical prediction tasks. The proposed framework provides a scalable and computationally efficient alternative for FEM-based orthopedic analyses and fracture risk assessment. The code is publicly available on GitHub.
zh_abstract: 髋部骨折是一项重要的临床挑战，因为它会导致额外残疾和死亡，并且随着人口老龄化、骨脆性增加，其发病率不断上升。尽管有限元分析（FEA）可对股骨强度进行生物力学评估，但其临床适用性主要受限于高计算成本。已有研究探索将传统机器学习（ML）方法作为FEA的替代模型；这类预测速度快，但无法捕捉有限元网格的空间和拓扑结构。为解决这些局限，本研究提出一种基于混合图神经网络（GNN）的框架，利用图结构有限元建模（FEM）数据进行股骨应力预测。所提出的GCN-SAGE-Residual架构结合图卷积、邻域聚合和残差学习，以建模网格单元间的空间依赖关系和应力传播。我们在主要比较中系统评估了14个模型，涵盖经典ML方法和基线GNN架构，并辅以针对性的架构消融实验，以分离所提出设计中各组件的贡献。评估结果表明，所提出的混合架构在所有评估模型中取得最强的预测性能。所提出的混合模型表现最佳，R^2分数为0.8022，平均绝对误差为2.879 MPa，突显了在生物力学预测任务中纳入网格拓扑的重要性。该框架为基于FEM的骨科分析和骨折风险评估提供了一种可扩展且计算高效的替代方案。代码已在GitHub上公开。

title: A System 1 Decision Model for Medical Multiple-Choice Questions Built on Frozen Language Models
zh_title: 冻结语言模型上的医学选择题单次决策模型
summary: 在冻结的Qwen与Granite模型上仅训练两个投影头，用对比损失做MedMCQA选择题，准确率约33%（随机25%）。
key_points: 冻结Qwen3.5-0.8B等三个模型，仅训练两个投影头与温度
使用对比损失，并加入批内负例与难负例
reason: 预印本方法探索，小模型仅小幅高于随机，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: A System 1 model answers a multiple-choice question in a single pass. A frozen language model turns the question and each option into vectors, two small, trained heads place them in a shared space, and the closest option wins. The design has been shown on agent decisions, but we are not aware of a study of how far it goes on exam questions that need medical knowledge, where the right option is often no more similar to the question than the wrong ones. We rebuilt the recipe from scratch for MedMCQA and trained only two projection heads and one temperature on top of frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B, Granite-4.2-3B and Qwen3-8B, using a contrastive loss with in-batch and hard negatives and a mask for repeated answers. With plain last-token vectors, both small encoders answer about one question in three correctly (33.1% and 33.0% on 3,842 held-out questions, where chance is 25.0%). Writing each text inside a one-word-summary prompt and lowering the learning rate of the heads raised this to 41.7% and 42.5% for the two small encoders and to 46.0% +-0.2 (three seeds) for Qwen3-8B. Shuffling the questions against the options returns accuracy to chance, so the heads do use the question. Flan-PaLM and Med-PaLM 2 report 57.6% and 72.3% on MedMCQA under a different protocol, so ours is a cheap, fast baseline and not a competitive system. We also say what our evidence cannot show: validation gains were about 1.7 to 2 times the test gains, and we could not separate the effect of reading several encoder layers from the other changes.
zh_abstract: System 1 模型通过单次前向回答一道多项选择题。一个冻结的语言模型将问题和每个选项转换为向量，两个小型可训练预测头将它们放入共享空间，最接近的选项获胜。该设计已在智能体决策中得到展示，但我们尚不知道有研究考察它在需要医学知识的考试题上能走多远；在这类题目中，正确选项往往并不比错误选项与问题更相似。我们为 MedMCQA 从零重建该配方，并且仅在冻结的 Qwen3.5-0.8B、Granite-4.2-3B 和 Qwen3-8B 之上训练两个投影头和一个温度参数，使用带批内负样本和难负样本的对比损失，并使用重复答案掩码。使用普通末词元向量时，两个小型编码器都能正确回答约三分之一的问题（在 3,842 道留出问题上分别为 33.1% 和 33.0%，随机水平为 25.0%）。将每段文本置于单词摘要提示中并降低各头的学习率后，两个小型编码器的准确率分别提升到 41.7% 和 42.5%，Qwen3-8B 提升到 46.0% ±0.2（三个随机种子）。将问题与选项打乱配对后，准确率回落到随机水平，因此这些头确实利用了问题。Flan-PaLM 和 Med-PaLM 2 在不同协议下报告 MedMCQA 上分别为 57.6% 和 72.3%，因此我们的方法是一个廉价、快速的基线，而不是一个有竞争力的系统。我们还说明了我们的证据无法表明什么：验证集增益约为测试集增益的 1.7 至 2 倍，并且我们无法将读取多个编码器层的影响与其他改动的影响区分开。

title: Geometry-bridge flow matching for blind rigid-motion correction in head cone-beam CT
zh_title: 头颈锥形束CT刚性运动校正的几何桥流匹配
summary: 提出三维流匹配先验学习运动所致图像变化，结合姿态估计与数据一致性迭代校正头颈CBCT刚性运动。
key_points: 几何桥连接同一体数据的运动伪影与无运动FDK图像
前向投影几何导数提供解析速度目标
30例CQ500留出模拟扫描上评估，属仿真验证
reason: 仿真数据小样本方法研究，未见外部临床验证，属增量档
abstract: Rigid motion of a patient head during head cone-beam CT (CBCT) scan can degrade image quality and complicate recovery of accurate anatomical structures from the measured projections. We present a 3D flow-matching prior approach that learns the image changes induced by motion. Its geometry-bridge connects motion-corrupted and motion-free Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstructed images of the same source volume through progressively reduced simulated motion. The forward projector's geometry derivative supplies analytic velocity targets along this path. A plug-and-play loop encompasses the learned image updates together with spline-based pose estimation, conjugate-gradient data consistency, and image total-variation regularization. Both the refined image volume and the FDK reconstructed image volume at the estimated poses are evaluated. On simulated 360-view scans from 30 held-out CQ500 patients with nominal per-component motion amplitudes within 10 mm / 10 degrees, the framework achieved state-of-the-art image reconstruction quality and motion accuracy in comparison with other methos such as learned autofocus and diffusion-based joint reconstruction. Mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) reached 37.1 dB and mean detector-plane reprojection error (RPE) was 0.27 mm. With matched endpoints at the inference settings, the geometry bridge improved PSNR by 1.6 dB and reduced RPE by 33% relative to image-linear training. With 50 prior updates and coarse-to-fine motion estimation, total processing time averaged 9.1 minutes per patient on an RTX A6000.
zh_abstract: 头部锥形束 CT（CBCT）扫描期间患者头部的刚性运动可能降低图像质量，并使从测量投影中恢复准确解剖结构变得复杂。我们提出一种三维流匹配先验方法，学习由运动引起的图像变化。其几何桥通过逐步减少模拟运动，将同一源体积的受运动污染和不受运动影响的 Feldkamp-Davis-Kress（FDK）重建图像连接起来。前向投影器的几何导数提供沿该路径的解析速度目标。即插即用循环将学习到的图像更新与基于样条的位姿估计、共轭梯度数据一致性和图像全变分正则化结合在一起。对细化后的图像体以及估计位姿下的 FDK 重建图像体均进行了评估。在来自 30 名留出 CQ500 患者的模拟 360 视角扫描上，标称各分量运动幅度在 10 mm / 10 度以内，与学习式自动聚焦和基于扩散的联合重建等其他方法相比，该框架实现了最先进的图像重建质量和运动精度。平均峰值信噪比（PSNR）达到 37.1 dB，平均探测器平面重投影误差（RPE）为 0.27 mm。在推理设置下匹配端点时，相对于图像线性训练，几何桥将 PSNR 提高了 1.6 dB，并将 RPE 降低了 33%。在 50 次先验更新和由粗到细的运动估计下，在 RTX A6000 上每名患者的平均总处理时间为 9.1 分钟。

title: Rational Ensemble Logic for Cohort Discovery with Real-World Electrophysiology Data
zh_title: 真实世界电生理数据队列发现的形式化逻辑
summary: 提出Rational Ensemble Logic，用时间模态算子形式化刻画真实世界电生理数据中的时序表型以支持队列发现。
key_points: 三种参数化模态算子结合布尔连接与一阶量化
以区间集合语义表示标注记录
给出模型检验算法并证明区间运算的封闭性与语义正确性
reason: 方法学形式化工作，未见规模或外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Biomedical knowledge representation should make the passage from observations to conclusions transparent, rigorous, understandable, explainable, and reproducible (TRUER). We introduce Rational Ensemble Logic (QEL) for specifying temporal phenotypes in real-world electrophysiology data (RWED), with a meaning independent of the implementation software. QEL combines three parameterized modal operators (exact displacement, bounded existence, and bounded universality) over rational time with Boolean connectives and first-order quantification. Its Labeled Interval Ensemble (LINE) semantics represents annotated records as finite interval ensembles. We relate the operators to morphological operations and develop endpoint-array algorithms and finite rational evidence sets for model checking. We prove closure and semantic correctness of the interval operations, obtain finite evidence sets by quantifier elimination, and establish polynomial data complexity for fixed formulas. On 54 manually constructed records, a prototype agreed with the assigned outcomes for base and strict post-ictal generalized EEG suppression (PGES) queries. A separate feasibility experiment over 1,976 patients identified 37 qualifying patients and 45 annotation patterns in 16 seconds. The released prototype uses endpoint candidates and numerical tolerances. QEL supports the TRUER principle through explicit phenotype definitions, precise semantics, and provably correct evaluation procedures, with rational witnesses for existential queries. These provide a logical foundation for formal specification and correctness of algorithms that are independent of specific clinical interpretation, data annotation quality, and software implementation.
zh_abstract: 生物医学知识表示应使从观察到结论的过程透明、严谨、可理解、可解释且可复现（TRUER）。我们引入理性集成逻辑（Rational Ensemble Logic, QEL），用于在真实世界电生理数据（RWED）中指定时间表型，其含义独立于实现软件。QEL 在有理时间上结合三个参数化模态算子（精确位移、有界存在和有界全称）与布尔连接词和一阶量化。其标记区间集成（Labeled Interval Ensemble, LINE）语义将标注记录表示为有限区间集成。我们将这些算子与形态学操作联系起来，并开发端点数组算法和用于模型检验的有限有理证据集。我们证明了区间操作的封闭性和语义正确性，通过量词消去获得有限证据集，并针对固定公式建立多项式数据复杂度。在 54 条人工构建记录上，原型对基线和严格发作后全面性脑电图抑制（PGES）查询的判定与指定结果一致。一项针对 1,976 名患者的独立可行性实验在 16 秒内识别出 37 名符合条件患者和 45 种标注模式。发布的原型使用端点候选和数值容差。QEL 通过显式表型定义、精确语义和可证明正确的评估程序支持 TRUER 原则，并为存在性查询提供有理见证。这些为算法的形式化规范与正确性提供了逻辑基础，而这些算法独立于特定临床解释、数据标注质量和软件实现。

title: Self-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Better-Structured Medical Explanations in Small Language Models
zh_title: 自奖励强化学习改善小模型医学解释结构
summary: 在Mistral-7B上用LoRA加PPO与自监督奖励训练，使医学解释更长、词汇更多样、结构更完整。
key_points: 基于Meerkat衍生的2000条医学提示训练
奖励偏好更长、词汇多样、标点规范的回复，惩罚过短
不依赖人工偏好标注，面向本地化隐私部署
reason: 预印本小规模风格优化，无临床或人工评估，属增量档
abstract: Small language models (SLMs) can run on commodity hardware and support privacy-preserving, on-premises clinical deployment, but their medical explanations are often short and poorly structured compared with large language models. Recent supervised approaches such as Meerkat transfer chain-of-thought reasoning into 7B-8B backbones, yet their training objective does not directly target the style or organization of the generated rationales. Building on the instruction-tuned Mistral-7B backbone, we investigate whether a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) step can improve explanation structure without human preference labels.We apply Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with LoRA adaptation to 2,000 Meerkat-derived medical prompts, guided by a simple self-supervised reward that favors longer, lexically diverse, and well-punctuated responses while penalizing very short ones. Training for about 170 PPO steps on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU yields a stable increase in the average reward. Quantitative and qualitative comparisons show that the RL-tuned model produces longer, more organized, multi-point explanations while preserving the underlying medical content.We discuss the promise and the limitations of self-rewarded RL for shaping the style of medical explanations.
zh_abstract: 小型语言模型（SLMs）可以在通用硬件上运行，并支持隐私保护的本地临床部署，但与大型语言模型相比，它们的医学解释通常较短且结构较差。近期诸如 Meerkat 的监督方法将思维链推理迁移到 7B-8B 主干模型中，然而其训练目标并不直接针对生成理由的风格或组织方式。在指令微调的 Mistral-7B 主干模型基础上，我们研究一个轻量级强化学习（RL）步骤是否能在无需人类偏好标签的情况下改善解释结构。我们将近端策略优化（PPO）与 LoRA 适配应用于 2,000 个源自 Meerkat 的医学提示，并由一个简单的自监督奖励引导，该奖励偏好更长、词汇多样且标点良好的回答，同时惩罚过短的回答。在单块 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上训练约 170 个 PPO 步骤，使平均奖励稳定提高。定量和定性比较显示，经 RL 调优的模型产生更长、更有组织、多要点的解释，同时保留底层的医学内容。我们讨论了自奖励 RL 在塑造医学解释风格方面的前景和局限。

title: DAL: Dynamic Angular Loss for Imbalanced Medical Image Classification
zh_title: DAL：面向不平衡医学图像分类的动态角度损失
summary: 推导角度softmax参数的数据驱动界，提出批自适应角度间隔与动态加权交叉熵相结合的损失函数。
key_points: 针对医学场景类别数少且严重不平衡
给出尺度参数上下界与角度间隔上界
在四个高度不平衡医学数据集上评估
预印本，仅描述方法层面结果
reason: 损失函数改进类预印本，属常规方法增量，样本与外部验证信息不足
abstract: Class imbalance remains a major obstacle in medical image classification, where rare but clinically important classes are often overshadowed by majority categories. Although current strategies for reducing bias, including angle-based softmax (ABS) losses, offer strong discriminative features, their behavior in settings with a small number of severely imbalanced classes remains insufficiently understood. Previous approaches that estimate the intrinsic parameters of ABS rely on the assumption of many classes, which does not hold in medical settings. We derive data-driven upper and lower bounds for the scale parameter and an upper bound for the angular margin using negative-angle statistics, and use these to drive a batch-adaptive angular margin (BAAM), which we combine with dynamically-weighted cross entropy (DWCE) to define our dynamic angular loss (DAL). Across four highly imbalanced medical image classification benchmarks spanning dermatology, ophthalmology, and gastrointestinal endoscopy, our method consistently achieves superior balanced accuracy and the lowest coefficient of variation of per-class recall. Although this entails a small performance reduction on majority classes, the gains on minority categories are substantial, yielding a reliable and equitable overall classifier. Our source code is available at: https://github.com/msalman95/DAL.
zh_abstract: 类别不平衡仍然是医学图像分类中的主要障碍，其中罕见但临床重要的类别常被多数类别所掩盖。尽管当前减少偏倚的策略，包括基于角度的 softmax（angle-based softmax, ABS）损失，提供了强判别特征，但它们在类别数少且严重不平衡的设置中的行为仍未得到充分理解。先前估计 ABS 内在参数的方法依赖于类别数很多这一假设，而该假设在医学场景中并不成立。我们利用负角度统计量推导尺度参数的数据驱动上下界以及角度间隔的上界，并据此驱动一种批次自适应角度间隔（batch-adaptive angular margin, BAAM），再将其与动态加权交叉熵（dynamically-weighted cross entropy, DWCE）结合，定义我们的动态角度损失（dynamic angular loss, DAL）。在跨越皮肤病学、眼科学和胃肠内镜学的四个高度不平衡医学图像分类基准上，我们的方法始终取得更优的平衡准确率以及最低的各类别召回率变异系数。尽管这会使多数类别性能略有下降，但少数类别上的增益十分显著，从而产生可靠且公平的整体分类器。我们的源代码可在 https://github.com/msalman95/DAL 获取。

跨参与者替换未能体现个体特异性

reason: 样本量中等、方法学评估为主，属预印本增量证据
abstract: Accurate cross-modal reconstruction is often treated as evidence of physiological coupling, although it may simply reflect temporal patterns shared across participants. We tested whether frozen bidirectional models captured subject-specific neuromuscular coupling between electromyographic activity and gait kinematics in 82 held-out able-bodied and 43 post-stroke participants. Complete source-modality removal and cross-participant source substitution, along with a cycle-position-age-sex template baseline, were applied. Learned bilateral asymmetry was also compared with transparent waveform and derivative asymmetry for predicting Performance-Oriented Mobility Assessment (POMA) scores in the case of repeated nested cross-validation. Complete source removal increased reconstruction RMSE by 6.90% for electromyography-to-kinematics and 11.38% in the reverse direction. In contrast, cross-participant substitution increased RMSE by only 1.68% and 1.67%, respectively, while the template reduced RMSE by 2.89% and 0.55%. For POMA prediction, walking speed, age, and sex achieved an MAE of 3.693, compared with 4.229 and 4.427 after adding absolute and signed learned asymmetry, respectively. In all of the 20 repeated evaluations, all asymmetry representations performed worse than the covariate baseline. No localized learned feature remained significant after covariate adjustment and false-discovery-rate correction. The model mainly relied on shared gait-phase patterns, with no clear subject-specific coupling or added clinical value. Participant-level controls are therefore needed before reconstruction accuracy is treated as evidence of individualized physiology.
zh_abstract: 准确的跨模态重建常被视为生理耦合的证据，尽管它可能仅反映参与者之间共享的时间模式。我们测试了冻结的双向模型是否在 82 名留出的健全参与者和 43 名卒中后参与者中捕捉到受试者特异性的神经肌肉耦合，即肌电活动与步态运动学之间的耦合。我们采用了完全移除源模态和跨参与者源替换，以及一个周期位置-年龄-性别模板基线。在重复嵌套交叉验证的情况下，还将学习到的双侧不对称性与透明的波形及导数不对称性进行比较，以预测 Performance-Oriented Mobility Assessment（POMA）评分。完全移除源模态使肌电到运动学的重建 RMSE 增加 6.90%，反方向增加 11.38%。相比之下，跨参与者替换分别仅使 RMSE 增加 1.68% 和 1.67%，而模板使 RMSE 降低 2.89% 和 0.55%。对于 POMA 预测，步行速度、年龄和性别达到 MAE 3.693，而加入绝对值和带符号的学习到的不对称性后分别为 4.229 和 4.427。在所有 20 次重复评估中，所有不对称性表征的表现均劣于协变量基线。在协变量调整和错误发现率校正后，没有任何局部学习特征保持显著。该模型主要依赖共享的步态相位模式，没有明确的受试者特异性耦合或额外临床价值。因此，在将重建准确率视为个体化生理学证据之前，需要进行参与者水平的对照。

abstract: [Sage open pathology] Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), encompassing Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, remains a complex and heterogeneous condition with variable response to biologic therapies. Despite significant advances with anti-TNF agents, integrin inhibitors, and interleukin-12/23 blockers, treatment outcomes are limited by primary nonresponse, secondary loss of efficacy, immunogenicity, and substantial healthcare costs. The advent of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) algorithms, offers new opportunities to address these challenges by integrating diverse clinical, laboratory, imaging, histologic, genetic, and microbiome data. Recent studies demonstrate that AI-based models achieve high accuracy in predicting biologic response, remission, and adverse outcomes, outperforming conventional statistical approaches. AI has also shown promise in real-time endoscopic assessment, histologic grading, and forecasting disease progression, enabling earlier intervention and personalized therapy. However, current models are constrained by limited datasets, heterogeneity, lack of large-scale prospective validation, and concerns regarding interpretability, transparency, and patient privacy. Future efforts should prioritize multicenter trials, external validation, and ethical integration into clinical workflows. Collectively, AI-driven prediction of biologic therapy response represents a pivotal step toward precision medicine in IBD, with the potential to optimize therapeutic strategies, reduce ineffective treatment exposure, and improve patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Sage open pathology] 炎症性肠病（IBD）包括克罗恩病和溃疡性结肠炎，仍是一种复杂且异质性的疾病，对生物制剂的反应存在差异。尽管抗TNF药物、整合素抑制剂和白细胞介素-12/23阻断剂取得了显著进展，但治疗结局仍受限于原发性无应答、继发性疗效丧失、免疫原性和高昂的医疗费用。人工智能（AI），特别是机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）算法的出现，通过整合多样的临床、实验室、影像、组织学、遗传和微生物组数据，为解决这些挑战提供了新机会。近期研究表明，基于AI的模型在预测生物制剂应答、缓解和不良结局方面达到高准确度，优于传统统计方法。AI在实时内镜评估、组织学分级和预测疾病进展方面也显示出前景，使早期干预和个体化治疗成为可能。然而，当前模型受限于数据集有限、异质性、缺乏大规模前瞻性验证，以及对可解释性、透明度和患者隐私的担忧。未来工作应优先开展多中心试验、外部验证，并以合乎伦理的方式整合到临床工作流程中。总体而言，AI驱动的生物治疗应答预测是迈向IBD精准医学的关键一步，具有优化治疗策略、减少无效治疗暴露和改善患者结局的潜力。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Lokman Hekim University; conditions: Nursing Education; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 60; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] More than 300 million surgical procedures are performed worldwide each year. However, surgical errors remain among the most common medical errors causing preventable patient harm. Although various health policies have been implemented globally and nationally, adverse events continue to occur due to factors such as high patient volumes and insufficient staffing. One of the most important initiatives developed to prevent surgery-related adverse events is the World Health Organization's "Safe Surgery Saves Lives" project. Within this initiative, the Surgical Safety Checklist was developed and has contributed to significant reductions in adverse events. The World Health Organization has encouraged countries to adapt the checklist to their healthcare systems. In Türkiye, it was revised by adding an additional section based on the principle that "Safe surgery starts in the clinic." Current patient safety policies and initiatives largely focus on healthcare professionals. However, developing a culture of surgical safety should begin during undergraduate education. After graduation, students may adopt existing institutional practices regarding patient and surgical safety. Therefore, developing nursing students' knowledge, skills, and professional judgment regarding safe surgery before graduation is essential. This randomized controlled experimental study aims to compare the effectiveness of an artificial intelligence-assisted virtual simulation game and traditional simulation in improving nursing students' knowledge and skills regarding the Surgical Safety Checklist. The effects of these interventions on students' problem-solving skills and patient safety competencies will also be examined. Students, research fellows, and the statistician will be blinded. Data will be collected using the Surgical Safety Checklist Knowledge Test, Surgical Safety Checklist Skills Assessment Checklist, Problem Solving Inventory, and a scale assessing nursing students' patient safety competencies. Data will be analyzed using SPSS, with p\<0.05 considered statistically significant.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Lokman Hekim University；条件：护理教育（Nursing Education）；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；分期：NA；入组人数：60；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING] 全球每年实施超过3亿例手术。然而，手术错误仍然是最常见的导致可预防患者伤害的医疗错误之一。尽管全球和国家层面已实施各种卫生政策，但由于患者量大和人员配备不足等因素，不良事件仍持续发生。为预防手术相关不良事件而制定的最重要举措之一是世界卫生组织（World Health Organization）的“安全手术拯救生命”（Safe Surgery Saves Lives）项目。在该倡议中，开发了手术安全核查表（Surgical Safety Checklist），并已促进不良事件显著减少。世界卫生组织鼓励各国根据其医疗系统调整该核查表。在土耳其（Türkiye），基于“安全手术从诊所开始”的原则，通过增加一个额外部分对其进行了修订。当前患者安全政策和举措主要聚焦于医疗专业人员。然而，培养手术安全文化应始于本科教育。毕业后，学生可能会采用现有的关于患者和手术安全的机构实践。因此，在毕业前培养护理学生对安全手术的知识、技能和专业判断至关重要。这项随机对照实验研究旨在比较人工智能辅助虚拟模拟游戏与传统模拟在提高护理学生关于手术安全核查表的知识和技能方面的有效性。还将考察这些干预措施对学生问题解决能力和患者安全胜任力的影响。学生、研究员和统计师将被设盲。数据将使用手术安全核查表知识测试（Surgical Safety Checklist Knowledge Test）、手术安全核查表技能评估核查表（Surgical Safety Checklist Skills Assessment Checklist）、问题解决量表（Problem Solving Inventory）以及评估护理学生患者安全胜任力的量表收集。数据将使用SPSS分析，p<0.05被认为具有统计学意义。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: mevlüt aydın; conditions: Surgical Fear; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to investigate the associations between digital health literacy, generative artificial intelligence (AI) use, and preoperative surgical fear in adult patients scheduled for elective surgery. Approximately 1,000 patients will be included in this observational, cross-sectional study. Before surgery, participants will complete questionnaires assessing digital health literacy, experiences with generative AI tools, and surgical fear. Digital health literacy will be assessed using the eHealth Literacy Scale (eHEALS), while surgical fear will be evaluated using the Surgical Fear Questionnaire (SFQ). An investigator-developed questionnaire will assess AI use frequency, purposes of use, perceived reliability, and perceived benefits and risks. The study will examine the relationships between digital health literacy, AI use, and surgical fear, including concerns about short-term and long-term consequences of surgery. No experimental intervention will be performed, and participation will not affect routine clinical care.

title: Management of Behavioral Addictions via Artificial Intelligence based Digital Technologies
zh_title: AI数字技术用于行为成瘾管理的综述专著
summary: 以专著形式综述数字技术与AI在游戏、赌博、社交媒体等行为成瘾的预防、识别、治疗与康复中的应用。
key_points: 覆盖问题性游戏、赌博、社交媒体使用与网络购物
强调传统评估治疗在可扩展性与可及性上的局限

reason: 综述类专著，AI应用描述宽泛且无具体研究证据，属增量档
abstract: Behavioral addictions, such as problematic gaming, gambling, social media use, and online shopping, have emerged as a growing global concern with significant psychological, social, and economic consequences. Traditional assessment and treatment approaches, while clinically grounded, often struggle with scalability, accessibility, and long-term engagement. In recent years, advances in digital technologies and artificial intelligence (AI) have enabled the development of novel, data-driven solutions for the prevention, detection, treatment, and recovery of behavioral addictions. This book presents a comprehensive survey of the management of behavioral addictions through digital technologies, bridging clinical foundations with state-of-the-art computational approaches. This book aims to provide researchers, clinicians, and practitioners with a unified, interdisciplinary perspective on the opportunities and limitations of AI-based digital technologies in behavioral addiction management,and to highlight pathways toward more scalable, personalized, and effective intervention strategies.
zh_abstract: 行为成瘾，如问题性游戏、赌博、社交媒体使用和网络购物，已成为日益增长的全球关注问题，并带来显著的心理、社会和经济后果。传统评估和治疗方法虽然具有临床基础，但常常在可扩展性、可及性和长期参与度方面面临困难。近年来，数字技术和人工智能（AI）的进步使得开发新的、数据驱动的解决方案成为可能，用于行为成瘾的预防、检测、治疗和康复。本书对通过数字技术管理行为成瘾进行了全面综述，将临床基础与最先进的计算方法相衔接。本书旨在为研究人员、临床医生和从业者提供统一、跨学科的视角，以理解基于 AI 的数字技术在行为成瘾管理中的机遇和局限，并突出通往更具可扩展性、个性化和有效干预策略的路径。

title: Opportunistic Risk Assessment of Major Osteoporotic Fractures from Routine Chest Radiographs Using Deep Learning
zh_title: 胸片深度学习机会性预测骨质疏松性骨折
summary: 在53,109名成人中开发卷积神经网络生存模型，利用常规胸片预测主要骨质疏松性骨折，并在两家独立机构85,284例中外部验证。
key_points: tertiary医院53,109名成人中开发CNN生存模型
两家独立机构85,284例胸片外部验证
主要结局为新增主要骨质疏松性骨折
reason: 大样本且经两家独立机构外部验证，属重要档
abstract: Background Bone mineral density (BMD) and the Fracture Risk Assessment Tool (FRAX) incompletely capture fracture risk in the osteopenic range, where much of the fracture burden occurs. Routine chest radiographs are acquired across a broad range of patients and may contain information relevant to fracture risk, offering a potential opportunistic complement without additional imaging burden. Methods We developed a convolutional neural network survival model in 53,109 adults at a tertiary hospital and externally validated it in 85,284 patients from two independent institutions. Eligibility required a chest radiograph obtained within 1 year of dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry scans, so all participants had been referred for densitometry. The primary outcome was incident major osteoporotic fracture. Discrimination was assessed by using the concordance index (C-index) and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) at 2, 3, 5, and 10 years, compared with FRAX with BMD and with the lowest BMD T-score. Results In the external validation cohorts (mean 58.6 years of age; 68.9% female; and follow-up of 77 months), the deep-learning (DL) model achieved a C-index of 0.843 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.837 to 0.850) and a censoring-adjusted 10-year AUROC of 0.855 (95% CI, 0.846 to 0.863), which was higher than that of FRAX with BMD (C-index, 0.779, 95% CI, 0.770 to 0.787; 10-year AUROC, 0.785, 95% CI, 0.775 to 0.794; both P Conclusions A survival DL model applied to routine chest radiographs identified patients at high fracture risk with discrimination exceeding that of FRAX, with the greatest benefit in patients with osteopenia. As all participants had been referred for densitometry, absolute-risk and case-finding estimates require prospective evaluation in an unselected routine-radiography population. (Funded by the National Research Foundation of Korea and others.).
zh_abstract: 【背景】骨密度（BMD）和骨折风险评估工具（FRAX）在骨量减少范围内不能完全捕捉骨折风险，而相当一部分骨折负担发生在此范围。常规胸部X线摄影在广泛患者中获取，可能包含与骨折风险相关的信息，提供一种潜在的机会性补充，而不增加额外影像负担。【方法】我们在三级医院的53109名成人中开发了一个卷积神经网络生存模型，并在来自两个独立机构的85284例患者中对其进行外部验证。入选要求为在双能X线吸收测定（DXA）扫描1年内获取胸部X线摄影，因此所有参与者均曾被转诊进行骨密度测定。主要结局为发生重大骨质疏松性骨折。通过一致性指数（C-index）和2年、3年、5年和10年的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）评估区分度，并与结合BMD的FRAX以及最低BMD T值进行比较。【结果】在外部验证队列中（平均年龄58.6岁；68.9%女性；随访77个月），深度学习（DL）模型达到C-index 0.843（95%置信区间[CI]，0.837至0.850）和经删失校正的10年AUROC 0.855（95% CI，0.846至0.863），高于结合BMD的FRAX（C-index，0.779，95% CI，0.770至0.787；10年AUROC，0.785，95% CI，0.775至0.794；两者均 P）。【结论】应用于常规胸部X线摄影的生存DL模型识别出高骨折风险患者，其区分度超过FRAX，在骨量减少患者中获益最大。由于所有参与者均曾被转诊进行骨密度测定，绝对风险和病例发现估计需要在未经选择的常规X线摄影人群中进行前瞻性评估。（由韩国国家研究基金会及其他资助方资助。）

title: Routine laboratory trajectories predict organ-level complications in cancer
zh_title: 常规检验轨迹预测癌症器官层面并发症
summary: 基于3905例患者277万余条检验数据的Transformer模型，预测两年内162种治疗相关并发症。
key_points: 277万条检验、3905例患者
预测162种治疗相关并发症
MIMIC-IV与CoMMpass外部验证
reason: 同行评审、大样本并有两个外部队列验证，属重要档
abstract: Routine laboratory panels drawn during cancer treatment constitute longitudinal physiological recordings of organ function, yet their temporal structure is discarded by single-timepoint prognostic tools. A transformer trained on 2,777,595 laboratory measurements from 3905 patients with multiple myeloma or ovarian cancer predicted which of 162 treatment-associated complications would be newly recorded within two years, spanning eight clinical categories, achieving 1.5- to 6.1-fold enrichment above prevalence. Across individual endpoints it exceeded non-sequential baselines, including engineered-trajectory models, by +0.024 to +0.070 in mean AUROC. Predictions generalised across both cancers, divergence concentrating in disease-specific complications, and biomarker masking recovered signatures consistent with established pathophysiology. External validation on MIMIC-IV and MMRF CoMMpass showed transferability, strongest for renal and metabolic endpoints, attenuated for infection endpoints. On CoMMpass it added prognostic value to ISS staging. Routine oncological laboratory data carry complication-specific physiological signal months before a complication is recorded, and require no testing beyond standard oncological care.
zh_abstract: 癌症治疗期间采集的常规实验室检查组合构成器官功能的纵向生理记录，但单时间点预后工具丢弃了其时间结构。一个Transformer模型基于3905名多发性骨髓瘤或卵巢癌患者的2,777,595次实验室测量值进行训练，预测162种治疗相关并发症中哪些会在两年内新被记录，涵盖八个临床类别，较患病率实现1.5至6.1倍富集。在各单项终点上，其平均AUROC较非序列基线（包括工程化轨迹模型）高出+0.024至+0.070。预测在两种癌症间均具有泛化性，差异集中于疾病特异性并发症，并且生物标志物遮蔽恢复了与既有病理生理学一致的信号特征。在MIMIC-IV和MMRF CoMMpass上的外部验证显示了可迁移性，以肾脏和代谢终点最强，感染终点减弱。在CoMMpass上，它为ISS分期增加了预后价值。常规肿瘤学实验室数据在并发症被记录前数月即携带并发症特异性生理信号，且无需在标准肿瘤诊疗之外进行额外检测。

title: Artificial Intelligence–Enhanced Auscultation to Identify Left Ventricular Dysfunction — Development and External Validation in Prospective Multicenter Studies
zh_title: AI听诊识别左室功能不全的多中心外部验证
summary: 前瞻性多中心研究在转诊超声心动检查的成人中开发并外部验证AI数字听诊方法，用于识别LVEF≤40%的左室功能不全。
key_points: 前瞻性多中心，纳入转诊超声心动检查的成人
四部位数字听诊联合单导联心电，Transformer+一维CNN集成
以同期超声LVEF≤40%定义左室功能不全
reason: 前瞻性多中心设计并做外部验证，属重要档
abstract: Background Left ventricular dysfunction (LVD) is common and associated with adverse prognosis, even in asymptomatic individuals. Early treatment improves outcomes, underscoring the need for efficient strategies to identify patients who may benefit from echocardiographic evaluation. This study aimed to develop and externally validate an AI auscultation method to detect LVD among patients referred for clinically indicated echocardiography. Methods In this prospective, multicenter study, adult patients referred for echocardiography were enrolled to undergo digital auscultation at four standard auscultation sites with simultaneous single-lead ECGs. LVD was defined as a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) less than or equal to 40% on concurrent echocardiography. An ensemble model combining a transformer-based network and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network was trained on multicenter data and externally validated. The model's performance was compared with a seven-cardiologist reader substudy and clinical logistic regression models incorporating clinical variables, single-lead ECG-derived features, and B-type natriuretic peptide levels. Results The multicenter training cohort included 2359 patients (mean age, 69.7±13.5 years; 40.4% female; 8.9% with reduced LVEF). The external validation cohort of 964 patients (mean age, 68.6±15.4 years; 38.9% female; 7.6% with reduced LVEF) was obtained from another independent multicenter registry. The four-site AI auscultation outperformed ECG-only models and the clinical logistic models, achieving an area under the receiver operator curve (AUROC) of 0.926 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.911 to 0.939) in the training cohort. In the external validation cohort, AUROC was 0.904 (95% CI, 0.876 to 0.930) and sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy were 86.3%, 74.2%, and 75.1%, respectively. In a 100-patient reader substudy, AI auscultation outperformed cardiologist consensus in accuracy (82.0% vs. 62.0%; P=0.004). Model performance was consistent across prespecified subgroups. The simplified two-site auscultation model retained high accuracy in the external validation cohort (AUROC, 0.903; 95% CI, 0.878 to 0.927). Conclusions AI auscultation accurately detected LVD among patients referred for clinically indicated echocardiography, supporting its potential as a scalable and accessible pre-echocardiographic risk-enrichment tool. Further validation is warranted before broader screening applications. (Funded by AMI Inc
zh_abstract: 【背景】左心室功能障碍（LVD）常见且与不良预后相关，即使在无症状个体中也是如此。早期治疗可改善结局，这凸显了需要高效策略来识别可能从超声心动图评估中获益的患者。本研究旨在开发并外部验证一种AI听诊方法，用于在因临床指征转诊接受超声心动图检查的患者中检测LVD。【方法】在这项前瞻性多中心研究中，因超声心动图转诊的成人患者被纳入，在四个标准听诊部位进行数字听诊，并同步记录单导联心电图。LVD定义为同期超声心动图左心室射血分数（LVEF）≤40%。一个结合基于Transformer的网络和一维卷积神经网络的集成模型在多中心数据上训练并进行外部验证。该模型性能与一项由7名心脏病科医生阅片者组成的子研究以及纳入临床变量、单导联心电图衍生特征和B型利钠肽水平的临床逻辑回归模型进行比较。【结果】多中心训练队列包括2359例患者（平均年龄69.7±13.5岁；40.4%女性；8.9% LVEF降低）。外部验证队列964例患者（平均年龄68.6±15.4岁；38.9%女性；7.6% LVEF降低）来自另一个独立多中心注册库。四部位AI听诊优于仅心电图模型和临床逻辑模型，在训练队列中达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）0.926（95%置信区间[CI]，0.911至0.939）。在外部验证队列中，AUROC为0.904（95% CI，0.876至0.930），敏感性、特异性和准确性分别为86.3%、74.2%和75.1%。在100例患者阅片者子研究中，AI听诊在准确性上优于心脏病科医生共识（82.0% vs. 62.0%；P=0.004）。模型性能在预设亚组中一致。简化的两部位听诊模型在外部验证队列中保持高准确性（AUROC，0.903；95% CI，0.878至0.927）。【结论】AI听诊在因临床指征转诊接受超声心动图检查的患者中准确检测出LVD，支持其作为可扩展且可及的超声心动图检查前风险富集工具的潜力。在更广泛筛查应用前仍需进一步验证。（由AMI Inc资助）

title: A Meta-Research Review of Statistical Practices for Image-Reliant AI Tools Predicting Lung Cancer Outcomes
zh_title: 肺癌影像AI统计实践的元研究综述
summary: 横断面元研究综述纳入36项2023年至2025年开发的肺癌影像AI研究，评估其统计方法严谨性与报告透明度并指出最佳实践缺口。
key_points: 横断面元研究，纳入36项肺癌影像AI研究
75%使用CNN，81%以AUC为主要评价指标
64%报告不确定性量化，但多限于性能指标置信区间
reason: 方法学元研究，纳入36项研究结论明确，但属综述类上限档
abstract: AbstractAI models using medical images are increasingly proposed to support clinical decision-making in lung cancer, motivating assessment of their methodological rigor and transparency. To assess how these models are developed, evaluated, and reported, and to identify gaps in best statistical practices, we conducted a cross-sectional meta-research review of OpenAlex-indexed studies (January 1, 2023, to June 30, 2025) that developed image-based AI tools for lung cancer risk prediction, detection, or prognosis. Thirty-six studies met our inclusion criteria. Convolutional neural networks were used in most studies (27 studies, 75%), and area under the curve (AUC) was the most frequently reported evaluation metric (29 studies, 81%). Although 23 studies (64%) reported some form of uncertainty quantification, most were limited to presenting confidence intervals for global performance metrics (e.g., AUC, sensitivity, and accuracy) rather than individual prediction- or risk-level uncertainty. Common limitations included limited external test set use (14 studies, 39%), insufficient subgroup analyses (10 studies, 28%), and limited adherence to established prediction-model reporting guidelines. Overall, future research should prioritize standardized reporting, use of external test sets, and model performance assessment across clinically relevant subpopulations. The coexistence of increasingly powerful AI-based prediction models with inconsistent study design, evaluation, and reporting practices emphasizes the urgent need to implement more rigorous and transparent methodological standards in this field. (Funded by Yale School of Public Health.).
zh_abstract: 使用医学图像的 AI 模型越来越多地被提出用于支持肺癌临床决策，这促使评估其方法学严谨性和透明度。为评估这些模型如何开发、评价和报告，并识别最佳统计学实践中的差距，我们对 OpenAlex 索引的研究（2023年1月1日至2025年6月30日）进行了横断面元研究综述，这些研究开发了基于图像的 AI 工具用于肺癌风险预测、检测或预后。36项研究符合我们的纳入标准。大多数研究使用卷积神经网络（27项研究，75%），曲线下面积（AUC）是最常报告的评估指标（29项研究，81%）。尽管23项研究（64%）报告了某种形式的不确定性量化，但大多数仅限于呈现全局性能指标（如AUC、敏感性和准确性）的置信区间，而非个体预测层面或风险层面的不确定性。常见局限包括外部测试集使用有限（14项研究，39%）、亚组分析不足（10项研究，28%）以及对既定预测模型报告指南的依从性有限。总体而言，未来研究应优先考虑标准化报告、使用外部测试集以及在临床相关亚人群中评估模型性能。日益强大的基于AI的预测模型与不一致的研究设计、评价和报告实践并存，强调该领域迫切需要实施更严谨和透明的方法学标准。（由耶鲁大学公共卫生学院资助。）

title: Effect of Previsit AI-Generated Document Summaries on Consultation Time and Patient–Physician Communication — The AI-INFOCARE Randomized Controlled Trial
zh_title: AI会诊前摘要对沟通与就诊时长影响的RCT
summary: 单中心随机对照试验纳入300名神经外科门诊成人，评估会诊前提供经质量核查的AI生成通俗病情摘要对医患沟通与就诊时长的影响。
key_points: 单中心RCT，1:1随机，纳入300名成人
干预为会诊前AI生成并质量核查的通俗摘要
主要终点为患者报告的医患互动质量FAPI
reason: 前瞻性RCT设计加分，但单中心、300例、患者报告结局，处重要档下限
abstract: Background Limited health literacy, clinical jargon, and time-constrained consultations often impair patients' understanding of medical findings. We evaluated whether AI-generated, quality-checked lay language summaries provided before consultations improve communication-related outcomes. Methods In this single-center, randomized trial in an outpatient neurosurgical setting, 300 adults were randomly assigned 1:1 to standard care with or without a quality-checked, AI-generated layperson summary of their medical findings (Simply Onno) before consultation. The primary end point was patient-reported quality of physician-patient interaction (Fragebogen zur Arzt-Patient-Interaktion [FAPI]). Secondary end points included autonomy support (Health Care Climate Questionnaire [HCCQ]), encounter difficulty (Difficult Doctor-Patient Relationship Questionnaire [DDPRQ-10]), and consultation duration (minutes). Results The mean FAPI score was higher in the intervention group (4.42±0.51 vs. 4.25±0.54; difference, 0.17; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.05 to 0.29; P=0.005; Hedges' g=0.33), driven by shared decision-making (difference, 0.29; 95% CI, 0.15 to 0.42), with no evidence of a difference in perceived empathy. Patient-rated autonomy support was higher (difference, 0.14; 95% CI, 0.06 to 0.23), whereas physicians rated their own autonomy support slightly lower (difference, -0.12; cluster-robust 95% CI, -0.21 to -0.04). Median consultation time was 25 versus 33 minutes in the intervention group versus the control group, respectively, an approximate 21% relative reduction (ratio of geometric means, 0.79; 95% CI, 0.70 to 0.88). For encounter difficulty (DDPRQ-10), we found potential evidence of a small increase (difference, 0.09; cluster-robust 95% CI, -0.03 to 0.21). Secondary end point confidence intervals were unadjusted for multiplicity. Conclusions AI-generated summaries provided before outpatient neurosurgical consultations were associated with better patient-reported interaction quality and autonomy support and shorter consultations. Physicians rated their own autonomy support as slightly lower in the intervention group; evidence for increased encounter difficulty was limited, with confidence intervals compatible with no difference. These findings support further evaluation of quality-checked, patient-facing document translation; effects on clinical outcomes and clinician workload require confirmation before routine adoption.
zh_abstract: 【背景】健康素养有限、临床术语和专业且时间受限的咨询常会损害患者对医学检查结果的理解。我们评估了在咨询前提供经质量核查的AI生成通俗语言摘要是否能改善沟通相关结局。【方法】在这项单中心随机试验中，研究场所为门诊神经外科环境，300名成人按1:1随机分配至标准诊疗加或不加在咨询前提供经质量核查、AI生成的其医学检查结果通俗语言摘要（Simply Onno）。主要终点为患者报告医患互动质量（Fragebogen zur Arzt-Patient-Interaktion [FAPI]）。次要终点包括自主性支持（Health Care Climate Questionnaire [HCCQ]）、就诊困难（Difficult Doctor-Patient Relationship Questionnaire [DDPRQ-10]）和咨询时长（分钟）。【结果】干预组平均FAPI评分更高（4.42±0.51 vs. 4.25±0.54；差值0.17；95%置信区间[CI]，0.05至0.29；P=0.005；Hedges' g=0.33），这由共同决策驱动（差值0.29；95% CI，0.15至0.42），感知共情无差异证据。患者评定的自主性支持更高（差值0.14；95% CI，0.06至0.23），而医生对自身自主性支持评分略低（差值-0.12；聚类稳健95% CI，-0.21至-0.04）。干预组与对照组的中位咨询时间分别为25分钟与33分钟，相对减少约21%（几何均值比0.79；95% CI，0.70至0.88）。对于就诊困难（DDPRQ-10），我们发现小幅增加的潜在证据（差值0.09；聚类稳健95% CI，-0.03至0.21）。次要终点的置信区间未进行多重性校正。【结论】在门诊神经外科咨询前提供AI生成摘要与更好的患者报告互动质量和自主性支持以及更短的咨询相关。干预组中医生对自身自主性支持评分略低；就诊困难增加的证据有限，其置信区间与无差异相容。这些发现支持进一步评估经质量核查、面向患者的文件翻译；在常规采用前，其对临床结局和临床医生工作量的影响需要确认。

title: When artificial intelligence falls short: Multimodal analysis improves head and neck lymphoma classification.
zh_title: 多模态融合提升头颈淋巴瘤病理分类
summary: 基于 10 家机构 610 例的头颈淋巴病变多模态框架，融合病理组学特征与临床病理变量，在两个外部队列维持性能。
key_points: UNI 单模态模型泛化有限（准确率 0.66、AUROC 0.66）
多模态内部准确率 0.91、AUROC 0.87
两个外部队列准确率 0.84 与 0.79、AUROC 0.84 与 0.80
reason: 同行评审、10 家机构来源并含两个外部队列验证，达重要档
abstract: [iScience] Artificial intelligence is increasingly applied in digital pathology, yet its generalizability in routine diagnostic settings remains challenging. We developed a multimodal framework for classifying head and neck lymphoid lesions using 610 cases from ten institutions. UNI was used for histological feature extraction, while CellViT++ enabled nuclear segmentation and quantitative morphometry, subsequently integrated with clinicopathological variables. The UNI-based model showed limited generalization (accuracy of 0.66, F1 score of 0.65, and Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.66), whereas multimodal integration substantially improved internal performance (accuracy of 0.91, F1 score of 0.91, and AUROC of 0.87) and maintained performance across two external cohorts (accuracy of 0.84 and 0.79 and AUROC of 0.84 and 0.80). Class-stratified SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis revealed distinct feature attribution patterns across diagnostic groups, with nuclear morphometric features contributing prominently to model predictions. Morphology alone imposes a clear performance ceiling in head and neck lymphomas. Multimodal integration provides a more reliable and clinically relevant approach, supporting diagnostic triage in routine practice.
zh_abstract: 【iScience】人工智能正日益应用于数字病理学，但其在常规诊断环境中的泛化能力仍具挑战性。我们开发了一个多模态框架，用于对来自十家机构的610例头颈部淋巴样病变进行分类。UNI用于组织学特征提取，CellViT++用于细胞核分割和定量形态学测量，随后与临床病理变量整合。基于UNI的模型显示出有限的泛化能力（准确率0.66、F1分数0.65、受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）0.66），而多模态整合显著提高了内部性能（准确率0.91、F1分数0.91、AUROC 0.87），并在两个外部队列中保持性能（准确率分别为0.84和0.79，AUROC分别为0.84和0.80）。按类别分层的SHapley加性解释（SHAP）分析揭示了不同诊断组之间不同的特征归因模式，其中细胞核形态学特征对模型预测有显著贡献。仅依靠形态学在头颈部淋巴瘤中形成了明显的性能上限。多模态整合提供了一种更可靠且更具临床相关性的方法，支持常规实践中的诊断分诊。

title: FIRE-EVIDENCE: enabling LLM-driven, machine-readable evidence synthesis for women’s health
zh_title: FIRE-EVIDENCE：面向女性健康的LLM证据合成框架
summary: npj Digital Medicine 提出将临床研究全文转为FHIR对齐可计算证据的LLM框架，并在小规模数据集上评测。
key_points: 输出为FHIR对齐的可计算证据
在26项RCT与18项研究上评测
面向女性健康与更年期决策
样本规模较小，属早期验证
reason: 方法有新意且同行评审，但评测集仅数十篇文献、证据有限
abstract: Clinical evidence is abundant in the published literature yet remains fragmented and underutilized, particularly in women’s health and menopause, where timely, personalized decision-making is critical. Conventional evidence synthesis relies on resource-intensive manual review, limiting scalability and delaying translation into practice, while automated approaches often produce outputs that are not directly computable or integrable into decision-support workflows. We present FIRE-EVIDENCE, a large language model framework that transforms full-text clinical studies into structured, Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR)-aligned computable evidence. The pipeline was optimized on seven development documents and evaluated on two datasets: a primary dataset of 26 expert-annotated randomized controlled trials and a secondary dataset of 18 studies derived from five systematic reviews. Across expert-annotated trials, FIRE-EVIDENCE achieved 94.35% completeness, 94.61% correctness, 97.36% source faithfulness, and an F _1 score of 94.43%. FHIR-compliance testing in a 10-output native FHIR-R5 subset showed that all validated outputs passed base HL7 FHIR validation without errors. FIRE-EVIDENCE demonstrates a feasible pathway for standard-based, machine-readable evidence synthesis.
zh_abstract: 已发表文献中临床证据丰富，但仍呈碎片化且未得到充分利用，尤其是在女性健康与绝经领域，及时、个性化的决策至关重要。传统证据综合依赖资源密集的人工审阅，限制了可扩展性并延迟了向实践的转化，而自动化方法产生的输出往往无法直接计算或整合到决策支持工作流中。我们提出 FIRE-EVIDENCE，一个大型语言模型框架，可将全文临床研究转化为结构化、符合快速医疗互操作性资源（Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources, FHIR）的可计算证据。该流程在七份开发文档上优化，并在两个数据集上评估：一个由26项专家标注随机对照试验组成的主要数据集，以及一个源自五项系统综述的18项研究的次要数据集。在专家标注试验中，FIRE-EVIDENCE 达到94.35%完整性、94.61%正确性、97.36%来源忠实度，F_1 分数为94.43%。在一个包含10个输出的原生 FHIR-R5 子集中进行 FHIR 合规性测试，显示所有经过验证的输出均通过基础 HL7 FHIR 验证且无错误。FIRE-EVIDENCE 展示了基于标准的、机器可读证据综合的可行路径。

title: Comparative Cost of Care Recommended by Large Language Models versus Treating Physicians
zh_title: 大模型与医师推荐诊疗方案的费用比较
summary: 用200份公开去标识门诊与急诊病历评估24个AI系统生成诊疗方案，按2026年Medicare价格比较其与主治医师记录方案的费用差异。
key_points: 24个AI系统各生成200份病历的诊疗计划
检查与转诊按2026年Medicare价格计价
以医师记录计划为对照，另测试两种提示词
reason: 多系统与医师对照评估有新意，但病历样本有限、无真实患者结局，值得一看
abstract: Background Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly consulted for clinical decision support, yet the cost of services or treatment they recommend has not been systematically evaluated. Methods We evaluated 24 AI systems on 200 deidentified outpatient and emergency department notes from MTSamples, a public collection of deidentified U.S.-format clinical notes contributed by practicing clinicians. Each system received the presentation recorded before the physician's assessment and wrote its own plan; the physician's documented plan was the comparator. Orders from both were extracted by three independent LLMs and priced at 2026 Medicare rates. The primary outcome was the per-visit total cost of recommended care: diagnostic tests plus specialist referrals. New medications were counted rather than priced. We also tested two prompts: one cost-aware prompt and one parsimonious-but-safe prompt. Results Across the 20 general-purpose systems, AI-suggested care cost a mean of US$314 per visit, compared with US$97 for care recommended by treating physicians - a difference of US$216 per visit (95% confidence interval, US$177 to US$257; P Conclusions The care these systems recommended cost substantially more than physicians' documented care, chiefly because they suggested testing at visits where the physician had ordered none. LLM outputs are suggestions, not plans of care; final decisions should remain with clinicians.
zh_abstract: 【背景】大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被咨询用于临床决策支持，但其所推荐服务或治疗的成本尚未得到系统评估。【方法】我们在来自 MTSamples 的200份去标识化门诊和急诊记录上评估了24个AI系统；MTSamples 是一个由执业临床医生贡献的去标识化美国格式临床记录公共集合。每个系统接收在医生评估之前记录的病情陈述，并撰写自己的计划；医生记录的诊疗计划作为对照。两者的医嘱由三个独立的大语言模型（LLM）提取，并按2026年 Medicare 费率计价。主要结局是每次就诊推荐医疗的总成本：诊断检查加专科转诊。新药仅被计数，而未计价。我们还测试了两种提示词：一种成本意识提示词和一种简约但安全的提示词。【结果】在20个通用型系统中，AI建议的医疗平均每次就诊花费314美元，而治疗医生推荐的医疗为97美元——每次就诊相差216美元（95%置信区间：177至257美元；P【结论】这些系统推荐的医疗费用显著高于医生记录的医疗，主要因为它们在医生未开具任何检查的就诊中建议了检查。LLM输出是建议，不是诊疗计划；最终决定应仍由临床医生作出。

title: FDA Clears GE HealthCare Mobile X-Ray Ai for Feeding Tube Assessment
zh_title: FDA清关GE医疗移动X光AI喂养管评估功能
summary: FDA批准GE HealthCare移动X射线AI功能，用于喂养管位置评估。
reason: 监管实质进展，但仅标题、为单点功能清关，受标题限制取6分

title: GEHC gets FDA clearance for feeding tube AI on mobile x-ray
zh_title: GE 移动X光喂饲管AI获FDA许可
summary: GE HealthCare 用于移动X光影像的喂饲管 AI 功能获得 FDA 许可。
reason: FDA 许可属实质监管进展，但仅有标题、信息有限

title: PeriaTrace: Tooth-Level Grounding Diagnosis and Patient-Facing Explanations from Periapical Radiographs
zh_title: PeriaTrace：根尖片牙位级诊断与患者友好解释
summary: 预印本提出三阶段框架，在12,877张根尖片及两个外部临床队列上实现牙位级诊断、可视化报告生成与患者易懂解释。
key_points: 内部数据集含12,877张根尖片，并在两个外部队列验证
内部评估牙位定位与FDI编号联合F1为94.37%
外部队列中资深牙髓医生认可度分别为91.16%与84.52%
reason: 万级样本且有外部临床队列验证，属重要档；预印本未再上调
abstract: Periapical radiographs (PRs) are central to endodontic diagnosis, but interpreting them and preparing reports are time-consuming. Technical language can limit patients' understanding, while existing automated methods often lack tooth-level links between findings and image evidence. We present PeriaTrace, a three-stage framework integrating tooth-level diagnosis, visually grounded report generation, and patient-friendly explanations and care recommendations. PeriaTrace was developed and evaluated using 12,877 PRs from an internal dataset and two external clinical cohorts. In internal evaluation, it achieved a macro Dice coefficient of 85.35%, BLEU-4 of 0.6504, an F1 score of 94.37% for joint tooth localization and Fédération Dentaire Internationale (FDI) identification, and a grounding-tag F1 score of 77.93%. In the two external cohorts, senior endodontists considered 91.16% and 84.52% of reports suitable for retention or revision without complete rewriting. Generation averaged 4.41 seconds per PR, several tens of times faster than manual drafting. Among 196 survey participants without medical backgrounds, 96.4% preferred reports with plain-language explanations and care recommendations, and 84.7% found visual localization cues helpful. PeriaTrace may enable faster, evidence-traceable reporting while supporting clinical review and patient communication. (Abridged version)
zh_abstract: 根尖周X线片（periapical radiographs，PRs）是牙髓病诊断的核心，但解读这些影像并撰写报告耗时。技术性语言可能限制患者的理解，而现有自动化方法往往缺乏检查发现与图像证据之间的牙位级关联。我们提出 PeriaTrace，这是一个三阶段框架，整合牙位级诊断、视觉依据支撑的报告生成以及患者友好的解释和护理建议。PeriaTrace 使用来自一个内部数据集和两个外部临床队列的 12,877 张 PRs 进行开发和评估。在内部评估中，其宏观 Dice 系数达到 85.35%，BLEU-4 为 0.6504，联合牙位定位与国际牙科联盟（Fédération Dentaire Internationale，FDI）识别的 F1 分数为 94.37%，依据标签（grounding-tag）F1 分数为 77.93%。在两个外部队列中，资深牙髓病专科医生认为分别有 91.16% 和 84.52% 的报告适合保留或修改而无需完全重写。生成平均每张 PR 用时 4.41 秒，比人工起草快数十倍。在 196 名无医学背景的调查参与者中，96.4% 偏好带有通俗语言解释和护理建议的报告，84.7% 认为视觉定位提示有帮助。PeriaTrace 可能实现更快、证据可追溯的报告，同时支持临床审查和患者沟通。（节略版）

title: Segment Anything for Microscopy 2
zh_title: Segment Anything for Microscopy 2：光学与电镜2D/3D分割基础模型
summary: 在2300万细胞核与160万细胞结构标注上训练，实现光镜与电镜的二维/三维联合分割，并支持分类与追踪。
key_points: 训练标注超2300万细胞与核、160万细胞结构
体积数据上优于通用与专用方法
支持少标注像素/目标分类及2D/3D细胞追踪
reason: 大规模公开训练数据与开放基础模型，含充分基线对比，属重要档
abstract: Foundation models have advanced microscopy image segmentation, but existing models are trained on two-dimensional data, struggle with complex structures in volumetric data, and address only a narrow range of analysis tasks. Here we present Segment Anything for Microscopy 2 (SAM2), a foundation model that adapts SAM2 to joint 2D and 3D segmentation in light and electron microscopy. Trained on annotations of more than 23 million cells and nuclei and 1.6 million cellular structures, SAM2 achieves state-of-the-art automatic and interactive segmentation and outperforms generalist and specialist methods on volumetric data. Dedicated models further enable accurate mitochondrion and nucleus segmentation in electron microscopy. Beyond segmentation, SAM2 supports pixel and object classification from few annotations as well as cell tracking in 2D and 3D time-lapse data. All functionality is available in the user-friendly SAM napari plugin. We demonstrated the capabilities of SAM2 on challenging use cases spanning developmental biology, organoid research, cardiac physiology, and histopathology.
zh_abstract: 基础模型推动了显微镜图像分割的发展，但现有模型在二维数据上训练，难以处理体数据中的复杂结构，并且仅能处理有限范围的分析任务。在此，我们提出用于显微镜的 Segment Anything 2（SAM2），这是一个将 SAM2 适配于光学和电子显微镜中联合二维和三维分割的基础模型。SAM2 在超过 2300 万个细胞和细胞核以及 160 万个细胞结构的标注上训练，实现了最先进的自动和交互式分割，并在体数据上优于通用和专用方法。专用模型进一步能够在电子显微镜中准确分割线粒体和细胞核。除分割之外，SAM2 支持基于少量标注的像素和对象分类，以及二维和三维延时数据中的细胞追踪。所有功能均可在用户友好的 SAM napari 插件中使用。我们在涵盖发育生物学、类器官研究、心脏生理学和组织病理学的挑战性用例中展示了 SAM2 的能力。

title: SCAN: Site-Aware Collaborative Privacy-Preserving Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for Neurological Disease Classification
zh_title: SCAN：站点感知的隐私保护视觉语言模型协作适配
summary: 提出站点感知协作适配框架，使新站点无需共享脑MRI即可适配3D医学视觉语言模型，并在67个站点数据上评估。
key_points: 各站点保留类原型，仅共享加噪的范数受限摘要
使用12国67站点共7641例扫描，含AD、卒中、癫痫
7个未见站点零样本AUC：AD与卒中0.833–0.945
reason: 多中心大样本并在7个未见站点做外部验证，属重要档，受预印本限制不再上调
abstract: Worldwide neuroimaging data could strengthen diagnostic foundation models, but privacy rules often prevent centralizing brain MRI scans. We present SCAN, a site-aware collaborative adaptation framework for Neurological Disease Classification that lets new sites adapt a 3D medical vision-language model (VLM) without retraining or sharing patient scans. Each site keeps exact class prototypes for local prediction and can share privacy-protected class summaries: norm-bounded sums and counts perturbed once with calibrated noise. Using 7,641 scans from 67 sites across 12 countries, covering Alzheimer's disease (AD), stroke, epilepsy and controls, we assess local adaptation, cross-site benefits, and effects on existing sites. At seven unseen sites, the frozen VLM's zero-shot AUCs were 0.833-0.945 for AD and stroke. Training-free local prototypes improved epilepsy AUC at three sites from 0.598/0.625/0.508 to 0.684/0.729/0.762 and AD AUC at one site from 0.833 to 0.863, nearly matching a classifier trained at each site (mean AUC 0.757 vs. 0.759). With differential privacy ($ε$ = 4), new sites contributed without materially reducing accuracy at existing sites (AUC change $\leq$0.2%), although gains from sharing were limited, and membership attacks performed near chance. SCAN offers hospitals a worldwide framework to adapt and share brain MRI VLMs without exchanging scans or retraining.
zh_abstract: 全球神经影像数据可增强诊断基础模型，但隐私规则往往阻止集中脑MRI扫描。我们提出SCAN，这是一种面向神经疾病分类的站点感知协作自适应框架，使新站点无需重新训练或共享患者扫描即可适配三维医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）。每个站点保留用于本地预测的精确类别原型，并可共享受隐私保护的类别摘要：范数有界的和与计数，经校准噪声一次性扰动。使用来自12个国家67个站点的7,641次扫描，涵盖阿尔茨海默病（AD）、卒中、癫痫和对照，我们评估了本地适配、跨站点获益以及对现有站点的影响。在七个未见站点，冻结VLM的零样本AUC在AD和卒中为0.833–0.945。无需训练的本地原型将三个站点的癫痫AUC从0.598/0.625/0.508提高至0.684/0.729/0.762，并将一个站点的AD AUC从0.833提高至0.863，几乎匹配在各站点训练的分类器（平均AUC 0.757 vs. 0.759）。在差分隐私（ε = 4）下，新站点作出了贡献，而未实质性降低现有站点的准确率（AUC变化≤0.2%），尽管共享带来的增益有限，且成员攻击的表现接近随机水平。SCAN为医院提供了一个全球性框架，可在不交换扫描或重新训练的情况下适配和共享脑MRI VLM。

title: WHITE-Net: White matter HyperIntensities Tissue Extraction using deep learning network.
zh_title: WHITE-Net：深度学习白质高信号分割网络
summary: 基于3D ResUNet的框架，用多中心多厂商MRI数据训练，在BrainLaus、ADNI与WMH Challenge三个独立数据集评估。
key_points: 针对脑小血管病白质高信号自动分割
多中心训练覆盖厂商与协议差异
三个独立数据集外部评估
reason: 多中心训练加三个独立数据集外部验证，但仅报告分割指标
abstract: [Imaging neuroscience (Cambridge, Mass.)] White matter hyperintensities (WMH) are a hallmark of cerebral small vessel disease, a highly prevalent condition in aging, making their accurate detection in large-scale magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) studies critically important. Currently available semi-automated and automated segmentation methods are frequently limited by sensitivity to variations in imaging conditions and computational constraints, restricting their applicability across diverse acquisition settings. We present WHITE-Net, a deep learning-based framework for automated WMH segmentation built on a 3D ResUNet architecture and trained on multisite MRI data encompassing substantial variability in scanner vendors, acquisition protocols, spatial resolution, and image characteristics. Evaluated across three independent datasets-BrainLaus, ADNI, and WMH Challenge, WHITE-Net achieves high segmentation accuracy and ranks among the top-performing methods across datasets, enabling a comprehensive assessment of generalizability in varied imaging environments. WHITE-Net maintains stable performance in a wide spectrum of lesion loads and demonstrates a favorable balance between precision and recall, effectively limiting false positive detections-a common limitation of existing approaches. Beyond accuracy, WHITE-Net requires no parameter tuning and offers fast inference times, making it well suited for deployment in large-scale neuroimaging studies. The obtained results highlight the value of training on diverse multisite data for improving generalizability and position WHITE-Net as a reliable, scalable tool for automated WMH segmentation in computational anatomy research.
zh_abstract: [Imaging neuroscience (Cambridge, Mass.)] 白质高信号（WMH）是脑小血管病的标志，而脑小血管病是衰老中高度流行的疾病，因此在大规模磁共振成像（MRI）研究中准确检测 WMH 至关重要。目前可用的半自动和自动分割方法常常受限于对成像条件变化的敏感性和计算约束，从而限制了它们在不同采集设置中的适用性。我们提出 WHITE-Net，一个基于深度学习的自动 WMH 分割框架，建立在 3D ResUNet 架构上，并在涵盖扫描仪厂商、采集协议、空间分辨率和图像特征显著变异的多中心 MRI 数据上训练。在三个独立数据集——BrainLaus、ADNI 和 WMH Challenge——上评估，WHITE-Net 实现高分割准确度，并在各数据集中位列表现最佳的方法之一，从而能够在多样成像环境中全面评估泛化性。WHITE-Net 在广泛病变负荷范围内保持稳定性能，并展示出精确率与召回率之间的有利平衡，有效限制假阳性检测——这是现有方法的一个常见局限。除准确度外，WHITE-Net 无需参数调优并提供快速推理时间，使其非常适合部署于大规模神经影像研究。所获得的结果凸显了在多样多中心数据上训练对提高泛化性的价值，并将 WHITE-Net 定位为计算解剖研究中用于自动 WMH 分割的可靠、可扩展工具。

abstract: [Journal of clinical gastroenterology] In December 2025, the Food and Drug Administration assessed and qualified the first artificial intelligence (AI)-powered tool for use in drug development trials; this AI system evaluates digital liver biopsies for steatohepatitis and fibrosis. However, AI is still being investigated before it can be applied directly to patient care in the field of Hepatology. Current patient-facing applications at most institutions are limited to assistive tools such as computer-aided polyp detection and large language model documentation tools that draft clinic notes and patient communications, although there exist radiographic and pathologic liver AI tools that could function at and may even exceed human capabilities. This review provides a broad introduction to AI and highlights clinical research that use AI to enhance the diagnosis, prognostication, and management of liver diseases. It will also discuss the challenges that will need to be overcome before AI can be adopted to clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical gastroenterology] 2025年12月，美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）评估并认定首个用于药物开发试验的人工智能（AI）工具合格；该AI系统评估数字肝脏活检以检测脂肪性肝炎和纤维化。然而，在肝病学领域，AI在可直接应用于患者照护之前仍在研究中。目前大多数机构面向患者的应用仅限于辅助工具，如计算机辅助息肉检测和大型语言模型文档工具（用于起草门诊记录和患者沟通内容），尽管已有放射学和病理学肝脏AI工具能够在人类能力水平上发挥作用，甚至可能超越人类能力。本综述对AI进行了广泛介绍，并重点介绍了利用AI增强肝病诊断、预后和管理的研究。还将讨论在AI应用于临床实践之前需要克服的挑战。

title: Using a Large Language Model Chatbot for Allergen Avoidance Counseling in Contact Dermatitis: Quantitative Evaluation Study.
zh_title: 大语言模型聊天机器人用于接触性皮炎过敏原回避咨询评估
summary: 同行评审研究用GPT-4对30个标准斑贴试验过敏原推荐5种无过敏原产品，由皮肤科医生对回答有效性分类。
key_points: 覆盖国际标准斑贴试验30个过敏原组
采用3种复杂度不同的提问格式各推荐5种产品

abstract: [JMIR dermatology] AI is increasingly impacting health care. Large language models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT, have shown potential in supporting clinical decision-making. However, their application in dermatology, particularly in allergen avoidance counseling for contact dermatitis, remains underexplored. This study aimed to demonstrate a potential use case for LLM responses in recommending allergen-free products for the management of contact allergies. A total of 30 allergen groups included in the international standard patch test were assessed. ChatGPT (GPT-4) was used in this study from September 2023 to January 2024. For each allergen, ChatGPT was tasked with recommending 5 allergen-free products using 3 question formats of varying complexity. Responses were included if they specified a product and were manually classified by dermatologists into 5 categories: valid, invalid, cross-reaction, unknown, and unresponsive. ChatGPT provided 79.20% (1782/2250) valid responses, with 1.78% (40/2250) classified as invalid, 2% (45/2550) classified as cross-reactions, 8.67% (195/2250) classified as unknown, and 8.36% (188/2250) classified as unresponsive. The simplest question format yielded the highest proportion of valid recommendations (640/750, 85.33%). ChatGPT performed best when recommending cosmetics (1233/1365, 90.33%) and medications (198/240, 82.5%). However, lower validity rates were observed for recommendations involving certain sensitive allergens, including fragrance mixes and para-phenylenediamine (PPD), with frequent cross-reactive recommendations related to Peru balsam. The version of ChatGPT evaluated in this study showed potential as a supplementary tool for allergen avoidance counseling. However, its recommendations require verification and should not replace clinician guidance or established allergen avoidance resources.
zh_abstract: [JMIR Dermatology] 人工智能正日益影响医疗保健。大型语言模型（LLMs），如 ChatGPT，已显示出支持临床决策的潜力。然而，它们在皮肤病学中的应用，尤其是在接触性皮炎的过敏原回避咨询中的应用，仍未被充分探索。本研究旨在展示 LLM 响应在推荐无过敏原产品以管理接触性过敏方面的潜在用例。评估了国际标准斑贴试验中包含的共 30 个过敏原组。本研究于 2023 年 9 月至 2024 年 1 月使用 ChatGPT（GPT-4）。对于每种过敏原，要求 ChatGPT 使用 3 种复杂度不同的问题格式推荐 5 种无过敏原产品。若回答明确指定了产品则纳入，并由皮肤科医生手动分为 5 类：有效、无效、交叉反应、未知和未回应。ChatGPT 提供了 79.20%（1782/2250）的有效回答，其中 1.78%（40/2250）被归类为无效，2%（45/2550）被归类为交叉反应，8.67%（195/2250）被归类为未知，8.36%（188/2250）被归类为未回应。最简单的问题格式产生了最高比例的有效推荐（640/750，85.33%）。ChatGPT 在推荐化妆品（1233/1365，90.33%）和药物（198/240，82.5%）时表现最佳。然而，对于涉及某些敏感过敏原（包括香料混合物和对苯二胺（PPD））的推荐，观察到较低的有效率，并且频繁出现与秘鲁香脂相关的交叉反应推荐。本研究中评估的 ChatGPT 版本显示出作为过敏原回避咨询辅助工具的潜力。然而，其推荐需要核实，且不应取代临床医生指导或既定的过敏原回避资源。

title: From static structures to conformational ensembles: Artificial intelligence for protein sampling and dynamics.
source: PubMed · Current opinion in structural biology
zh_title: AI用于蛋白质构象集合采样与动力学
summary: 综述梳理机器学习从结构预测转向蛋白质构象集合与动力学建模的进展与挑战。
key_points: 目标覆盖宽时间尺度与序列-动力学关系
实验数据稀缺是主要瓶颈
涵盖加速分子动力学与直接采样等路线
reason: 同行评审综述，信息量较好但无原始数据，按综述上限评为5
abstract: [Current opinion in structural biology] After sparking a revolution in protein structure prediction, machine learning (ML), and artificial intelligence (AI) are now reshaping the modeling of protein conformational ensembles and dynamics. A fast, scalable, and accurate representation of protein conformational ensembles could enable genome-scale studies of protein function, with broad applications in drug discovery and protein engineering. The challenges associated with this goal, however, are far greater than those involved in single structure prediction because of the broad timescales spanned by protein motion, the complex relationship between sequence and dynamics, and the scarcity of datasets with experimental measurements. Despite these difficulties, many promising solutions have emerged in recent years, ranging from accelerated molecular dynamics to direct sampling of the conformational distribution, as well as some hybrid methods. Here, we review recent AI-powered approaches to tackle protein dynamics and conformational sampling, and outline their current limitations.
zh_abstract: [Current Opinion in Structural Biology] 在引发蛋白质结构预测领域的革命之后，机器学习（machine learning, ML）和人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）如今正在重塑蛋白质构象系综与动力学的建模。对蛋白质构象系综进行快速、可扩展且准确的表示，有望实现对蛋白质功能的基因组规模研究，并在药物发现和蛋白质工程中具有广泛应用。然而，与这一目标相关的挑战远大于单结构预测所涉及的挑战，原因在于蛋白质运动跨越广泛的时间尺度、序列与动力学之间的复杂关系，以及具有实验测量值的数据集稀缺。尽管存在这些困难，近年来已涌现出许多有前景的解决方案，从加速分子动力学到对构象分布的直接采样，以及一些混合方法。在此，我们综述近期用于处理蛋白质动力学和构象采样的 AI 驱动方法，并概述其当前局限性。

title: Generative Artificial Intelligence-Based Dietary Advice: A Scoping Review of Nutritional Accuracy, Safety, and Eating-Related Risks.
zh_title: 生成式AI饮食建议的范围综述：准确性与安全
summary: 范围综述汇总生成式AI或大模型提供饮食建议的营养准确性、安全性、体重管理及饮食相关伤害证据。
key_points: 按PRISMA-ScR框架检索五个数据库
纳入评估饮食建议与饮食障碍指导的实证研究
关注专业防护措施与安全性风险
reason: 设计规范的范围综述，聚焦安全性但无新数据；综述上限档
abstract: [Clinical nutrition ESPEN] This scoping review aimed to synthesize current evidence on generative artificial intelligence (AI)-based dietary advice, with particular attention to nutritional accuracy, safety, weight-management guidance, eating-related harm, and professional safeguards. A scoping review was conducted following the Arksey and O'Malley framework, refined by Levac et al., and reported according to the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR). PubMed, Scopus, CINAHL, Web of Science, and Embase were searched up to 30 June 2026. Original empirical studies evaluating generative AI or large language models for dietary advice, meal planning, nutritional information, weight management, or eating-disorder-related guidance were eligible. Study selection, data charting, and synthesis were performed independently by two reviewers, with disagreements resolved by consensus or third-reviewer assessment. Nine studies published between 2023 and 2026 were included. In this small and emerging evidence base, one study reported 84.38% accuracy on an objective nutrition-literacy assessment, and another found overall Diet Quality Index-International scores above 70 for chatbot-generated weight-loss plans. However, important limitations were identified in caloric accuracy, portion sizing, macronutrient and micronutrient balance, reproducibility, personalization, and management of food allergies and multimorbidity. Potential safety concerns were identified in adolescent and eating-disorder scenarios, where chatbot responses sometimes combined appropriate healthy-eating advice with restrictive or weight-focused recommendations; these studies did not establish resulting clinical or behavioral harm. Although some systems encouraged consultation with healthcare professionals, safety warnings and referral to regulated resources were inconsistent. Evidence from the nine included studies remains preliminary, heterogeneous, and largely simulation-based. Generative AI may have a supplementary role in nutrition education and preliminary dietary guidance, but the available evidence is insufficient to support autonomous use in place of dietitians. Current findings indicate potential safety risks in high-risk or clinically complex scenarios rather than demonstrated long-term harm. Longitudinal and real-world studies are needed to establish the clinical and behavioral effects of AI-generated dietary advice.
zh_abstract: [Clinical nutrition ESPEN] 本范围综述旨在综合当前关于基于生成式人工智能（AI）的饮食建议的证据，特别关注营养准确性、安全性、体重管理指导、饮食相关伤害以及专业保障措施。按照Arksey和O'Malley框架（经Levac等完善）开展范围综述，并依据系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告条目扩展版范围综述（PRISMA-ScR）进行报告。检索PubMed、Scopus、CINAHL、Web of Science和Embase，截至2026年6月30日。纳入评估生成式AI或大语言模型用于饮食建议、膳食计划、营养信息、体重管理或进食障碍相关指导的原创实证研究。研究筛选、数据提取和综合由两名评价者独立完成，分歧通过共识或第三名评价者评估解决。纳入9项发表于2023年至2026年的研究。在这一规模小且新兴的证据基础中，一项研究在客观营养素养评估中报告了84.38%的准确率，另一项研究发现聊天机器人生成的减重计划的总体国际饮食质量指数（Diet Quality Index-International）评分高于70。然而，在热量准确性、份量大小、宏量营养素和微量营养素平衡、可重复性、个性化以及食物过敏和多重疾病管理方面发现了重要局限性。在青少年和进食障碍情境中发现了潜在安全性问题，聊天机器人回复有时将适当的健康饮食建议与限制性或以体重为中心的建议结合在一起；这些研究未确定由此导致的临床或行为伤害。尽管一些系统鼓励咨询医疗专业人员，但安全警告和转介至受监管资源的情况并不一致。来自9项纳入研究的证据仍属初步、异质性大且主要基于模拟。生成式AI可能在营养教育和初步饮食指导中发挥补充作用，但现有证据不足以支持其自主使用以替代营养师。当前发现提示在高风险或临床复杂情境中存在潜在安全风险，而非已证实的长期伤害。需要纵向和真实世界研究来确定AI生成饮食建议的临床和行为影响。

title: Comprehensive or Wasteful? Clinical AI and the Up-front Workup
zh_title: 评论：临床AI前置检查是周全还是浪费
summary: 评论文章讨论Aran等研究所示大模型比实际接诊医师推荐更多前置检查、转诊与治疗且短期费用超三倍，指出其临床与费用后果尚不明确。
key_points: 指出临床AI采用速度快于评估
引述研究：大模型推荐更多前置检查与治疗，费用超三倍
尚无法判定属浪费性过度还是合理周全
reason: 述评类文章按上限档处理，观点有信息量但无新数据
abstract: AbstractClinical AI is being adopted faster than it is being evaluated, on the promise that it will improve health and reduce waste. Aran and colleagues show that large language models recommend more up-front testing, referrals, and treatment than the physicians who actually saw the patients and at more than three times cost, at least in the short-term. But practicing differently is not the same as practicing worse: whether this reflects wasteful excess or appropriate thoroughness is unknown, as are the consequences for long-run health and spending. On one hand, more up-front care could reduce diagnostic errors, catch disease earlier, deliver guideline-concordant treatment that clinicians overlook, and avert costly late-stage care. On the other hand, it could surface incidental findings that spark anxiety and follow-up cascades, add treatments of marginal benefit, and raise spending through added visits and more intensive billing and diagnosis coding. Neither vignettes nor single-visit studies can settle this. Clinical AI deserves the standard we would demand of any new therapy: trials that randomize practices to these tools and measure long-run effects on patients' health and spending.
zh_abstract: 临床AI的采用速度快于对其评估的速度，其依据是它将改善健康并减少浪费的承诺。Aran及其同事表明，大型语言模型比实际看过患者的医生推荐更多前置检查、转诊和治疗，且成本超过三倍，至少在短期内如此。但诊疗方式不同并不等同于诊疗更差：这反映的是浪费性过度诊疗还是适当的全面性尚不清楚，对长期健康和支出的后果也不清楚。一方面，更多前置诊疗可能减少诊断错误、更早发现疾病、提供临床医生忽视的符合指南的治疗，并避免昂贵的晚期诊疗。另一方面，它可能发现偶发发现，引发焦虑和后续检查连锁反应，增加边际获益的治疗，并通过增加就诊以及更密集的计费和诊断编码提高支出。无论是情景案例还是单次就诊研究都无法解决这一问题。临床AI应达到我们对任何新疗法所要求的标准：将诊疗实践随机分配至这些工具的试验，并测量对患者健康和支出的长期影响。

zh_title: GRACE：检索增强的通用医学图像分割校正

abstract: Automated segmentation is routinely used as the first step in quantitative image-based clinical workflows, where predicted masks are subsequently reviewed and corrected by human operators. Automated correction of the residual structural errors is currently addressed one anatomy at a time, so the number of trained correctors scales with the number of segmentation targets. We present GRACE, a retrieval-augmented refiner that edits an input mask under context drawn from a shared knowledge base of verified prior cases. The refiner is trained once on a multi-organ corpus spanning compact organs, cavities, branching vessels, and tumour lesions. In the held-out dataset-transfer evaluation, three held-out datasets query a fixed knowledge base built from training data only. A separate leave-one-anatomy-out experiment tests parameter-free index extension: verified cases of an unseen solid organ enter the knowledge base, and the refiner stays frozen. A light shape-aware projection head on a frozen multimodal encoder maps embedding similarity to the shape agreement of the masks, so the knowledge base returns cases that the refiner can use as a shape prior. We evaluate GRACE on 18 public datasets spanning CT, MRI and ultrasound, using nine refinement configurations and seven upstream segmentors that span weak, mid, and strong operating regimes. We report each change with the DSC of its input mask. On the weak tier, the input DSC is 0.386 and GRACE adds up to +0.35 DSC. On a strong segmentor, the input DSC is 0.932 and the mean change is small. Transfer to an imaging modality that is absent from training and from the index is partial and depends on the anatomy, and remains an open research direction. Our results suggest retrieval-conditioned refinement is a practical alternative to anatomy-specific correction models. Code: https://github.com/robustml-eurecom/grace
zh_abstract: 自动分割通常被用作基于图像的定量临床工作流程的第一步，其中预测掩膜随后由人工操作者审核和校正。对残余结构误差的自动校正目前一次针对一个解剖结构进行处理，因此训练所得校正器的数量会随分割目标数量而扩展。我们提出 GRACE，一种检索增强的精修器，它在由已验证既往病例组成的共享知识库所提供的上下文下编辑输入掩膜。该精修器在一个涵盖紧凑器官、腔隙、分支血管和肿瘤病变的多器官语料库上一次性训练。在留出数据集迁移评估中，三个留出数据集查询一个仅由训练数据构建的固定知识库。一个单独的留一解剖结构实验检验无参数索引扩展：一个未见实体器官的已验证病例进入知识库，而精修器保持冻结。一个位于冻结多模态编码器上的轻量形状感知投影头将嵌入相似度映射为掩膜的形状一致性，因此知识库返回精修器可用作形状先验的病例。我们在涵盖 CT、MRI 和超声的 18 个公开数据集上评估 GRACE，使用九种精修配置和七种上游分割器，这些分割器涵盖弱、中、强运行区间。我们用每个输入掩膜的 DSC 报告其变化。在弱档，输入 DSC 为 0.386，GRACE 最多增加 +0.35 DSC。在强分割器上，输入 DSC 为 0.932，平均变化很小。迁移到训练中和索引中均不存在的成像模态是部分的，且取决于解剖结构，仍是一个开放研究方向。我们的结果表明，检索条件化精修是解剖结构特异性校正模型的一种实用替代方案。代码：https://github.com/robustml-eurecom/grace

abstract: [European neuropsychopharmacology : the journal of the European College of Neuropsychopharmacology] Suicide is a leading, preventable cause of premature mortality, yet identifying individuals at imminent risk remains difficult. There are no validated biomarkers for routine stratification, and common approaches (clinical interviews, rating scales, self-report) are limited by subjectivity, reporting bias, and weak positive predictive value for rare outcomes. Rapid advances in artificial intelligence (AI)-including machine learning, deep learning, and large language models-offer opportunities to integrate heterogeneous signals relevant to risk and treatment response. This narrative review summarizes recent AI-enabled prediction and characterization of suicidal thoughts and behaviors across major data modalities: structured electronic health records and claims; natural language processing of clinical notes and digital text; speech and facial/behavioral signals; neuroimaging and other neurobiological measures; and passive sensing from smartphones and wearables. We review common modeling and evaluation practices, emphasizing clinically relevant performance assessment (discrimination and calibration) and the importance of temporal and external validation. We also highlight barriers to translation, including class imbalance and label noise, dataset shift across sites and time, limited prospective evaluation, and the need for interpretable outputs that can support medication decisions and care pathways (e.g., triage, monitoring, and stepped interventions). Ethical and implementation challenges-privacy and consent, algorithmic bias and equity, governance, and the clinical consequences of false-positive and false-negative predictions-are discussed with an emphasis on safe deployment. We conclude with priorities for the field, including multimodal longitudinal cohorts, harmonized reporting standards, and pragmatic trials to determine whether AI decision support measurably improves suicide-prevention outcomes.
zh_abstract: [European neuropsychopharmacology : the journal of the European College of Neuropsychopharmacology] 自杀是可预防的过早死亡的主要原因之一，但识别处于迫近风险中的个体仍然困难。目前没有经过验证的生物标志物可用于常规风险分层，而常用方法（临床访谈、评定量表、自我报告）受主观性、报告偏倚以及对罕见结局阳性预测值较弱的限制。人工智能（AI）——包括机器学习、深度学习和大型语言模型——的快速进展为整合与风险和治療反应相关的异质性信号提供了机会。本叙述性综述总结了近期基于AI的自杀想法和行为预测与刻画，涵盖主要数据模态：结构化电子健康记录和理赔数据；临床记录和数字文本的自然语言处理；语音和面部/行为信号；神经影像和其他神经生物学测量；以及来自智能手机和可穿戴设备的被动感知。我们回顾了常见建模和评估实践，强调临床相关性能评估（区分度和校准），以及时间和外部验证的重要性。我们还强调了转化障碍，包括类别不平衡和标签噪声、跨站点和跨时间的数据集偏移、有限的前瞻性评估，以及需要可解释的输出以支持用药决策和照护路径（例如分诊、监测和阶梯式干预）。讨论了伦理和实施挑战——隐私和知情同意、算法偏倚和公平性、治理，以及假阳性和假阴性预测的临床后果——并强调安全部署。我们最后提出该领域的优先事项，包括多模态纵向队列、统一的报告标准，以及务实试验，以确定AI决策支持是否能可测量地改善自杀预防结局。

abstract: [Health care science] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping health systems worldwide, offering unprecedented opportunities but also introducing new risks. Effective governance is therefore essential to ensure that AI in health is safe, trustworthy, and aligned with public interest. This article examines emerging global t`rends in AI governance in health across a diverse set of countries. Three major trends are shaping the global governance landscape. First, national health data resources are increasingly treated as strategic assets, reflecting a shift toward digital sovereignty. Countries are investing in nationally governed health data infrastructures to enable AI development while safeguarding national interests. Second, regulators are coordinating between general AI laws and health-specific regulations, adopting different governance approaches based on the countries' situations. Third, regulatory systems are transitioning from static, pre-market gatekeeping to lifecycle-based oversight. Countries such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Singapore, and China are pioneering mechanisms to manage adaptive AI systems. Beyond these, emerging themes-including regulatory sandboxes, evolving definitions of AI safety, and the prioritization of equity and digital inclusion-are reshaping national strategies. The analysis highlights the need for interoperable standards, robust data governance, and capacity-building for regulators and health institutions.
zh_abstract: 【健康护理科学】人工智能（AI）正在迅速重塑全球卫生系统，带来前所未有的机遇，但也引入新的风险。因此，有效治理对于确保卫生领域AI安全、可信且符合公共利益至关重要。本文考察了多个不同国家在卫生领域AI治理方面新出现的全球趋势。三大趋势正在塑造全球治理格局。第一，国家卫生数据资源日益被视为战略资产，反映出向数字主权转变。各国正在投资由国家治理的卫生数据基础设施，以促进AI发展，同时维护国家利益。第二，监管机构正在协调通用AI法律与卫生专项法规，并根据各国情况采用不同的治理方法。第三，监管体系正从静态的上市前把关转向基于生命周期的监督。美国、英国、加拿大、新加坡和中国等国家正在率先建立管理自适应AI系统的机制。除此之外，包括监管沙盒、AI安全定义的演变，以及对公平和数字包容的优先关注等新兴主题，正在重塑国家战略。该分析强调需要可互操作的标准、稳健的数据治理，以及监管机构和卫生机构的能力建设。

abstract: [JAMA network open] Hospital discharge summaries are essential for continuity of care, but fragmented electronic health record (EHR) data can compromise their quality and safety. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed for clinical documentation tasks despite limited evidence regarding their performance in health care settings compared with the current standard of care. To evaluate clinician acceptability of LLM-generated discharge summaries derived from EHRs compared with routine clinician-written summaries. In this retrospective comparative effectiveness study using a prespecified noninferiority framework, acceptability of LLM-generated discharge summaries was compared with clinician-authored discharge summaries. Admission records from 5 London hospitals for September 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, were evaluated against the full admission record by practicing physicians. Admissions were eligible only if the clinician-authored discharge summary contained identifiable clinical summary, plan and requested actions, and information given sections. zh_abstract: [JAMA network open] 医院出院摘要对于照护连续性至关重要，但碎片化的电子健康记录（EHR）数据可能损害其质量与安全性。大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被提议用于临床文档任务，尽管与当前标准照护相比，其在医疗保健环境中表现的证据仍然有限。评估临床医生对源自 EHR 的 LLM 生成出院摘要与常规临床医生撰写摘要相比的接受度。在这项采用预先设定非劣效性框架的回顾性比较有效性研究中，将 LLM 生成出院摘要的可接受性与临床医生撰写的出院摘要进行比较。由执业医师依据完整入院记录，对5家伦敦医院2022年9月1日至2023年9月30日的入院记录进行评估。仅当临床医生撰写的出院摘要包含可识别的临床摘要、计划与请求采取的行动以及所提供信息部分时，入院病例才符合纳入条件。数据分析于2025年7月至2026年2月进行。LLM 生成的摘要使用 GPT-4o mini（2024年7月18日发布；OpenAI）和由临床医生共同设计的提示词生成。主要结局为无需修改或仅需轻微修改的临床医生签署确认，由2个连续问题得出：（1）审阅者是否会签署该摘要；（2）是否需要无需、轻微或重大修改。预先设定了5个百分点的非劣效性界值。次要结局评估准确性、完整性、语气和清晰度（使用5点 Likert 量表：1，差；2，一般；3，好；4，很好；5，优秀），以及缺失或错误信息的潜在危害程度（使用5点 Likert 量表：1，无危害；2，轻微危害；3，中度危害；4，高危害；5，极高危害）。研究样本包括1294份（649份由临床医生撰写，645份由 LLM 生成）不重复的病例出院摘要，由12名执业医师依据完整入院记录进行评估。病例患者的中位年龄为46.0岁（IQR，26.2–69.8岁），733例（56.6%）出生时被指定为女性，中位住院时长为3.0天（IQR，1.0–7.0天）。模型估计的无需修改或仅需轻微修改的签署确认概率的绝对差异（LLM 生成减去临床医生撰写）为22.2个百分点（95% CI，19.0–27.5个百分点）；下限超过了预设的非劣效性界值 -5 个百分点

title: Calpha: Toward Native Biomolecular Intelligence in a General-Purpose Language Model
zh_title: Calpha：让通用语言模型具备原生生物分子能力
summary: 预印本报告将Qwen3.5-9B与预训练SimpleFold结构头连接，由LLM输出单链蛋白结构的初步结果。

以token调用预训练结构预测头
