title: Know Thy Neighbour: Benchmarking Protein Language Model Embedding-Based Annotation Reveals Anisotropy Substantially Impacts Retrieval
zh_title: 蛋白质语言模型嵌入注释基准：各向异性影响检索
summary: 预印本对比12个蛋白质语言模型嵌入与MMseqs2、Foldseek的远同源检索，指出嵌入各向异性显著影响检索表现。
key_points: 按1%假阳性率固定各模型阈值
评测数据集基于Swiss-Prot与SCOPe
未训练检索的pLM最多恢复15%远同源
reason: 预印本基准分析，方法清晰但证据限于检索任务，值得一看档。
abstract: Functional annotation using protein language models (`pLMs') usually proceeds by transferring the function of a query's nearest neighbour in a reference database. A major drawback is that embedding-based annotation transfer has no null model, i.e. no accepted way to set a cosine-similarity threshold to control false positives. This contrasts with traditional bioinformatics methods, including sequence- and structure-based alignment tools, which rank hits with E-values derived from explicit null models. Here, we benchmark final-layer, mean-pooled embeddings from twelve models against MMseqs2 and Foldseek for remote-homology retrieval on curated datasets based on Swiss-Prot and SCOPe, fixing per-model thresholds at a 1% false-positive rate and probing the score with a ladder of synthetic decoys. On Swiss-Prot, pLMs without retrieval training recover at most 15% of remote homologs at this operating point, against 85% for MMseqs2, and for the ESM-2 and ESM-C families shuffled decoys have higher cosine similarities to their nearest database hits than real remote homologs do. These two pLM families exhibit extreme anisotropy, using fewer than 15 effective dimensions out of 640-2560, and low effective dimensionality is strongly associated with poor performance across models. Applying ZCA whitening, fit on the reference database, to the embeddings sharply raises threshold-free Top-1 superfamily retrieval, e.g. for ESM-2 650M from 59% to 88% on SCOPe, and generally improves remote homology sensitivity at a fixed false-positive rate. As correcting embedding anisotropy requires only the reference database and is compute cheap, it should be considered and tested for any pLM embedding-based annotation task.
zh_abstract: 使用蛋白质语言模型（pLMs）进行功能注释通常通过转移查询在参考数据库中最近邻的功能来进行。一个主要缺点是，基于嵌入的注释转移没有零模型，即没有公认的方法来设置余弦相似度阈值以控制假阳性。这与传统生物信息学方法（包括基于序列和基于结构的比对工具）形成对比，后者使用由显式零模型推导出的 E 值对命中进行排序。在此，我们在基于 Swiss-Prot 和 SCOPe 构建的精选数据集上，针对远程同源检索，将来自十二个模型的最终层、平均池化嵌入与 MMseqs2 和 Foldseek 进行基准比较，将每个模型的阈值固定为 1% 假阳性率，并用一系列合成诱饵探针探测评分。在 Swiss-Prot 上，未经过检索训练的 pLMs 在该操作点最多恢复 15% 的远程同源物，而 MMseqs2 为 85%；对于 ESM-2 和 ESM-C 家族，打乱诱饵与最近数据库命中的余弦相似度高于真实远程同源物。这两个 pLM 家族表现出极端各向异性，在 640–2560 个维度中仅使用少于 15 个有效维度，而低有效维度与跨模型的较差性能强烈相关。将基于参考数据库拟合的 ZCA 白化应用于嵌入，可显著提高无阈值 Top-1 超家族检索，例如 ESM-2 650M 在 SCOPe 上从 59% 提高到 88%，并通常在固定假阳性率下改善远程同源敏感性。由于校正嵌入各向异性只需参考数据库且计算成本低，对于任何基于 pLM 嵌入的注释任务，都应考虑并测试该方法。

title: An apicomplexan-specific foundation model improves prediction of regulatory genomic signals in Plasmodium falciparum
zh_title: 疟原虫基因组基础模型提升调控信号预测
summary: bioRxiv预印本在76种顶复门原虫455个基因组上预训练模型，微调后预测恶性疟原虫表观基因组特征，检验数据稀疏基因组中自监督预训练的价值。
key_points: 在23Mbp、高A/T的疟原虫基因组上测试预训练增益
预训练语料为76种顶复门原虫455个组装
留出染色体上评估转录因子结合、染色质可及性等
针对数据稀疏小基因组是否受益于自监督
reason: 方法有新意且对比基线，但为预印本、缺外部验证
abstract: Genomic foundation models learn transferable sequence representations through self-supervision, yet their practical value is contested. In data-rich mammalian genomes, task-specific models trained from scratch can match or exceed pretrained models on many regulatory prediction tasks. Whether self-supervised pretraining provides an advantage in small, data-sparse genomes has not been directly tested. We address this in the compact, 23Mbp, A/T-rich genome of the malaria parasite, Plasmodium falciparum. We trained a Genomic Pretrained Network (GPN) via masked-nucleotide reconstruction on 455 genome assemblies spanning 76 apicomplexan species. We then fine-tuned the model to predict a variety of epigenomic features in a held-out chromosome, including transcription factor binding sites, chromatin-accessibility, histone modifications, and 10 chromatin states. Pretraining followed by fine tuning improved prediction of most features, with most of the benefit concentrated on datasets with relatively little labeled data (fewer than 3,000 training examples). In contrast, a human-pretrained model transferred poorly, indicating that phylogenetically relevant pretraining, not foundation-model status alone, drives beneficial performance. Self-supervised pretraining on clade-specific assemblies is thus a practical route to data-efficient regulatory modeling in small genomes where training data is scarce.
zh_abstract: 基因组基础模型通过自监督学习可迁移的序列表征，但其实际价值仍有争议。在数据丰富的哺乳动物基因组中，从头训练的任务特异性模型在许多调控预测任务上可以匹配或超过预训练模型。自监督预训练是否在小规模、数据稀疏的基因组中提供优势，尚未得到直接检验。我们在疟疾寄生虫恶性疟原虫（Plasmodium falciparum）紧凑的、23Mbp、富含A/T的基因组中对此进行了研究。我们通过掩码核苷酸重建，在涵盖76种顶复门（apicomplexan）物种的455个基因组组装上训练了一个基因组预训练网络（Genomic Pretrained Network, GPN）。随后，我们微调该模型，以预测留出染色体中的多种表观基因组特征，包括转录因子结合位点、染色质可及性、组蛋白修饰和10种染色质状态。预训练后进行微调改善了对大多数特征的预测，且大部分收益集中在标记数据相对较少的数据集上（少于3,000个训练示例）。相比之下，一个人类预训练模型的迁移效果很差，表明系统发育相关的预训练，而不仅仅是基础模型身份，驱动了有益性能。因此，在分支特异性组装上进行自监督预训练，是在训练数据稀缺的小基因组中实现数据高效调控建模的一条实用途径。

title: Safety-Preserving Medical LLM Fine-Tuning via Bilevel Data Selection
zh_title: 双层数据选择实现保安全的医学大模型微调
summary: 提出 S-BDS 双层数据选择方法，用于医学指令微调，在提升医学能力的同时控制面向患者的安全风险。
key_points: 提出 S-BDS 双层数据选择方法
结合临床医生验证的安全数据与未筛选数据做SFT
在 HealthBench 上联合评估能力与安全
reason: 预印本新方法，有基准评测但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: As general large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adapted for patient-facing medical applications, improving medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks remains a critical challenge. Large-scale medical instruction data are essential for acquiring domain knowledge through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), but unsafe responses can undermine existing safety alignment. To address this problem, we propose Scalable Bilevel Data Selection (S-BDS) for safety-preserving medical SFT. By controlling selection-weight concentration, S-BDS enables reliable sample ranking over large candidate pools and identifies training examples that improve medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks. We combine clinician-validated safe data and selected data with unscreened medical instruction data for SFT, and jointly evaluate medical capability and patient-facing safety on HealthBench and PatientSafetyBench, respectively. Experiments across Llama and Qwen models show that S-BDS achieves the highest safe rates among all compared methods, outperforming the strongest baselines by 4.64 and 3.00 percentage points, respectively, while maintaining competitive medical capability. Further experiments show that varying the safety-oriented weight during SFT controls the trade-off between medical capability and patient-facing safety.
zh_abstract: 随着通用大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被适配用于面向患者的医疗应用，在提升医学能力的同时控制面向患者的风险仍是一项关键挑战。大规模医学指令数据对于通过监督微调（SFT）获取领域知识至关重要，但不安全的回复可能削弱现有的安全对齐。为解决这一问题，我们提出可扩展双层数据选择（Scalable Bilevel Data Selection，S-BDS）用于保护安全的医学SFT。通过控制选择权重集中度，S-BDS能够在大规模候选池中实现可靠的样本排序，并识别出在提升医学能力的同时控制面向患者风险的可用于训练的样本。我们将经临床医生验证的安全数据与选定数据同未经筛查的医学指令数据结合用于SFT，并分别在HealthBench和PatientSafetyBench上联合评估医学能力和面向患者的安全性。在Llama和Qwen模型上的实验表明，S-BDS在所有比较方法中达到最高的安全率，分别比最强基线高出4.64和3.00个百分点，同时保持有竞争力的医学能力。进一步实验表明，在SFT过程中改变安全导向权重可控制医学能力与面向患者安全性之间的权衡。

title: iEEG Can Help EEG: Improving Clinical Scalp EEG Analysis through Intracranial Priors
zh_title: 颅内EEG先验辅助头皮EEG临床分析
summary: 利用颅内EEG单独训练信号到信号模型并冻结为跨模态先验，用于改善头皮EEG的信号质量与下游分析。
key_points: 头皮EEG受非神经干扰与容积传导影响
两模态少有配对且通道空间不共享
以神经元同步机制为动机的再编程方法
reason: 跨模态方法有新意但证据限于预印本初步结果，属值得一看档
abstract: Scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is a cornerstone of clinical brain monitoring, making the quality of its signal fundamental to downstream tasks and models. However, that signal is heavily contaminated by non-neural interference and blurred by volume conduction. Existing methods operate almost exclusively within the scalp modality, so they inherit the contamination they would need to overcome. In practice, intracranial EEG (iEEG) observes the neural activity with far higher fidelity, yet it is invasive and therefore scarce, and the two modalities are rarely recorded as pairs at scale, share no common channel space, and offer no clean ground truth to directly supervise a mapping. Motivated by the neuronal synchronization mechanism shared by the two modalities, we propose a reprogramming approach that fits a signal-to-signal model on iEEG alone and freezes it as a cross-modal prior. We introduce ReBrain, a framework to transfer an iEEG-learned prior to scalp EEG, which re-expresses any scalp signal through that prior and can be inserted upstream of any downstream model with no pairing or fine-tuning. ReBrain consistently improves host models across recordings from multiple hospitals and across architecture families, and our analysis traces this gain to genuine neural structure carried by iEEG rather than to the architecture itself. This work provides evidence that a scarce clean modality can serve as a transferable prior for an abundant noisy one, offering a general recipe for cross-modal transfer among biosignals. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xianglong-Bao/ReBrain.
zh_abstract: 头皮脑电图（electroencephalography, EEG）是临床脑监测的基石，因此其信号质量对下游任务和模型至关重要。然而，该信号受到非神经干扰的严重污染，并因体积传导而变得模糊。现有方法几乎完全在头皮模态内运作，因此继承了它们本应克服的污染。在实践中，颅内脑电图（intracranial EEG, iEEG）以高得多的保真度观测神经活动，但它是侵入性的，因而稀缺；而且这两种模态很少在大规模上成对记录，不共享共同的通道空间，也没有干净的基准真值来直接监督映射。受两种模态共有的神经元同步机制启发，我们提出一种重编程方法（reprogramming approach），仅在iEEG上拟合信号到信号模型，并将其冻结为跨模态先验。我们引入ReBrain，一个将iEEG学习到的先验迁移到头皮EEG的框架；该框架通过该先验重新表达任何头皮信号，并可插入任何下游模型的上游，无需配对或微调。ReBrain在来自多家医院的记录以及跨架构家族中持续提升宿主模型，我们的分析将这一增益归因于iEEG所携带的真实神经结构，而非架构本身。这项工作提供了证据，表明一种稀缺的干净模态可以作为丰富但含噪模态的可迁移先验，为生物信号之间的跨模态迁移提供通用方案。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Xianglong-Bao/ReBrain 获取。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Prediction of Midpalatal Suture Maturation from Cervical Vertebral Maturation Assessed on Lateral Cephalometric Radiographs: Development of a Combined Diagnostic Model.
zh_title: AI辅助从头颅侧位片预测腭中缝成熟度
summary: 基于250例颈椎成熟度与CBCT腭中缝分期，用1448张头颅侧位片训练YOLOv11分类，并在325例队列中构建联合诊断模型，仅做内部留出验证。
key_points: 250例关联分析，1448张侧位片训练YOLOv11
联合模型队列325例，训练260例、内部测试65例
仅内部验证，未报告外部队列结果
reason: 回顾性设计、样本量中等且仅内部验证，按标准最高6分，取值得一看档
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: This study evaluated the association between cervical vertebral maturation (CVM) and midpalatal suture (MPS) maturation and developed an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted model for predicting MPS stage from lateral cephalometric radiographs and clinical variables. Methods: CVM and cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT)-defined MPS stages were assessed in 250 individuals. Their association was examined using Spearman correlation and multivariable ordinal logistic regression incorporating CVM stage, chronological age, and sex. A separate dataset of 1448 cephalograms was used to develop and evaluate a YOLOv11 model for automated CVM classification. The combined-model cohort comprised 325 patients, including the initial 250 and 75 additional patients, divided into training (n = 260) and held-out internal test (n = 65) subsets. The combined model was trained using reference CVM stage, chronological age, and sex and evaluated on the held-out test set using AI-predicted CVM stage in place of reference CVM. Results: CVM and MPS stages were strongly correlated (r = 0.749, p < 0.001). CVM stage and age were significantly associated with MPS stage, whereas sex was not (Nagelkerke R2 = 0.716). YOLOv11 correctly detected and classified 277/344 reference regions (80.5%). On the held-out test set, the combined model achieved 69.2% five-class accuracy (45/65; 95% CI: 57.2-79.1%) and 92.3% binary accuracy for A-C versus D-E. Repeated nested cross-validation across 325 patients yielded 58.3% mean accuracy with reference CVM, compared with 58.8% for reference CVM alone. Substituting AI-CVM only during evaluation in the 65-patient subset yielded 55.7% mean accuracy. Conclusions: The proposed AI-assisted model remains exploratory, with automated-input evaluation limited to 65 patients. The added predictive value of age and sex beyond CVM staging alone remains unproven. Its performance does not establish the ability to predict expansion success or justify replacing clinically indicated CBCT. External validation is required before clinical implementation.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics（Basel，Switzerland）]【背景/目的】本研究评估颈椎成熟度（CVM）与腭中缝（MPS）成熟度之间的关联，并开发了一种人工智能（AI）辅助模型，用于根据侧位头影测量放射照片和临床变量预测MPS分期。【方法】在250名个体中评估了CVM及锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）定义的MPS分期。采用Spearman相关和纳入CVM分期、实际年龄及性别的多变量有序logistic回归检查其关联。使用一个包含1448张头影测量片的独立数据集开发并评估用于自动化CVM分类的YOLOv11模型。联合模型队列由325名患者组成，包括最初的250名和另外75名患者，分为训练子集（n = 260）和留出内部测试子集（n = 65）。联合模型使用参考CVM分期、实际年龄和性别进行训练，并在留出测试集上使用AI预测的CVM分期替代参考CVM进行评估。【结果】CVM与MPS分期强相关（r = 0.749，p < 0.001）。CVM分期和年龄与MPS分期显著相关，而性别则不相关（Nagelkerke R2 = 0.716）。YOLOv11正确检测并分类了277/344个参考区域（80.5%）。在留出测试集上，联合模型达到了69.2%的五分类准确率（45/65；95% CI：57.2-79.1%）以及A-C与D-E的92.3%二分类准确率。在325名患者中重复嵌套交叉验证，使用参考CVM时平均准确率为58.3%，而仅使用参考CVM时为58.8%。仅在65名患者子集的评估期间替换AI-CVM，平均准确率为55.7%。【结论】所提出的AI辅助模型仍处于探索性阶段，自动化输入评估仅限于65名患者。年龄和性别在CVM分期之外的附加预测价值仍未得到证实。其性能并不能确立预测扩弓成功的能力，也不足以证明可替代有临床指征的CBCT。在临床实施前需要外部验证。

title: Future-Information Leakage in 30-Day Readmission Prediction: An Empirical Audit and a Calibrated Electronic Health Record Model in Medicare-Insured Adults
zh_title: 30天再入院预测中的未来信息泄漏审计
summary: 预印本审计再入院模型特征时点泄漏，并在23.7万例Medicare住院数据上内部验证校准模型。
key_points: 基于MIMIC-IV约23.7万次住院
发现住院时长趋势特征含未来信息
仅内部验证，报告性能变化
reason: 回顾性内部验证，方法学审计有参考价值，最高6分档内取5
abstract: Objective: To develop and internally validate a calibrated discharge model of 30-day within-system readmission in Medicare-insured adults, and to quantify how a future-information leak and outcome artifacts distorted performance, timing, and subgroup conclusions. Materials and Methods: Retrospective study of 236,906 Medicare-insured MIMIC-IV v3.1 admissions (87,750 patients; prevalence 21.4%). Predictors were audited for discharge-time availability; history features were tested for future information and recomputed from raw timestamps. A consensus gradient-boosted (XGBoost) model was selected inside patient-grouped folds; CIs used patient-cluster bootstrap. Results: A feature documented as a prior 180-day length-of-stay trend used each patient's whole record, including later admissions; removing it and two derived terms lowered test area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) from 0.774 to 0.706. The corrected procedure reached an out-of-fold AUROC of 0.7057 (95% CI 0.7016 to 0.7102; primary); the 44-feature model scored 0.7056 on the historically exposed test partition (calibration slope 0.99), above reconstructed LACE and HOSPITAL (both P<.001). A day-1 discrimination peak largely reflected 2,368 probable administrative continuations within 1 hour of discharge; merging these into the preceding stay gave test AUROC 0.698 (0.702 after refitting). The White minus Black AUROC difference was 0.003 (95% CI -0.018 to 0.024); specificity was lower for Black patients (0.61 vs 0.69). Discussion: Documentation audits and patient-grouped validation missed a leak that inflated discrimination and created spurious subgroup and calendar-period differences; simple empirical checks found it. Conclusion: Empirical leakage checks should accompany availability audits. The corrected model is calibrated, moderately discriminating, and needs external validation before clinical use.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并内部验证一个针对 Medicare 保险成年人 30 天内系统内再入院的校准出院模型，并量化未来信息泄漏和结局伪影如何扭曲性能、时序和亚组结论。【材料与方法】对 236,906 次 Medicare 保险的 MIMIC-IV v3.1 住院（87,750 名患者；患病率 21.4%）进行回顾性研究。对预测变量进行出院时可用性审计；对病史特征进行未来信息检验，并从原始时间戳重新计算。在按患者分组的折内选择共识梯度提升（XGBoost）模型；置信区间（CI）采用患者聚类 bootstrap。【结果】一个被记录为既往 180 天住院时长趋势的特征使用了每名患者的整个记录，包括后续住院；移除该特征和两个衍生项后，测试集受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）从 0.774 降至 0.706。校正后的流程达到折外 AUROC 0.7057（95% CI 0.7016 至 0.7102；主要分析）；44 特征模型在历史暴露的测试分区上得分为 0.7056（校准斜率 0.99），高于重建的 LACE 和 HOSPITAL（两者 P<.001）。第 1 天的区分度峰值在很大程度上反映了 2,368 例出院后 1 小时内可能的行政性连续住院；将这些合并到前一次住院后，测试 AUROC 为 0.698（重新拟合后为 0.702）。白人减去黑人的 AUROC 差异为 0.003（95% CI -0.018 至 0.024）；黑人患者的特异性较低（0.61 对 0.69）。【讨论】文档审计和按患者分组的验证漏掉了一处泄漏，该泄漏抬高了区分度并产生了虚假的亚组和日历时期差异；简单的经验性检查发现了它。【结论】经验性泄漏检查应与可用性审计同时进行。校正后的模型经过校准、具有中等区分度，在临床使用前需要外部验证。

title: Offline-First Quantized AI: Design and Evaluation of an On-Device Maternal-Health Assistant for Low-Connectivity Environments
zh_title: 离线量化模型驱动的孕产健康助手评估
summary: 在低连接环境比较两款量化模型构建的离线安卓孕产健康助手，Gemma回答质量与安全评分更高，Qwen更快更省内存。
key_points: 45段对话312轮比较Gemma与Qwen
临床医生评150条回答，均分3.80/4
配对RAG开关实验评估本地检索效果
reason: 有临床医生评估与新意，但规模小、无外部验证，属值得一看
abstract: Offline language models could extend access to maternal-health information where internet connectivity is unreliable, but deployment requires both clinically appropriate responses and feasible local execution. This study presents an offline Android assistant integrating ready-made quantized language models, a clinically validated local knowledge package, conversational context, and model-initiated local retrieval. Gemma 4 E2B and Qwen3.5 0.8B were compared across 45 conversations and 312 turns per configuration, including a dedicated offline agentic benchmark. Gemma achieved higher response-quality, context-retention, and safety scores; Qwen offered faster generation and lower memory use. Clinician assessment of 150 Gemma responses across nine clinical domains yielded a mean quality score of 3.80/4, with 147 responses meeting the acceptance criterion. A paired RAG-on/off experiment evaluated 74 questions: retrieval improved 11 responses, left 56 neutral, produced four adverse response changes, and left three pairs unassessable. RAG-on had descriptively higher mean usefulness, safety, correctness, and actionability in the conditional 70-pair subset excluding the four flagged pairs from both conditions. Physical-device testing demonstrated offline responses on a 6 GB Android handset, with a 14.3 s median latency, alongside successful reconnection synchronization in the integrated application. Together, the findings document clinical response quality and practical performance of the integrated offline maternal-health assistant.
zh_abstract: 离线语言模型可在互联网连接不可靠的地方扩大孕产妇健康信息的获取，但部署既需要临床上适当的回答，也需要可行的本地执行。本研究提出了一款离线 Android 助手，整合现成的量化语言模型、经临床验证的本地知识包、对话上下文以及模型发起的本地检索。Gemma 4 E2B 和 Qwen3.5 0.8B 在每种配置 45 段对话和 312 轮对话上进行比较，包括一项专门的离线智能体基准。Gemma 获得更高的回答质量、上下文保持和安全评分；Qwen 提供更快的生成速度和更低的内存使用。临床医生对 Gemma 在九个临床领域中的 150 条回答进行评估，平均质量评分为 3.80/4，其中 147 条回答达到接受标准。一项配对 RAG 开启/关闭实验评估了 74 个问题：检索改善了 11 条回答，56 条保持中性，产生 4 条不良回答变化，并有 3 对无法评估。在排除两种条件下四个被标记配对后的条件性 70 对子集中，RAG 开启在平均有用性、安全性、正确性和可操作性方面描述性更高。物理设备测试证明，在一部 6 GB Android 手机上可提供离线回答，中位延迟为 14.3 秒，并且在集成应用中成功实现了重连同步。总之，这些发现记录了集成式离线孕产妇健康助手的临床回答质量和实际性能。

title: What Matters for Cross-Modal Alignment
zh_title: 跨模态对齐为何在医学影像上失败
summary: 零配对图像-文本对齐在五数据集上仅COCO成功，医学影像共变子空间方差占比最小，据此提出LightAlign。
key_points: 零配对对齐在四个数据集上失败
医学影像共享子空间方差占比最小
随机矩阵理论预测所需配对数量
reason: 有新方法但仅预印本与基准实验，证据有限
abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that models trained on different modalities converge toward a shared representation. Related work aligns frozen image and text encoders on natural images without paired data. We test zero-pair alignment on five datasets across four modalities: natural images, environmental audio, chest radiographs, and 3D computed tomography (CT). It succeeds only on COCO and fails on the other four. We analyze the failures and find that alignment must first locate the subspace where the modalities co-vary and then orient the mapping within it. Consistent with previous studies, medical imaging is the hardest case: its shared subspace carries the smallest fraction of the variance. When this fraction is small, alignment needs image-text pairs, and random-matrix theory predicts how many pairs are needed. These findings motivate LightAlign: a few pairs let a ridge regression between two frozen encoders locate and orient the mapping simultaneously, and a classifier fitted only on report text then predicts findings from the mapped images. On 3D CT, LightAlign surpasses models trained end to end on image-report pairs without finding-level labels: with only 200 pairs, LightAlign outperforms CT-CLIP on CT-RATE (0.754 vs. 0.733 AUROC), and with only 100 CT-RATE pairs, it does so on RAD-ChestCT, an out-of-distribution dataset from a different hospital. On CheXpert, it reaches 0.862 mean AUROC with only about 5% as many pairs as models trained on MIMIC-CXR.
zh_abstract: 柏拉图表示假说（Platonic Representation Hypothesis）提出，在不同模态上训练的模型会收敛到一种共享表示。相关研究在没有配对数据的自然图像上对齐冻结的图像编码器和文本编码器。我们在四种模态（自然图像、环境音频、胸部X线片和三维计算机断层扫描（CT））的五个数据集上测试零配对对齐。它仅在 COCO 上成功，在其他四个数据集上失败。我们分析失败原因，发现对齐必须首先定位模态共同变化的子空间，然后在该子空间内确定映射的方向。与既往研究一致，医学影像是最困难的情形：其共享子空间承载的方差比例最小。当该比例很小时，对齐需要图文配对，而随机矩阵理论可预测需要多少配对。这些发现促成了 LightAlign：少量配对使两个冻结编码器之间的岭回归（ridge regression）能够同时定位并定向映射，随后仅用报告文本拟合的分类器即可从映射后的图像预测影像所见。在三维 CT 上，LightAlign 超过了在图像-报告配对上端到端训练且没有发现级标签的模型：仅用 200 对配对，LightAlign 在 CT-RATE 上优于 CT-CLIP（AUROC 0.754 对 0.733）；仅用 100 对 CT-RATE 配对，它在 RAD-ChestCT（来自不同医院的分布外数据集）上也做到这一点。在 CheXpert 上，它仅用约相当于在 MIMIC-CXR 上训练的模型 5% 的配对量，就达到 0.862 的平均 AUROC。

title: Objectify, Don't Delete: Complaint-Derived Evaluation of Ambient Clinical Notes
zh_title: 从临床投诉中挖掘AI病历生成评价标准
summary: 提出“客体化”步骤，将临床医生投诉类模糊标准改写为可判定的具体决策，用于评价AI生成的临床病历。
key_points: 标准指标只衡量词面相似度，无法反映临床医生的真实关切
投诉类标准常由多个问题复合而成，难以直接判定
方法将复合标准拆解为限定范围的具体决策以提升可执行性
reason: 新评价方法预印本，问题意识清晰，但证据与外部验证有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Evaluating the quality of AI-generated clinical notes is hard: standard metrics like ROUGE measure lexical similarity to reference notes, while expert checklists encode what committees believe matters. Neither captures what clinicians actually complain about. Recent work has shown that evaluation criteria can be mined from user feedback and filtered to criteria that LLM judges can reliably enforce. We argue that this is where much of the value is lost. The criteria that fail enforceability are disproportionately the ones clinicians raise most often, because high-frequency complaints are stated as several questions glued together. No yes/no judgment can grade such composites as posed. We introduce an objectification step that rewrites such criteria into sets of scoped, determinate decisions. We demonstrate the approach through an evaluation pipeline that mines criteria from complaints, objectifies them, and deploys LLM judges against both planted defects and production notes. Across eleven defects planted into ACI-bench reference notes, objectified judges localize violations with median recall of 0.95, while reference metrics change by at most 0.037. Given the complaint as one broad question, the same judges still find every planted defect, but they also flag 70% of the unperturbed reference notes; one section-pair question per call raises Youden's J from 0.30 to 0.72 (by 0.19 to 0.26 with prompt effort matched). We release ACI-Defect, a perturbation benchmark; clinician-reviewed instance-level labels showing quality gaps in the ACI-bench gold standard (32 of 40 notes contain hallucinations; 40 of 40 omit discussed facts); and grounding-judge verdicts. On 1,446 production notes, mean instance-rate burden falls at every clinician-rating step (rho=-0.15), a small association. Defect counts have to be kept per span rather than collapsed into one pass/fail bit per note.
zh_abstract: 评估 AI 生成的临床记录质量很困难：ROUGE 等标准指标衡量与参考记录的词汇相似度，而专家检查表编码的是委员会认为重要的内容。两者都没有捕捉到临床医生实际抱怨的内容。近期工作表明，可以从用户反馈中挖掘评价标准，并筛选出 LLM 评审员能够可靠执行的标准。我们认为，价值的大量损失正发生在这里。无法执行的标准恰恰不成比例地是临床医生最常提出的标准，因为高频抱怨往往被表述为多个问题粘在一起。任何是/否判断都无法按原样给这种复合问题评分。我们引入一个客观化步骤，将此类标准改写为一组有范围限定的、确定性的判定。我们通过一个评价流程演示该方法：从抱怨中挖掘标准、将其客观化，并部署 LLM 评审员针对植入缺陷和生产记录进行评判。在植入 ACI-bench 参考记录的 11 个缺陷中，客观化后的评审员定位违规的中位召回率为 0.95，而参考指标的变化至多为 0.037。将抱怨作为一个宽泛问题给出时，同一批评审员仍能找到每一个植入缺陷，但他们也会标记 70% 的未受扰动参考记录；每次调用只问一个区段配对问题，可将 Youden's J 从 0.30 提高到 0.72（在提示努力匹配时提高 0.19 至 0.26）。我们发布 ACI-Defect（一个扰动基准）；经临床医生审阅的实例级标签，显示 ACI-bench 金标准存在质量差距（40 份记录中有 32 份含幻觉；40 份中有 40 份遗漏所讨论的事实）；以及 grounding-judge 判定。在 1,446 份生产记录上，平均实例率负担在每个临床医生评分步骤都下降（rho=-0.15），但关联很小。缺陷计数必须按片段（span）保留，而不能折叠为每份记录一个通过/不通过位。

title: Bioformer-RetroMAE: retrieval-oriented pretraining of a compact biomedical language model for literature search
zh_title: Bioformer-RetroMAE：紧凑生物医学检索模型
summary: 用RetroMAE继续预训练得到4300万参数生物医学编码器，在BioASQ 12B检索任务上各项指标超过同设定微调的BioBERT与PubMedBERT。
key_points: 4300万参数，约3200万条PubMed标题摘要预训练
以RetroMAE做面向检索的继续预训练
BioASQ 12B全部指标优于同设定基线
reason: 紧凑检索模型的预印本，有基线对比但无外部临床验证
abstract: Dense retrieval is increasingly used for biomedical literature search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Most biomedical bi-encoders are built on BERTBase-sized encoders pretrained with masked language modeling (MLM). These encoders are costly for corpus-scale indexing and latency-sensitive query encoding, and MLM does not explicitly train the [CLS] vector that a bi-encoder uses to represent a whole text. We present Bioformer-RetroMAE, a compact (43M-parameter) retrieval-oriented biomedical encoder obtained by continually pretraining Bioformer8L} with RetroMAE on approximately 32 million PubMed titles and abstracts. After bi-encoder fine-tuning with BM25 hard negatives, we evaluated it on BioASQ Task 12B test questions by retrieving from all PubMed abstracts. Bioformer-RetroMAE outperformed BioBERT and PubMedBERT bi-encoders fine-tuned under identical settings on all metrics, despite having about 40% of their parameters and producing 512-dimensional rather than 768-dimensional vectors. Compared with PubMedBERT, it improved mean average precision (MAP) by 37.0% and Recall@100 by 29.1%. Compared with the original Bioformer8L}, RetroMAE pretraining improved MAP by 53.6% and Recall@100 by 32.8% without changing model size or inference cost. In hybrid retrieval, fusing Bioformer-RetroMAE with BM25 through weighted reciprocal rank fusion improved MAP and NDCG@10 over BM25 alone by 4.9% and 4.6%, respectively, larger gains than those obtained by fusing BM25 with PubMedBERT or BioBERT.
zh_abstract: 稠密检索（dense retrieval）越来越多地用于生物医学文献检索和检索增强生成（retrieval-augmented generation, RAG）。大多数生物医学双编码器（bi-encoder）建立在以掩码语言建模（masked language modeling, MLM）预训练的BERTBase规模编码器之上。这些编码器对于语料库规模索引和延迟敏感的查询编码而言成本高昂，而且MLM并不显式训练双编码器用于表示整个文本的[CLS]向量。我们提出Bioformer-RetroMAE，这是一个紧凑的（43M参数）、面向检索的生物医学编码器，通过在约3200万条PubMed标题和摘要上以RetroMAE持续预训练Bioformer8L}而获得。在使用BM25硬负例进行双编码器微调后，我们通过从所有PubMed摘要中检索，在BioASQ Task 12B测试问题上对其进行评估。尽管参数约为BioBERT和PubMedBERT双编码器的40%，并生成512维而非768维向量，Bioformer-RetroMAE在相同设置下微调后，在所有指标上均优于这两个双编码器。与PubMedBERT相比，它将平均精度均值（mean average precision, MAP）提高了37.0%，将Recall@100提高了29.1%。与原始Bioformer8L}相比，RetroMAE预训练在不改变模型大小或推理成本的情况下，将MAP提高了53.6%，将Recall@100提高了32.8%。在混合检索中，通过加权倒数排名融合（weighted reciprocal rank fusion）将Bioformer-RetroMAE与BM25融合，相较单独BM25分别将MAP和NDCG@10提高了4.9%和4.6%，增益大于将BM25与PubMedBERT或BioBERT融合所获得的增益。

title: EndoComparer: Comparative Surgical Video Question Answering with Pseudo-Siamese Visual Adaptation and Perceive-then-Compare Reasoning
zh_title: EndoComparer：手术视频对比问答模型与基准
summary: 提出手术视频对比问答视觉语言模型，含伪孪生视觉LoRA与先感知后比较推理链，并构建近1.1万题基准。
key_points: 伪孪生视觉LoRA让两段视频在视觉通路分离
先感知后比较的推理链先描述再作答
构建EndoDiffVQA近1.1万道多选题基准
reason: 有新方法与自建基准，但预印本、无外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Purpose: Surgical training benefits from explicit comparison between cases: in patient condition, in technique and in skill proficiency. Surgical vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising and flexible interface for this purpose. Yet current VLMs typically see one video at a time, and they often fall short when asked to compare videos. Methods: We propose EndoComparer, a VLM for comparative surgical video question answering with two components. (a) A Pseudo-Siamese Visual LoRA (PSVL) gives each video slot its own low-rank adapter over a shared frozen vision encoder, separating the two videos in the visual pathway at the cost of a single encoder pass. (b) A Perceive-then-Compare chain of thought (PtC-CoT) trains the model to first state what each video shows, then derive the answer from these statements. We further curate EndoDiffVQA, a benchmark of nearly 11K multiple-choice questions on video-pair over cholecystectomy and gastric bypass procedures, covering anatomy, tool, action and skill. Results: EndoComparer outperforms strong generalist and surgical VLMs on detecting and specifying difference between videos. Ablations show that two proposed components contribute complimentarily, and the model remains more robust under a video-swap control that exposes confusion between the two videos. Conclusion: Providing a dedicated visual reasoning path through PSVL and PtC-CoT makes cross-case comparison of surgical videos more robust for VLMs. EndoDiffVQA and EndoComparer provide a benchmark and a strong baseline for this task. Project page: https://camma-public.github.io/endocomparer
zh_abstract: 【目的】外科培训受益于病例之间的明确比较：患者病情、技术和技能熟练度方面的比较。外科视觉语言模型（VLM）为此目的提供了有前景且灵活的接口。然而当前VLM通常一次只观看一个视频，在要求比较视频时往往表现不足。【方法】我们提出EndoComparer，一种用于比较性外科视频问答的VLM，包含两个组件。(a) 伪孪生视觉LoRA（PSVL）为每个视频槽在共享的冻结视觉编码器上提供各自的低秩适配器，以单次编码器前向传递为代价，在视觉通路中分离两个视频。(b) 先感知后比较思维链（PtC-CoT）训练模型首先陈述每个视频展示的内容，然后从这些陈述中推导答案。我们进一步构建EndoDiffVQA，一个包含近11K道视频对多项选择题的基准，涵盖胆囊切除术和胃旁路术，覆盖解剖、工具、动作和技能。【结果】在检测并具体说明视频间差异方面，EndoComparer优于强大的通用和外科VLM。消融实验表明两个提出的组件互补地贡献，并且模型在暴露两个视频之间混淆的视频交换对照下仍更稳健。【结论】通过PSVL和PtC-CoT提供专门的视觉推理路径，使VLM对手术视频的跨病例比较更稳健。EndoDiffVQA和EndoComparer为该任务提供了基准和强基线。项目页面：https://camma-public.github.io/endocomparer

title: PathLoop: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Reasoning for Evidence-Grounded Whole-Slide Image Analysis
zh_title: PathLoop：面向全切片图像的自演化多智能体框架
summary: 提出整合组学数据的自演化多智能体框架，在切片、斑块、像素层面协同视觉与组学解读以支持全切片图像分析。
key_points: 多智能体协同视觉与组学解读三类尺度信息
用分子信号引导组织区域选择并兼顾全局
以病理知识库校验所收集证据的一致性
reason: 多智能体与组学融合有新意，但预印本且描述中未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Analyzing whole-slide images (WSIs) requires combining evidence across tissue regions and spatial scales. Multi-agent systems offer a promising approach to this task. However, existing systems make limited use of molecular evidence, often select visually prominent but less representative regions while overlooking global context, and struggle to reuse experience from previous cases. To address these challenges, we present PathLoop, a self-evolving multi-agent framework that integrates omics data for evidence-grounded WSI analysis. Specifically, PathLoop coordinates visual and omics interpreters across slide, patch, and pixel levels, using molecular signals to guide region selection and combining local tissue details with global slide features. A judgment agent then checks the consistency of the collected evidence against Pathology-Wiki, a knowledge base built from 48 entries across 24 organ systems, and triggers re-examination when the evidence is inconsistent. To reuse past experience, a four-level memory stores reasoning trajectories, practical tips, skills, and tools to guide future cases, forming a loop of evidence collection, review, and memory update. We evaluate PathLoop on four TCGA cohorts with biomarker prediction, survival prediction, and subtype classification. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of PathLoop across these tasks and support its use for evidence-grounded WSI analysis.
zh_abstract: 分析全切片图像（WSI）需要整合跨组织区域和空间尺度的证据。多智能体系统为这一任务提供了有前景的方法。然而，现有系统对分子证据利用有限，常选择视觉上显著但代表性较低的区域，同时忽略全局背景，并且难以复用既往病例的经验。为应对这些挑战，我们提出PathLoop，一个自我进化的多智能体框架，整合组学数据以进行有证据依据的WSI分析。具体而言，PathLoop在切片、图像块和像素层级协调视觉与组学解释器，利用分子信号指导区域选择，并将局部组织细节与全局切片特征相结合。然后一个判断智能体根据Pathology-Wiki检查所收集证据的一致性，该知识库由24个器官系统中的48个条目构建；当证据不一致时触发重新检查。为复用既往经验，四级记忆存储推理轨迹、实用提示、技能和工具以指导未来病例，形成证据收集、审查和记忆更新的循环。我们在四个TCGA队列上评估PathLoop，任务包括生物标志物预测、生存预测和亚型分类。结果证明PathLoop在这些任务中的有效性，并支持其用于有证据依据的WSI分析。

title: FDA Seeks Feedback on Risks from Autonomous/Remote Teleoperation Medical Devices
zh_title: FDA就自主/远程遥操作医疗器械风险征求意见
summary: FDA就自主与远程遥操作医疗器械的风险公开征求反馈。
reason: 监管机构征求意见属实质进展，但仅标题、信息有限

title: Large language models as oncology world models
zh_title: 大语言模型作为肿瘤学世界模型
summary: arXiv预印本系统考察LLM对肿瘤学的内部表征：仅给肿瘤类型时生成患者高度同质，36项模型-情景评估中29项符合生物标志物与治疗逻辑。
key_points: 同肿瘤类型生成患者同质度高，81.0%–93.2%共享最常见值
36项评估中29项遵循生物标志物与治疗逻辑
既往治疗或衰弱因素相关评估仅1/12正确
预测12个月生存89.9%，观察值为72.2%
reason: 有新意的预印本评估方法，但证据有限、未经同行评审
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can synthesize cancer patient cases, but their internal representation of oncology, or world model, has not been explored systematically. By only specifying tumor type, we show that LLMs tend to generate similar patients per cancer, with on average 81.0% to 93.2% of a cancer's patients sharing the most frequent value of each baseline feature. By systematically varying patient features in 12 clinical scenarios, we show that they follow biomarker and treatment logic in 29 of 36 model-scenario assessments, against 1 of 12 when previous treatment or frailty matters. Continuing real patient trajectories, an LLM predicted 89.9% 12-month survival, and 79.2% with similar patients as examples, against 72.2% observed. To represent these trajectories, we developed the Clinical State Space, a dynamic representation framework that we also applied to real patients. Despite the limits we show, improved world models may support digital twins, which our framework can evaluate.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够合成癌症患者病例，但其对肿瘤学的内部表征（或称世界模型）尚未得到系统探索。仅指定肿瘤类型时，我们表明LLMs倾向于为每种癌症生成相似的患者，平均而言，一种癌症的患者中有81.0%至93.2%在每个基线特征上共享最常见取值。通过在12个临床场景中系统改变患者特征，我们表明，在36项模型-场景评估中有29项遵循生物标志物和治疗逻辑，而当既往治疗或虚弱状态重要时，这一比例为12项中的1项。在延续真实患者轨迹时，一个LLM预测的12个月生存率为89.9%，以相似患者作为示例时为79.2%，而观察到的为72.2%。为了表征这些轨迹，我们开发了临床状态空间（Clinical State Space），这是一个动态表征框架，我们也将其应用于真实患者。尽管我们展示了这些局限，改进的世界模型可能支持数字孪生，而我们的框架可以对其进行评估。

title: LABEL: Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits in Drug Knowledge and Language Models
zh_title: 药物文献中疗效与安全信息的不对称
summary: 基于PrimeKG的574种药物，比较说明书适应症与禁忌症在维基百科与PubMed文本中的记载频率，发现收益被提及的频次约为安全限制的两倍，语言模型呈现同样倾向。
key_points: 574种药物，对比同一药物的适应症与禁忌症记载
维基百科与PubMed摘要中收益提及约为限制的两倍（OR 2.19）
作者将该记录缺口命名为LABEL，语言模型亦呈现该偏向
reason: 预印本测量性研究，有新意的安全议题但无外部验证或临床结局，属值得一看到档
abstract: Every medication comes with two types of medical facts: indications, which describe what conditions the drug treats (benefits), and contraindications, which describe who must avoid it to prevent serious harm (safety limits). Although contraindications are critical for patient safety and FDA regulations require listing them as rigorously as indications, we find that contraindications are far less documented than indications in general prose. In this paper, we measure how often these texts contain both facts across 574 drugs from PrimeKG by comparing a drug's indications against its own contraindications. Across Wikipedia articles and PubMed abstracts, we find that reference prose names a drug's benefits about twice as often as its safety limits (within-drug odds ratio 2.19). We call this documentation gap LABEL (Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits). Language models mirror this gap. As we scale Qwen2.5 from 0.5B to 14B, accuracy on indications rises by 18.3 points, whereas accuracy on contraindications remains flat near random guessing. However, when we provide models with a retrieved passage that states the answer, they use safety facts just as effectively as benefits. Furthermore, routing safety questions to official FDA labels boosts accuracy by 15.8 points whenever the label states the fact. Overall, our findings show that models fail on medication safety not because they cannot reason about risk, but because free-text corpora lack safety facts. Clinical AI systems should therefore route medication-safety questions to official regulatory labels and structured databases rather than relying on general public records. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SMRayeed/LABEL.
zh_abstract: 每种药物都有两类医学事实：适应证，描述该药治疗哪些疾病（获益）；禁忌证，描述哪些人必须避免使用以防止严重伤害（安全限制）。尽管禁忌证对患者安全至关重要，且FDA法规要求像适应证一样严格列出禁忌证，但我们发现，在一般性文本中，禁忌证的记录远少于适应证。在本文中，我们通过比较574种来自PrimeKG的药物的适应证与其自身禁忌证，衡量这些文本同时包含这两类事实的频率。在维基百科文章和PubMed摘要中，我们发现参考文本提及药物获益的频率约为其安全限制的两倍（药物内比值比2.19）。我们将这种记录差距称为LABEL（疗效与限制之间的文献不对称）。语言模型也反映了这一差距。当我们将Qwen2.5从0.5B扩展到14B时，适应证的准确率上升18.3个百分点，而禁忌证的准确率基本持平，接近随机猜测。然而，当我们向模型提供一段陈述答案的检索段落时，它们使用安全事实的效果与使用获益事实一样有效。此外，只要FDA官方标签陈述了该事实，将安全问题路由到FDA官方标签可使准确率提高15.8个百分点。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，模型在药物安全方面失败，不是因为它们无法推理风险，而是因为自由文本语料库缺乏安全事实。因此，临床AI系统应将药物安全问题路由到官方监管标签和结构化数据库，而不是依赖一般公开记录。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/SMRayeed/LABEL 获取。

title: Foundation Model Fine-Tuning with Attention-based Multi-View Fusion for Multi-Task Cardiac Function Assessment
zh_title: 基础模型微调结合多视角融合评估心脏功能
summary: 预印本提出多任务框架：按心动周期对超声序列进行时间标准化，再用多视角时空特征微调 EchoPrime 基础模型，同时估计 LVEF 并分类心功能障碍。
key_points: 按估计心动周期采样，对四腔与两腔切面序列做时间标准化
基于 EchoPrime 基础模型端到端微调
联合优化 LVEF 回归与心功能不全分类
reason: 有新意的超声基础模型微调预印本，但仅描述方法，未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: In cardio-oncology, left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) is the standard biomarker for monitoring cardiac function during cancer therapy. However, its estimation from echocardiography is highly operator dependent, and clinically meaningful declines are often detected only after myocardial injury has progressed, motivating automated methods for standardized assessment and earlier detection of LV dysfunction. To address this need, we propose a multi-task framework integrating cardiac cycle-based temporal standardization, multi-view spatiotemporal feature extraction, and joint optimization for LVEF estimation and LV dysfunction classification. Apical four- and two-chamber echocardiographic sequences are temporally standardized by sampling a clip over an estimated cardiac cycle before being processed by the EchoPrime foundation model, which is fine-tuned end-to-end within the proposed architecture. View-specific features are fused through an attention-based aggregation module to generate a patient-level embedding, from which two task-specific prediction heads estimate continuous LVEF and binary LV dysfunction. To broaden the LVEF distribution encountered during training, samples from the MIMIC-IV-ECHO dataset are incorporated using a balanced sampling strategy. Evaluated on the EchoRisk-MICCAI Challenge, our method achieves an MAE of 4.003 for LVEF estimation (Task 1) and an AUC of 0.764 for LV dysfunction detection (Task 2) on the validation set, demonstrating the effectiveness of foundation model fine-tuning with attention-based multi-view fusion for automated cardiac function assessment in cardio-oncology.
zh_abstract: 在心脏肿瘤学中，左心室射血分数（left ventricular ejection fraction, LVEF）是癌症治疗期间监测心功能的标准生物标志物。然而，其基于超声心动图的估计高度依赖操作者，临床上有意义的下降往往只有在心肌损伤已经进展后才被检测到，这推动了用于标准化评估和更早检测左心室（LV）功能障碍的自动化方法。为满足这一需求，我们提出一个多任务框架，整合基于心动周期的时间标准化、多视角时空特征提取，以及针对 LVEF 估计和 LV 功能障碍分类的联合优化。心尖四腔和两腔超声心动图序列通过在估计的心动周期内采样一个片段进行时间标准化，然后由 EchoPrime 基础模型处理，该模型在所提架构内进行端到端微调。视角特异性特征通过基于注意力的聚合模块融合，生成患者级嵌入，两个任务特异性预测头由此估计连续 LVEF 和二元 LV 功能障碍。为拓宽训练中遇到的 LVEF 分布，使用平衡采样策略纳入来自 MIMIC-IV-ECHO 数据集的样本。在 EchoRisk-MICCAI 挑战赛上评估时，我们的方法在验证集上对 LVEF 估计（任务 1）达到 MAE 4.003，对 LV 功能障碍检测（任务 2）达到 AUC 0.764，证明了基础模型微调结合基于注意力的多视角融合在心脏肿瘤学自动心功能评估中的有效性。

title: Between Obligations and Evidence: A Participatory Study of Translating the EU AI Act into Technical Requirements
zh_title: 将欧盟 AI 法案转化为技术要求的参与式研究
summary: 预印本通过 32 名研究者、政策制定者与从业者的参与式工作坊，考察医疗等场景下监管义务如何被转译为可测量技术要求与合规证据。
key_points: 工作坊覆盖医疗、招聘与公共交通场景
揭示义务转译、责任与人工监督之间的张力
合规证据有效性随运行条件变化而受质疑
reason: 监管落地议题有信息量，但为小规模工作坊质性研究，属值得一看档
abstract: The EU AI Act imposes technical and organizational requirements for high-risk AI systems, but applying these requirements involves contextual choices about what to measure and what evidence supports a compliance claim. We investigate these challenges through a participatory workshop involving 32 researchers, policymakers, and practitioners from different disciplines, using realistic scenarios in healthcare, recruitment, and public transport to examine how regulatory obligations are interpreted, translated into technical requirements, and evaluated in practice. Through a thematic analysis of workshop data, we identify recurring tensions between how regulatory obligations are translated into measurable system properties, how responsibility and human oversight are exercised in practice, and how the validity of compliance evidence is affected by changing operational conditions and system uses. For example, participants highlighted how fairness metrics could conceal discrimination in recruitment, how time pressure and limited information could undermine human oversight in public transport, and how changes in patient populations could invalidate previously established evidence of system performance. Our findings suggest that technical, organizational, and evidentiary challenges are interdependent, and that establishing and maintaining compliance requires attention not only to technical assessments but also to how AI systems are used, governed, and monitored over time. We discuss implications for supporting context-sensitive and ongoing compliance.
zh_abstract: 《欧盟人工智能法案》对高风险人工智能系统提出了技术和组织要求，但应用这些要求涉及关于衡量什么以及何种证据支持合规主张的情境性选择。我们通过一场有来自不同学科的32名研究人员、政策制定者和从业者参与的参与式研讨会来研究这些挑战，使用医疗保健、招聘和公共交通中的现实场景，考察监管义务如何被解释、转化为技术要求并在实践中被评估。通过对研讨会数据进行主题分析，我们识别出以下方面之间反复出现的张力：监管义务如何被转化为可测量的系统属性，责任和人类监督在实践中如何被行使，以及合规证据的有效性如何受到变化的运行条件和系统用途的影响。例如，参与者强调公平性指标可能掩盖招聘中的歧视，时间压力和有限信息可能削弱公共交通中的人类监督，患者群体的变化可能使先前建立的系统性能证据失效。我们的发现表明，技术、组织和证据方面的挑战相互依存，建立和维持合规不仅需要关注技术评估，还需要关注人工智能系统如何随时间被使用、治理和监测。我们讨论了对支持情境敏感且持续合规的意义。

title: CARET: Clinical Assertion-Aware Residual Calibration for Medical Image-Text Alignment
zh_title: CARET：面向医学图文对齐的断言感知校准
summary: 预印本提出参数高效的图像侧适配方法，用有界残差按临床断言方向校正图像特征，区分明确存在、否定、不确定与未提及的发现。
key_points: 保留预训练图像与文本编码器，仅适配图像侧
以正负临床陈述构建低维语义校正空间
CheXpert 零样本分类报告 67.80% 准确率
reason: 方法有新意并有零样本对比，但为预印本且证据限于基准指标，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical vision--language models align radiographs with free-text reports, but radiology language distinguishes explicit findings, negation, uncertainty, and omission. Treating these report states as interchangeable during feature adaptation can change image predictions without supporting visual evidence. We introduce CARET, a parameter-efficient image-side adaptation method that retains pretrained image and text encoders and uses paired positive and negative clinical statements to define a low-dimensional semantic correction space. A bounded residual adjusts image features along these directions, while assertion-aware supervision distinguishes explicitly present and absent findings from uncertain or unmentioned ones. At inference, the adapter requires only an image; textual references remain fixed. In zero-shot classification, CARET achieves 67.80\% accuracy on CheXpert 5$\times$200 and 65.20\% on RSNA. These scores exceed the published CLEFT-LoRA results by 1.06 and 0.27 percentage points, respectively. Comparisons to literature baselines are informative but not controlled for differences in pretraining and evaluation protocols. Ablations across eight components identify the four-state distinction and assertion objective as major contributors, with task-dependent effects for nonmention preservation and pair alignment.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型将放射影像与自由文本报告对齐，但放射学语言区分明确发现、否定、不确定和遗漏。在特征适配过程中将这些报告状态视为可互换，可能会在缺乏支持性视觉证据的情况下改变图像预测。我们提出 CARET，一种参数高效的图像侧适配方法，它保留预训练的图像和文本编码器，并使用成对的阳性和阴性临床陈述来定义低维语义校正空间。有界残差沿这些方向调整图像特征，而断言感知监督将明确存在和明确不存在的发现与不确定或未提及的发现区分开来。在推理时，适配器仅需要一张图像；文本参考保持固定。在零样本分类中，CARET 在 CheXpert 5×200 上达到 67.80% 的准确率，在 RSNA 上达到 65.20%。这些分数分别比已发表的 CLEFT-LoRA 结果高出 1.06 和 0.27 个百分点。与文献基线的比较具有参考价值，但未控制预训练和评估协议的差异。跨八个组件的消融实验确定四状态区分和断言目标为主要贡献因素，而未提及保留和配对对齐具有任务依赖性影响。

title: LEAP-LLM: Preserving lead-time structure for question-conditioned ECG interpretation
zh_title: LEAP-LLM：保留导联与时序结构的心电问答
summary: 预印本提出导联感知的心电-语言模型结构，用临床问题引导心电特征提取并保留显式导联与时间结构。
key_points: 针对现有心电-语言模型与问题无关编码的局限
以临床问题条件化心电特征提取
保留导联特异性细节与时序结构
reason: 心电语言模型的新架构预印本，尚缺外部验证与临床结局证据，属值得一看档
abstract: The electrocardiogram (ECG) records cardiac electrical activity across multiple leads and is used for detecting cardiac abnormalities. Recent ECG-language models enable large language models (LLMs) to interpret cardiac signals and answer clinically relevant questions. However, existing ECG-language models typically encode the ECG independently of the clinical question, forcing the ECG representation to retain broad and potentially irrelevant signal information. Moreover, these models often aggregate information across leads which can obscure lead-specific details needed for a particular question. To tackle these limitations, we introduce LEAP-LLM, an ECG-LLM architecture for Lead-aware ECG Alignment with Prompt conditioning. LEAP-LLM uses the clinical question to guide ECG feature extraction while preserving explicit lead and temporal structure. Task-trained instruction representations distill information from the question and guide two complementary branches. The Lead branch captures question-relevant temporal patterns within each ECG lead, while the Temporal branch summarizes relevant information across leads at each temporal position. Together, they provide the LLM with compact, question-relevant ECG information while preserving lead and temporal structure. LEAP-LLM reduces modality-token count by 89.0% and prefill FLOPs by 7.2x on average relative to other ECG-LLMs baselines. Across four ECG benchmarks, LEAP-LLM achieves better performance, including a 3.4-percentage-point improvement in G12EC over the strongest prior ECG-specific method. We further show that the model adaptively emphasizes the clinically relevant anatomical lead groups for different cardiac abnormalities, with lead importance patterns consistent with established diagnostic knowledge, providing interpretable evidence that the predictions are supported by clinically meaningful ECG structure.
zh_abstract: 心电图（ECG）记录多个导联上的心脏电活动，并用于检测心脏异常。近期的心电图-语言模型使大语言模型（LLM）能够解释心脏信号并回答临床相关问题。然而，现有的心电图-语言模型通常独立于临床问题对心电图进行编码，迫使心电图表示保留广泛且可能无关的信号信息。此外，这些模型通常聚合跨导联的信息，这可能模糊特定问题所需的导联特异性细节。为解决这些局限，我们提出 LEAP-LLM，一种心电图-大语言模型架构，用于具有提示条件化的导联感知心电图对齐。LEAP-LLM 使用临床问题指导心电图特征提取，同时保留显式的导联和时间结构。任务训练的指令表示从问题中蒸馏信息，并指导两个互补分支。导联分支捕获每个心电图导联内与问题相关的时间模式，而时间分支在每个时间位置汇总跨导联的相关信息。二者共同为大语言模型提供紧凑的、与问题相关的心电图信息，同时保留导联和时间结构。相对于其他心电图-大语言模型基线，LEAP-LLM 平均将模态 token 数减少 89.0%，将预填充 FLOPs 减少 7.2 倍。在四个心电图基准上，LEAP-LLM 取得更好的性能，包括在 G12EC 上相较于先前最强的心电图专用方法提高 3.4 个百分点。我们进一步表明，该模型针对不同的心脏异常自适应地强调临床相关的解剖导联组，其导联重要性模式与既有诊断知识一致，提供了可解释的证据，表明预测由有临床意义的心电图结构支持。

title: Unlocking Fine-Grained Cell Representations via Soft-Interior Rim Dense-Grid Pooling in Pathology Foundation Models
zh_title: 病理基础模型中的软内部边缘密集网格池化
summary: 提出无需训练的几何感知读出方法SRDP，通过半步长投影与偏移网格提升病理基础模型的细粒度细胞表示。
key_points: 无需训练，用半步长投影与四个偏移网格采样
把细胞掩膜映射为分数覆盖率权重
合并全细胞池化与两个内边界池化
reason: 跨四数据集与六个冻结编码器评估，方法有新意但为预印本且无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Fine-grained cell representations are essential for characterizing cellular heterogeneity and tissue organization in computational pathology. Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide powerful pretrained features for transferable tissue analysis. HoVer-Net uses task-trained segmentation and typing, whereas CellViT++ averages native-grid tokens assigned to detected nuclei. However, the former requires cell-specific training; the latter ignores fractional nuclear coverage and can mix nuclear content with neighbouring tissue. Therefore, we propose SRDP, short for Soft-interior Rim Dense-grid Pooling, a training-free geometry-aware readout. We apply the frozen patch projection at half stride, interleave four offset lattices, map the cell mask to fractional coverage weights, and concatenate whole-cell pooling with two inner boundary pools. Across four datasets and six frozen encoders, SRDP improves mean balanced accuracy by 5.68 percentage points over native token averaging across 24 settings, including 11.22 points on average for CoNIC and Lizard. SRDP converts a coarse frozen PFM lattice into a mask-aligned, fine-grained cell representation without updating the encoder.
zh_abstract: 细粒度细胞表征对于刻画计算病理学中的细胞异质性和组织结构至关重要。病理基础模型（pathology foundation models, PFMs）为可迁移的组织分析提供了强大的预训练特征。HoVer-Net 使用任务训练的分割与分型，而 CellViT++ 则对分配给所检测细胞核的原生网格 token 取平均。然而，前者需要针对细胞的专门训练；后者忽略了细胞核的部分覆盖，并可能将细胞核内容与邻近组织混合。因此，我们提出 SRDP，即软内部—边缘密集网格池化（Soft-interior Rim Dense-grid Pooling），一种无需训练的几何感知读出方法。我们以半步长应用冻结的图块投影，交错四个偏移网格，将细胞掩码映射为部分覆盖权重，并将全细胞池化与两个内部边界池化拼接。在四个数据集和六个冻结编码器上，SRDP 在 24 种设置下相较原生 token 平均将平均平衡准确率提升了 5.68 个百分点，其中在 CoNIC 和 Lizard 上平均提升 11.22 个百分点。SRDP 在不更新编码器的情况下，将粗糙的冻结 PFM 网格转换为与掩码对齐的细粒度细胞表征。

title: Quantifying Membership Inference Risks in Genomic Data Sharing: The Role of Attacker's Auxiliary Information
zh_title: 基因组数据共享中的成员推断风险量化
summary: 提出发布前的服务端审计框架，用主成分分析与差分隐私估计基因组数据共享中的成员推断攻击风险。
key_points: 将基因组数据映射到共享低维空间后审计
用拉普拉斯机制实现局部差分隐私
在5%假阳性率下估计成员推断攻击能力
reason: 隐私风险评估方法有实用价值，但为预印本且无部署验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Genomic data sharing is essential for biomedical research but introduces significant privacy risks, including membership inference attacks, in which an adversary determines whether a specific individual's data was used in a study. Existing privacy protections are typically applied after a release format has already been chosen, leaving researchers without a principled method to assess dataset-specific risk beforehand. We propose a server-assisted, principal component analysis-based pre-release auditing framework that maps genomic data into a shared low-dimensional space, applies epsilon-local differential privacy via the Laplace mechanism with a formally derived sensitivity for principal component analysis scores, and estimates membership inference attack power at a controlled 5% false-positive rate using a distance-threshold attack. A membership-neutrality diagnostic based on Unbiased Reconstruction Robustness is reported alongside attack power, precision, and recall. Experiments using the openSNP and 1000 Genomes Project datasets across multiple dimensionalities and privacy budgets show that separation between the researcher's dataset and public auxiliary data in principal component analysis space is a dominant determinant of attack success, exceeding the effect of perturbation level alone. Comparison against a genome-wide association study-style likelihood ratio test baseline further contextualizes the measured risk. This framework enables researchers, data repositories, and institutional review bodies to quantify dataset-specific membership inference risk before genomic data publication, supporting more informed and privacy-aware biomedical data-sharing decisions.
zh_abstract: 基因组数据共享对生物医学研究至关重要，但会带来显著的隐私风险，包括成员推断攻击（membership inference attack），即攻击者判定某个特定个体的数据是否被用于某项研究。现有的隐私保护通常在已经选定发布格式之后才实施，使研究人员缺乏在事前评估特定数据集风险的原则性方法。我们提出一种服务器辅助的、基于主成分分析（principal component analysis, PCA）的发布前审计框架，该框架将基因组数据映射到共享的低维空间，通过 Laplace 机制施加 ε-本地差分隐私（ε-local differential privacy），其中对主成分分析得分采用形式化推导的敏感度，并使用距离阈值攻击在受控的 5% 假阳性率下估计成员推断攻击功效。报告了基于无偏重构鲁棒性（Unbiased Reconstruction Robustness）的成员中立性诊断指标，与攻击功效、精确率和召回率一同给出。使用 openSNP 和 1000 Genomes Project 数据集在多种维度和隐私预算下进行的实验表明，研究者的数据集与公共辅助数据在主成分分析空间中的分离程度是攻击成功的主要决定因素，其影响超过单独扰动水平的作用。与全基因组关联研究（genome-wide association study）式似然比检验基线的比较，进一步为所测得的风险提供了参照。该框架使研究者、数据存储库和机构审查机构能够在基因组数据发布之前量化特定数据集的成员推断风险，从而支持更明智且更具隐私意识的生物医学数据共享决策。

title: AI-Based Multi-View Echocardiographic Image Synthesis using Dynamic Shape Control
zh_title: 基于动态形状控制的多视角超声心动图图像合成
summary: 提出形状可控的多视角超声心动图序列合成框架，从全心动周期网格提取切面，再用两阶段AI流程生成类超声图像。
key_points: 从动态全心网格提取多视角切面
两阶段AI流程生成类超声外观
目标是缓解标注数据稀缺问题
reason: 有新意的合成数据方法预印本，缺乏下游验证与外部评估，属值得一看档
abstract: Although automated methods have improved echocardiographic workflows, progress remains constrained by the need for large, well-annotated datasets. As the development of clinical databases is often limited by ethical and logistical challenges, synthetic data generation has emerged as a promising alternative. However, existing approaches commonly rely on left ventricle shape-based supervision or are tailored to specific cardiac views, limiting the generation of additional standard and unconventional imaging planes and the preservation of multi-view consistency across cardiac chambers. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework for shape-controlled synthesis of multi-view echocardiographic sequences. First, multi-view cross-sections are extracted from dynamic whole-heart meshes. Ultrasound-like appearance is then introduced through a two-stage AI-based pipeline. In Stage 1, an unpaired GAN-diffusion model translates these cross-sections into realistic echocardiographic frames. As this translation is performed independently at the frame level, Stage 2 employs masked video reconstruction to improve temporal coherence and cardiac motion. Evaluation demonstrated high frame-level realism for both stages, while the integration of Stage 2 substantially improved video-level motion quality and temporal consistency. Overall, the proposed framework enables the generation of realistic multi-view echocardiographic sequences from diverse cardiac models, providing a scalable source of annotated data for dataset augmentation and the development of multi-view cardiac assessment methods.
zh_abstract: 虽然自动化方法改善了超声心动图工作流程，但进展仍受限于对大型、标注良好数据集的需求。由于临床数据库的开发常受伦理和后勤挑战限制，合成数据生成已成为一种有前景的替代方案。然而，现有方法通常依赖左心室（left ventricle）形状监督，或针对特定心脏视图定制，限制了额外标准和非标准成像平面的生成，以及跨心腔多视图一致性的保持。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种用于多视图超声心动图序列形状控制合成的新框架。首先，从动态全心脏网格中提取多视图横截面。随后，通过两阶段基于AI的流程引入类超声外观。在第1阶段，非配对GAN-扩散模型（GAN-diffusion model）将这些横截面转换为逼真的超声心动图帧。由于该转换在帧级别独立进行，第2阶段采用掩蔽视频重建以提高时间相干性和心脏运动。评估显示两个阶段均具有高帧级真实感，而第2阶段的整合显著改善了视频级运动质量和时间一致性。总体而言，所提框架能够从多样心脏模型生成逼真的多视图超声心动图序列，为数据集增强和多视图心脏评估方法的开发提供可扩展的标注数据来源。

title: TotalSegmentator Aorta Report: Automated Aortic Diameter Measurement at 11 Standardized Landmarks on CT Images
zh_title: TotalSegmentator主动脉报告：CT自动测径工具
summary: 回顾性单中心研究，用开源工具基于TotalSegmentator定位11个解剖标志，对239例CT自动测量主动脉直径并与放射科医师参考标准比较。
key_points: 单中心回顾性，239例动脉期CTA（230例患者）
以资深放射科医师复核修正结果为参考标准
报告各标志点MAE、偏倚及>2 mm差异比例
工具开源，按现行指南推荐位点测量
reason: 单中心回顾性、同中心参考标准，属设计规范的回顾性研究档
abstract: Purpose: To develop and evaluate a fully automated, open-source tool that measures aortic diameters at 11 standardized landmarks from the aortic annulus to the bifurcation on any CT image, following current guideline recommendations. Materials and Methods: This retrospective single-center study included 239 arterial phase CT angiography examinations of 230 patients (median age, 65 years [range, 18-99 years]; 163 men) performed between April 2025 and October 2026 (209 electrocardiographically [ECG] gated). The tool locates landmarks from TotalSegmentator segmentations of aortic branches and vertebrae and measures the maximum diameter at each. A senior radiologist reviewed and, where needed, corrected the automated measurements to create the reference standard. Agreement was assessed with mean absolute error (MAE), bias, and differences greater than 2 mm. Results: Across all landmarks, MAE was 1.06 mm (95% CI: 0.91, 1.22), and 86.6% (95% CI: 84.4, 88.5) of differences were 2 mm or less. The tool measured slightly larger diameters (bias, 0.45 mm [95% CI: 0.34, 0.57]). The sinuses of Valsalva had the largest MAE (2.17 mm [95% CI: 1.59, 2.86]). For 1.2% of landmarks, the automatic measurement failed. Examination-level MAE did not differ significantly by pathology, atherosclerosis grade (P=.95), or ECG gating (P=.14). Examinations with mural thrombus more often had an MAE greater than 2 mm (50% [95% CI: 31, 69] vs 20%; P=.03). Conclusion: The tool measured aortic diameters at 11 landmarks along the entire aorta with an MAE of about 1 mm, below published interreader variability. Agreement was lower at the aortic root and with mural thrombus. Code availability: The tool is open source and freely available at https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并评估一种全自动、开源工具，该工具按照当前指南建议，在任何CT图像上测量从主动脉瓣环至分叉处11个标准化标志点的主动脉直径。【材料与方法】这项回顾性单中心研究纳入2025年4月至2026年10月期间进行的239次动脉期CT血管造影检查，涉及230例患者（中位年龄65岁[范围18-99岁]；163例男性）（其中209次为心电图[ECG]门控）。该工具根据TotalSegmentator对主动脉分支和椎体的分割结果定位标志点，并测量每个标志点的最大直径。一名资深放射科医师审核并在需要时校正自动测量结果，以建立参考标准。采用平均绝对误差（MAE）、偏倚以及大于2 mm的差异评估一致性。【结果】在所有标志点中，MAE为1.06 mm（95% CI：0.91，1.22），86.6%（95% CI：84.4，88.5）的差异≤2 mm。该工具测得的直径略大（偏倚0.45 mm[95% CI：0.34，0.57]）。Valsalva窦的MAE最大（2.17 mm[95% CI：1.59，2.86]）。1.2%的标志点自动测量失败。检查水平的MAE按病变、动脉粥样硬化分级（P=.95）或ECG门控（P=.14）无显著差异。存在附壁血栓的检查更常出现MAE大于2 mm（50%[95% CI：31，69] vs 20%；P=.03）。【结论】该工具测量了沿整个主动脉11个标志点的主动脉直径，MAE约为1 mm，低于已发表的阅片者间变异性。主动脉根部和存在附壁血栓时一致性较低。代码可用性：该工具为开源工具，可在 https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator 免费获取。

title: Explanations that Transfer: Interpreting Medical Retrieval with Sparse AutoEncoders
zh_title: 稀疏自编码器解释医学检索的可迁移性
summary: 预印本将稀疏自编码器用于医学信息检索，结合重建目标与 InfoNCE 对比损失，在六个医学检索数据集上评估三种嵌入模型。
key_points: 把稠密文本嵌入转为语义可解释表示
损失结合重建与查询-文档相关性保持
覆盖域内与域外共六个医学检索数据集
reason: 可解释性方向有新意且多数据集评估，但为预印本无外部临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical AI systems that answer users' queries rely on retrieving medical knowledge from large document collections. In this context, finetuning general models on medical datasets can improve retrieval relevance. Yet the dense embeddings underlying modern retrieval systems remain largely opaque, making it difficult to understand the mechanics behind their results. Moreover, adapting to a specific medical dataset risks losing transferability to new clinical corpora. In this work, we tackle these issues by applying Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to medical information retrieval, transforming dense text embeddings into semantically interpretable representations. To do so, our model combines a reconstruction objective with an InfoNCE contrastive loss that directly preserves query-document relevance. We evaluate three embedding models across six medical retrieval datasets, both in-domain and out-of-domain. Trained on a medical corpus, our sparse codes improve in-domain retrieval over the original embeddings, and lose less out-of-domain performance than their dense counterparts, especially when the target corpus is distant from the training one. Importantly, our experiments show that the method yields interpretable features whose semantic content can be inferred from the queries and documents that activate them most strongly. The interpretation of these features sheds light on why a particular document was retrieved, and transfers beyond the training distribution.
zh_abstract: 回答用户查询的医学AI系统依赖从大型文档集合中检索医学知识。在此背景下，在医学数据集上微调通用模型可以提高检索相关性。然而，现代检索系统所依赖的稠密嵌入在很大程度上仍不透明，使得难以理解其结果背后的机制。此外，适应特定医学数据集存在丧失对新临床语料库可迁移性的风险。在本工作中，我们通过将稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoders, SAEs）应用于医学信息检索来应对这些问题，将稠密文本嵌入转换为语义可解释表示。为此，我们的模型将重建目标与一种InfoNCE对比损失相结合，该损失直接保留查询-文档相关性。我们在六个医学检索数据集上评估了三个嵌入模型，涵盖域内和域外。在医学语料库上训练后，我们的稀疏编码相比原始嵌入改善了域内检索，并且相比其稠密对应物在域外性能上损失更少，尤其是当目标语料库与训练语料库相距较远时。重要的是，我们的实验表明，该方法产生可解释特征，其语义内容可以从最强烈激活这些特征的查询和文档中推断出来。对这些特征的解释有助于揭示为何检索到某一特定文档，并且可迁移到训练分布之外。

title: When evaluation becomes intervention in clinical AI
zh_title: 当评估成为干预：临床AI中的模型评判
summary: 观点文章指出用AI评判模型筛选提示或训练模型时，评判者本身成为干预，可能偏向其忽略的错误。
key_points: 评判模型参与选择即构成干预
选择会放大评判未察觉的错误
提出评判报告应含内容与独立临床检验要求
reason: 方法学观点类预印本，议题有价值但无实证数据，按观点文章档次给5分
abstract: AI judges, models that grade another system's output against a rubric, extend clinical review to the scale at which clinical AI writes. When teams use judge assessments to select a prompt or train a model, the judge becomes part of the intervention. Selection can then favor errors the judge overlooks. We describe what a judge's report must contain and the independent clinical test each judge-driven change needs.
zh_abstract: AI评判器（AI judges）——即依据评分标准（rubric）对另一系统输出进行评分的模型——将临床审查扩展到临床AI生成内容的规模。当团队使用评判器评估来选择提示词或训练模型时，评判器便成为干预的一部分。此时，选择可能偏向评判器所忽视的错误。我们描述评判器报告必须包含的内容，以及每一项由评判器驱动的变更所需的独立临床检验。

title: Vessel2Brain: Edge-Aware Multi-Scale Flow Matching for 3D Brain Image Generation from Vessel Masks
zh_title: 由血管掩膜生成三维脑MRI的流动匹配方法
summary: 提出边缘感知多尺度条件流动匹配框架Vessel2Brain，仅以血管标签图合成全脑三维MRI，用于数据增强与仿真。
key_points: 仅以稀疏血管标签图为条件生成全脑MRI
边缘感知多尺度条件连续流建模
面向数据增强、仿真与下游神经影像分析
reason: 生成方法有明确新意但无外部验证或临床评估，属值得一看档
abstract: Generating realistic 3D brain MRI volumes from sparse anatomical priors is a highly ill-posed yet clinically valuable problem, with important applications in data augmentation, simulation, and downstream neuroimaging analysis. In this work, we investigate the challenging task of synthesising full 3D brain MRI volumes conditioned solely on vascular label maps. While vascular structures provide strong anatomical and topological cues, they occupy only a small fraction of the brain volume and offer no direct information about surrounding tissue appearance. To address this challenge, we propose Vessel2Brain, an edge-aware multi-scale conditional flow matching framework that explicitly incorporates vascular structure information into the generative process. Our approach formulates vessel-guided brain image synthesis as a conditional continuous flow, enabling stable training and flexible generation while preserving structural correspondence. A multi-scale flow matching strategy is introduced to jointly model global anatomical coherence and fine-grained local details, with auxiliary velocity predictions providing additional supervision across spatial resolutions. Furthermore, we design an edge-aware objective that emphasises vascular boundaries during training, encouraging anatomically faithful tissue synthesis around vessel structures. We evaluate Vessel2Brain on two public 3D brain MRI datasets with paired vascular annotations. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative models in terms of reconstruction accuracy, structural consistency, and distributional realism.
zh_abstract: 从稀疏解剖先验生成逼真的 3D 脑 MRI 体积是一个高度不适定但具有临床价值的问题，在数据增强、仿真和下游神经影像分析中具有重要应用。在本工作中，我们研究了仅以血管标签图为条件合成完整 3D 脑 MRI 体积这一具有挑战性的任务。虽然血管结构提供了强的解剖和拓扑线索，但它们仅占据脑体积的一小部分，并且不提供关于周围组织外观的直接信息。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Vessel2Brain，一个边缘感知的多尺度条件流匹配框架，其将血管结构信息显式地纳入生成过程。我们的方法将血管引导的脑图像合成表述为条件连续流，从而在保持结构对应关系的同时实现稳定训练和灵活生成。引入多尺度流匹配策略以联合建模全局解剖一致性和细粒度局部细节，并利用辅助速度预测跨空间分辨率提供额外监督。此外，我们设计了一个边缘感知目标，在训练过程中强调血管边界，促使在血管结构周围合成解剖学上忠实的组织。我们在两个带有配对血管标注的公开 3D 脑 MRI 数据集上评估 Vessel2Brain。大量定量和定性实验表明，我们的方法在重建准确性、结构一致性和分布真实性方面始终优于最先进的生成模型。

title: Shadow-Mode Evaluation of an AI Assistant for Multidisciplinary Tumor Boards
zh_title: 肿瘤多学科会诊AI助手影子模式评估试验登记
summary: 慕尼黑工业大学注册观察性研究，在三个肿瘤委员会以影子模式比较AI草拟建议与会诊决策一致性。
key_points: 观察性研究，计划入组450例，正在招募
AI会前草拟建议，不影响患者诊疗
比较AI建议与委员会决策的一致率

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Technical University of Munich; conditions: Hematologic Neoplasms, Sarcoma, Bone Neoplasms, Head and Neck Neoplasms; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 450; status: RECRUITING] This study tests whether an artificial intelligence (AI) system that drafts tumor board recommendations performs as well on new cases as it did on archived cases. The system runs in shadow mode at three multidisciplinary tumor boards of TUM University Hospital rechts der Isar. For each case it drafts a recommendation before the board meets. The board does not see the draft, and the draft has no influence on patient care. After the meeting, each draft is compared with the board decision. The agreement rate is then compared with the rate measured on archived decisions of the same boards.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：慕尼黑工业大学；疾病：血液系统肿瘤、肉瘤、骨肿瘤、头颈部肿瘤；类型：观察性；入组人数：450；状态：招募中] 本研究检验一种起草肿瘤委员会建议的人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）系统在新病例上的表现是否与在归档病例上的表现一样好。该系统在慕尼黑工业大学伊萨尔河右岸医院（TUM University Hospital rechts der Isar）的三个多学科肿瘤委员会以影子模式运行。对每例病例，它在委员会开会前起草一份建议。委员会不会看到该草案，且草案对患者照护没有影响。会议后，将每份草案与委员会决定进行比较。然后将一致率与在同一批委员会归档决定上测得的比率进行比较。

title: Artificial intelligence in healthcare: Transformative impacts, peril, and the imperative of ethical stewardship.
source: PubMed · African journal of reproductive health
zh_title: 社论：医疗AI的变革性影响、风险与伦理治理
summary: 社论讨论AI在诊断、临床决策与卫生系统效率方面的潜力与风险，主张应实施强有力的伦理治理。
key_points: AI可助中低收入国家弥补人力与专科服务缺口
算法偏倚、决策不透明与数据治理失效构成风险
强调伦理治理以防止数字不平等加剧
reason: 社论类观点文章，无数据无验证，属增量档
abstract: [African journal of reproductive health] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping global healthcare, offering unprecedented opportunities to strengthen diagnostics, clinical decision making, population health surveillance, and health system efficiency. Its promise is particularly significant for low and middle income countries, where AI enabled tools can help bridge gaps in workforce capacity, disease monitoring, and access to specialized care. Yet these advances carry profound risks. Algorithmic bias, opaque decision pathways, data governance failures, and widening digital inequities threaten to undermine trust and exacerbate existing disparities. Without robust ethical stewardship, AI may amplify structural vulnerabilities rather than alleviate them. This editorial examines AI's dual trajectory in global health-its transformative potential and emerging hazards-and argues for a coordinated governance framework grounded in transparency, accountability, equity, and human rights. As nations accelerate digital adoption, ethical leadership must become a central pillar of global health strategy to ensure AI serves collective benefit rather than drives unintended harm.
zh_abstract: [African Journal of Reproductive Health] 人工智能（AI）正在迅速重塑全球医疗保健，为加强诊断、临床决策、人群健康监测和卫生系统效率提供了前所未有的机会。其对低收入和中等收入国家的意义尤为重大，在这些国家，AI赋能工具有助于弥合劳动力能力、疾病监测和获得专科照护方面的差距。然而，这些进步也带来深远风险。算法偏倚、不透明的决策路径、数据治理失败以及不断扩大的数字不平等，可能削弱信任并加剧现有差距。如果没有强有力的伦理治理，AI可能放大结构性脆弱性，而非缓解这些脆弱性。这篇社论审视了AI在全球健康中的双重轨迹——其变革潜力与新出现的危害——并主张建立一个以透明、问责、公平和人权为基础的协调治理框架。随着各国加速数字技术应用，伦理领导必须成为全球健康战略的核心支柱，以确保AI服务于集体利益，而不是造成意外伤害。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Team-Based and Case-Based Learning in Neurosurgery Clinical Education
zh_title: AI辅助团队与案例教学用于神经外科临床教育

zh_abstract: 【新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：南通市第一人民医院；条件：Education, Medical（医学教育）；类型：INTERVENTIONAL（干预性）；分期：NA；入组人数：75；状态：COMPLETED（已完成）】本研究在神经外科实习期间，比较了将基于团队的学习（TBL）和基于病例的学习（CBL）相结合的人工智能（AI）辅助教学模式与单独采用 TBL 和 CBL 的教学模式。主要结局为理论考试成绩和临床技能评估成绩；教学满意度为次要结局。

title: Machine-learning Algorithm for Prediction of CKD From Retinal Images
zh_title: 视网膜图像机器学习预测慢性肾病试验

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Centre Mohammed VI de la Recherche et de l'Innovation (CM6RI); conditions: Chronic Kidney Disease, Hypertension, T2DM (Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus), eGFR; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 500; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This is a non-interventional study being conducted to validate the performance of a machine learning algorithm for prediction of eGFR from digital retinal images in a target population for future intended use as a populated-based screening tool. abstract: [Journal of surgical education] To evaluate artificial intelligence (AI) use and perceptions among urology applicants during the 2025 to 2026 residency match cycle. An anonymous survey was distributed to all applicants at a single academic urology residency program after rank list submission and before match day. A 29-item subset of the survey was analyzed, which assessed applicant demographics, application components, AI use patterns, and perceptions regarding various AI-related issues. Both descriptive and between-group comparison statistics were utilized to summarize responses. Seventy complete responses were analyzed, resulting in a 45% response rate. Overall, 51% of applicants reported using AI during the application process, but inaccurately perceived higher rates of use among their peers. ChatGPT was the most used AI tool (83%). Inaccurate or misleading AI-generated information was common, and though 86% encountered it at least once, only 44% of applicants always verified AI outputs. AI was most often used for personal statement writing, application content, and interview preparation, with these also rated as most helpful. Among AI users, 61% reported at least slight improvement in application material quality, whereas only 44% reported the same for interview preparation. Few respondents supported restricting applicant AI use (23%), while the majority (54%) supported prohibiting AI use by residency programs. Urology applicants report wide but varied use of AI across the residency match cycle, with modest perceived benefits despite mixed opinions on allowing AI use going forward. Nevertheless, thoughtfully designed and ethically integrated AI tools have immense potential to increase efficiency, equity, and outcomes in the competitive urology match process.
zh_abstract: [Journal of surgical education] 评估2025至2026年住院医师匹配周期中泌尿外科申请者对人工智能（AI）的使用情况及认知。在排名名单提交后、匹配日之前，向单一学术型泌尿外科住院医师项目的所有申请者发放匿名调查。分析了调查中29个条目组成的子集，评估申请者人口学特征、申请材料组成部分、AI使用模式以及对各种AI相关问题的看法。使用描述性和组间比较统计汇总回答。分析了70份完整回答，应答率45%。总体而言，51%的申请者报告在申请过程中使用AI，但错误地认为同龄人中使用率更高。ChatGPT是最常用的AI工具（83%）。AI生成的不准确或误导性信息很常见，尽管86%至少遇到过一次，但仅44%的申请者总是核实AI输出。AI最常用于个人陈述撰写、申请内容和面试准备，这些也被评为最有帮助。在AI使用者中，61%报告申请材料质量至少略有改善，而仅44%报告面试准备有同样改善。少数受访者支持限制申请者使用AI（23%），而多数（54%）支持禁止住院医师项目使用AI。泌尿外科申请者报告在整个住院医师匹配周期中广泛但多样地使用AI，尽管对今后允许使用AI意见不一，但感知获益有限。尽管如此，经过审慎设计并以合乎伦理方式整合的AI工具有巨大潜力，可提高竞争激烈的泌尿外科匹配过程的效率、公平性和结果。

abstract: [Current problems in diagnostic radiology] As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly integrated into radiology workflows, radiologists need to know which tools add value for which tasks. OpenEvidence (OE) is a literature-grounded clinical LLM platform, free to verified U.S. clinicians, that recently introduced "dotflows," customizable and shareable instruction templates designed to streamline clinical tasks. In this review, we propose that the distinctive value of OE dotflows lies in tasks that depend on retrieval of peer-reviewed literature and guidelines. We illustrate two such applications with examples from our own use, examination protocoling anchored to the American College of Radiology Appropriateness Criteria and case-based clinical teaching, including what worked and what required correction, and briefly address guideline-concordant recommendations in impressions. We distinguish these from tasks that restructure text the radiologist has already supplied, such as converting free dictation into a structured report, drafting an impression from supplied findings, or checking a report for internal inconsistencies, for which dotflows mainly offer the convenience of reusable instructions. We also describe how dotflow instructions can be drafted with a separate general-purpose LLM and outline the steps an institution must take before protected health information can be entered under a business associate agreement. All AI-generated content requires radiologist validation, and future studies should compare dotflow outputs with those of general-purpose LLMs given identical instructions and inputs.
zh_abstract: [诊断放射学当前问题] 随着大语言模型（LLM）日益融入放射学工作流程，放射科医生需要了解哪些工具能为哪些任务增加价值。OpenEvidence（OE）是一个基于文献的临床LLM平台，对美国经认证的临床医生免费，最近推出了“dotflows”，即可定制和共享的指令模板，旨在简化临床任务。在本综述中，我们提出OE dotflows的独特价值在于依赖检索同行评审文献和指南的任务。我们用自身使用中的例子说明两个此类应用：以美国放射学会（American College of Radiology）适宜性标准（Appropriateness Criteria）为依据的检查方案制定，以及基于病例的临床教学，包括哪些做法有效、哪些需要纠正，并简要讨论印象中符合指南的建议。我们将这些与重构放射科医生已提供文本的任务区分开来，例如将自由口述转换为结构化报告、根据提供的发现起草印象，或检查报告内部不一致性；对于这些任务，dotflows主要提供可复用指令的便利性。我们还描述了如何用另一个通用LLM起草dotflow指令，并概述在根据业务伙伴协议输入受保护健康信息之前机构必须采取的步骤。所有AI生成内容都需要放射科医生验证，未来研究应在相同指令和输入下比较dotflow输出与通用LLM的输出。

title: Machine Learning-Enhanced Mucosal Luminal Interface Metaproteomics Reveals Diagnostic Potential of Microbial Proteins in Pediatric Inflammatory Bowel Disease

reason: 预印本、单中心组学探索，未见外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Abstract: Background: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD), a chronic gastrointestinal disorder with two main subtypes, Crohn's Disease (CD) and Ulcerative Colitis (UC), is associated with more aggressive phenotypes and greater diagnostic complexity in pediatric patients. Conventional diagnostic biomarkers, lack sufficient distinguishing power between IBD subtypes. This study aimed to investigate and compare proteomic and metaproteomic profiles of pediatric IBD (PIBD) patients and healthy controls to develop a diagnostic panel capable of accurately diagnose IBD and distinguish its subtypes. Methods: We performed an in-depth evaluation of mucosal luminal interface samples from PIBD patients and healthy individuals, separately analyzing both the human proteome and microbial metaproteome data. The study involved selecting appropriate protein sets, employing feature selection techniques and machine learning across three intestinal regions: the terminal ileum, ascending colon, and descending colon. Results: Notably, panels composed solely of microbial biomarkers outperformed both human-only and combined human-microbial panels, achieving highly accurate results. Furthermore, the ascending colon emerged as the optimal sampling site, a result that aligns with the rich microbial diversity revealed in its taxonomic profile. Conclusions: Using a machine learning-based strategy on combined proteomics and metaproteomics, this study uncovered disease-relevant signaling pathways and delivered taxonomic as well as functional insights into the microbial dysbiosis of PIBD. A diagnostic panel built around microbial proteins (particularly those originating from the ascending colon) emerges as a promising tool for more precise stratification of PIBD subtypes. Larger, prospective studies are now needed to validate these candidate biomarkers and translate them into clinically deployable diagnostic panels. Keywords: Metaproteome, Biomarker, Pediatric Inflammatory bowel disease, Machine learning, Mucosal luminal interface.
zh_abstract: 摘要：【背景】炎症性肠病（Inflammatory Bowel Disease, IBD）是一种慢性胃肠道疾病，主要有两种亚型：克罗恩病（Crohn's Disease, CD）和溃疡性结肠炎（Ulcerative Colitis, UC）；在儿童患者中，IBD 与更侵袭性的表型和更高的诊断复杂性相关。传统诊断生物标志物在区分 IBD 亚型方面缺乏足够的辨别力。本研究旨在调查并比较儿童 IBD（pediatric IBD, PIBD）患者与健康对照的蛋白质组和宏蛋白质组谱，以开发能够准确诊断 IBD 并区分其亚型的诊断组合。【方法】我们对 PIBD 患者和健康个体的黏膜腔界面样本进行了深入评估，分别分析人类蛋白质组和微生物宏蛋白质组数据。该研究涉及选择合适的蛋白质集，在三个肠道区域——回肠末端、升结肠和降结肠——采用特征选择技术和机器学习。【结果】值得注意的是，仅由微生物生物标志物组成的组合优于仅含人类蛋白的组合以及人类-微生物联合组合，取得了高度准确的结果。此外，升结肠被确定为最佳采样部位，这一结果与其分类学谱中显示的丰富微生物多样性一致。【结论】本研究采用基于机器学习的策略，结合蛋白质组学和宏蛋白质组学，揭示了疾病相关信号通路，并为 PIBD 的微生物失调提供了分类学和功能方面的见解。围绕微生物蛋白（尤其是来源于升结肠的微生物蛋白）构建的诊断组合成为更精确地对 PIBD 亚型进行分层的有前景工具。现在需要更大规模的前瞻性研究来验证这些候选生物标志物，并将其转化为可临床部署的诊断组合。关键词：宏蛋白质组、生物标志物、儿童炎症性肠病、机器学习、黏膜腔界面。

abstract: The complex network of mechanisms that surround cellular senescence, such as its precise causes and effects, are not entirely understood at present. Senescence occurs when a cell permanently ceases dividing, halts apoptosis, stops performing its normal functions, and begins secreting chemicals that can induce other cells in its environment to also become senescent. Senescent cells are present in both healthy and unhealthy tissue, but their abundance is positively correlated with disease and age. A better understanding of senescence could lead to healthier aging, improved recovery from chemotherapy, or increased lifespan. This study used novel machine learning algorithms - with guaranteed properties of correctness under broad assumptions - to investigate senescence in human liver tissue by analyzing Visium spatial transcriptomics data. This produced data-driven models of the causes and effects of senescence, both locally and from nearby tissue. This report includes an assessment of whether the data meet key requirements for causal analysis, the transcripts identified by causal analyses as causes and effects of senescence marker genes, and pathway analyses of those gene sets.
zh_abstract: 围绕细胞衰老的复杂机制网络，例如其确切原因和效应，目前尚未被完全理解。衰老发生于细胞永久停止分裂、停止凋亡、停止执行其正常功能，并开始分泌可诱导其环境中其他细胞也发生衰老的化学物质时。衰老细胞存在于健康和不健康组织中，但其丰度与疾病和年龄呈正相关。更好地理解衰老可能带来更健康的衰老、改善化疗后的恢复或延长寿命。本研究使用新颖的机器学习算法——在广泛假设下具有保证的正确性性质——通过分析Visium空间转录组学数据来研究人肝组织中的衰老。这产生了数据驱动的衰老原因和效应模型，既包括局部的，也包括来自邻近组织的。本报告包括对数据是否满足因果分析关键要求的评估，因果分析识别出的作为衰老标志基因原因和效应的转录本，以及这些基因集的通路分析。

abstract: Single-cell transcriptome sequencing has been widely applied across the life sciences. It enables accurate and robust identification of cell types in heterogeneous biological tissues through unsupervised clustering, shallow learning, and deep learning. While deep learning does not outperform shallow learning in classification performance, it streamlines cell type identification by eliminating cumbersome preprocessing procedures. However, the availability of training datasets with comprehensive cell type annotations is always limited, so new datasets inevitably contain cell populations that are not pre-defined in the training data. To address this limitation, we integrated unsupervised clustering with transformer-based models to identify cell populations unrecognized by classical methods. Specifically, we developed the Nankai GeneRank Classifier by fine-tuning the pre-trained Geneformer-V1 model, and then clustered cells based on its softmax-normalized class probability matrix (SCPM). Applied to a public colorectal cancer dataset, the new method, named SCPM-based clustering, resolved cell populations that cannot be unambiguously identified by classical methods alone and led to the discovery of novel candidate markers of colorectal cancer stem cells, demonstrating its utility.
zh_abstract: 单细胞转录组测序已在生命科学领域广泛应用。它通过无监督聚类、浅层学习和深度学习，能够在异质性生物组织中准确且稳健地识别细胞类型。尽管深度学习在分类性能上并不优于浅层学习，但它通过省去繁琐的预处理流程，简化了细胞类型识别。然而，具有全面细胞类型注释的训练数据集总是有限的，因此新数据集不可避免地包含训练数据中未预先定义的细胞群体。为解决这一局限，我们将无监督聚类与基于Transformer的模型整合，以识别经典方法未识别出的细胞群体。具体而言，我们通过微调预训练的Geneformer-V1模型开发了Nankai GeneRank分类器，然后基于其softmax归一化类别概率矩阵（SCPM）对细胞进行聚类。将该新方法（命名为基于SCPM的聚类）应用于一个公开的结直肠癌数据集时，它解析了仅靠经典方法无法明确识别的细胞群体，并促成了结直肠癌干细胞新型候选标志物的发现，展示了其效用。
