reason: 纳入54项研究的系统梳理且结论明确，但为预印本、非疗效meta分析，属值得看档
abstract: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes have moved rapidly from experimental pilots to enterprise-wide deployment across health systems, promising reduced documentation burden and improved clinician experience. While research evaluating these tools has expanded quickly, there are no agreed-upon protocols or standardized metrics for assessing their performance, making it difficult to compare findings or cumulatively synthesize evidence across studies. Across 54 recent evaluation studies, we identify ten evaluation dimensions and 40 distinct metrics, operationalized in 96 different ways-35 of them (36%) used by only a single study. Assessment is dominated by documentation efficiency and time, measured in 44 of 54 studies. The other dimensions appear at broadly similar rates (16-24 studies each), and safety and clinical outcome least consistently of all. Ripple effects on the broader care system, such as impact on patients' care outcomes, redistribution of work, changes in billing and coding intensity, and downstream use of notes by other clinicians are rarely assessed. Moreover, the metrics used rely heavily on self-report and are fragmented and inconsistently operationalized, which limits comparability and hinders synthesis across studies. As an effort to support more rigorous and cumulative evaluation, in this paper we review the study designs, data sources, and metrics commonly used to evaluate ambient AI scribes in healthcare settings, discuss the limitations of current evaluation practice, and argue for a more holistic approach grounded in a standardized, multi-dimensional set of metrics.
zh_abstract: 环境式人工智能（AI）记录员（ambient AI scribes）已迅速从实验性试点转向在卫生系统中全企业范围部署，有望减轻文书负担并改善临床医生体验。尽管评估这些工具的研究迅速增多，但尚无公认的方案或标准化指标来评估其性能，这使得不同研究的发现难以比较，也难以累积综合证据。在 54 项近期评估研究中，我们识别出十个评估维度和 40 个不同指标，并以 96 种不同方式操作化——其中 35 个（36%）仅被一项研究使用。评估以文书效率和时间为重点，54 项研究中有 44 项测量了这些内容。其他维度的出现率大致相似（每项 16–24 项研究），而安全性和临床结局在所有维度中最不一致。对更广泛照护系统的连锁影响，例如对患者照护结局的影响、工作再分配、计费与编码强度的变化，以及其他临床医生对病历记录的下游使用，很少被评估。此外，所用指标严重依赖自我报告，且碎片化、操作化不一致，这限制了可比性并阻碍了跨研究综合。为支持更严谨和累积性的评估，本文综述了常用于评估医疗环境中环境式 AI 记录员的研究设计、数据来源和指标，讨论了当前评估实践的局限，并主张采用基于标准化、多维指标集的更整体性方法。

title: Structural-preserving diffusion generation for zero-shot CECT-to-NCCT synthesis.
zh_title: 结构保持扩散生成实现零样本CECT到NCCT合成
summary: 提出SPDG方法，基于预训练扩散模型仅推理即可零样本由增强CT生成平扫CT，无需配对数据，意在减少辐射与配准误差。
key_points: 无需配对数据的零样本合成
基于预训练扩散模型的仅推理流程
目标为减少辐射暴露与配准误差
reason: 方法有新意但仅方法层面报告，缺外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] Contrast-enhanced and non-contrast computed tomography (CECT/NCCT) are widely used in various clinical scenarios. CECT-to-NCCT synthesis enables NCCT images to be directly generated from CECT images. This streamlines clinical workflows, reduces radiation exposure risk, and prevents co-registration errors. However, to learn the mapping relationship between CECT and NCCT images, existing CECT-to-NCCT synthesis methods typically require supervised settings, which are reliant on substantial paired data. In this paper, we propose a structural preservation diffusion generation (SPDG) method for zero-shot CECT-to-NCCT synthesis. SPDG does not rely on paired data and can be implemented on a pretrained vanilla diffusion model, utilizing an inference-only process to generate NCCT images. Specifically, our SPDG is a guided diffusion generation method that uses the generative prior of the diffusion model and exploits structure-dependent guidance functions to achieve CECT-to-NCCT synthesis. Using guide images from CECT, we design consistency guidance and smoothness constraints as guidance functions for NCCT image generation. Based on the distribution characteristics of the enhanced regions in CECT images, we split the image into a potential enhancement region and an intensity stable region, and designed specific consistency guiding functions for each. The SPDG method is evaluated on abdomen and head and neck datasets, and the results demonstrate that state-of-the-art performance is achieved in unsupervised CECT-to-NCCT synthesis.
zh_abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] 对比增强和非对比增强计算机断层扫描（CECT/NCCT）广泛用于各种临床场景。CECT 到 NCCT 合成能够直接从 CECT 图像生成 NCCT 图像。这简化了临床工作流程，降低了辐射暴露风险，并防止了配准错误。然而，为了学习 CECT 和 NCCT 图像之间的映射关系，现有的 CECT 到 NCCT 合成方法通常需要监督设置，依赖大量配对数据。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于零样本 CECT 到 NCCT 合成的结构保持扩散生成（SPDG）方法。SPDG 不依赖配对数据，并可在预训练的原始扩散模型上实现，利用仅推理过程生成 NCCT 图像。具体而言，我们的 SPDG 是一种引导式扩散生成方法，利用扩散模型的生成先验，并利用结构依赖引导函数来实现 CECT 到 NCCT 合成。使用来自 CECT 的引导图像，我们设计了一致性引导和平滑性约束作为 NCCT 图像生成的引导函数。基于 CECT 图像中增强区域的分布特征，我们将图像划分为潜在增强区域和强度稳定区域，并为每个区域设计了特定的一致性引导函数。SPDG 方法在腹部和头颈部数据集上进行了评估，结果表明在无监督 CECT 到 NCCT 合成中达到了最先进性能。

title: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
zh_title: ProTEUS：突变分辨的闭环蛋白质进化世界模型
summary: 预印本提出基于突变偏置注意力的蛋白质世界模型，并结合快速全原子预测器指导突变探索。
key_points: 在深度突变扫描数据上预训练联合表征
以突变为动作预测功能后果
配套物理约束快速全原子预测器
reason: 预印本新方法思路清晰，但未见外部湿实验验证或充分基线对比，属值得一看档
abstract: Protein engineering requires navigating rugged fitness landscapes, where small sequence changes can produce large functional differences, but experimental screening can only sample a small fraction of sequence space. Thus, a central challenge is to efficiently traverse the large combinatorial space of mutations in silico. We introduce ProTEUS, a mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution. Pretrained on deep mutational scanning assays, ProTEUS learns a joint representation of sequence, evolutionary, and structural information using MutationFormer, a mutation-biased attention architecture. Variants are represented as states in this joint latent space, and mutations define actions whose functional consequences are predicted. To support exploration of many mutants, we developed a fast, physics-constrained all-atom predictor that utilizes explicit geometric constraint enforcement to achieve >10 fold increase in speed than AlphaFold3 with guaranteed physical validity. Lastly, ProTEUS refines its prediction and understanding of protein activity through closed loop experimental feedback to guide evolution toward a desired phenotype. ProTEUS surpasses established models in both zero-shot and supervised fine-tuning mutation prediction tasks. We experimentally demonstrate its utility in two closed-loop multi-objective engineering campaigns on aldehyde dehydrogenase and levansucrase, yielding variants with >10 fold higher activity than wild type. ProTEUS provides a world-model framework that connects virtual evaluation of mutational outcomes with experimental learning for efficient protein evolution.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质工程需要在崎岖的适应度景观中导航，其中微小的序列变化可能产生巨大的功能差异，但实验筛选只能采样序列空间的一小部分。因此，一个核心挑战是在计算机中高效遍历巨大的组合突变空间。我们介绍 ProTEUS，一种用于闭环蛋白质进化的突变分辨世界模型。ProTEUS 在深度突变扫描测定上预训练，使用 MutationFormer——一种突变偏置注意力架构——学习序列、进化和结构信息的联合表示。变体被表示为该联合潜空间中的状态，突变定义动作，并预测其功能后果。为支持对大量突变体的探索，我们开发了一种快速的、物理约束的全原子预测器，利用显式几何约束执行，在保证物理有效性的同时，速度比 AlphaFold3 提高 >10 倍。最后，ProTEUS 通过闭环实验反馈改进其对蛋白质活性的预测和理解，以引导进化朝向所需表型。ProTEUS 在零样本和监督微调突变预测任务中均超越已有模型。我们在醛脱氢酶和果聚糖蔗糖酶（levansucrase）上的两个闭环多目标工程活动中实验证明了其效用，产生的变体活性比野生型高 >10 倍。ProTEUS 提供了一个世界模型框架，将突变结果的虚拟评估与实验学习连接起来，以实现高效的蛋白质进化。

title: Deviation-Aware Pretraining for Cardiovascular Disease Detection from Electrocardiograms
zh_title: 偏差感知预训练用于心电图心血管病检测
summary: 预印本提出自监督心电特征提取框架，用近百万条无标注12导联心电图学习，含偏差定位与跨导联关联重建两模块。
key_points: 基于近百万条无标注12导联心电图自监督预训练
偏差定位嵌入检测波形级异常偏差
AUROC最高提升6.5%、F1提升12.8%
reason: 大规模自监督预印本方法，有基线对比但未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals are critical for cardiovascular disease (CVD) detection. Most current deep learning models rely on supervised, task-specific training, which limits their ability to generalize across diseases, patient populations, and acquisition settings. This paper presents a self-supervised ECG feature extraction framework that learns from nearly one million unlabeled 12-lead ECG recordings. The framework includes two modules: Deviation Localization Embedding (DLE), which detects waveform-level deviations from normal patterns, and Association Reconstruction Embedding (ARE), which models cross-lead associations through deviation-guided reconstruction to capture abnormal patterns expressed across multiple leads. These modules enable the framework to capture subtle deviation-related patterns and their cross-lead context. The framework achieves up to 6.5% AUROC and 12.8% F1 improvements over prior methods on multiple public datasets, even without additional fine-tuning the pretrained feature extractor. Embedding visualizations show that the learned features support meaningful disease grouping and anomaly identification. The approach reduces the need for labeled data and can support clinicians in diverse healthcare settings. The framework has potential to improve early detection and monitoring of cardiovascular diseases, contributing to more accessible and equitable heart care.
zh_abstract: 心电图（ECG）信号对心血管疾病（CVD）检测至关重要。当前大多数深度学习模型依赖有监督的、任务特定的训练，这限制了它们跨疾病、患者人群和采集设置进行泛化的能力。本文提出了一种自监督ECG特征提取框架，该框架从近一百万条未标注的12导联ECG记录中学习。该框架包括两个模块：偏差定位嵌入（Deviation Localization Embedding，DLE），用于检测波形层面相对于正常模式的偏差；以及关联重建嵌入（Association Reconstruction Embedding，ARE），通过偏差引导的重建来建模跨导联关联，以捕捉在多个导联中表现的异常模式。这些模块使该框架能够捕捉细微的偏差相关模式及其跨导联背景。在多个公开数据集上，即使未对预训练特征提取器进行额外微调，该框架相较先前方法最高实现6.5%的AUROC提升和12.8%的F1提升。嵌入可视化显示，学到的特征支持有意义的疾病分组和异常识别。该方法减少了对标注数据的需求，并可在多样化医疗环境中支持临床医生。该框架有潜力改善心血管疾病的早期检测和监测，促进更可及、更公平的心脏照护。

title: Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Aware Framework for Trustworthy Molecular Property Prediction
zh_title: Chem World：大规模分子性质预测基准
summary: 预印本发布整合17个数据集、逾80万实例的分子性质基准，并提出物理感知建模框架。
key_points: 17个公开数据集、10类性质任务统一评测
覆盖单分子与多组分体系含药物溶解度
提出物理约束的组合式建模方法PACM
reason: 大规模公开基准具复用价值，但为预印本且尚无外部采用证据，属值得一看档
abstract: Molecular property prediction is fundamental to computational chemistry and drug formulation research, yet existing benchmarks remain fragmented across datasets, properties, and evaluation protocols, limiting systematic evaluation of model generalization. We introduce Chem World, a large-scale benchmark integrating 17 public datasets with over 800,000 molecular and chemical-system instances across 10 property tracks, covering single-molecule and multi-component systems, including drug solubility. Chem World provides a unified testbed for evaluating molecular representations and compositional modeling across diverse chemical properties. Building on the benchmark, we propose PACM (Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling), which combines molecular representations with composition-aware modeling and domain-specific physical constraints. Extensive experiments show that molecular language models provide strong and transferable representations, while PACM consistently improves prediction across diverse chemical systems. Chem World and our PACM-powered drug-property prediction Agent support generalizable chemical modeling and offer a foundation for AI-assisted biomedical research and drug formulation development.
zh_abstract: 分子性质预测是计算化学和药物制剂研究的基础，然而现有基准在数据集、性质和评估协议方面仍然碎片化，限制了对模型泛化能力的系统评估。我们介绍 Chem World，一个大规模基准，整合了 17 个公共数据集、超过 800,000 个分子和化学系统实例，涵盖 10 个性质赛道，覆盖单分子和多组分系统，包括药物溶解度。Chem World 提供了一个统一测试平台，用于评估跨多样化学性质的分子表示和组成建模。基于该基准，我们提出 PACM（Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling，物理感知组成建模），它将分子表示与组成感知建模和领域特定物理约束相结合。大量实验表明，分子语言模型提供了强大且可迁移的表示，而 PACM 在多样化学系统中持续改进预测。Chem World 和我们由 PACM 驱动的药物性质预测 Agent 支持可泛化的化学建模，并为 AI 辅助的生物医学研究和药物制剂开发提供基础。

title: Hx2Dx: From Anamnesis to Diagnosis - A Multimodal Arena for Conversational Clinical Reasoning in LLMs
zh_title: Hx2Dx ARENA：对话式临床推理基准
summary: 基于1000例NEJM病例构建交互式基准，评估大模型从问诊到诊断的推理能力。
key_points: 收录1000例NEJM临床病例
模拟问诊、查体、检查至诊断全流程
指出现有静态病例评测未覆盖问诊过程
reason: 新交互式评测范式且规模较大，但为预印本、未报告外部验证。
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve expert-level diagnostic accuracy in static evaluations, where the model receives a curated vignette or case report that already condenses the diagnostically relevant findings. Such evaluations measure inference over already selected evidence; the evaluations do not account for the inquiry used to obtain it. In clinical practice, however, diagnosis is an iterative process of inquiry. Clinicians take the patient's history, or anamnesis (Hx), through targeted questioning, examine the patient, and request and interpret tests, progressively narrowing the differential until they reach a final diagnosis (Dx). We introduce Hx2Dx ARENA, an interactive benchmark of 1'000 clinical cases from the New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM). Each case is a simulated encounter that proceeds from initial presentation through history taking and physical examination to diagnostic workup. We evaluate open- and closed-source LLMs under multiple configurations. Performance varies considerably across models in the interactive setting, and every model loses diagnostic accuracy relative to the static setting, where the full case is presented upfront. The ability to ask the right questions accounts for much of both the gap between models and the loss of accuracy: diagnosis improves as questions become more targeted and build a more complete clinical picture. LLMs thus reason well once the relevant data are available but remain limited in hypothesis-driven information gathering, in knowing what to ask in order to know. Closing this gap is a prerequisite for their safe integration into real-world diagnostic workflows.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在静态评估中达到专家级诊断准确率，在静态评估中，模型接收一个精心整理的病例摘要或病例报告，其中已浓缩了诊断相关发现。此类评估衡量的是对已经选定的证据进行推理；这些评估并未考虑获取该证据所使用的询问过程。然而，在临床实践中，诊断是一个迭代的询问过程。临床医生通过有针对性的提问采集患者病史，即病史采集（anamnesis，Hx），检查患者，并申请和解读检查，逐步缩小鉴别诊断范围，直至达到最终诊断（Dx）。我们引入 Hx2Dx ARENA，一个包含来自《新英格兰医学杂志》（New England Journal of Medicine，NEJM）的 1'000 个临床病例的交互式基准。每个病例都是一次模拟诊疗过程，从初始就诊开始，经过病史采集和体格检查，到诊断性检查。我们在多种配置下评估开源和闭源 LLM。在交互式设置中，不同模型之间的表现差异相当大，并且与静态设置（一次性呈现完整病例）相比，每个模型的诊断准确率都有所下降。提出正确问题的能力在很大程度上解释了模型之间的差距和准确率的损失：随着问题变得更有针对性并构建出更完整的临床图景，诊断会得到改善。因此，LLM 一旦获得相关数据就能很好地进行推理，但在假设驱动的信息收集中仍然有限，即不知道为了获知需要问什么。缩小这一差距是将其安全整合到真实世界诊断工作流程中的先决条件。

title: BioXArena-Pro: a research-grade benchmark for autonomous biomedical machine learning agents
zh_title: BioXArena-Pro：生物医学ML智能体基准
summary: 含64项研究级建模任务、22种智能体配置的基准，最佳得分仅55.1分。
key_points: 涵盖八个生物医学领域64项任务
多数任务留出物种或队列等整个生物单元
最佳配置55.1分，脚手架影响接近模型本身
reason: 新基准设计严谨、任务经审计，但为预印本且未涉及临床结局。
abstract: Coding agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous builders of biomedical models, but existing benchmarks are small, near saturation or open to leaked information. We present BioXArena-Pro, 64 research-level modelling tasks from eight biomedical domains, each rebuilt from a published study; most hold out whole biological units such as species or cohorts. Across 22 agent configurations, the best scores 55.1 of 100, and the scaffold matters almost as much as the model. We re-ran a published method for every task: where the published recipe applies unchanged, the best agent and the methods tie; on rebuilt tasks the methods trail by 8.2 points, suggesting that agents gain by adapting to new data. Pretrained models (including biological foundation models) matter where the strongest agent uses them: forbidding them decreases its score on those tasks by 9 points. Every task was audited in several AI-assisted rounds and a final human review.
zh_abstract: 编码智能体（coding agents）越来越多地被提出作为生物医学模型的自主构建者，但现有基准规模小、接近饱和或存在信息泄露风险。我们提出BioXArena-Pro，包含来自八个生物医学领域的64项研究级建模任务，每项任务均基于一项已发表研究重建；大多数任务留出整个生物学单元（如物种或队列）。在22种智能体配置中，最佳得分是100分中的55.1分，而脚手架（scaffold）的重要性几乎与模型相当。我们针对每项任务重新运行了一种已发表方法：在已发表配方可原样适用的情况下，最佳智能体与方法打平；在重建任务上，方法落后8.2分，提示智能体通过适应新数据而获益。预训练模型（包括生物基础模型）在最强智能体使用它们时具有重要作用：禁用它们会使该智能体在这些任务上的得分下降9分。每项任务均经过多轮AI辅助审核和最终人工审查。

title: The BRIDGE dataset: paired brightfield whole-slide images of prostate core-needle biopsies in paraffin, after deparaffinization and H&E staining
zh_title: BRIDGE：前列腺穿刺活检配对全切片图像数据集
summary: 发布波兰肿瘤中心采集的前列腺穿刺活检配对全切片数据集，含169例患者、2607张全切片图像。
key_points: 869张玻片、169例患者、共2607张全切片图像
切片后经脱蜡与H&E染色依次数字化形成配对
面向无标记虚拟染色模型的开发与外部验证
reason: 公开配对全切片数据集有价值，但患者数有限且为预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Computational approaches are increasingly being explored to streamline histopathology workflows, including label-free methods that aim to reduce reliance on chemical staining. Among these, deep learning-based label-free virtual staining uses images of unstained tissue to computationally generate stained images. Despite growing interest, model development and validation remain constrained by the scarcity of paired, clinically annotated whole-slide imaging datasets. We present BRIDGE, a dataset of prostate core-needle biopsies collected at the Prof. Franciszek Lukaszczyk Oncology Centre in Bydgoszcz, Poland. The dataset comprises 869 glass slides from 169 patients, each digitized sequentially after sectioning, deparaffinization, and hematoxylin and eosin staining, yielding in total 2607 whole-slide images. The dataset supports the development and external validation of label-free virtual staining, virtual unstaining, image-registration and segmentation methods. Each slide is accompanied by a Gleason score, enabling downstream analyses of cancer classification and grading concordance. The stained images can be used independently for color normalization and cross-scanner robustness studies. All images are de-identified, distributed in their native scanner format and will be available through the BioImage Archive.
zh_abstract: 人们日益探索计算方法以简化组织病理学工作流程，包括旨在减少对化学染色依赖的无标记方法。其中，基于深度学习的无标记虚拟染色利用未染色组织图像通过计算生成染色图像。尽管兴趣日益增长，模型开发和验证仍受限于配对且具有临床标注的全切片成像数据集的稀缺。我们提出BRIDGE，这是一个在波兰比得哥什的Franciszek Lukaszczyk教授肿瘤中心（Prof. Franciszek Lukaszczyk Oncology Centre）采集的前列腺穿刺活检数据集。该数据集包含来自169名患者的869张玻璃载玻片，每张载玻片在切片、脱蜡和苏木精-伊红染色后依次数字化，共产生2607张全切片图像。该数据集支持无标记虚拟染色、虚拟去染色、图像配准和分割方法的开发与外部验证。每张切片均附带Gleason评分，从而支持癌症分类和分级一致性的下游分析。染色图像可独立用于颜色归一化和跨扫描仪鲁棒性研究。所有图像均已去标识化，以原生扫描仪格式分发，并将通过BioImage Archive提供。

title: Interleaving anatomical inspection and diagnostic reasoning for explainable radiology report generation
zh_title: 解剖检查与诊断推理交错的可解释报告生成
summary: ARIVE 将解剖区域检查与诊断推理交错，基于 MIMIC-CXR 构建 15.9 万条多模态思维链轨迹训练报告生成模型。
key_points: 解剖检查与诊断推理交错，提升报告可追溯性
构建 159,416 条 MIMIC-CXR 多模态思维链轨迹
以解剖与临床内容奖励优化，临床效力优于基线
reason: 新方法加大规模思维链数据构建，但仅 MIMIC-CXR 单库评估，属预印本档
abstract: Automated radiology report generation can draft clinically plausible reports, yet the pathway from visual evidence to reported findings remains opaque, leaving the diagnostic basis of these reports unexplained and the generated reports difficult to review or revise. We introduce ARIVE (Anatomy-guided Reasoning with Interleaved Visual Evidence), an explainable report generation framework that interleaves anatomical inspection with diagnostic reasoning prior to final report composition. To support this process, we constructed 159,416 multimodal chain-of-thought (MCoT) trajectories from MIMIC-CXR, wherein visual evidence from inspected anatomical regions informs subsequent clinical interpretation. Trained on these trajectories and further optimized using anatomical and clinical-content rewards, ARIVE achieved superior clinical-efficacy performance compared with strong baselines on MIMIC-CXR and the abnormality-centered MIMIC-ABN. ARIVE's reports were competitive with those of leading models in blinded expert grading, and its MCoT trajectories earned high ratings for diagnostic traceability. Furthermore, a paired review evaluation suggests that access to MCoT can aid in identifying errors within generated reports.
zh_abstract: 自动放射学报告生成可以起草临床上看似合理的报告，但从视觉证据到报告发现的路径仍不透明，使这些报告的诊断依据无法解释，且生成的报告难以审阅或修改。我们引入 ARIVE（Anatomy-guided Reasoning with Interleaved Visual Evidence），这是一个可解释的报告生成框架，在最终报告撰写之前将解剖检查与诊断推理交错进行。为支持这一过程，我们从 MIMIC-CXR 构建了 159,416 条多模态思维链（MCoT）轨迹，其中来自所检查解剖区域的视觉证据为后续临床解读提供信息。在这些轨迹上训练并使用解剖学和临床内容奖励进一步优化后，ARIVE 在 MIMIC-CXR 和以异常为中心的 MIMIC-ABN 上相比强基线取得了更优的临床效能表现。在盲法专家评分中，ARIVE 的报告与领先模型的报告具有竞争力，其 MCoT 轨迹在诊断可追溯性方面获得高评分。此外，一项配对评审评估表明，能够访问 MCoT 有助于识别生成报告中的错误。

title: SepsisFlow: an event-stream foundation model for continuous risk warning and trajectory modelling in ICU sepsis
zh_title: SepsisFlow：ICU 脓毒症连续风险预警与病程建模基础模型
summary: SepsisFlow 结合预训练 Mamba 与树模型做脓毒症前预警，并在发病时与发病后建模病程轨迹。
key_points: 基于 257 万份电子病历预训练 Mamba 编码器
同一小时时间轴覆盖发病前、发病时、发病后
MIMIC-IV 上等报警量时检出多于 NEWS2、qSOFA、SIRS
reason: 大样本预训练并对比传统评分，但仅 MIMIC-IV 内部评估，属预印本上限档
abstract: Sepsis is a leading cause of ICU death with heterogeneous onset and course, yet most warning models predict only whether sepsis will occur, leaving clinicians uncertain of its onset context and early trajectory once an alarm sounds. To answer these questions on one hourly clock from ICU admission, we built SepsisFlow: before onset, it combines a Mamba model pretrained on 2.57 million EHRs with about 1,700 hourly features in gradient-boosted trees to predict 6/12/24-h risk; at onset, it fuses Mamba and tabular encoders via a gated network into continuous patient states defining onset contexts; after onset, it encodes 72-h organ-support and physiological trajectories via an attention bidirectional recurrent network into early courses. For pre-onset warning in MIMIC-IV, SepsisFlow detected more cases than NEWS2, qSOFA, and SIRS at equal alarms, gaining about 8 cases per 100 from hourly updating, while outperforming 16 retrained algorithms and maintaining risk ranking in eICU. At onset, its contexts separated 2% cardiovascular-ICU from 15%-17% other 28-day mortality, and within each context after onset, persistent support carried fivefold higher mortality than de-escalation. SepsisFlow establishes a foundation-model paradigm for continuous risk and trajectory stratification in critical care.
zh_abstract: 脓毒症是ICU死亡的主要原因，其发病和病程具有异质性，然而大多数预警模型仅预测脓毒症是否会发生，使临床医生在警报响起后仍不确定其发病情境和早期轨迹。为了以ICU入科为起点、按每小时一个时间步的统一时钟回答这些问题，我们构建了SepsisFlow：发病前，它将一个在257万份EHR上预训练的Mamba模型与梯度提升树中约1,700个逐小时特征相结合，以预测6/12/24小时风险；发病时，它通过门控网络将Mamba和表格编码器融合为定义发病情境的连续患者状态；发病后，它通过注意力双向循环网络将72小时器官支持和生理轨迹编码为早期病程。在MIMIC-IV的发病前预警中，SepsisFlow在相同警报数量下检测到比NEWS2、qSOFA和SIRS更多的病例，通过逐小时更新每100例中约多检出8例，同时优于16种重新训练的算法，并在eICU中保持风险排序。发病时，其情境可将28天死亡率为2%的心血管ICU人群与死亡率为15%-17%的其他人群区分开；在发病后的每个情境内，持续器官支持者的死亡率是降阶梯者的五倍。SepsisFlow为重症监护中的连续风险和轨迹分层建立了一种基础模型范式。

title: Predicting Single-Cell Spatial Gene Expression from H&E using Pathology Foundation Models
zh_title: 用病理基础模型从H&E预测单细胞空间基因表达
summary: 预印本系统评估病理基础模型适配策略，在配对H&E与Xenium 5K数据上做单细胞空间基因表达预测，基因层面平均相关提升2.67倍。
key_points: 使用配对H&E与Xenium 5K数据评估
基因层面平均Pearson相关提升2.67倍
全基因面板AUROC为0.800
reason: 有新方法且有基线对比的预印本，但未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Predicting gene expression directly from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images offers a scalable and cost-effective approach to deriving spatial molecular insights from routine histology. Pathology foundation models, typically pretrained using tile-level objectives, may not adequately capture the fine-grained cellular features required for single-cell molecular prediction. In this work, we systematically evaluate and establish domain-informed and task-specific strategies for adapting pathology foundation models to single-cell spatial gene expression prediction. Using paired H&E and Xenium 5K data, our approach improves mean gene-wise Pearson correlation by 2.67x over the standard zero-shot baseline and achieves state-of-the-art performance on this task. We demonstrate strong gene-detection performance across the full gene panel (AUROC = 0.800) and importantly identify that predictive performance varies substantially across biological contexts, with our model achieving its highest Pearson correlation for spatially variable genes (r = 0.643). Our findings demonstrate that, despite the challenges of sparse single-cell measurements, H&E-derived representations can recover biologically meaningful spatial expression patterns, highlighting both the opportunities and limitations of morphology-based molecular inference at cellular resolution.
zh_abstract: 直接从苏木精-伊红（H&E）图像预测基因表达，为从常规组织学中获得空间分子见解提供了一种可扩展且具有成本效益的方法。病理学基础模型通常使用瓦片级目标进行预训练，可能无法充分捕获单细胞分子预测所需的细粒度细胞特征。在本工作中，我们系统评估并建立了领域知识驱动和任务特定的策略，用于将病理学基础模型适配于单细胞空间基因表达预测。使用配对的H&E和Xenium 5K数据，我们的方法将平均基因层面Pearson相关系数较标准零样本基线提高2.67倍，并在该任务上达到最先进性能。我们在全基因panel上展示了很强的基因检测性能（AUROC = 0.800），并且重要的是发现预测性能在不同生物学情境间差异很大，我们的模型对空间可变基因达到最高的Pearson相关系数（r = 0.643）。我们的发现表明，尽管单细胞测量稀疏带来挑战，H&E衍生的表示仍能恢复具有生物学意义的空间表达模式，凸显了细胞分辨率下基于形态学的分子推断的机遇与局限。

title: The measure that matters: What medicine asks of artificial intelligence.
zh_title: 真正重要的度量：医学对人工智能的要求
summary: 观点文章指出AI评测侧重模型性能，与临床关注的患者结局之间存在错位，并提出以生命为中心的评价框架。
key_points: 临床大模型随机试验多以专科医生偏好为终点
86项AI临床试验中仅17%以症状或行为为主要终点
提出包含五项原则的生命中心评价框架
reason: 同行评审观点文章，引用范围综述数据但无新研究，按综述/观点上限打5分
abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] Medical artificial intelligence (AI) is advancing at unprecedented speed, yet the dominant question in the field, how well does a model perform, diverges from what clinicians ask of it in practice. Did it help someone survive? In this Position Paper, we argue that a misalignment exists between how the AI community evaluates success and how clinicians define value. Even the strongest randomized trials of clinical large language models measure subspecialist preference rather than patient survival, and in a 2024 scoping review of 86 randomized trials of AI in clinical practice, only 17% had a primary endpoint related to patient symptoms or behavior. Surveys of clinicians point to a further dimension that no benchmark captures, the erosion of human connection between clinician and patient. We propose a life-centered evaluation framework built on five principles, namely outcome primacy, dynamic evaluation, clinician co-design, relational outcomes, and transparent failure publication. The measure that ultimately matters is whether a system keeps a patient out of the intensive care unit, prevents a resuscitation, or spares a family a preventable loss.
zh_abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] 医学人工智能（AI）正以前所未有的速度发展，但该领域的主导问题——模型表现有多好——与临床医生在实践中对它的追问相背离。它是否帮助某人活了下来？在本立场论文（Position Paper）中，我们认为，AI 界评价成功的方式与临床医生定义价值的方式之间存在错位。即使是临床大语言模型最强的随机试验，测量的也是亚专科医生的偏好，而非患者生存；在 2024 年一项对 86 项临床实践中 AI 随机试验的范围综述中，只有 17% 的主要终点与患者症状或行为相关。对临床医生的调查还指向没有任何基准能够捕捉的另一个维度，即临床医生与患者之间人际联系的侵蚀。我们提出一个以生命为中心的评价框架，建立在五项原则之上，即结局优先、动态评价、临床医生共同设计、关系性结局和透明发布失败。最终重要的衡量标准是，一个系统是否能让患者不住进重症监护室、避免一次复苏抢救，或让一个家庭免于本可避免的丧失。

title: Drug Design and Discovery: The Long Road From Hansch Analysis to Artificial Intelligence.
zh_title: 从Hansch分析到人工智能：药物设计的长路
summary: 综述梳理QSAR从早期数据分析到机器学习的演变，指出AI已用于药物发现各环节，并强调建模的严格前提。
key_points: 回顾QSAR历史演变与分子表征变化
AI用于靶点识别至ADMET预测各环节
强调QSAR模型开发的严格前提
reason: 历史性综述，无新方法或新数据，属增量档
abstract: [ChemMedChem] The present article traces the long journey of the historical evolution and transformation of QSAR from its early days to its current role in drug discovery. It begins with the breakthrough created by the introduction of data analysis and highlights the major advances achieved throughout its development. Changes in molecular representation resulted in an explosion of molecular descriptors, while the rapid accumulation of large amounts of data demanded the application of elaborated statistical techniques. Today, machine learning and artificial intelligence have become integral components of pharmaceutical research, supporting every stage of the drug discovery pipeline, from target identification and hit discovery to lead optimization and the prediction of ADMET properties. At the same time, strict prerequisites have been established to ensure the development of QSAR models capable of reliable and robust predictions. Model validation, applicability domain, and model interpretability are fundamental principles of robust QSAR modeling. These principles are closely related to the distinction between local and global models, reflecting the trade-off between predictive performance, generalizability, and mechanistic interpretability. Finally, multi-objective optimization is discussed, as an approach to address the complex and often conflicting requirements, associated with successful drug candidates and decision-making throughout the drug discovery pipeline, including library design.
zh_abstract: [ChemMedChem] 本文追溯了 QSAR 从早期到当前在药物发现中作用的历史演变与转变的漫长历程。它以引入数据分析所带来的突破为开端，并强调了其发展过程中取得的主要进展。分子表示的变化导致分子描述符数量激增，而大量数据的快速积累则要求应用精细的统计技术。如今，机器学习和人工智能已成为药物研究中不可或缺的组成部分，支持药物发现流程的每个阶段，从靶点识别和苗头化合物发现到先导化合物优化以及 ADMET 性质的预测。与此同时，已建立严格的前提条件，以确保开发出能够进行可靠且稳健预测的 QSAR 模型。模型验证、适用域和模型可解释性是稳健 QSAR 建模的基本原则。这些原则与局部模型和全局模型之间的区分密切相关，反映了预测性能、泛化性和机制可解释性之间的权衡。最后，讨论了多目标优化，将其作为一种方法，用于应对与成功候选药物以及贯穿药物发现流程（包括化合物库设计）的决策相关的复杂且常常相互冲突的要求。

title: Beyond the Stethoscope: Artificial Intelligence for Heart Failure Diagnosis and Phenotyping.
zh_title: 超越听诊器：AI用于心衰诊断与分型
summary: 综述介绍AI心电模型与心电-超声多模态方法用于结构性心脏病筛查及心衰表型识别。
key_points: AI心电模型支持结构性心脏病机会性筛查
心电与超声多模态可早期识别特定心衰表型
落地仍需前瞻性评估与工作流适配
reason: 同行评审综述，无新数据与外部验证，按综述档上限判为增量档
abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping cardiovascular medicine by transforming routinely collected clinical data into tools for earlier disease detection and more precise phenotyping. Heart failure (HF) represents a particularly compelling opportunity for AI-driven innovation, as many patients with structural heart disease remain unrecognized and traditional diagnostic frameworks often fail to capture disease heterogeneity. AI-enabled electrocardiogram (ECG) models, including EchoNext and PRESENT-SHD, highlight the potential for scalable opportunistic screening strategies for structural heart disease. Multimodal approaches, using ECGs and echocardiograms, are enabling earlier recognition of specific HF phenotypes, such as transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis. Successful implementation of these technologies will require prospective evaluation, thoughtful workflow integration, and responsible deployment. Early-career cardiologists are uniquely positioned to lead this transformation of AI in clinical medicine, ensuring that AI serves as a tool to augment clinical reasoning and ultimately advances more personalized, patient-centered cardiovascular care.
zh_abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] 人工智能（AI）正在通过将常规收集的临床数据转化为用于更早期疾病检测和更精准表型分析的工具，重塑心血管医学。心力衰竭（HF）是AI驱动创新的一个尤其引人注目的机会，因为许多结构性心脏病患者仍未被识别，而传统诊断框架往往无法捕捉疾病异质性。AI赋能的心电图（ECG）模型，包括EchoNext和PRESENT-SHD，凸显了针对结构性心脏病的可扩展机会性筛查策略的潜力。使用ECG和超声心动图的多模态方法，正在使特定HF表型（如转甲状腺素蛋白心脏淀粉样变性）的更早期识别成为可能。这些技术的成功实施将需要前瞻性评估、审慎的工作流程整合和负责任的部署。早期职业心脏科医生具有独特优势，能够引领AI在临床医学中的这一转变，确保AI作为增强临床推理的工具，并最终推动更个性化、以患者为中心的心血管照护。

title: Symmetry-Consistent Attention Supervision for Explainable Multi-label Temporal-Bone CT Assessment.
source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
zh_title: 颞骨CT多标签评估的对称一致注意力监督
summary: 开发可解释深度学习框架，在颞骨CT上分区域多标签评估内耳与中耳状态，仅内部测试评估。
key_points: 数据为87例患者的2399幅轴位与冠状位CT
预测左右耳正常与先天畸形共8个标签
用左右等变一致性正则约束双侧对称
reason: 单中心小样本、仅内部验证的回顾性影像研究
abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] The purpose of this study is to develop an explainable deep learning framework for region-wise, multi-label assessment of inner- and middle-ear status on temporal-bone computed tomography (CT). The framework used a ResNet-18 encoder with class-specific attention pooling to predict eight labels representing normal and congenital malformation states of the left and right inner and middle ears. Sparse polygon annotations supervised attention using masked binary cross-entropy, Dice-overlap, and outside-mask penalties. A left-right equivariant consistency regularizer enforced bilateral symmetry under horizontal flipping. The dataset comprised 2399 axial and coronal CT images from 87 patients. Development used fourfold patient-level cross-validation on 35 patients (1018 images), followed by evaluation on a held-out internal test set of 52 patients (1381 images). In cross-validation, the full model achieved a macro-AUC of 0.765 and a macro-F1 of 0.627. On the held-out internal test set, image-level evaluation yielded a macro-AUC of 0.688 and a macro-F1 of 0.572, representing the highest mean performance among the evaluated CNN, vision transformer, and MedViT baselines. Patient-level aggregation further yielded a macro-AUC of 0.716 and a macro-F1 of 0.621. The proposed attention maps were also more side-specific and anatomically concentrated than baseline heatmaps. Attention supervision and bilateral equivariance may improve interpretable temporal-bone CT assessment. Larger external studies and patient-level evaluation are required before clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 本研究旨在开发一个可解释的深度学习框架，用于在颞骨计算机断层扫描（CT）上对区域级、多标签的内耳和中耳状态进行评估。该框架使用带有类别特定注意力池化的ResNet-18编码器，预测八个标签，代表左、右内耳和中耳的正常与先天性畸形状态。稀疏多边形标注通过掩膜二元交叉熵、Dice重叠和掩膜外惩罚来监督注意力。左右等变一致性正则化器在水平翻转下强制双侧对称。数据集包括来自87名患者的2399张轴位和冠状位CT图像。开发阶段在35名患者（1018张图像）上采用四折患者级交叉验证，随后在由52名患者（1381张图像）组成的留出内部测试集上进行评估。在交叉验证中，完整模型达到macro-AUC 0.765和macro-F1 0.627。在留出内部测试集上，图像级评估得到macro-AUC 0.688和macro-F1 0.572，在评估的CNN、视觉Transformer（vision transformer）和MedViT基线中代表最高平均性能。患者级聚合进一步得到macro-AUC 0.716和macro-F1 0.621。所提出的注意力图也比基线热图更具侧别特异性且在解剖上更集中。注意力监督和双侧等变可能改善可解释的颞骨CT评估。在临床部署之前，需要更大规模的外部研究和患者级评估。

title: Therapeutic Robots: Understanding the Limits of AI.
zh_title: 治疗性机器人：理解AI的限度
summary: 从精神分析视角质疑将AI聊天机器人称为“治疗性”的合法性，讨论伦理、认识论与临床意涵。
key_points: 认为聊天机器人缺乏主体性、移情与象征化
个案说明用户关系停留于“仿佛”层面
呼吁伦理反思、监管与长期研究
reason: 理论性评论文章，无论文数据，属增量档
abstract: [American journal of psychoanalysis] This paper critically examines the use of therapeutic chatbots based on artificial intelligence from a psychoanalytic perspective. Drawing on current literature, it questions the legitimacy of labeling these tools as "therapeutic," arguing that they lack essential elements such as subjectivity, transference, symbolization, and the capacity for psychic transformation. A case example illustrates how the relationship users establish with chatbots is narcissistic remaining in the "as if" register in the absence of a real other to enable intersubjectivity. Ethical, epistemological, and clinical implications are discussed, especially in relation to vulnerable populations. The paper highlights the urgency for ethical reflection, regulation, and long-term research as these technologies advance in the field of mental health.

title: Identification of metabolic vulnerabilities and synthetic lethal targets utilizing artificial intelligence-driven precision medicine.
zh_title: AI驱动精准医学识别代谢脆弱性与合成致死靶点
summary: 综述讨论AI与系统生物学在癌症代谢脆弱性和合成致死靶点识别中的预测价值与证据边界。
key_points: 区分计算预测与实验验证证据
AI可加速生成代谢脆弱性假设
综述聚焦合成致死靶点识别
reason: 同行评审综述，非系统综述，无新数据，属值得一看档。
abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Cancer metabolism is highly plastic, and most attempts to turn that plasticity into a therapeutic target fail for a specific, recurring reason: a computational prediction of a metabolic vulnerability is not the same evidentiary object as an experimentally confirmed one, and the two are routinely discussed as if they were interchangeable. This review takes that distinction as its starting point rather than its conclusion. Artificial intelligence and genome-scale systems biology have made it easy to generate metabolic hypotheses at a scale no experimental program could match - machine learning models trained on genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic data now output candidate vulnerabilities, biomarkers, and drug combinations faster than they can be tested - but the resulting literature has not been consistently honest about how far any given prediction has actually traveled toward clinical relevance. We examine six areas where this gap is most visible: multi-omics data integration, genome-scale metabolic network modeling, computational discovery of metabolic vulnerabilities and synthetic lethal interactions, single-cell and spatial resolution of metabolic heterogeneity, AI-guided drug and biomarker discovery, and the small set of studies that have actually reached clinical testing. Rather than summarizing these areas as separate literatures, we grade every substantive finding discussed against an explicit four-tier evidence standard - associative, mechanistic, perturbation-validated, or clinically tested - and we apply that standard critically rather than deferentially: several widely cited computational vulnerabilities remain unconfirmed outside the cell lines in which they were discovered, genome-scale models continue to carry unresolved gaps in reaction coverage that limit their predictive reach, and, of the AI-derived metabolic predictions discussed in this review, only one has so far been tested in a completed prospective clinical trial. We argue that this shortage of prospective validation, not a shortage of computational sophistication, is the field's central constraint, and we close by identifying where methodological effort would do the most good: standardized validation reporting, tissue-resolved rather than bulk metabolic models, and closer coupling between computational prediction and the specific experimental designs capable of falsifying it.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] 癌症代谢具有高度可塑性，而大多数试图将这种可塑性转化为治疗靶点的尝试都因一个具体且反复出现的原因而失败：对代谢脆弱性的计算预测与经实验证实的预测并不是同一种证据对象，但二者常被当作可以互换来讨论。本综述将这一区分作为出发点而非结论。人工智能和基因组尺度系统生物学使得以任何实验计划都无法匹敌的规模生成代谢假说变得容易——基于基因组、转录组、蛋白质组和代谢组数据训练的机器学习模型现在输出候选脆弱性、生物标志物和药物组合的速度快于它们被检验的速度——但由此产生的文献并未始终诚实地说明任何给定预测实际距离临床相关性有多远。我们考察这一差距最明显的六个领域：多组学数据整合、基因组尺度代谢网络建模、代谢脆弱性和合成致死相互作用的计算发现、代谢异质性的单细胞和空间分辨率、人工智能引导的药物和生物标志物发现，以及少数实际进入临床测试的研究。我们不是将这些领域作为相互独立的文献来总结，而是按照明确的四级证据标准对讨论的每一项实质性发现进行分级——关联性（associative）、机制性（mechanistic）、扰动验证（perturbation-validated）或临床测试（clinically tested）——并且我们批判性而非顺从地应用该标准：若干被广泛引用的计算脆弱性在其被发现的细胞系之外仍未得到确认，基因组尺度模型在反应覆盖方面仍存在未解决的缺口，限制了其预测范围，并且在本综述讨论的 AI 衍生代谢预测中，迄今只有一个已在完成的前瞻性临床试验中接受检验。我们认为，这种前瞻性验证的短缺，而非计算复杂性的短缺，是该领域的核心限制；最后我们指出方法学努力最能发挥作用的方向：标准化验证报告、组织分辨而非批量的代谢模型，以及计算预测与能够证伪该预测的具体实验设计之间更紧密的耦合。

title: RawMod: Modification-Agnostic Detection of DNA Base Modifications from Nanopore Signal Pileups

abstract: Summary: Identifying epigenetically modified bases (e.g., methylation) is crucial for many important applications such as discovering mechanisms of cancer development, cell differentiation, and bacterial defense. Nanopore sequencing generates electrical signals that can differentiate canonical bases from modified ones. To detect base modifications from signals, machine learning (ML) methods and statistical approaches are commonly used. These methods can either detect a specific modification type or require an additional unmodified copy of the same DNA as a control group. However, no released model detects modification types beyond those it was trained for, which makes it difficult to detect rare modification types without an unmodified control. Our goal is to accurately identify the presence of modified sites regardless of their modification type, which we define as modification-agnostic detection. To this end, we propose RawMod, a transformer-based modification-agnostic and control-free method for detecting epigenetically modified genomic positions. The key idea of RawMod is to compare the raw signals of many reads at each site with the unmodified reference sequence, using a small model that learns many modification types as a single modified class. Based on our extensive evaluations on the detection of various modification types (5mC, 5hmC, 4mC, 6mA, and 5hmU) using various genomes, RawMod achieves the highest mean AUROC across modifications compared to control-based methods and control-free modification models. A single RawMod model with 0.23M parameters detects five modification types with a mean AUROC of 0.964, against 0.799 for the best released model. When a modification type is withheld from training, RawMod still detects it (AUROC 0.91--0.98), provided another modification of the same base was seen in training. We use RawMod to map 5hmU without a control across a 7.7 Mb contig of the Amphidinium carterae genome, consistent with two published trends. Further, we show that the modification-aware embeddings from RawMod can be used to differentiate read origin (e.g., cell types, tumor/normal origin, and native/PCR-amplified DNA). We discuss how RawMod can enable further work on label-free classification of cell types using these modification-aware embeddings. zh_abstract: 摘要：识别表观遗传修饰碱基（如甲基化）对于许多重要应用至关重要，例如发现癌症发生、细胞分化和细菌防御机制。纳米孔测序可产生能够区分标准碱基与修饰碱基的电信号。为了从信号中检测碱基修饰，常用机器学习（ML）方法和统计方法。这些方法要么检测特定修饰类型，要么需要同一 DNA 的额外未修饰副本作为对照组。然而，已发布的模型无法检测其训练范围之外的修饰类型，这使得在没有未修饰对照的情况下难以检测罕见修饰类型。我们的目标是准确识别修饰位点的存在，而不论其修饰类型，我们将其定义为与修饰类型无关的检测（modification-agnostic detection）。为此，我们提出 RawMod，一种基于 Transformer 的、与修饰类型无关且无需对照的方法，用于检测表观遗传修饰的基因组位置。RawMod 的核心思想是将每个位点上许多读段的原始信号与未修饰参考序列进行比较，使用一个小模型将多种修饰类型学习为单一修饰类别。基于我们在使用多种基因组检测多种修饰类型（5mC、5hmC、4mC、6mA 和 5hmU）方面的广泛评估，与基于对照的方法和无对照修饰模型相比，RawMod 在各类修饰中取得最高的平均 AUROC。一个仅有 0.23M 参数的单一 RawMod 模型可检测五种修饰类型，平均 AUROC 为 0.964，而表现最好的已发布模型为 0.799。当某一修饰类型在训练中被排除时，只要训练中见过同一碱基的另一种修饰，RawMod 仍能检测到它（AUROC 0.91--0.98）。我们使用 RawMod 在 Amphidinium carterae 基因组的 7.7 Mb contig 上无对照地定位 5hmU，结果与两项已发表趋势一致。此外，我们表明 RawMod 的修饰感知嵌入可用于区分读段来源（例如细胞类型、肿瘤/正常来源，以及天然/PCR 扩增 DNA）。我们讨论了 RawMod 如何利用这些修饰感知嵌入，推动基于无标签的细胞类型分类的进一步工作。可用性与实现：RawMod 可在 https://github.com/STORMgroup/RawMod 和 https://huggingface.co/STORMResearch/RawMod 获取。我们还提供了脚本，以完全复现我们的

title: Leveraging state-of-the-art AI structure predictors to generate atomic resolution ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins
zh_title: 用结构预测AI生成无序蛋白原子级构象系综
summary: 预印本将bAIes框架扩展至AlphaFold2/3、Boltz-1/2、ESMFold等六种结构预测工具，生成天然无序蛋白的原子级构象系综。
key_points: 基于预测残基间距离分布生成构象系综

abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) are central to many biological processes, but their function depends on dynamic conformational ensembles rather than a single structure. Despite the impact of artificial intelligence on protein structure prediction, determining these ensembles at atomistic resolution remains challenging. Recently, we introduced bAIes, a framework that leverages the structural information encoded in AlphaFold2 distograms to generate conformational ensembles of IDPs at atomistic resolution. Here, we extend this framework to six state-of-the-art structure prediction tools (AlphaFold2, AlphaFold3, Boltz-1, Boltz-2, ESMFold, and ESMFold2) and systematically compare the structural information encoded in their predicted inter-residue distance distributions. Despite differences between predictors, we show that bAIes generates ensembles with comparable accuracy against experimental NMR and SAXS data, and competitive performance relative to state-of-the-art all-atom simulations and alternative IDP ensemble generation methods. These results demonstrate that bAIes is robust to the choice of structure predictor and that the distance distributions generated by different deep learning architectures contain valuable information about the conformational preferences of disordered proteins. More broadly, our work highlights the potential of combining AI-derived structural information with physics-based modeling to generate atomistic ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins and regions.
zh_abstract: 内在无序蛋白（IDPs）是许多生物过程的核心，但其功能取决于动态构象系综而非单一结构。尽管人工智能对蛋白质结构预测产生了影响，但以原子分辨率确定这些系综仍然具有挑战性。最近，我们提出了bAIes，这是一个利用AlphaFold2距离分布图（distograms）中编码的结构信息，以原子分辨率生成IDPs构象系综的框架。在此，我们将该框架扩展到六种最先进的结构预测工具（AlphaFold2、AlphaFold3、Boltz-1、Boltz-2、ESMFold和ESMFold2），并系统比较了其预测的残基间距离分布中所编码的结构信息。尽管不同预测器之间存在差异，我们表明bAIes生成的系综相对于实验NMR和SAXS数据具有可比的准确性，并且相对于最先进的全原子模拟和替代性IDP系综生成方法具有竞争力。这些结果表明，bAIes对结构预测器的选择具有稳健性，并且不同深度学习架构生成的距离分布包含关于无序蛋白构象偏好的有价值信息。更广泛地说，我们的工作凸显了将AI衍生的结构信息与基于物理的建模相结合，以生成内在无序蛋白和区域的原子系综的潜力。

title: DE-Rigor-Agent: An Agentic Workflow for Assumption-Aware Differential Expression Analysis of Bulk RNA-seq Data
zh_title: 面向bulk RNA-seq的假设感知差异表达分析智能体
summary: 提出DE-Rigor-Agent，按输入标准化、方法筛选、方法执行三阶段自动完成差异表达分析。
key_points: 三阶段工作流组织差异表达分析
执行前评估六种方法的适用假设
在140个模拟数据集14类场景评估
reason: 预印本方法，有模拟数据评估但无外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Differential expression (DE) methods for bulk RNA-seq differ in their statistical assumptions, input data requirements, and supported study designs. Large language model (LLM) agents can automate DE analysis, but they may default to popular methods without checking whether these methods are appropriate for the data. We introduce DE-Rigor-Agent, an assumption-aware agent that organizes DE analysis into three stages: input standardization, method filtering, and method execution. Before executing any DE method, the agent uses expert-curated criteria and dataset-specific diagnostics to evaluate six commonly used methods, documents the reasons for retaining or excluding each method, and executes all retained methods. We evaluated DE-Rigor-Agent on 140 simulated datasets spanning 14 challenging scenarios involving small sample sizes, zero inflation, expression outliers, pre-normalized inputs, and confounded batch effects. Benchmarks showed that method-dataset incompatibilities could lead to inflated false discovery rates (FDRs) or reduced statistical power. Two general-purpose LLM agent baselines, including one explicitly prompted to consider statistical assumptions, selected DESeq2 or edgeR for nearly all datasets. In contrast, DE-Rigor-Agent's filtering decisions closely matched the incompatibilities introduced in the simulations and remained consistent across random seeds, with little additional computational cost. These results demonstrate that DE-Rigor-Agent provides an automated approach to assessing method suitability, making DE analysis more rigorous and transparent.
zh_abstract: 用于批量 RNA-seq 的差异表达（DE）方法在其统计假设、输入数据要求和所支持的研究设计方面各不相同。大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以自动化 DE 分析，但它们可能默认采用流行方法，而不检查这些方法是否适合数据。我们引入 DE-Rigor-Agent，一个具有假设感知能力的智能体，将 DE 分析组织为三个阶段：输入标准化、方法过滤和方法执行。在执行任何 DE 方法之前，该智能体使用专家制定的标准和数据集特异性诊断来评估六种常用方法，记录保留或排除每种方法的理由，并执行所有保留的方法。我们在 140 个模拟数据集上评估 DE-Rigor-Agent，这些数据集涵盖 14 个具有挑战性的场景，涉及小样本量、零膨胀、表达离群值、预标准化输入和混杂批次效应。基准测试表明，方法-数据集不兼容可能导致假发现率（FDR）膨胀或统计功效降低。两个通用 LLM 智能体基线（包括一个被明确提示考虑统计假设的基线）在几乎所有数据集上都选择了 DESeq2 或 edgeR。相比之下，DE-Rigor-Agent 的过滤决策与模拟中引入的不兼容性密切匹配，并在不同随机种子下保持一致，且额外计算成本很小。这些结果表明，DE-Rigor-Agent 提供了一种自动化方法来评估方法适用性，使 DE 分析更加严谨和透明。

title: Pocket similarity guided selection of protein targets for systematic protein ligand dataset generation
zh_title: 口袋相似性指导蛋白靶点选择
summary: 以口袋相似性描述符映射人类可成药口袋组，用于构建蛋白-配体数据集。
key_points: 识别15559个蛋白上51535个预测可成药口袋
以口袋而非序列或折叠相似性选代表性靶点
服务于Target 2035开放结合数据计划
reason: 方法学预印本，为ML药物发现数据构建提供新思路，尚无验证结果。
abstract: The scarcity of large, diverse, and unbiased protein ligand binding datasets limits the performance of machine learning approaches in drug discovery, particularly for understudied proteins. The Target 2035 initiative aims to address this gap by generating open-access binding data for more than 2,000 human proteins, a goal whose value depends on maximizing the diversity of the selected targets. Because proteins with different folds can share chemically analogous binding sites, we reasoned that pocket similarity, rather than sequence or fold similarity, is the appropriate criterion for selecting representative targets that maximize coverage of the human pocketome. Here, we use PocketVec, an alignment-free descriptor of binding sites, to map the human globular pocketome, identifying 51,535 predicted druggable pockets across 15,559 proteins. A two level hierarchical clustering, first within protein families and then across the whole proteome, grouped these pockets into 1,865 clusters of chemically similar binding sites. After discarding 533 clusters containing pockets with known ligands, we selected the 100 most populated of the remaining 1,332 ligand free clusters and chose two high quality representative pockets per cluster, ranked by their resemblance to known ligand-binding sites. Finally, we implemented two complementary prioritization strategies, one favoring structurally unexplored proteins and the other proteins amenable to experimental follow up, and selected 200 pockets from 100 different clusters from each strategy, with 89 clusters in common. Both selections cover over 10,000 pockets in ~5,600 proteins, approximately 36% of the human proteins with annotated druggable pockets, which represents a 2.8- to 4.4-fold increase in the number of covered pockets, domains, and proteins than random selection baselines. This pocket based framework offers a principled strategy to select diverse targets for Target 2035 and other large scale protein ligand data generation efforts in chemical biology.
zh_abstract: 大型、多样且无偏的蛋白质-配体结合数据集的稀缺限制了机器学习方法在药物发现中的性能，尤其是对研究不足的蛋白质。Target 2035计划旨在通过为超过2,000种人类蛋白质生成开放获取的结合数据来弥补这一空白，而该目标的价值取决于能否最大化所选靶标的多样性。由于具有不同折叠的蛋白质可以共享化学上相似的结合位点，我们据此推断，口袋相似性而非序列或折叠相似性，是选择代表性靶标以最大化人类口袋组（pocketome）覆盖度的合适标准。在此，我们使用PocketVec——一种无需比对（alignment-free）的结合位点描述符——来绘制人类球状口袋组图谱，在15,559种蛋白质中识别出51,535个预测的可成药口袋。采用两级层次聚类，首先在蛋白质家族内、然后在全蛋白质组范围内，将这些口袋归入1,865个化学相似结合位点簇。在剔除533个包含具有已知配体口袋的簇后，我们从其余1,332个无配体簇中选择口袋数量最多的100个簇，并按与已知配体结合位点的相似性排序，为每个簇选择两个高质量代表性口袋。最后，我们实施两种互补的优先排序策略：一种偏向结构上尚未探索的蛋白质，另一种偏向适合实验后续研究的蛋白质；每种策略从100个不同簇中选择200个口袋，两种选择共有89个簇相同。两种选择共覆盖约5,600种蛋白质中的超过10,000个口袋，约占具有注释可成药口袋的人类蛋白质的36%，相比随机选择基线，覆盖的口袋、结构域和蛋白质数量增加了2.8至4.4倍。这一基于口袋的框架为Target 2035以及化学生物学中其他大规模蛋白质-配体数据生成工作选择多样化靶标提供了有原则的策略。

title: The Confessions of a Protein Language Model: Steering, Activations, and What Predicted Confidence Cannot Certify
zh_title: 蛋白质语言模型的审计：引导、激活与置信度局限

未引导激活可预测置信度门控，ROC-AUC约0.786
预测门控不等同于可折叠性，稳定性未超随机
reason: 对蛋白质语言模型常用读出的严谨审计，方法有新意但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Protein generate-and-screen pipelines use interventions and readouts to select candidates, but rarely test whether these track their intended targets. We audit published repetition steering, ESMFold confidence, and an activation readout. Steering preserves confidence at its operating point, but a fitted cliff follows at alpha_50 = 1.240x (sweep's own control: 64.0%). Direction matters at moderate matched-norm push, but not at saturation. Unsteered generator activations predict the confidence gate (ROC-AUC 0.786 +/- 0.004), supporting cost-aware, model-specific triage. We also replicate established length sensitivity, through which shortening can manufacture false nulls. Yet on composition- and length-matched design--scramble pairs, no balanced-accuracy interval excludes chance for experimental stability. Predicting the gate does not establish foldability. We should test what a readout measures before using it to select. Code and data: https://github.com/paninishah/plm-steering-audit
zh_abstract: 蛋白质生成-筛选流程（protein generate-and-screen pipelines）使用干预和读出指标来选择候选物，但很少检验这些指标是否追踪其预期靶标。我们审计了已发表的重复引导（repetition steering）、ESMFold 置信度和一种激活读出指标。引导在其工作点保持置信度，但在 alpha_50 = 1.240x 时出现拟合的悬崖（该扫描自身对照：64.0%）。方向在中等匹配范数推动下重要，但在饱和时不重要。未引导的生成器激活可预测置信度门控（ROC-AUC 0.786 +/- 0.004），支持成本感知的、模型特异性分诊。我们还复现了已确立的长度敏感性，通过这种敏感性，缩短可制造虚假零结果。然而，在组成和长度匹配的设计——打乱配对（design--scramble pairs）上，没有平衡准确率区间能排除实验稳定性的随机机会。预测门控并不能确立可折叠性。我们应在使用读出指标进行选择之前，检验它测量的是什么。代码和数据：https://github.com/paninishah/plm-steering-audit

title: Toward Foundation Detection Models via Example-Based Grounding in EM-DETR
zh_title: EM-DETR：基于示例定位的医学病灶基础检测模型
summary: 预印本提出学生-教师训练整合标注体系异构的医学影像数据集，构建多领域病灶检测基础模型。
key_points: 用学生-教师策略合并异构标签空间数据集
缓解灾难性遗忘并改善特征学习
扩展示例驱动的EM-DETR进行联合学习
reason: 预印本提出新训练与检测框架，但未见外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: DeepLearning (DL)-based Computer-Aided Diagnostic (CAD) systems have shown great promise in supporting clinicians, but their performance heavily depends on the availability of large, well-annotated datasets. In medical lesion detection, the scarcity of comprehensive, stan dardized annotations and the heterogeneity of existing datasets limit the development of robust foundation models. In this work, we introduce a novel approach to building a multi-domain foundation model for le sion detection by integrating diverse medical image datasets annotated for both anatomical structures and abnormalities. We first propose a student-teacher training strategy to effectively combine datasets with heterogeneous label spaces, mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and im proving feature learning. In addition, building on our previously pro posed example-based EM-DETR framework, we adapt it to jointly learn from multiple domain-specific datasets, enabling fine-grained, example driven detection across modalities. Our model achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results, with image-level AUC scores exceeding previous SOTA by 1% point on four key findings in CXRs. We achieve a leading mAP50 in CXRs and mammography, surpassing EM-DETR trained on a single dataset by 2-3% points. This approach paves the way for scalable foundation models in medical imaging that leverage heterogeneous data while maintaining robust and generalizable performance.
zh_abstract: 基于深度学习（DL）的计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统在支持临床医生方面已显示出巨大前景，但其性能在很大程度上取决于大型、注释良好的数据集的可用性。在医学病变检测中，全面、标准化注释的稀缺以及现有数据集的异质性限制了稳健基础模型的发展。在这项工作中，我们引入一种新方法，通过整合针对解剖结构和异常均进行注释的多样医学图像数据集，构建用于病变检测的多域基础模型。我们首先提出一种学生-教师训练策略，以有效结合具有异质标签空间的数据集，减轻灾难性遗忘并改进特征学习。此外，在我们先前提出的基于示例的 EM-DETR 框架基础上，我们对其进行调整，使其能够联合学习多个领域特定数据集，从而实现跨模态的细粒度、示例驱动检测。我们的模型取得了最先进（state-of-the-art, SOTA）结果，在 CXR 的四项关键发现上，图像级 AUC 分数超过先前 SOTA 1 个百分点。我们在 CXR 和乳腺摄影中取得了领先的 mAP50，超过在单一数据集上训练的 EM-DETR 2-3 个百分点。这种方法为医学影像中可扩展的基础模型铺平了道路，这些模型利用异质数据，同时保持稳健且可泛化的性能。

title: CLADE: Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
zh_title: CLADE：证据粒度不足时的类别级作答
summary: 预印本提出检索增强模型在仅检索到粗粒度类别证据时直接作答的现象CLADE，并在生物医学问题上评测。
key_points: 定义“可解析的不足”这一检索证据情形
发现模型倾向作答而非弃答或再检索
在生物医学问答上进行评测
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，聚焦生物医学问答，证据有限
abstract: Retrieval-augmented systems often retrieve passages that are accurate and relevant but state the answer at a coarser level of granularity than the question requires. For example, a question may ask which specific disease a drug treats (familial hyperlipidemia), while the retrieved passage mentions the broader disease family (hyperlipidemia). Prior work on context sufficiency treats such coarse passages simply as insufficient. We argue that they form a distinct case, which we call resolvable insufficiency: text alone cannot settle the fine-grained answer, but the broader category it mentions maps to a short list of candidate answers in a domain ontology. When language models read these coarse, family-only passages, they exhibit a phenomenon we call Clade (Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence): they answer instead of abstaining or searching further. On biomedical questions from PrimeKG, family-only passages reduce abstention by 13.8 points compared to uninformative passages, and the resulting guesses are wrong about half the time. A counterfactual test confirms the cause: replacing an exact disease name with its broader family name lowers abstention by 17.4 points compared to deleting the sentence. Simple fixes like confidence filtering, scaling to a larger model, and explicitly instructing the model to abstain cannot resolve Clade, and this replicates on ecological species interactions in GloBI. Finally, we test whether an ontology can turn coarse passages into exact answers. Given the correct family, an ontology list includes the true answer in 98.5% of cases, but string matching finds that family on the page for only 19.8%. Letting the model choose the family raises this to 30.0% and end-to-end recovery from 10.0% to 26.8%. Overall, our results show when language models should stop guessing and consult an ontology, and highlight which steps of that process remain unsolved.
zh_abstract: 检索增强系统常常检索到准确且相关的段落，但其陈述答案的粒度比问题所要求的更粗。例如，问题可能询问某种药物可治疗哪种特定疾病（家族性高脂血症），而检索到的段落却提到更宽泛的疾病家族（高脂血症）。此前关于上下文充分性的工作将此类粗粒度段落简单视为不充分。我们认为它们构成一种不同的情形，称之为可解决的不足（resolvable insufficiency）：仅凭文本无法确定细粒度答案，但其提到的更宽泛类别可映射到领域本体中的一小份候选答案列表。当语言模型阅读这些仅含家族的粗粒度段落时，它们表现出我们称之为 Clade（Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence，缺陷证据下的类别级作答）的现象：它们给出答案，而不是弃答或进一步检索。在来自 PrimeKG 的生物医学问题上，与无信息段落相比，仅含家族的段落使弃答率降低 13.8 个百分点，而由此产生的猜测约有一半是错误的。反事实测试证实了原因：与删除句子相比，用更宽泛的家族名称替换确切疾病名称使弃答率降低 17.4 个百分点。简单的修复方法，如置信度过滤、扩大到更大模型以及明确指示模型弃答，都无法解决 Clade，并且这一点在 GloBI 的生态物种相互作用上得到复现。最后，我们测试本体能否将粗粒度段落转化为确切答案。给定正确的家族，本体列表在 98.5% 的情况下包含真实答案，但字符串匹配仅在 19.8% 的页面上找到该家族。让模型选择家族可将这一比例提高到 30.0%，并将端到端恢复率从 10.0% 提高到 26.8%。总体而言，我们的结果表明语言模型应在何时停止猜测并查阅本体，并突出该过程中哪些步骤仍未解决。

title: What Factors Matter for Collection-Level Counting with Human-AI Collaboration?
zh_title: 人机协作的集合级计数中哪些因素重要
summary: 在12项任务（含生物医学显微图像）中比较模型、估计器与适配策略对人机协作集合级计数的影响。
key_points: 统一人在回路计数框架跨12个任务比较
多模态模型可作为免训练起点
微调检测器在域偏移下表现不同
reason: 方法学预印本，跨任务对比有新意但非临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Many scientific and policy decisions require estimating the total number of target objects across a large image collection. Exhaustive human labeling is often infeasible, while raw model predictions can be biased, especially under domain shift. Recent human-AI estimation methods combine imperfect model predictions with limited human verification to obtain reliable collection-level estimates. However, existing work provides little guidance on how practitioners should choose among models, estimators, and adaptation strategies for a new deployment. We study these choices within a common human-in-the-loop counting framework across 12 tasks spanning biomedical microscopy, ground-level and aerial wildlife surveys, and overhead imagery of urban structures. Our results show that modern multimodal models provide a strong, training-free starting point for many tasks, while fine-tuned detectors become more advantageous at larger labeling budgets and across repeated deployments. Estimation efficiency improves further when model predictions are used to prioritize which units humans label, rather than sampling uniformly. We also find that each model's ranking quality can be estimated with a small pilot set, yielding practical guidance for selecting strategies on new counting tasks. In a field deployment on aerial pronghorn surveys, a task-specific adaptation of these methods meets the survey's $\pm 5\%$ tolerance after reviewing a median of only $3.2\%$ of collected images.
zh_abstract: 许多科学和政策决策需要估计大型图像集合中目标对象的总数。穷尽式人工标注往往不可行，而原始模型预测可能有偏，尤其是在域偏移下。近期的人-AI估计方法将不完美的模型预测与有限的人工核验相结合，以获得可靠的集合级估计。然而，现有工作很少指导从业者在新的部署中如何在模型、估计器和适应策略之间进行选择。我们在一个共同的人在回路计数框架内，跨12项任务研究这些选择，任务涵盖生物医学显微成像、地面和航空野生动物调查以及城市结构俯视影像。我们的结果表明，现代多模态模型为许多任务提供了强大的、无需训练的起点，而微调检测器在更大的标注预算和重复部署中更具优势。当使用模型预测来确定人类标注单元的优先级，而不是均匀采样时，估计效率进一步提高。我们还发现，每个模型的排序质量可通过小规模试点集估计，为在新计数任务上选择策略提供实用指导。在航空叉角羚调查的现场部署中，这些方法的任务特定适配在仅审阅所收集图像的中位数3.2%后，就满足调查的±5%容差。

title: From Tool State to Scientific Action: Auditing Decision Provenance in Biomedical Research Agents
zh_title: 生物医学研究智能体的决策溯源审计
summary: 预印本提出BioAgent-DF，通过在同一计算位点替换数值，检验科学智能体结论与引用证据的分离情况。
key_points: 用配对参考值与候选值检验证据溯源
八个SciFact批次中两模型出现可重复变化
完整还原可恢复证据集而结论保持不变
reason: 有新意的智能体审计预印本，仅小规模评测无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: A scientific agent can give the same verdict while reading and citing different evidence. BioAgent-DF tests this separation using paired reference and candidate values saved at the same scientific computation site. It restores or transplants those values at their original coordinates, then runs the agent on healthy hardware. Across eight SciFact batches, Qwen3.5-4B shows repeatable citation changes in three capture-claim combinations, and Gemma 3 4B IT shows repeatable read and citation changes in four. These seven combinations cover two claims. Full restoration recovers the reference evidence sets while verdicts remain unchanged. Verdict changes observed under the baseline prompt did not recur under the explicit-example prompt. Complementary tool and optimizer experiments distinguish recovery of numerical state, recovery of ranked lists, and restoration of an agent's visible history. These results show that an audit should track both the evidence an agent uses and its final answer. In hERG cardiac-safety assay allocation, silent numerical faults changed testing decisions while the fixed-budget shortlist kept the same number of compounds labeled as blockers. After the agent had used faulty values, restoring its earlier execution state and supplying certified scores recovered all 39 changed decisions, whereas replacing the prediction file recovered none; no incorrect action was committed. A streaming implementation of the arithmetic checks reduced the total time for forward execution and verification by 42.4% relative to the original FP64 implementation, with identical flags and recovery outputs.
zh_abstract: 一个科学智能体在阅读并引用不同证据时可能给出相同判定。BioAgent-DF 使用保存在同一科学计算位点的成对参考值和候选值来检验这种分离。它将这些值恢复或移植到其原始坐标，然后在无故障硬件上运行智能体。在八个 SciFact 批次中，Qwen3.5-4B 在三种捕获-主张组合中显示出可重复的引用变化，Gemma 3 4B IT 在四种组合中显示出可重复的读取和引用变化。这七种组合涵盖两个主张。完整恢复可找回参考证据集，而判定保持不变。在基线提示词下观察到的判定变化在明确示例提示词下未再出现。补充的工具和优化器实验区分了数值状态恢复、排序列表恢复以及智能体可见历史恢复。这些结果表明，审计应同时追踪智能体使用的证据及其最终答案。在 hERG 心脏安全性测定分配中，静默数值故障改变了检测决策，而固定预算候选短名单仍将相同数量的化合物标记为阻断剂。在智能体使用故障值后，恢复其较早的执行状态并提供经认证的评分可恢复全部 39 项改变的决策，而替换预测文件则未恢复任何一项；未执行任何错误操作。算术检查的流式实现相对于原始 FP64 实现将前向执行与验证的总时间减少了 42.4%，且标志和恢复输出完全相同。

title: A Concept-Based Interpretable Framework for Clinical Text-based Prediction via Token-Concept Attention without Concept Supervision
zh_title: 无概念监督的临床文本可解释预测框架
summary: 提出基于令牌-概念交叉注意力的框架，无需概念标注即可为临床文本预测提供概念级解释。
key_points: 无需概念标签的交叉注意力瓶颈
预训练语言模型嵌入文本与概念描述
输出令牌级概念相关性分数
reason: 预印本新方法，证据限于方法描述，属值得一看档。
abstract: Objective: Concept-based interpretation has emerged as a promising approach for explaining blackbox models using human-understandable, high-level concepts. However, most existing methods require annotated concept labels to train the model to identify concepts in the input, and obtaining such annotations in clinical text is often expensive. This study aims to enable concept-based interpretation for language models without concept supervision on clinical prediction tasks. Methods: We propose a novel framework that enables concept-based interpretation without concept supervision through a tailored cross-attention bottleneck. Clinical text and the text descriptions of medical concepts are first tokenized and embedded by a pretrained language model. A cross-attention module then estimates the presence of each concept for each text token, producing concept relevance scores that capture how concepts are involved throughout the note. These scores are pooled and used in a linear prediction layer to model clinical outcomes in an interpretable manner. Results: The performance of the proposed framework was compared against blackbox models across two tasks: chest trauma severity stratification using a private dataset and an in-hospital mortality prediction task using the publicly available MIMIC-III dataset. The proposed framework achieved AUROC values within 0.02 of the corresponding blackbox models. The framework also enabled cohort- and patient-level interpretation, capturing the overall concept importance across the cohort and patient-specific concept contributions. Conclusion: Our proposed framework realizes concept-based interpretation without requiring ground-truth concept presence labels. It improves the transparency of clinical text predictions while maintaining strong performance in clinical prediction tasks.
zh_abstract: 【目的】基于概念的解释已成为一种有前景的方法，可利用人类可理解的高层概念来解释黑箱模型。然而，大多数现有方法需要标注概念标签来训练模型识别输入中的概念，而在临床文本中获得此类标注往往代价高昂。本研究旨在使语言模型在临床预测任务中无需概念监督即可实现基于概念的解释。【方法】我们提出一种新颖框架，通过定制的交叉注意力瓶颈（cross-attention bottleneck）在无需概念监督的情况下实现基于概念的解释。临床文本和医学概念的文本描述首先由预训练语言模型进行分词和嵌入。随后，交叉注意力模块估计每个文本标记（token）对应的每个概念是否存在，生成概念相关性得分，以捕捉概念如何贯穿整个记录。这些得分被池化，并用于线性预测层，以可解释的方式建模临床结局。【结果】所提出框架的性能在两个任务上与黑箱模型进行比较：使用私有数据集的胸部创伤严重程度分层，以及使用公开可用的 MIMIC-III 数据集的院内死亡预测任务。所提出框架达到的 AUROC 值在相应黑箱模型的 0.02 以内。该框架还实现了队列水平和患者水平的解释，捕捉整个队列中的总体概念重要性以及患者特定的概念贡献。【结论】我们提出的框架无需真实概念存在标签即可实现基于概念的解释。它提高了临床文本预测的透明度，同时在临床预测任务中保持强劲性能。

title: MEOW: Medical Open-World Interactive Segmentation
zh_title: MEOW：医学开放世界交互式分割框架
summary: 预印本提出MEOW框架，将非交互分割骨干转为不更新参数的交互式开放世界学习器。
key_points: 结合无参数转导推理与记忆固化
在训练未见的类别上持续自我改进
可零样本迁移至micro-CT等其他模态
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本，描述中未见量化外部验证
abstract: In open-world recognition, machine learning models not only make predictions on unknown structures ("generalized open-set"), but also continually learn and improve from those predictions over time. Interactive segmentation, despite its access to user feedback, has so far remained confined to the open-set setting. In this work we introduce MEOW, the first framework that turns non-interactive segmentation backbones into interactive open-world learners without updating learnable model parameters. MEOW combines parameter-free transductive reasoning with memory consolidation to accumulate knowledge and thereby improve future performance. Focusing on medical data, we show that MEOW consistently improves its own predictions on classes never seen during training, and transfers zero-shot to unfamiliar domains, including micro-CT data and other imaging modalities.
zh_abstract: 在开放世界识别中，机器学习模型不仅对未知结构（“广义开放集”）进行预测，还会随着时间推移从这些预测中持续学习和改进。交互式分割尽管能够获得用户反馈，但迄今仍局限于开放集设定。在本工作中，我们引入MEOW，这是首个在不更新可学习模型参数的情况下将非交互式分割骨干网络转变为交互式开放世界学习器的框架。MEOW将无参数直推式推理与记忆巩固相结合，以积累知识并由此提升未来性能。聚焦医学数据，我们表明MEOW在训练期间从未见过的类别上持续改进自身预测，并能零样本迁移到不熟悉领域，包括显微CT（micro-CT）数据和其他成像模态。

title: MicroBT: Centroid-Guided Synergistic Learning for Multi-Modal Micro Brain Tumor Segmentation and Counting
zh_title: MicroBT：质心引导的多模态微小脑肿瘤分割与计数
summary: 提出质心锚定的多模态框架 MicroBT，用于亚3毫米微小脑肿瘤的分割与实例计数，以缓解基于重叠目标对大病灶的偏好。
key_points: 指出重叠类目标会系统性压制3毫米以下微小病灶
以尺度不变的病灶质心为锚点进行协同学习
同时做像素级分割与实例级计数，属预印本方法
reason: 有新意的分割计数方法预印本，缺乏外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Multi-modal brain tumor segmentation is essential for clinical diagnosis, radiotherapy planning, and longitudinal monitoring. While recent studies have achieved remarkable overall segmentation performance, they rely on overlap-based objectives that inherently favor large regions, causing sub-3 mm micro-lesions to be systematically suppressed during training. Moreover, existing pixel-level segmentation frameworks lack explicit instance-level modeling, leading to unreliable lesion counting that directly impacts clinical staging and therapeutic decisions. To address these challenges, we propose MicroBT, a unified multi-modal framework for micro brain tumor segmentation and counting. Our core insight is that a fundamental geometric property is inherently scale-invariant: regardless of size, each lesion possesses a well-defined centroid. Leveraging this, we first devise a centroid-anchored synergistic paradigm that utilizes predicted centroids as shared anchors to simultaneously condition dense segmentation and instance-level localization. To counteract the tumor size imbalance, we further devise a Volume-Calibrated Loss (VC-Loss) that adaptively amplifies the gradient contribution of micro-lesions, alongside a Size-Aware Curriculum Optimization (SACO) that stabilizes multi-task training by establishing global representations before progressively unlocking fine-grained localization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MicroBT outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly on metastases, where micro-lesion ($\leq 3$ mm) localization precision improves by approximately 7% and counting estimation errors decrease by approximately 26%. The code is available at https://github.com/leonlou921/MicroBT.
zh_abstract: 多模态脑肿瘤分割对于临床诊断、放疗计划和纵向监测至关重要。尽管近期研究已取得显著的总体分割性能，但它们依赖基于重叠的目标函数，这些目标函数天然偏向大区域，导致小于3 mm的微小病灶在训练期间被系统性抑制。此外，现有像素级分割框架缺乏显式的实例级建模，导致病灶计数不可靠，直接影响临床分期和治疗决策。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MicroBT，一个用于微小脑肿瘤分割与计数的统一多模态框架。我们的核心洞察是，一个基本几何属性本质上是尺度不变的：无论大小如何，每个病灶都具有明确的质心。利用这一点，我们首先设计了一种以质心为锚的协同范式，利用预测质心作为共享锚点，同时为密集分割和实例级定位提供条件。为抵消肿瘤大小不平衡，我们进一步设计了体积校准损失（VC-Loss），自适应放大微小病灶的梯度贡献，并配合尺寸感知课程优化（SACO），通过在逐步解锁细粒度定位之前建立全局表示来稳定多任务训练。大量实验表明，MicroBT优于最先进方法，尤其是在转移瘤上，微小病灶（≤ 3 mm）定位精度提高约7%，计数估计误差降低约26%。代码可在https://github.com/leonlou921/MicroBT获取。

title: Performance of Claude 3.5 Sonnet Compared to Human Readers of The New England Journal of Medicine Clinical Case Challenges.
zh_title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet 与人类读者解答 NEJM 病例挑战比较
summary: 在 20 例 NEJM 临床病例挑战上，Claude 3.5 Sonnet 多模态诊断准确率约半数且显著高于网站人类应答者。
key_points: 20 例 NEJM 病例，输入文本加全部图像
模型正确率约 50%，显著高于人类应答者
样本量小，比较对象为网站自愿答题者
reason: 有人机对照但仅 20 例、非临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [PRiMER (Leawood, Kan.)] Large language models (LLMs) can pass the US medical licensing exam and outperform residents on the family medicine in-training exam. The diagnostic performance of LLMs when applied to more complex medical cases, however, remains unknown. We evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of Claude (Anthropic), an LLM, on 20 case challenges published in The New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM). For each case, we presented Claude 3.5 Sonnet with multimodal input, including the text and all corresponding images from the cases. Claude was instructed to give an answer among multiple choices. We compared Claude's diagnostic accuracy to human respondents on the NEJM website. Claude 3.5 Sonnet diagnosed cases correctly about half the time, and at a significantly higher rate than NEJM readers (beta-binomial odds ratio 2.79; 95% CI [profile-likelihood] 1.09-7.01; P = 0.031). Claude was highly self-consistent in repeated exposure to questions, with perfect accuracy (100%) in nine cases and no accuracy (0%) in 10 cases, with one case at 90% accuracy. Human accuracy ranged from 9%-63% across cases. Claude's performance was better on easier cases (ie, those with human accuracy >25%). Claude 3.5 Sonnet demonstrated significantly higher diagnostic accuracy compared to medical journal readers, though with notable variability in performance. Further research comparing consistency and reliability of artificially intelligent diagnostic capabilities to that of licensed physicians is needed.
zh_abstract: [PRiMER (Leawood, Kan.)] 大语言模型（LLMs）能够通过美国医师执照考试，并在家庭医学在训考试中表现优于住院医师。然而，LLMs 应用于更复杂医学病例时的诊断表现仍未知。我们在《The New England Journal of Medicine》（NEJM）发表的 20 个病例挑战中评估了大语言模型 Claude（Anthropic）的诊断准确性。对于每个病例，我们向 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 提供多模态输入，包括病例文本及所有对应图像。Claude 被指示在多个选项中选择一个答案。我们将 Claude 的诊断准确性与 NEJM 网站上的人类应答者进行了比较。Claude 3.5 Sonnet 约有一半时间正确诊断病例，且正确率显著高于 NEJM 读者（beta-binomial 优势比 2.79；95% CI [profile-likelihood] 1.09-7.01；P = 0.031）。Claude 在重复接触问题时高度自洽：9 个病例准确率为完美（100%），10 个病例准确率为零（0%），1 个病例准确率为 90%。不同病例中人类准确率范围为 9%-63%。Claude 在较容易的病例（即人类准确率 >25% 的病例）上表现更好。与医学期刊读者相比，Claude 3.5 Sonnet 表现出显著更高的诊断准确性，尽管其表现存在明显变异性。仍需进一步研究，将人工智能诊断能力的一致性和可靠性与执业医师进行比较。

title: FedVP: Federated Learning across Heterogeneous Models by Pooling Locally Trained Verifiers
zh_title: FedVP：以本地验证器汇聚实现异构模型联邦学习
summary: 提出联邦验证器池范式，各机构冻结不同 LLM 主干预训练本地验证器并汇总判断，在五个医学问答数据集评估。
key_points: 不聚合参数，通过共享验证器实现异构协作
支持不同家族、不同规模 LLM，主干保持冻结
在五个公开医学问答数据集上评测
reason: 方法有新颖性且多数据集评测，但为预印本、无临床落地验证
abstract: Conventional federated learning relies on the shared model backbone to aggregate client updates, limiting collaboration among institutions that deploy large language models (LLMs) from different families and at different scales. We propose Federated Verifier Pool (FEDVP), a new federated learning paradigm that enables heterogeneous clients to collaborate through shared verification rather than parameter aggregation. Each client trains a verifier using local data and responses generated by its chosen LLM backbone. The server pools these independently trained verifiers and combines their judgments to select answers without merging model parameters. This allows both LLM backbones and verifiers to differ in architecture and size, while keeping the LLM backbones frozen and deriving collaborative gains from improved answer selection. We evaluate FEDVP across five public medical question-answering datasets treated as federated clients, using Qwen and LLaMA backbones ranging from 3B to 14B parameters. FEDVP consistently improves performance across all five clients and outperforms the strongest conventional federated baselines by 1.46-5.79 percentage points in mean accuracy.
zh_abstract: 传统联邦学习依赖共享模型骨干来聚合客户端更新，这限制了部署来自不同家族、不同规模大语言模型（LLMs）的机构之间开展协作。我们提出联邦验证器池（Federated Verifier Pool, FEDVP），这是一种新的联邦学习范式，使异构客户端能够通过共享验证而非参数聚合进行协作。每个客户端使用本地数据及其所选LLM骨干生成的回答训练一个验证器。服务器汇集这些独立训练的验证器，并结合它们的判断来选择答案，而无需合并模型参数。这允许LLM骨干和验证器在架构和规模上均不相同，同时保持LLM骨干冻结，并从改进的答案选择中获得协作收益。我们在五个被视为联邦客户端的公开医学问答数据集上评估FEDVP，使用参数规模从3B到14B的Qwen和LLaMA骨干。FEDVP在全部五个客户端上持续提升性能，并在平均准确率上比最强的传统联邦基线高出1.46-5.79个百分点。

title: TransGHOST: Real-Time, Synthesis-Free Reconstruction of Instrument-Occluded Regions in Ophthalmic Microsurgery
zh_title: TransGHOST：眼科显微手术遮挡区实时重建
summary: 预印本提出非生成式、因果参考引导的重建流程，实时还原眼科显微手术中被器械遮挡的区域，并给出逐像素置信度与来源。
key_points: 非生成式安全模式可实时运行
提供逐像素置信度与来源，并标记弃权
在新构建的兽医临床数据上评估
reason: 思路新颖的手术视频方法预印本，证据限于自建数据集，属值得一看档
abstract: Intraoperative scene perception in ophthalmic microsurgery is limited by instrument occlusion: when a tool enters the high-magnification field, it conceals tissue from both the surgeon and the perception components of robot-assisted systems that process the video. Generative inpainting can remove the occluder but replaces the missing image content with synthesis, which is unsuitable when visual provenance matters. Many video inpainters also depend on future frames and cannot operate online. We present TransGHOST, a causal reference-guided reconstruction pipeline whose non-generative safe mode operates in real time. Every restored value is obtained by resampling a recorded frame using geometric transforms fitted only to visible regions. The system provides per-pixel confidence and provenance and marks unsupported pixels as abstentions. We evaluate TransGHOST on a new veterinary clinical corpus of canine cataract surgery with pixel-level instrument and anatomy labels. Only the occluded region is scored, and each scoring target is verified to differ from the reference supplied to the system. Safe mode reaches 31.89 dB masked PSNR and 0.915 masked SSIM at 51.7 ms median and 85.5 ms 95th-percentile latency. On a pre-declared held-out cohort using instrument cutouts excluded from segmentation training, it reaches 29.83 dB masked PSNR, while matched-mask evaluation on validation shows a 3.45 dB advantage over LaMa. Region-aware reference selection improves masked PSNR by 3.60 dB over recency when candidate references can themselves be occluded. Reference-age analysis further defines the operating interval for the brief, repeated occlusions targeted by TransGHOST.
zh_abstract: 眼科显微手术中的术中场景感知受到器械遮挡的限制：当器械进入高倍放大视野时，它会遮挡组织，使外科医生以及处理视频的机器人辅助系统的感知组件均无法看到组织。生成式图像修复可以去除遮挡物，但会用合成内容替代缺失的图像内容，这在视觉来源很重要时不适用。许多视频修复器还依赖未来帧，无法在线运行。我们提出 TransGHOST，一种因果参考引导重建流程，其非生成式安全模式可实时运行。每个恢复值均通过仅对可见区域拟合的几何变换，对已记录帧进行重采样获得。系统提供逐像素置信度和来源，并将不支持的像素标记为弃权。我们在一个新的犬白内障手术兽医临床语料库上评估 TransGHOST，该语料库具有像素级器械和解剖标签。仅对遮挡区域评分，并验证每个评分目标均与提供给系统的参考不同。安全模式在 51.7 ms 中位延迟和 85.5 ms 第 95 百分位延迟下达到 31.89 dB 掩膜 PSNR 和 0.915 掩膜 SSIM。在一个预先声明的留出队列上，使用未纳入分割训练的器械抠除区域，其达到 29.83 dB 掩膜 PSNR，而在验证集上的匹配掩膜评估显示其相较于 LaMa 有 3.45 dB 优势。当候选参考本身可能被遮挡时，区域感知参考选择相较于最近帧选择将掩膜 PSNR 提高 3.60 dB。参考帧时龄分析进一步界定了 TransGHOST 所针对的短暂、反复遮挡的工作区间。

title: The evolving landscape of artificial intelligence in cholecystectomy: a bibliometric and science-mapping analysis.
zh_title: 胆囊切除术AI研究的文献计量与科学图谱分析
summary: 基于559篇文献的文献计量分析，梳理胆囊切除术相关AI研究的主题演变与合作格局。

abstract: [Updates in surgery] To map the global research landscape and thematic evolution of artificial intelligence (AI)-related research in cholecystectomy and to identify major contributors, collaboration patterns, and intellectual foundations. English-language articles and reviews were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection and Scopus. After deduplication and eligibility screening, 559 publications were included. Publication trends, scientific collaboration, keyword co-occurrence, conceptual structure, thematic evolution, and co-citation and citation-burst patterns were analyzed using bibliometrix, VOSviewer, and Python. Research activity increased markedly in recent years, with 424 publications (75.8%) appearing between 2022 and 2025. China contributed the largest publication output, whereas the United States received the highest total citations. Keyword and conceptual-structure analyses identified research domains involving AI and computational methods, surgical workflow and intraoperative visual analysis, and computer-vision-based applications. Thematic evolution suggested a progression from early workflow- and convolutional-neural-network-related research toward machine learning, deep learning, radiomics, surgical phase recognition, and more recent transformer-related approaches. Twinanda et al. [1] showed the strongest citation burst and occupied a prominent position in the reference co-citation network. AI-related research in cholecystectomy has expanded rapidly and become increasingly diverse in its methodological and application-oriented focus. Current bibliometric patterns suggest growing attention to workflow analysis, computer vision, surgical phase recognition, and newer model architectures. Further multicenter validation and prospective clinical evaluation are needed to determine whether these developments translate into generalizable and clinically meaningful applications.
zh_abstract: [Updates in surgery] 旨在绘制胆囊切除术中人工智能（AI）相关研究的全球研究图景和主题演变，并识别主要贡献者、合作模式和知识基础。从 Web of Science 核心合集和 Scopus 检索英文论文和综述。经去重和合格性筛选后，纳入 559 篇出版物。使用 bibliometrix、VOSviewer 和 Python 分析出版趋势、科学合作、关键词共现、概念结构、主题演变以及共被引和引文爆发模式。近年来研究活动显著增加，2022 年至 2025 年间发表了 424 篇出版物（75.8%）。中国贡献的出版物产出最多，而美国获得的总被引次数最高。关键词和概念结构分析识别出涉及 AI 与计算方法、手术工作流程与术中视觉分析、以及基于计算机视觉的应用等研究领域。主题演变提示从早期工作流程和卷积神经网络相关研究，逐步转向机器学习、深度学习、影像组学、手术阶段识别以及更近期的 transformer 相关方法。Twinanda 等 [1] 显示出最强的引文爆发，并在参考文献共被引网络中占据突出位置。胆囊切除术中 AI 相关研究迅速扩展，其方法学和应用导向重点日益多样化。当前文献计量模式表明，对工作流程分析、计算机视觉、手术阶段识别和更新模型架构的关注日益增长。需要进一步的多中心验证和前瞻性临床评估，以确定这些进展是否能转化为可推广且具有临床意义的应用。

abstract: [Cardiovascular & hematological disorders drug targets] One of the main causes of death in the world is Cardiovascular Diseases (CVDs). The number of acute myocardial infarctions and fatalities may be considerably decreased by early detection of Cardiovascular (CV) events. However, the efficacy of conventional data analysis for diagnosis and treatment is hampered by the complexity of the disease and the wide range of affecting factors. Large, multidimensional medical datasets can be processed by Artificial Intelligence (AI) owing to its sophisticated computational capabilities. This narrative review was conducted through a structured search of PubMed/ MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar to identify peer-reviewed literature on artificial intelligence in cardiovascular medicine. Relevant studies addressing diagnosis, risk stratification, prognostic prediction, cardiovascular imaging, and clinical implementation were critically evaluated with emphasis on methodological quality, external validation, clinical applicability, and implementation challenges. AI-based systems have been shown to be more effective at classifying risk, predicting outcomes, and spotting illness trends. Early diagnosis and more customized treatment plans are made possible by these algorithms' ability to examine intricate relationships in large healthcare datasets. Clinical applications have improved auxiliary diagnostic instruments and increased patient care effectiveness. AI offers more accuracy and flexibility than traditional approaches when handling high-dimensional CVD data. It may reduce the burden of disease and promote tailored treatment regimens. However, data quality, standardization, and ethical concerns for broad use remain issues. The detection and treatment of CVDs are being revolutionized by AI-powered technology. Their use in clinical settings may improve cardiovascular care and lower the number of heart disease-related deaths worldwide.
zh_abstract: [Cardiovascular & Hematological Disorders Drug Targets]心血管疾病（Cardiovascular Diseases, CVDs）是世界上主要死亡原因之一。早期发现心血管（CV）事件可能显著减少急性心肌梗死和死亡的数量。然而，传统数据分析在诊断和治疗中的有效性受到疾病复杂性及影响因素广泛的阻碍。人工智能（Artificial Intelligence, AI）由于其先进的计算能力，可处理大型多维医学数据集。本叙述性综述通过结构化检索 PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science 和 Google Scholar 进行，以识别关于人工智能在心血管医学中应用的同行评审文献。对涉及诊断、风险分层、预后预测、心血管影像和临床实施的相关研究进行了批判性评价，重点关注方法学质量、外部验证、临床适用性和实施挑战。基于 AI 的系统已被证明在风险分类、结局预测和识别疾病趋势方面更有效。这些算法能够检查大型医疗保健数据集中的复杂关系，从而使早期诊断和更个性化的治疗方案成为可能。临床应用改进了辅助诊断工具并提高了患者照护效率。在处理高维 CVD 数据时，AI 比传统方法提供更高的准确性和灵活性。它可能减轻疾病负担并促进个体化治疗方案。然而，数据质量、标准化以及广泛使用的伦理问题仍然是问题。AI 驱动的技术正在彻底改变 CVD 的检测和治疗。其在临床环境中的使用可能改善心血管照护并降低全球心脏病相关死亡人数。
