title: Artificial Intelligence in Neuroradiology: Transforming Diagnosis, Prognostication, and Workflow.
source: PubMed · The Indian journal of radiology & imaging
zh_title: 神经影像AI综述：诊断、预后与工作流
summary: 综述以工作流框架梳理AI在神经影像的调度、质控、重建、病灶检测、治疗规划与预后应用。
key_points: 覆盖神经影像全临床工作流
部分工具已进入真实临床实施
外部验证、人机对比与校准仍不足
reason: 工作流导向综述，无原始数据，增量档
abstract: [The Indian journal of radiology & imaging] Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping neuroimaging across the entirety of the clinical workflow, encompassing patient scheduling, scan quality assurance, image acquisition and reconstruction, automated lesion detection, pathological characterization, treatment planning, and outcome prognostication. This review synthesizes contemporary evidence through a workflow-centric framework, with particular emphasis on AI tools that have achieved real-world clinical implementation. Although reported technical performance across these domains is frequently compelling, critical deficiencies persist in external validation, human-AI benchmarking, model calibration, and standardized performance reporting, collectively impeding full clinical integration. Emerging evidence suggests that the role of the neuroradiologist is transitioning toward a collaborative human-AI paradigm, rather than one of displacement.
zh_abstract: [《印度放射学与影像学杂志》] 人工智能（Artificial intelligence, AI）正在重塑整个临床工作流程中的神经影像学，涵盖患者预约安排、扫描质量保证、图像采集与重建、自动病灶检测、病理学表征、治疗计划和结局预测。本综述通过以工作流程为中心的框架综合当代证据，特别强调已实现真实世界临床实施的 AI 工具。尽管这些领域报告的技术性能往往令人信服，但在外部验证、人-AI 基准评估、模型校准和标准化性能报告方面仍存在关键缺陷，共同阻碍了完整的临床整合。新兴证据表明，神经放射科医生的角色正在向人-AI 协作范式转变，而非被取代。

title: An artificial intelligence assisted framework for automated quantified root canal curvature measurement on periapical radiographs.
zh_title: AI 自动量化根管弯曲度
summary: 牙科研究用 YOLO26n-seg 分割根尖片牙根，结合方向标准化、中心线提取与三点圆拟合自动测量根管弯曲角并分级。
key_points: YOLO26n-seg 分割牙根并区分单/多根牙
图像算法标准化方向并拟合切线段测角
以人工判定的参考标准验证框架性能
reason: 单中心、小样本、仅报告测量一致性，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of dental sciences] Root canal curvature is a complex anatomical variation that complicates endodontic treatments. Traditionally, dentists rely on two-dimensional periapical radiographs (PA) and manual methods to estimate curvature angles. However, this conventional approach is highly time-consuming and subjective, often leading to inconsistent measurements. This study aims to develop a fully automated, objective framework for precise angular measurement and severity grading of root canal curvature. The YOLO26n-seg model was employed to segment roots and classify single- or multi-rooted teeth from PA. Furthermore, we proposed an image processing algorithm that standardized orientation, extracted centerlines, and applied three-point circle fitting to establish tangential lines for curvature measurement. The framework's performance was validated against a ground truth determined by five experienced dentists. YOLO26n-seg achieved outstanding segmentation precision (98.8%), sensitivity (97.3%), and intersection over union (96.2%). For angular measurement, the framework demonstrated high accuracy with errors of merely 0.7-1.6 degrees compared to manual assessments, yielding a root mean square error of 1.2° and R2 up to 98.9%. Moreover, the automated system reduced average processing time per PA from 39.9 to 70.8 s to just 0.6-1.7 s, an approximately 44-fold increase in efficiency. The proposed automated framework for root canal curvature measurement provides accurate and consistent geometric data, offering robust support for clinical diagnostic needs. By enhancing evaluation efficiency and reducing the diagnostic burden on clinicians, this system serves as a valuable auxiliary tool that further advances the standardization of dental imaging analysis.
zh_abstract: [Journal of dental sciences] 根管弯曲是一种复杂的解剖变异，使牙髓治疗复杂化。传统上，牙医依赖二维根尖周X线片（PA）和手工方法估计弯曲角度。然而，这种传统方法非常耗时且主观，常导致测量不一致。本研究旨在开发一个全自动、客观的框架，用于根管弯曲的精确角度测量和严重程度分级。采用 YOLO26n-seg 模型从 PA 中分割牙根并对单根或多根牙进行分类。此外，我们提出一种图像处理算法，该算法标准化方向、提取中心线，并应用三点圆拟合建立用于弯曲测量的切线。该框架的性能以五名经验丰富牙医确定的真值进行验证。YOLO26n-seg 取得了出色的分割精度（98.8%）、灵敏度（97.3%）和交并比（96.2%）。对于角度测量，该框架表现出高准确性，与人工评估相比误差仅为 0.7-1.6 度，均方根误差为 1.2°，R2 高达 98.9%。此外，该自动化系统将每张 PA 的平均处理时间从 39.9 至 70.8 秒缩短至仅 0.6-1.7 秒，效率提高约 44 倍。所提出的根管弯曲自动测量框架提供准确且一致的几何数据，为临床诊断需求提供有力支持。通过提高评估效率并减轻临床医生的诊断负担，该系统作为一种有价值的辅助工具，进一步推进牙科影像分析的标准化。

title: Deep learning-based automated per-tooth detection and segmentation from unretracted smile photographs.
zh_title: 自然微笑照片的深度学习逐牙检测与分割
summary: 在 1471 张自然微笑照片上比较 15 个 YOLO 模型并结合 HQ-SAM 实现逐牙检测与分割。
key_points: 自建 1471 张微笑照片标注数据集
比较 3 个架构族共 15 个 YOLO 模型
两阶段流程：检测器+HQ-SAM 分割，75 张子集评估
reason: 单中心小样本回顾性、仅内部评估，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of dental sciences] Natural smile photographs are universally accessible yet no automated method achieves clinically acceptable per-tooth detection from these images. Existing frameworks require lip-retracted intraoral views, and prior work on smile images achieved insufficient accuracy. This study developed a per-tooth detection and segmentation pipeline for natural smile photographs and assessed its applicability to digital smile design. A total of 1471 smile photographs were annotated via model-assisted labeling. Fifteen You Only Look Once (YOLO) models across three architecture families and five size tiers were compared. A two-stage pipeline combined the best-performing detector with high-quality Segment Anything Model (HQ-SAM) for per-tooth mask segmentation. Segmentation quality was evaluated against manually drawn ground truth on a 75-image subset, and intra-rater reliability was assessed on 20 images. YOLO12x achieved the highest mean average precision (mAP 50-95) of 0.915. YOLO12 variants occupied the top two positions in precision. HQ-SAM segmentation yielded a mean dice similarity coefficient (Dice) of 0.970 ± 0.055 on 709 matched teeth without dental-specific fine-tuning. A domain comparison confirmed that the smile-trained model substantially outperformed a retracted-view model (mean average precision at intersection over union (IoU) 0.50 [mAP50] 0.959 vs 0.600). Per-tooth detection and segmentation from natural smile photographs are feasible using data-efficient fine-tuning on a modestly sized, progressively annotated dataset. The narrow performance gap across model sizes suggests compact variants are viable for resource-constrained deployment. Zero-shot HQ-SAM segmentation achieves strong agreement with manual annotations without dental-specific fine-tuning.
zh_abstract: [Journal of dental sciences] 自然微笑照片普遍可获取，但尚无自动化方法能从这些图像中实现临床可接受的逐牙检测。现有框架需要唇部牵拉的口内视图，而既往针对微笑图像的工作准确性不足。本研究开发了一种用于自然微笑照片的逐牙检测与分割流程，并评估其在数字化微笑设计中的适用性。通过模型辅助标注对总共 1471 张微笑照片进行了标注。比较了来自三个架构家族和五个尺寸层级的 15 个 You Only Look Once（YOLO）模型。两阶段流程将性能最佳的检测器与高质量的 Segment Anything Model（HQ-SAM）结合，用于逐牙掩膜分割。在 75 张图像子集上，以人工绘制的真值评估分割质量，并在 20 张图像上评估评分者内信度。YOLO12x 取得了最高的平均精度均值（mAP 50-95），为 0.915。YOLO12 变体在精确率上占据前两位。HQ-SAM 分割在 709 颗匹配牙齿上产生了平均 Dice 相似系数（Dice）0.970 ± 0.055，且未进行牙科特异性微调。领域比较证实，经微笑图像训练的模型显著优于牵拉视图模型（交并比（IoU）0.50 下的平均精度均值 [mAP50] 为 0.959 对 0.600）。在规模适中、逐步标注的数据集上使用数据高效微调，从自然微笑照片进行逐牙检测和分割是可行的。不同模型尺寸之间性能差距较小，提示紧凑型变体在资源受限部署中可行。零样本 HQ-SAM 分割无需牙科特异性微调即与人工标注达到高度一致性。

title: Targeting PRMT5 Across Cancers and AI-Driven Discovery of Candidate Compounds
zh_title: PRMT5泛癌分析与AI虚拟筛选候选化合物
summary: 预印本将PRMT5泛癌多组学分析与深度神经网络虚拟筛选结合，从约150万化合物中优选3个候选并做分子对接与动力学模拟。
key_points: 多组学分析显示PRMT5在GBM、LGG、KIRC中具肿瘤特异性预后意义
深度神经网络筛选约150万PubChem化合物，ROC-AUC 0.9857
优选3个候选分子，经对接、ADMET与100 ns分子动力学模拟评估
reason: 预印本计算类筛选研究，仅对接与模拟验证，无实验或外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Protein arginine methyltransferase 5 (PRMT5) is a promising anticancer target, yet existing inhibitors shown limited clinical efficacy. Here, we paired multi-omics pan-cancer profiling with a machine learning virtual screening pipeline. Bioinformatics analyses with TIMER3, GEPIA2, UALCAN/CPTAC, the Human Protein Atlas, cBioPortal, STRING and Enrichr revealed widespread of PRMT5 mRNA expression, protein abundance, survival, genetic alteration, immune infiltration and co-expression networks with tumor-specific prognostic impact in GBM, LGG and KIRC. A deep neural network screened about 1.5 million PubChem compounds and deep neural network reached a ROC-AUC = 0.9857 and prioritized three candidates, CID 44345182, CID 2794188 and CID 44345334. Subsequent molecular docking against PRMT5 (PDB ID: 4X61), ADMET filtering and toxicity prediction, and 100 ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulations identified CID 44345182 as the potential hit, similar the docking scores of -9.8 compared with -9.2 kcal/mol for the reference ligand in binding affinity and trajectory stability. These findings clarify the context-dependent roles of PRMT5 and further experiment validations are needed to establish CID 44345182 as a promising candidate.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质精氨酸甲基转移酶 5（PRMT5）是一个有前景的抗癌靶点，但现有抑制剂显示出有限的临床疗效。在此，我们将多组学泛癌分析与机器学习虚拟筛选流程相结合。使用 TIMER3、GEPIA2、UALCAN/CPTAC、Human Protein Atlas、cBioPortal、STRING 和 Enrichr 进行的生物信息学分析揭示了 PRMT5 mRNA 表达、蛋白丰度、生存、遗传改变、免疫浸润和共表达网络的广泛分布，并在 GBM、LGG 和 KIRC 中具有肿瘤特异性预后影响。深度神经网络筛选了约 150 万个 PubChem 化合物，深度神经网络达到 ROC-AUC = 0.9857，并优先选出三个候选化合物：CID 44345182、CID 2794188 和 CID 44345334。随后的针对 PRMT5（PDB ID：4X61）的分子对接、ADMET 过滤和毒性预测，以及 100 ns 分子动力学（MD）模拟，确定 CID 44345182 为潜在命中化合物，其对接评分为 -9.8，而参考配体为 -9.2 kcal/mol，在结合亲和力和轨迹稳定性方面相似。这些发现阐明了 PRMT5 的背景依赖性作用，仍需进一步实验验证以确立 CID 44345182 为有前景的候选化合物。

title: A physics-informed neural network framework for inferring infinitesimal phase response curves from finite-pulse circadian recordings
zh_title: 物理信息神经网络从有限脉冲记录推断昼夜节律相位响应曲线
summary: bioRxiv 预印本提出PINN-iPRC框架，将相位方程嵌入损失函数，从常规有限脉冲刺激响应记录推断iPRC。
key_points: 以神经网络表示未知iPRC并嵌入相位方程
无需详细机制模型或群体重置实验
目标为预测节律对新刺激时序的响应
reason: 预印本方法学工作，属基础节律建模，临床与AI医疗相关性间接
abstract: Biological clocks reset and entrain to external cues in a phase-dependent manner. The infinitesimal phase response curve (iPRC) provides the local dynamical rule underlying this process by quantifying how an input changes the instantaneous phase velocity of an oscillator. Inferring iPRCs would make it possible to predict how rhythms respond to new stimulus timings and durations, but existing approaches often require detailed mechanistic models, long perturbation recordings, or specialized population-level resetting experiments. Here we introduce Physics-informed neural network for iPRC inference (PINN-iPRC), a physics-informed neural network framework for inferring iPRCs from standard finite-pulse stimulus-response recordings. PINN-iPRC represents the unknown iPRC as a neural network and embeds the phase equation into the loss function, identifying the iPRC that leads to the observed transient phase trajectory under the known stimulus. In synthetic oscillators, PINN-iPRC accurately recovered iPRCs from finite-pulse recordings, including complex ones that are difficult to capture with simpler parametric reconstructions. Applied to existing experimental Arabidopsis circadian recordings, PINN-iPRC recovered iPRCs comparable to those obtained from specialized population-level resetting experiments, while requiring only conventional stimulus-response trajectories. The inferred iPRCs were further used to predict finite-duration PRCs and circadian peak phases across photoperiods. In particular, the predicted near-invariance of the prr7 peak phase across 8-16 h of darkness was consistent with independently published prr7-11 root recordings. These results support PINN-iPRC as a practical physics-informed approach for extracting interpretable phase-sensitivity functions from routine biological oscillator recordings, with potential applications in experimental design, entrainment prediction, and chronotherapeutic or pharmacological schedule optimization.
zh_abstract: 生物钟以相位依赖的方式重置并同步到外部线索。无穷小相位响应曲线（infinitesimal phase response curve, iPRC）通过量化输入如何改变振荡器的瞬时相位速度，提供了这一过程背后的局部动力学规则。推断 iPRC 将使得预测节律如何对新的刺激时机和持续时间作出反应成为可能，但现有方法通常需要详细的机制模型、长时间的扰动记录或专门的群体水平重置实验。在这里，我们介绍用于 iPRC 推断的物理信息神经网络（Physics-informed neural network for iPRC inference, PINN-iPRC），这是一个从标准有限脉冲刺激-响应记录中推断 iPRC 的物理信息神经网络框架。PINN-iPRC 将未知 iPRC 表示为神经网络，并将相位方程嵌入损失函数，从而识别出在已知刺激下导致观察到瞬态相位轨迹的 iPRC。在合成振荡器中，PINN-iPRC 从有限脉冲记录中准确恢复了 iPRC，包括难以用更简单参数化重建捕捉的复杂 iPRC。应用于现有实验拟南芥昼夜节律记录时，PINN-iPRC 恢复的 iPRC 与从专门群体水平重置实验获得的 iPRC 相当，同时仅需常规刺激-响应轨迹。推断出的 iPRC 进一步用于预测有限持续时间 PRC 和不同光周期下的昼夜节律峰值相位。特别是，预测的 prr7 峰值相位在 8–16 小时黑暗条件下近似不变，这与独立发表的 prr7-11 根记录一致。这些结果支持 PINN-iPRC 作为一种实用的物理信息方法，从常规生物振荡器记录中提取可解释的相位敏感性函数，并在实验设计、同步预测以及时间治疗或药理学方案优化中具有潜在应用。

title: EigenGradCAM with AugSmooth: Enhancing Explainability and Precision in Multi-Stage Alzheimer's Disease Detection
zh_title: EigenGradCAM与AugSmooth提升阿尔茨海默病多阶段检测可解释性
summary: arXiv预印本提出结合特征向量Grad-CAM与梯度平滑的可解释深度学习方案，用2D轴位MRI做四分类AD分期。
key_points: 用PCA处理梯度加权卷积层并加高斯噪声稳定热图
以WGAN-GP生成样本缓解中度痴呆类别不平衡
声称提升显著图定位精度与稳定性，未经同行评审
reason: 预印本方法改进，缺外部验证与临床对照，属增量档
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurological disorder associated with memory loss, cognitive decline, and behavioral disturbances. Early and accurate diagnosis is essential, yet MRI-based deep learning models often lack interpretability, limiting their clinical use. This study presents an explainable deep learning approach for four-class AD staging using 2D axial MRI images. The method combines eigenvector-based Grad-CAM with gradient smoothing to improve saliency localization and heatmap stability. Principal component analysis is applied to gradient-weighted convolutional layers, while Gaussian noise is added to saliency weights before decomposition. To address class imbalance in the Moderate Dementia category, Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) generates synthetic samples to balance the four-stage training distribution. Custom convolutional neural networks are trained on the Best Alzheimer MRI Dataset, achieving 97.2% test accuracy, 97.0% balanced accuracy, and a Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.944. The area under the ROC curve ranges from 0.96 to 0.99 across classes. Generated heatmaps highlight the hippocampus and entorhinal cortex, regions associated with Alzheimer's disease biomarkers. These findings suggest that the proposed approach combines strong classification performance with improved model interpretability, although further clinical validation is needed.
zh_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）是一种进行性神经系统疾病，与记忆丧失、认知衰退和行为障碍相关。早期且准确的诊断至关重要，但基于 MRI 的深度学习模型通常缺乏可解释性，限制了其临床应用。本研究提出一种可解释的深度学习方法，使用 2D 轴位 MRI 图像进行四分类 AD 分期。该方法将基于特征向量的 Grad-CAM 与梯度平滑相结合，以改善显著性定位和热图稳定性。对梯度加权卷积层应用主成分分析，同时在分解前向显著性权重加入高斯噪声。为解决中度痴呆（Moderate Dementia）类别中的类别不平衡，使用带梯度惩罚的 Wasserstein 生成对抗网络（Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network with Gradient Penalty, WGAN-GP）生成合成样本，以平衡四阶段训练分布。在 Best Alzheimer MRI Dataset 上训练定制卷积神经网络，达到 97.2% 的测试准确率、97.0% 的平衡准确率和 0.944 的马修斯相关系数（Matthews correlation coefficient, MCC）。ROC 曲线下面积（area under the ROC curve, AUROC）在各类别中范围为 0.96 至 0.99。生成的热图突出显示海马（hippocampus）和内嗅皮层（entorhinal cortex），这些区域与阿尔茨海默病生物标志物相关。这些发现表明，所提出的方法将强大的分类性能与改善的模型可解释性相结合，但仍需进一步的临床验证。

title: CFBrainAug: Modularity-Induced Counterfactual Brain Network Augmentation for Interpretable fMRI-based Autism Diagnosis
zh_title: 反事实脑网络增强用于自闭症诊断
summary: 提出CFBrainAug框架，通过标签反转反事实脑网络增强提升fMRI自闭症诊断可解释性。
key_points: 反事实脑网络生成兼作数据增强
模块数约束下检索并精修候选网络
轻量SVM可比肩图深度模型
reason: 预印本方法创新但仅诊断准确率层面，属增量档
abstract: Machine learning on resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) brain networks is promising for diagnosing Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), but existing methods are prone to overfitting on limited training data, and their post-hoc statistical attribution offers limited clinical interpretability. We propose CFBrainAug, a counterfactual brain network learning framework that unifies data augmentation and counterfactual explanation by learning label-altered brain networks. Unlike conventional label-preserving augmentation, CFBrainAug first retrieves a label-opposite yet topologically similar candidate and then refines it under a module-number constraint. Jointly training on factual and counterfactual networks enriches the training distribution around the decision boundary, enabling a lightweight feature-selection-based SVM to perform competitively with recent graph deep learning methods. Meanwhile, the counterfactuals provide intrinsic explanations by identifying the connectivity differences between each subject and its counterfactual. Experiments on the ABIDE I dataset show that CFBrainAug reaches an accuracy of 74.1% on the NYU site, suggesting that counterfactual augmentation can complement more complex models in small-sample brain network analysis.
zh_abstract: 对静息态功能磁共振成像（resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging, rs-fMRI）脑网络进行机器学习，在诊断自闭症谱系障碍（Autism Spectrum Disorder, ASD）方面具有前景，但现有方法在有限训练数据上容易过拟合，且其事后统计归因的临床可解释性有限。我们提出 CFBrainAug，一种反事实脑网络学习框架，通过学习标签改变后的脑网络，将数据增强与反事实解释统一起来。与传统保持标签不变的增强不同，CFBrainAug 首先检索一个标签相反但拓扑相似的候选网络，然后在模块数约束下对其进行细化。在事实网络和反事实网络上联合训练，可丰富决策边界附近的训练分布，使基于特征选择的轻量级 SVM 能够与近期图深度学习方法竞争。同时，反事实通过识别每个受试者与其反事实之间的连接差异，提供内在解释。在 ABIDE I 数据集上的实验表明，CFBrainAug 在 NYU 站点达到 74.1% 的准确率，提示反事实增强可在小样本脑网络分析中补充更复杂的模型。

title: Augmentation Strategy for DINO in Glaucoma Classification
zh_title: DINO自监督增强策略用于青光眼分类
summary: 预印本分析DINO默认增强在视网膜眼底图上产生不可靠表征，重新设计增强策略以偏向诊断关键特征，并用冻结特征的线性分类器评估青光眼分类。
key_points: 默认自监督增强策略在眼底图上迁移效果不佳
重新设计增强，使裁剪视图冗余最小且保留临床信号
在冻结表征上训练线性分类器评估青光眼分类
reason: 自监督方法改进的预印本，仅内部评估、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a promising approach to medical image representation learning, yet augmentation strategies of SSL frameworks validated on natural images do not reliably transfer to specialized medical imaging domains. We analyze DINO, a knowledge-distillation based SSL framework, and empirically demonstrate that its default augmentation strategy produces unreliable representations for retinal fundus images, degrading downstream glaucoma classification performance. Guided by the principle that effective cropped views should share minimal redundant information while retaining clinically relevant signal, we redesign DINO's augmentation strategy. Our approach biases the learned representations toward diagnostically critical features rather than low-level image statistics. We evaluate our method for glaucoma classification by training a linear classifier on the frozen representations, achieving strong generalization across seven benchmark datasets. URL for code and weights: https://github.com/ashish-256/task_dino
zh_abstract: 自监督学习（SSL）为医学图像表示学习提供了一种有前景的方法，然而在自然图像上验证的SSL框架的增强策略并不能可靠地迁移到专门的医学成像领域。我们分析了DINO——一种基于知识蒸馏的SSL框架，并实证表明其默认增强策略会对视网膜眼底图像产生不可靠的表示，降低下游青光眼分类性能。基于有效裁剪视图应共享最少冗余信息同时保留临床相关信号这一原则，我们重新设计了DINO的增强策略。我们的方法使学习到的表示偏向诊断关键特征，而非低层图像统计特征。我们通过在冻结表示上训练线性分类器来评估我们的青光眼分类方法，在七个基准数据集上实现了强泛化。代码和权重网址：https://github.com/ashish-256/task_dino

title: OPTARI: An open-source software framework for clinical translation of optoacoustic imaging
zh_title: OPTARI：光声成像临床转化的开源软件框架
summary: 预印本发布开源图形化软件OPTARI，支持光声-超声数据处理、重建、分割与时空频谱分析，便于无编程基础者开展临床研究。
key_points: 基于napari与PATATO构建，提供独立可执行程序
支持厂商原始格式与HDF5，兼容IPASC标准
含感兴趣区标注、色团解混与深度学习组织分割
reason: 开源工具类预印本，AI成分有限且未报告临床验证，属增量档
abstract: Combined optoacoustic (OptA) and ultrasound imaging is a promising modality across a wide range of pathologies. Its use in clinical research, however, is limited by a lack of analysis software accessible to users without programming expertise. Existing tools are either script-based engineering frameworks or proprietary vendor applications. We present OPTARI, an open-source graphical software application to facilitate large-scale clinical optoacoustic-ultrasound (OPUS) studies. OPTARI builds on the napari image viewer and the PATATO toolkit for OptA data processing. It supports native vendor and open HDF5 data formats, aligns with the IPASC standard, and is distributed as a standalone executable. Features include region-of-interest annotation, reconstruction, chromophore unmixing, deep-learning-based tissue segmentation, and temporal and spectral analysis modules. OPTARI offers a combination of features for clinical study analysis that none of the compared tools provide. The automated tissue segmentation produced results comparable to expert labeling for muscle tissue, and batch processing reduced analysis time from minutes to under one second per scan. The tool is used in ongoing clinical OPUS studies. OPTARI connects engineering frameworks with medical research and provides an open-source basis for reproducible and standardized analysis in clinical OptA imaging studies.
zh_abstract: 光声（OptA）与超声联合成像是一种在广泛病理领域中很有前景的模态。然而，其在临床研究中的应用受到缺乏可供无编程专业知识用户使用的分析软件的限制。现有工具要么是基于脚本的工程框架，要么是专有供应商应用程序。我们推出OPTARI，一个开源图形软件应用程序，用于促进大规模临床光声-超声（OPUS）研究。OPTARI基于napari图像查看器和用于OptA数据处理的PATATO工具包构建。它支持原生供应商和开放HDF5数据格式，符合IPASC标准，并作为独立可执行文件分发。功能包括感兴趣区域标注、重建、发色团解混、基于深度学习的组织分割以及时间和频谱分析模块。OPTARI提供了用于临床研究分析的功能组合，而所比较的工具均未提供这些功能。自动化组织分割对肌肉组织产生的结果与专家标注相当，批处理将分析时间从数分钟缩短至每次扫描不到一秒。该工具已用于正在进行的临床OPUS研究。OPTARI连接了工程框架与医学研究，并为临床OptA成像研究中可重复和标准化分析提供了开源基础。

title: Automated Nucleus Segmentation in Histology Images: An Attention U-Net Approach with Comprehensive Preprocessing and Inference Pipelines
zh_title: Attention U-Net 用于组织学图像细胞核分割
summary: 预印本在 MoNuSeg 2018 上构建轻量 Attention U-Net，结合染色解卷积、掩膜平滑与重叠分块拼接，全分辨率测试集 IoU 为 0.8745。
key_points: 基于 MoNuSeg 2018 数据集训练轻量 Attention U-Net
预处理含染色解卷积与多轮掩膜平滑
推理采用重叠分块拼接策略，IoU 0.8745
reason: 单数据集、仅报告分割指标、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Objectives: In the area of digital pathology, nucleus segmentation is an essential step for quantitative analysis; however, high nuclear density and staining heterogeneity in histology images pose a great challenge. Methods: This study implements a lightweight Attention U-Net model on the MoNuSeg 2018 dataset to overcome these challenges. The proposed pipeline integrates comprehensive image and mask preprocessing, including stain deconvolution and multi-pass mask smoothing, with a high-fidelity overlapping patch-stitching strategy during inference on high-resolution images. Results: The model achieved an Intersection over Union (IoU) score of 0.8745 on full-resolution, unseen test images. This result demonstrates the effectiveness of attention mechanisms in enhancing feature localization and validates the stitching methodology for generating seamless and accurate segmentation maps. Conclusion: Attention U-Net is an effective and competitive method for automated, scalable nucleus delineation in challenging clinical contexts.
zh_abstract: 【目的】在数字病理学领域，细胞核分割是定量分析的关键步骤；然而，组织学图像中的高细胞核密度和染色异质性构成巨大挑战。【方法】本研究在 MoNuSeg 2018 数据集上实现一个轻量级 Attention U-Net 模型以克服这些挑战。所提出的流程整合了全面的图像和掩膜预处理，包括染色去卷积和多轮掩膜平滑，并在高分辨率图像推理期间采用高保真重叠块拼接策略。【结果】该模型在全分辨率、未见过的测试图像上取得交并比（IoU）分数 0.8745。该结果证明了注意力机制在增强特征定位方面的有效性，并验证了拼接方法可生成无缝且准确的分割图。【结论】Attention U-Net 是在具有挑战性的临床环境中进行自动化、可扩展细胞核描绘的一种有效且有竞争力的方法。

title: Hyperparameter-Free Boundary-Interior t-vMF Dice Loss for Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: 免调参边界-内部 t-vMF Dice 损失
summary: 预印本提出 STB-tvMF Dice 损失，按上一轮平均余弦相似度分别设定边界与内部区域形状参数，免去超参调优，在三个数据集与多种架构上验证。
key_points: 按区域均值相似度自动确定 t-vMF 形状参数
无需基于验证集选择超参数
在三个数据集与多种网络架构上实验
reason: 方法学预印本，仅报告分割效果，无外部验证或临床结局
abstract: Class imbalance and errors near anatomical boundaries remain challenges in medical image segmentation, motivating loss functions that account for these difficulties. Adaptive t-vMF Dice Loss adjusts the similarity function during training but requires hyperparameter tuning. We propose Self-Tuned Boundary-Aware t-vMF Dice Loss (STB-tvMF Dice), which adapts the function separately for boundary and interior regions without tuning shape-adaptation parameters. Each region's shape parameter of t-vMF function is determined from its mean prediction-target cosine similarity in the preceding epoch and remains fixed throughout the current epoch. This rule maximizes the slope of the similarity function at the observed mean similarity, providing a principled basis for adaptation without validation-based parameter selection. Experiments on three datasets and architectures demonstrated its effectiveness. On Synapse with U-Net, STB-tvMF Dice achieved a mean DSC of 70.75%, compared with 63.03% for Adaptive t-vMF Dice Loss. Our code will be available soon.
zh_abstract: 类别不平衡和靠近解剖边界处的错误仍然是医学图像分割中的挑战，促使人们设计考虑这些困难的损失函数。Adaptive t-vMF Dice Loss 在训练期间调整相似度函数，但需要超参数调优。我们提出 Self-Tuned Boundary-Aware t-vMF Dice Loss（STB-tvMF Dice），它分别针对边界区域和内部区域自适应调整该函数，而无需调节形状自适应参数。每个区域的 t-vMF 函数形状参数由前一 epoch 中该区域预测-目标余弦相似度的均值确定，并在整个当前 epoch 中保持固定。该规则使相似度函数在观测到的平均相似度处斜率最大化，为无需基于验证集选择参数的自适应提供了有原则的依据。在三个数据集和架构上的实验证明了其有效性。在 Synapse 数据集上使用 U-Net 时，STB-tvMF Dice 的平均 DSC 达到 70.75%，而 Adaptive t-vMF Dice Loss 为 63.03%。我们的代码即将公开。

title: Artificial intelligence and small-business competitiveness in an emerging economy.
zh_title: 新兴经济体人工智能与小微企业竞争力
summary: 以乌兹别克斯坦布哈拉地区数据预测小企业指标，与医疗健康AI应用无关。

采用ARIMA预测至2030年
非医疗健康场景

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Small and medium enterprises (SMEs) are the driving force of developing economies, yet they remain limited in resources to implement artificial intelligence (AI), and there is little empirical evidence that AI adoption is associated with small business growth in the region, particularly in Central Asia. This research makes two contributions. First, we propose a concise framework that links classes of AI technologies to SME competitiveness features and identifies machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI as low-cost, quick-return priority areas for resource-constrained firms. Second, using 16 years of data (2010-2025) for the Bukhara region of Uzbekistan, we estimate ARIMA models for each indicator and forecast eight small business indicators to 2030. Small business output is projected to grow at a steady rate of approximately 16% by 2030, with digital adoption and preferential credit support emerging as indicators associated with long-run growth. Forecast accuracy is high for the human-capital indicator and acceptable for output. The evidence is associational rather than causal: the framework and the forecasts converge on a single, cautiously formulated proposition-the adoption of low-cost AI is measurably associated with the sustainable competitiveness of SMEs, providing a practical, evidence-based starting point for regional AI policy in developing countries.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 中小企业（SMEs）是发展中经济体的驱动力，但其在实施人工智能（AI）方面的资源仍然有限，而且很少有实证证据表明 AI 采用与该地区的小企业增长相关，尤其是在中亚。本研究作出两项贡献。第一，我们提出一个简洁框架，将各类 AI 技术与中小企业竞争力特征联系起来，并识别出机器学习、自然语言处理（natural language processing）和生成式 AI（generative AI）作为资源受限企业低成本、快速回报的优先领域。第二，我们使用乌兹别克斯坦布哈拉（Bukhara）地区 16 年（2010-2025）的数据，为每个指标估计 ARIMA 模型，并预测八项小企业指标至 2030 年。预计到 2030 年，小型企业产出将以约 16% 的稳定速度增长，数字采用和优惠信贷支持逐渐成为与长期增长相关的指标。预测精度在人力资本指标上较高，在产出上可接受。这些证据是关联性的而非因果性的：该框架和预测汇聚于一个谨慎表述的命题——低成本 AI 的采用与中小企业的可持续竞争力存在可测量的关联，为发展中国家的区域 AI 政策提供了一个实用、基于证据的起点。
